chapters.title: I. Desperation and Rebirth
chapters.content:
Hongzheng twenty-fourth year, winter, seems to be colder than in previous years, has fallen several snowfalls in a row, only to stop slightly on this day.
Thirty miles outside of the capital, a black horse carrying two people galloped by, its hooves raising the snow on the ground, only slowly descending when the two were far away.
"Your Highness, the horse carrying two people can not run far ...... Put the minister down ...... " The voice of the person sitting behind is a little weak, but the tone is warm and moist as usual.
"No, you're hurt so badly, if I throw you in the snow, you'll die in a moment or three!" Jing Shao wiped a handful of ice on his face and clamped down on his horse's belly to continue running. Just coming out of the prison, he realized that the group of people who came to release him were not right, if they were pressuring him to go to Shu, they should at least heal the seriously injured princess, and without saying a word, they rushed them away. If he did not kill a lieutenant robbed the horses, afraid of just out of the capital on the head.
"This body of mine is already failing, sooner or later I will die, you quickly put me down!" The person behind him was a bit anxious, this horse was not a famous horse, carrying two people galloping for so long, it had already begun to pant sharply, if it continued like this, I'm afraid that both of them wouldn't be able to survive.
"No, to die together!" Jing Shao said loudly against the cold wind, this person is his explicitly married princess, was his favored concubine cold for more than ten years, in the end to accompany him to sit in jail, for him to be a knife, but only this he resented for more than ten years of male wife!
Jing Shao is the second son of Empress Yuan, at the age of fourteen on the battlefield to kill the enemy, the young king, war heroes. Chen Dynasty can marry a man's wife, for the sake of peace and quiet of the family house has a concubine son to marry a man's wife of the unwritten rules, but he is the first son, after the Empress even to him on the top of the sibling brother and forced him to marry a man, raw cut off his inheritance of the qualifications of the great lineage. So he grumbled, he disobeyed, never gave his wife a good face, and refused to sincerely help his brother earn that position ......
"Hehe, what virtue or ability do I, Mu Hanzhang, have that is worthy of Your Highness dying with me?" The person behind him laughed coldly.
"It's me who's sorry, if I can survive this time, I'll listen to you in everything." Jing Shao soothed the person behind him, holding the reins with one hand and tightening the knot between the two of them again with the other. Five more miles ahead is the Moonwatch Slope, there is a path over there that he used to take when he hunted, it leads straight to the Sealed Moon Mountain, and it's a good place to hide when you enter the mountain.
"Cough cough cough ......" Mu Hanzhang because just spoke into the wind, poured into the cold wind, can not help but lie on the back of Jing Shao coughing violently, a wisp of blood along the pale corners of the lips slipped down. He in the prison for Jing Shao blocked a knife, injured to the internal organs, bumps a bit on the pain, this moment because of the cold, the wound has no feeling, just since it has vomited blood ...... can not help but smile bitterly, simply lying on the back of Jing Shao.
After so many years of coldness, concubines have dared to flaunt with him, it is impossible not to resent, since he wants to accompany himself to death, then let him go, Mu Hanzhang thought with a broken heart.
He a marquis family commoner son, ten years of study, do not ask his father to pass the title to him, but only for his own examination of a merit to get out of that home earlier, but his father and first mother in the year before his examination to be married to the king of the man as a male wife! He is a man, but was born to break the wings, imprisoned in the inner house of the square inch, can no longer show ambition. After so many years, he didn't know whether to blame his cruel first mother or this irresponsible husband.
"In front!" From behind came a burst of hoofbeats, the clash of iron armor and swords, and a mishmash of cries and shouts, all sounding like urges.
Jing Shao gave his horse a hard whip on the ass and ran desperately towards the Moonwatch Slope.
"Whoosh~" the cracking sound of an iron arrow came from behind, Jing Shao accurately sidestepped and dodged it, and the person behind him was brought to a crooked position.
"Hold me tight!" Jing Shao exclaimed.
Mu Hanzhang wrapped her hands around Jing Shao's waist and pressed her body against his back, matching his movements.
Past the Moonwatch Slope was a forest path, convenient for dodging arrows, Jing Shao skillfully drove his horse through the forest, and the pursuers behind him drifted farther and farther away.
"Does the wound hurt?" Jing Shao pulled the reins violently to help the horse jump over a boulder, and turned around to ask after landing.
"No ...... it hurts ......" The words in reply grew fainter and fainter.
"Hanyang, don't sleep!" Jing Shao frowned and anxiously called out, "After the Feng Yue Mountain is Yan County, there are my old troops there, they will definitely be able to help us avoid the pursuit!" Comfort him at the same time is also encouraging himself, sitting in jail for so long, the clothes on the body and thin, lasted until now is completely by will to hold on.
"Whinny~" The horse underneath him suddenly hissed, launching into a frenzy. Jing Shao kicked the horse's belly, tugging Mu Hanzhang to spin around and jump away. Fixed eyes, I do not know which one here put the animal clip, actually clamped the horse's hooves.
"Just put me here." Mu Hanzhang said with a strong strand of clarity.
"Already reached the waist of Feng Yue Mountain, behind are all downhill roads, I'll carry you!" Jing Shao looked left and right, one side is a cliff, one side is a steep slope overgrown with grass, this mountain road is just this one, it would be troublesome for them to catch up. Without saying a word, he carried him on his back and scurried towards the steep slope of the mountain forest.
"See, get them!"
"Whoever takes King Cheng's head will be rewarded with a thousand taels of silver!"
"Whoosh~whoosh~" chaotic arrows kept coming from the forest, and Jing Shao fled in great distress.
"Well~" a stray arrow hit his right leg, Jing Shao stumbled a bit, and Mu Hanzhang fell off of him.
"Your Highness!" Struggling to get up, Mu Hanzhang stepped forward to support him.
Jing Shao glanced at him and found that the handsome pale face actually had blood color, and his spirit was also much better than just now, he was used to seeing death and naturally knew that this was a return to the light, he could not help but feel a pain in his heart, and violently pulled out the arrow, pulled up the person beside him and ran.
"Hahaha, let's see where you guys are going to run away?" The leading lieutenant came over with a big sword, laughing.
The two panicked and ran on a desperate road, in front of the cliff, behind the pursuers, it is really difficult to escape.
Jing Shao put the person in his arms on the edge of the cliff, turned around and swept a foot across the ground, that lieutenant was not on guard, but was actually kicked to the ground. Do not give him a chance to catch his breath, a kick in the heart, only to beat the man foaming at the mouth, seized the large knife in his hand, raised the knife to cut over the pursuers' horses, across the narrow mountain road, tripped over two horses in a row, the people on the horse followed the fall down the cliff.
"Whoosh ~" the people behind saw the road blocked by the horse corpse, Cheng Wang holding a large sword to kill red eyes, do not dare to easily go forward, have taken out their bows and arrows to shoot.
"Well ......" take the sword block also can not help, Jing Shao yanked out the arrow on the shoulder, backhand threw over, gusts of screams rang out, then jumped over the horse body a chopping, the rest of these few put hidden arrows are also killed, just he himself has been a thousand holes, standing in place Looking out, not far from the second wave of pursuers will soon come. Look at the steel sword in his hand, he can kill ten, but not hundreds of thousands of pursuers.
Carrying the bloodstained dagger back to the cliffside, the blood on the dagger and Jing Shao's blood mixed together, dragging out long blood marks. Carrying the person leaning against the rock into his arms, that person was already breathless, and his handsome face showed gray.
"Junqing, have you ever resented me?" Jing Shao reached out and wiped away the blood at the corner of his mouth, and for the first time in his life, he looked closely at this person, this wife whom he had explicitly married, only to realize that his beauty rivaled all the concubines of the Cheng King's House, and was not the kind of enchanting flirtation of a woman, but was a kind of beauty that was clear and handsome with the arrogance of a man of letters. Now, that pair of beautiful eyes reflected in his face full of stubble, how ironic, in the prison boredom talk, only to realize that this person is a life-long hard to meet confidant, their own more than ten years, just how much beauty missed?
"How can I not complain? If it wasn't for you, I would have been on the gold list and ascended to the temple," Jun Qing was his word, this person had never called him this before, Mu Hanzhang smiled, slowly reaching out to wipe away the blood stains on Jing Shao's face, "But this can't be blamed on you, you're a man of skill, and it was me who caused you to not be able to inherit the great lineage... . cough cough ......"
"Hahaha, capable? What have the ability? I have lived such a confused life, not a day of comfort, now that I think about it, it's actually been so wrong ...... hahahahaha ......" Jing Shao hugged the person in his arms tightly, and laughed up to the sky, thinking about his own life of campaigning for the country, but he ended up Bird end bow hide, spoiled concubine destroy wife, the last to him never leave is this he ignored more than ten years of male wives, jealous brother refused to help him wholeheartedly to seize the throne, after he fell in trouble for him to go around the effort but only this compatriot brother ...... lamentable, pathetic, in the end but is a joke!
"My life ...... may ...... not ...... also be a joke ......" Mu Hanzhang sighed softly. "If there ...... is an afterlife ......" a sentence did not finish, the last breath can no longer raise, beautiful eyes slowly closed, slender hand also fell on the green and black stone, no The last breath will not be taken anymore. The sky does not know when to start drifting snow again, snowflakes fell to his long eyelashes, was Jing Shao呵出来的气融化，变成水珠滚落下来.
"If there is an afterlife, I will treat you well, and use my whole life to make up for you ......" Jing Shao leaned the person in his arms against his chest and said softly, looking up to see the miles and miles of river and mountains in the distance, about to fall into the hands of the step-empress and her violent son ...... Hearing the sound of hoofbeats behind him, he slowly stood up. King Cheng has been invincible in battle all his life, and even if he dies, he will never die in the hands of these curmudgeons.
Leaping down the cliff, the mountain wind whistling past his ears, Jing Shao hugged the soundless person in his arms tightly, "If I don't let go of you, I'll be able to clutch the corner of your coat on the Naihe Bridge ......"
Open your eyes from the darkness, not the smoky spirit platform wonderland, not the green-faced fangs of the life-suppressing ghosts, full of red tents, the shimmering light of the remnants of the candles is bright and uncertain. Jing Shao was a little stunned, only to feel drained and have a splitting headache. Raising his hand to rub the distended corners of his forehead, he slowly sat up, and when his body's senses were restored, he suddenly realized that there was a person lying beside him, his bright red robe was torn, his green silk was scattered on his exposed chest, and his glistening jade-like skin was full of blue and purple scars.
Reaching out, he brushed away the hair covering his face, revealing a handsome face ...... Junqing!

chapters.title: II. Aftermath
chapters.content:
Jing Shao some disbelief touched Mu Hanzhang's face, slightly cool touch makes his heart tremble, feel carefully, but with body temperature, the body temperature of a living person. Through the candlelight to look carefully, is still that beautiful face, in addition to the lower lip was bitten out of the blood scar, this is clearly a not vicissitudes of life, just the weak crown of the young man's face.
What's going on here? Frozen for a long time, Jing Shao ripped open his inner shirt to check, Hongzheng eighteen years, an arrow in the heart nearly killed, now the skin here is intact, the old wounds in other places do not exist, the body's muscle lines smooth but slightly thinner than he remembered.
Turning over his hand in the bed on a hidden compartment a touch a press, a small cabinet door opened, inside lying a blue leather ledger, hastily opened to check, the last entry of the record is: "Received Li Yanqing silver two thousand taels, against five thousand taels of white for salt citation, Hongzheng thirteen years in February nineteen ...... "
Silently putting the account book back to its original place, Jing Shao looked around in a bit of a trance, it was clearly back to his wedding night, the spring of the thirteenth year of Hongzheng.
That year he returned victorious from driving away the Xiong Nu, and was the first of the princes to be crowned king, and no one dared to try his hand.
This year the step-queen persuaded her father to marry the common son of the Marquis of Northern Wei to him, and the marriage took place this very night.
This year, he was nineteen years old, three times unpeaceful, and everything had not yet begun ......
"Hahahaha, the sky does not kill me! Thief God, really treats me well, hahaha ......" Determining that this was not a dream, after the shock, there was the ecstasy of being reborn, Jing Shao couldn't help but laugh out loud.
"Well ......" the sudden moan | groan from the side, interrupting Jing Shao's self-satisfaction, the laughter came to an abrupt end. Busy turning back to look, the sleeping Mu Hanzhang was woken up by him, the long slender eyelashes fluttered, slowly opened a pair of beautiful eyes.
Who said that everything has not yet begun? This Thief God, it would have been better to let him be reborn two hours earlier, Jun Qing wouldn't have been hurt like this. Jing Shao slandered while reaching out to take Mu Hanzhang into his arms. Unexpectedly, just as his hand touched the other person's body, that person violently dodged backwards.
"Well ......," the sudden movement pulled the injury under the body, pain Mu Hanzhang immediately white face.
"Don't move!" Jing Shao pressed down on him, but felt the body under his palm trembling slightly. Could not help but frown, on the wedding night, he was suffocating in his heart, so he drank too much, after so many years he did not remember exactly what he did, he only remembered that on the second day when he paid his respects to the emperor and queen, out of the main hall Mu Huanzhang fainted. Now look at this situation, most likely to be their own strong on people, and hurt not light.
Mu Hanyang really stopped moving, only taking a pair of eyes to look at Jing Shao, those beautiful eyes full of humiliation and fear.
"You ......" Jing Shao opened his mouth, but he did not know what to say, so he turned around and pulled the silk sash in front of the bed, and in a short time, the answering voice of the maid came from outside.
"Prepare hot water, this king wants to bathe." In a loud voice, he ordered the maid to go and prepare the water, and when the maid answered and went, Jing Shao turned back around, still not knowing what to say, and scratched his head in some embarrassment.
"Don't be afraid," Jing Shao thought, but still softly comforted, "that ...... last night I drank too much, I really didn't mean to ...... "
"Your Highness, the hot water is ready, why don't the slave girls go inside and serve Your Highness a bath?" A rather steady maid voice rang out, Jing Shao remembered that this was Zhi Ruoxi, the eldest maid in his house. On the wedding night, hot water was naturally always prepared, the reason why he asked was also because he was afraid that there was something that shouldn't be seen by the underlings.
"No need, all retire." Jing Shao said impatiently.
Mu Han Zhang heard a sigh of relief, let him female ambush in the body of the man has been a strange shame, this woeful appearance if it is then seen by the subordinate ......
"Well ...... what are you doing?" Mu Hanzhang was startled when the man lifted his covers and picked him up.
"Don't move," after the quilt was lifted, the evils caused by himself were visible, not to mention the uncountable bruise marks, between the slender legs were full of red and white intermingled turbid liquid, the private place was even more wretched, Jing Shao's brows were more and more wrinkled, "I'll take you to wash it. "
Bathe him? Mu Hanzhang looked at the man in front of him, a little puzzled, this man claimed that he was going to bathe, this was to help him cover up his embarrassment? But why is he doing this, when he just tortured him, there was not the slightest bit of pity to be seen.
"I'll go by myself," Mu Hanzhang said in a cold voice, and suddenly felt that it was inappropriate, so he only lowered his voice, "How dare I labor on Your Majesty's trouble."
When Jing Shao saw this gambling and stoic look of his, he couldn't help but hook his lips, and felt that it didn't seem sincere enough, so he only pressed down the corners of his mouth and said in a deep voice, "Where do you have the strength? It's always my fault, consider it an apology to you." Although they were husband and wife, this kind of family never had the reason to let the prince serve the princess, but this was really normal in Jing Shao's opinion, everyone was a man, and he had also treated the wounds of the injured generals in the barracks, so he was confident that he still knew what he was doing.
Mu Hanzhang couldn't argue with him, so he had to let him go.
Seeing that the person in his arms no longer struggled, Jing Shao was satisfied and moved behind the screen with him in his arms, not caring that he was still wearing his inner shirt, he lifted his foot and stepped into the bath tub.
Into the water, Mu Hanzhang broke away from his embrace, leaning to the other side of the barrel to go, Jing Shao is not annoyed, Woods took off the soaked inner shirt, bowed a cup of hot water to wash his face, to get rid of the discomfort of the hangover.
The royal residence's bath tub is very large, sitting two men is not crowded, Mu Hanzhang took a side of the cloth towel to carefully clean the traces of his body, secretly observe the man's movements, see him constantly rubbing his temples, it seems that last night was really drunk.
Jing Shao shook his head, let himself wake up a little, the cold wind on the edge of the cliff is still in his ears, soaking in this hot water has a sense of unreality, but the immediate is not the time to lament life, reach out to the shrinking in a corner of the person dragged into his arms, the person's body immediately stiffened up.
"I'll wash ...... myself," Mu Hanzhang was startled, busy catching the hand that was going to probe under him.
"You're inconvenienced yourself," said Jing Shao, rather uprightly; "all men, what are you ashamed of?"
Mu Hanzhang was so choked by his justified tone that he couldn't speak, and just as he was about to retort, he was made to grunt out by the finger that suddenly stabbed into his body.
"Does it hurt?" Jing Shao saw him biting his lower lip again, and busily gathered the man into his arms, letting him lie on top of him, "Don't bite yourself, it'll be over soon, bite me if it hurts." Putting away the teasing mood, quickly and gently tickling inside him for a while, Mu Hanzhang didn't bite him either, just huffing in his own little voice. Once the inside was cleaned up, Jing Shao took a large piece of flannel and wrapped the man in his arms around him, quickly tucking him under the covers and turning around to look for the wound medicine himself.
Sheets have been changed, Mu Hanzhang sat up and put on the inner shirt, saw the man wearing only a thin shirt, hair still dripping water, barefoot standing in front of the cabinet do not know what to pick. Cleaning action is very gentle, view his eyes just now also does not seem to be false, which makes Mu Hanyang a little confused. However, if the king is not too bad for him, the future days will be much better.
"Here, I'll put some medicine on you."
The handsome face that suddenly enlarged in front of his eyes made the Mu Hanzhang who was contemplating froze, to say that this Cheng Wang looks really handsome, the royal people were born good looking, and this one is one of the best ...... Wait, the medicine!
"This ...... I'll just do it myself." A snatched the small bottle in the hands of Jing Shao, Mu Hanyang's face flushed red, just underwater could not see it is just, this moment the house is brightly lit, is not everything can be seen clearly.
"We are already husband and wife, what are you afraid of?" Seeing that pale face tinted with blood, Jing Shao couldn't help but bend the corners of his mouth and climbed onto the bed. Relying on his quickness, he snatched the bottle back again.
Mu Hanzhang couldn't argue with him, so he had to take the quilt and cover his head, out of sight, out of mind.
Jing Shao beautifully opened the slender legs, dug a block of ointment coated: "This medicine is my father before the war reward, stop bleeding and pain relief effect is particularly good."
The cool ointment didn't bring extra pain, soothed that hot wound, Mu Hanyang naturally knows how precious this medicine that won't bring pain is: "Such a precious medicine, how can it be used in this kind of place?" From the quilt to poke his head out, just happened to see Jing Shao full of pity eyes, originally already desperate heart, in this eyes to get some comfort, Mu Hanyang secretly laughed at their own really pathetic, actually for the pity of others and happy.
"It's exactly this kind of place that needs good medicine." Jing Shao applied the medicine and stared at the rounded twin mounds, which looked like they felt good in his hands ...... Forced his eyes to tear themselves away from that wonderful place, and with a face like he didn't see anything, he covered him up and got himself under the covers, sitting down against the bed, picking up the slightly cooled sobering broth on the small table, and gulping down a bowl of it. It wasn't a good start, but it couldn't be made worse.
"How can the king sleep on the outside, sleep inside." Wife sleeps on the outside to facilitate the husband's tea, changing clothes is the rule, was Jing Shao such a mess, the fear has long gone most of the feeling, Mu Huanzhang towards Jing Shao side moved, signaling him to roll over to the inside. Who knows this move, it came to the side of Jing Shao, the man did not have the intention to turn over.
"You're not a woman, why do you care about that?" Jing Shao lowered his head and smiled, took another small bottle, poured some translucent cream on his fingertips, "This is a kind of strange medicine I got in the western region, small wounds can be coated with scabs, the next day will be able to be good for seven or eight points, is some pain, you have to put up with it." Saying that, he wiped one finger on Mu Hanyang's lower lip.
The needle-like pain made Mu Hanzhang knit his brows, wanting to reach out to press, was Jing Shao grabbed: "Don't touch, it won't hurt in a while." The hand in his palm was slender and glistening, the touch was excellent, this was the hand that wrote and drew all year round, very different from his hand that held the sword.
Mu Hanzhang endured the stabbing pain, and when she saw that he was holding her hand and not letting go, she couldn't help but cough lightly.
"Oh, fast sleep." Jing Shao busy let go of people's hands, call the maid to extinguish the lamp, shrink into the quilt, tomorrow to see the emperor and queen must be early morning after the dynasty, can also sleep for two hours.
"Uh-huh." The person in the bed answered and said no more, only quietly reddening her ears where Jing Shao couldn't see.

chapters.title: III. General
chapters.content:
Jing Shao heard the breathing of the person next to him become long, slowly came over, gently fell a kiss on his forehead, thinking of carrying him to his arms, but afraid of waking him, only to give up. Lying on the bed to think about how he was suddenly reborn back to nineteen years old, when he was clearly holding Jun Qing jumped off the cliff, and then his eyes went black ...... thought for half a day and couldn't think of a reason, so he turned to start thinking back to Hongzheng thirteen years what happened.
Hongzheng twelve years winter, he drove the Xiong Nu returned victorious, the dragon's face is very happy, in his upper two brothers have not been divided into the case of exceptionally sealed him as the King of Cheng. For a time, the court was talking about, said the emperor this is intended to be his third son as the crown prince. Unexpectedly just after the year, the stepmother will tell him, ancestor has not been married on the reasoning of the king, so hurry to give him a marriage, that is, the North Marquis of the second son.
Jing Shao and the second prince are the Queen's out, is absolutely orthodox first son, after the Queen but let him marry a male wife to cut off his future, he naturally refused, immediately lifted the table and whisked his sleeve away, and was about to report to his father that the Queen's malicious intentions, the second day of the early morning of the Emperor but the father of the decree, the eighth of March to finish the marriage, do not give him any opportunity to resist.
From then on, King Cheng went from being the hot heir-to-be to an outcast whose father didn't love him and whose mother didn't.
Smiling to himself in the darkness, the "discarded pieces" that had been swallowed suddenly returned to the board as hidden killing moves, and it was hard to tell who would lose and who would win.
The next day, although he could wait until after the court to pay his respects to the emperor and queen, there was still a series of rituals to be done, and he could not sleep for long.
"Your Highness, Your Highness, it's time to get up." Zhi Ruoxi knocked on the door of the inner room.
"Wait outside the door," the shallow-sleeping Mu Hanzhang immediately awoke with a start, commanded outward, and gently nudged Jing Shao, "Your Highness, wake up."
"Hmm?" Jing Shao opened his eyes in a daze and saw a familiar face, the handsome face he would see every day when he woke up in the prison, "What's wrong?"
"It s time to get up, the minister ...... has to go down and put on the shirts first." Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, last night this person forced him to put medicine on him, and preferred to sleep on the outside, so that he had been unable to go down to get his shirts.
"...... "Jing Shao froze for a moment before reacting to the fact that this wasn't a dungeon, it was his bridal chamber, "Oh, it's my oversight." Reacting to the fact that his new wife was asking for pants from himself, Jing Shao immediately sat up and reached for the new shirts on the hanger to curtly hand them over.
Mu Hanzhang took the pants, but found that the man was still looking straight at himself, so he had to put them on under the covers.
Did not ask for praise and was treated as a traitor, because of the years of war and do not know what the "praise" expression, Jing Shao, can only embarrassingly touch his nose.
"Congratulations Your Highness, Your Highness, slave servant Duo Fu pays his respects to Your Highness." The one who entered the room first was a round-faced fat eunuch Duo Fu, also the chief eunuch of this Cheng Wang Fu, smilingly kneeling down to salute Mu Huan Zhang. Mu Hanzhang accepted this salute and rewarded him with the purse he had prepared earlier, "Eunuch Duofu, please rise." Duofu was an old eunuch who had taken care of Jing Shao since he was a child, and Mu Hanyang couldn't be too big.
Duo Fu received it with a smile, then Zhi Ruoxi, the eldest maid in the house, and Mengxi and Miao Ruoxi, the two who served Jing Shao personally. Mu Hanzhang was not courteous this time, and accepted the full gift one by one, rewarding the gold naked.
Jing Shao watched and secretly nodded his head, thinking that Jun Qing grew up in the family of a public official, even though he was a commoner son, the means of dealing with subordinates was not bad at all, so he did not intend to say anything more.
Mu Huan Zhang's two dowry maids also came to Jing Shao salute, Lan Xuan mouth stupid, only dryly said "see the king" and no further, Lan Ting timid, low head stuttering to say a toast, body are a little trembling.
Mengxi looked at the two maids and quietly nudged toward Miaoxi, thinking that they really were commoners, and even the maids were so unseasoned. She went to look at Zhi Ruoxi again, but was glared at by Zhi Ruoxi, who then lowered her head and stopped doing anything.
Mu Hanzhang just lightly glanced at his two maids, his calm eyes could not see any joy or anger. Before he got married, Mrs. Bei Wei Marquis said that the maids around him were old, and that following him around would cause suspicion, so she only allowed him to bring two small maids.
Jing Shao secretly frowned, these two maids looked nothing like the people who always follow Mu Hanzhang around, it seems that we have to find him two good manpower is: "Duo Fu, turn back to find a boy for the Wangfei and then with two guards to."
"It's the slave servant's negligence, I'll go do it today." Duo Fu was busy confessing, the crown princess is a man, can be matched with a boy and guards, just most husband's family will ignore this matter, the king is so accountable, it can be seen is really on the crown princess.
Hearing this, Mu Hanzhang's calm expression slightly loosened as he rose and saluted, "Thank you, Your Highness." The allocation of a boy and guards meant that he was allowed to go out on a regular basis, which was really a blessing in disguise for him nowadays.
Jing Shao saw the surprise in his eyes, only to feel the soreness in his heart, busy reaching out to help him: "This is what should be done, thank you for what?"
On the second day of the wedding to pay respect to the emperor and queen, the prince and consort should wear court dress. Jing Shao has now been crowned king, the grade of the court dress is naturally one grade higher. Officials above the third grade in the Chen Dynasty had a purple court dress; the prince's court dress was dark yellow, the crown prince wore apricot yellow, and the prince wore a moon white color. Mu Hanzhang is now the Prince Consort who sued the temple, the first grade lady title, but he is a man, can't wear women's enjoined clothes, so his court dress is also purple, the style is similar to the royal son clothes.
Mu Hanzhang was twenty years old this year and had already performed his crown ceremony, so Lan Ting buckled him into the purple and gold crown that matched his court dress; and although Jing Shao was less than twenty, he was crowned king, so he could take the five-clawed silver dragon crown. The purple and gold crown was different from ordinary crowns, and Lan Xuan, who had never seen this kind of crown before, couldn't buckle it, sweating anxiously, and unwilling to ask Zhi Ruoxi and the others for help, for fear of appearing as if they hadn't seen the world and disgracing the young master.
Jing Shao glanced at the little girl, stepped forward and signaled to give him the tiara, skillfully opened the purple gold buckle: "On the day of the wedding, when by my husband to give you a crown." In the former dynasty, there is a wedding morning husband to the bride of the tradition of yellow flowers, to comfort the wife because of the aunt and uncle to visit the heart of the disturbed, but nowadays it is not fashionable to stick flowers, Jing Shao this is completely their own nonsense reason.
"Your Highness?" Mu Hanzhang, who had been sitting, only stood up, "How does this make it possible?"
Jing Shao didn't reply, but just carefully clasped his hair in a bun, and smoothly smoothed the two strands of gold ribbon that hung down between the soft green silk.
Two equally handsome and extraordinary people standing together, one elegant, one cold, how to see how to match, Miaoxi who tied Jing Shao's jade belt couldn't help but praise, "Your Highness and Your Highness standing together, really is a golden boy and a jade child, couldn't be better matched."
This morning's situation she had long since understood, the king not only did not hate the princess, but also liked it very much, always clever Miaoxi naturally will not let go of the opportunity to curry favor with the king.
"Really?" Jing Shao sniffed and wrapped Mu Han Zhang's waist and dragged him to the dressing mirror, the person beside him was slender, but he was still half a head short of himself, which made Jing Shao quite self-satisfied, "Well, it's indeed a good match."
Mu Hanyang Zhang looked at the image in the mirror out of focus, found that the wound on the lower lip has really been good for seven or eight points, the blood scabs have fallen, only a pink trace remains, not to look closely to see. Until he heard the maidens laughing and joking, only then reacted, busy pulling down on his waist: "Quickly go, it's late." Said also did not wait for him, walked straight out.
"Your Highness is not to blame, Your Highness is shy." Realizing his young master's rudeness, Lan Ting was busy explaining to Jing Shao in a low voice.
"Hmph, when this king can't see it?" Jing Shao followed with little expression, looking at the tips of Jun Qing's slightly reddened ears with joy in his heart.
"Sister Zhi Ruoxi, is the king angry?" Lan Xuan shrank his neck at the cold snort and busily asked Zhi Ruoxi, who was beside him.
Zhixi took a handkerchief to cover her lips and said, "That's how the king is, the majesty brought out by years of fighting, you'll know that later."
To go to the palace is a red curtain Huagai eight sedan chair, two people sitting in the same sedan chair, Mu Hanzhang some discomfort to move, waist and femur pain is really hard to endure.
"Hard on your back? You lean against me and I'll rub it for you." Jing Shao naturally discovered this action, reached out and gathered him into his arms, not waiting for someone's consent before placing his large hands on his waist and rubbing it. Feeling the body in his arms stiffen for a moment and then slowly relax, he couldn't help but hook his lips, "Later if the Empress says anything, you listen to it, no matter what you are rewarded with despite the fact that you can take it."
He remembered that the Queen rewarded the very expensive things, which also let him mistakenly think that Mu Hanzhang is very much in the Queen's mind, naturally more and more do not treat him, and now think of their own time is really childish, the Queen's reward is not the reason not to take, and no matter who this person is, as long as it is a man, will certainly be in the Queen's mind.
Mu Hanzhang looked up at him and nodded, "I understand." He had heard about the royal affairs, and it was only normal for Jing Shao, as Empress Yuan's son, to be at odds with the step-empress. However, was this person saying this to comfort him? Thinking about this, there was some slight sweetness in his heart, other than that bad night, this person's behavior after he sobered up was really gentle.
"Don't call it 'minister' in private, how rusty it sounds." Jing Shao pinched while thinking that this tight waist feels so good, not like a woman who pinches it to break, but like a leopard's waist, with smooth lines and full of tension.
Waist kneading the force is just right, although I know it's not right, but it is not good to move away, mu hanzhang had to pretend not to know to talk to him: "rites can not be abolished, and the king privately talk to be more careful, or to call the 'mother of the queen' is good, if it is to the heart of the people to listen to it, it is enough to be a copy of the reference. "
"Jun Qing, is this caring about me?" Hearing this, Jing Shao couldn't help but hook her lips and ask him with a lowered head.
Mu Hanzhang glared at him, "I am merely admonishing." In the past, I had only heard people say that King Cheng was irritable and easy to anger, but I had never imagined that he was still this frivolous.
"Haha ......" Jing Shao only felt cute when she saw him in this appearance and couldn't help but laugh.
The little eunuch who followed outside the sedan chair couldn't help but pinch himself when he heard the laughter, gosh, the whole capital knows that King Cheng can't inherit the throne if he marries a male consort, but the king is still able to laugh so happily, he won't be mad at the queen, right?
Mu Hanyang saw that he was still laughing, so she turned her head to ignore him, who would have thought that a twist of her head would have bumped into Jing Shao's sturdy and warm chest, and she couldn't help but blush, so that it would be as if she had thrown herself on the mercy of her husband, and she was busy struggling to get up.
"Okay, okay, I won't laugh," Jing Shao busily pressed to keep him from getting up, whispering, "Don't move, or the bearers will find out."
"You ......" Mu Hanzhang really didn't dare to move, but just glared at him with a huff.
The author has something to say: yuan queen: the emperor's original queen, after the death of the other married queen called after the title: only the eunuchs of the Qing dynasty called themselves "lackey", before they are called "slave", the status of the small eunuchs called "small people! ""Little one"".

chapters.title: 4: Entering the Palace
chapters.content:
The beautiful black eyes were tinted with the color of emotion, much more animated than the dead look before, Jing Shao just looked at him with smiling eyes, wanting to tell him that he didn't have to be so fearful, but on second thought, his own previous life was because he refused to listen to him, arrogant and arrogant, and no one else, only to end up with the miserable fate of the wall falling down and people pushing him out, and he couldn't help converging on his smile.
"Your Highness, the noon gate has arrived." Little eunuch Chunxi said outside the sedan chair, then the sedan chair also stopped. Usually, the sedan chair can walk to the palace, but today, to pay a visit to the empress in the empress's palace, the two had to get off the sedan chair at the noon gate and change to the palace's carriage. The two of them will not say anything more as there are palace people on all sides of the carriage.
Hongzheng Emperor went to the Empress's Luan Yi Palace after the court, sitting in the main hall with Empress Wu waiting for the newcomers to pay their respects. Forty-something Hongzheng emperor is in his prime, has a qualified emperor's calm and wisdom, sitting there own a not angry from the compelling momentum.
Looking at his father, who was a dozen years younger, Jing Shao's hand hidden in his moon white sleeve clenched into a fist, then slowly loosened it again, and together with Mu Hanzhang, he respectfully bowed to the Empress and Empress.
Hongzheng Emperor first praised Jing Shao, and then taught a few sentences: "You are now an adult, the future of talking and doing things should be more thoughtful, do not let me hear again set off your mother's tea table such a thing."
"My son understands, thank you father for your teachings." Jing Shao only faintly answered, but his face was unconvinced.
"On this happy day, Your Majesty should not blame him any more," the Empress naturally took everything in her stride, and busily smiled and relieved herself, "Today is the day to see your daughter-in-law."
Next to a palace maid to the emperor and queen in front of the soft cushion, Mu Huanzhang went up to kneel down, kowtowed to Emperor Hongzheng, and then tea raised above his head: "Father, please use the tea." All etiquette movements are very standard, hands and feet full of the elegance of the master.
Emperor Hongzheng received the tea and took a sip, smiling, "The second son of the Mu Jin family, I didn't expect to be such a graceful character." Saying this, he rewarded him with a pair of sheep's fat jade ruyi.
"Thank you Father." Mu Hanzhang thanked the emperor without being humble and resumed kneeling in front of the empress to serve tea.
The Empress smiled and took it, and didn't rush to let him get up, but just turned her head to chat with the Emperor: "Your Majesty's holy wisdom, this Mu family's second son but at seventeen years old he won the Lifu Ren, and it is said that all those noble teenagers in the capital honored him with the name of 'Duke Wen Yuan' it."
"Really?" Hongzheng emperor this time is interested in, seventeen years old in the examination is a rare intelligent young man, usually can see only the Beiwei marquis family son, did not think that he has never seen this commoner son is a deep hidden pearl, can not help but feel some pity, such a character if he can take part in the examination, is certainly a talent, but also the jurisdiction of Beiwei marquis of a good tool, it is really a pity.
"But it's just the joking words of a few childhood playmates, it can't be true." Mu Hanzhang knelt for a long time, his body became more and more uncomfortable, and his face began to become pale, but his body still knelt straight, and interjected a sentence at the right time to remind those two that he was still kneeling.
"Yo, how does this child look so bad?" Empress said glanced at the side of the Jing Shao, see he does not seem to have a reaction, also do not want to help Mu Huan Zhang meaning, slightly convergence of the eyes of the essence of the convergence of the aura, smiled and handed Mu Huan Zhang an open brocade box, the box of colorful jewels who can see the value of the city.
Mu Hanzhang looked at such a heavy gift, remembered Jing Shao in the sedan chair words, then did not hesitate to accept it, stand up feel a little black in front of my eyes, body slightly shook a little before standing steady, side of the palace maid busy to come forward to assist.
"Your bodies are not feeling well, so you guys should go back early." Emperor Hongzheng waved his hand to signal that they could leave.
Mu Hanzhang refused the palace maid's continued assistance, Jing Shao did not care about him, saluted and walked out, God knows how much he wanted to hold Jun Qing in his arms right now to prevent him from taking a step, but still in the palace, he could only coldly pretend to be impatient.
Out of the palace gate, Mu Hanzhang stepped down from the carriage, looked at the cold back of the front striding toward the front, and smiled mockingly, what exactly was he expecting? What did he expect? Was that short-lived tenderness an illusion?
Trying to follow up, without taking two steps, suddenly his eyes went black and he fell forward, there was no unexpected pain, his body fell into a warm embrace, "Jun Qing, what's wrong with you?" When he opened his eyes again, what he saw was Jing Shao's anxious face.
Jing Shao saw that he fainted, his eyes and hands were quick to carry the person into his arms, and quickly walked into the sedan chair, "Chunxi, you go to the Imperial Hospital to ask Dr. Jiang Huan Jiang to make a trip to the King's Mansion, and get up the sedan chair to return to the King's Mansion right away."
"Yes!" The bearers answered and raised the sedan chair, while Chunxi ran all the way towards the Imperial Hospital.
"Junqing, Junqing? Where is it hard. Hmm?" Jing Shao leaned the person in his arms against his chest and touched his forehead, "Why did you start a fever?"
Mu Hanzhang only silent, this person cold and hot and let a person uncertain, today the emperor's regretful eyes and let him heartache. The body is difficult, the heart and sad, only feel disheartened, consciousness more and more drowsy.
"Viewing Shao'er's appearance, it seems that she is not quite satisfied with this marriage arranged by my concubine." After the two left, the Empress said with a difficult face.
"He is still young, since he can't understand the empress's bitterness, but this child is genuine." Hongzheng emperor is very satisfied, just now jingshao's reflection he saw clearly, disobedience, dislike are shown truly, if the loss of inheritance is still a look of gratitude, then the city is too deep.
Returning to the royal residence, Jing Shao hugged the person in his arms and ran towards the house, "Bring a cold handkerchief."
Covering Mu Hanzhang with the quilt, he took the handkerchief Zhi Ruoxi handed over to compress his forehead.
"Junqing, is it hard?" Jing Shao looked at him with heartache, in his last life Mu Hanzhang's body was getting worse and worse, in those last few years he even ate medicine like a meal, this time he must be taken care of carefully and nurse him back to health.
"I'm fine, don't I still have to go to the Second Prince's residence? Don't delay." After saying that, he struggled to get up, but was held down by Jing Shao.
"I've already sent someone to say on my brother's side, he won't blame." Although he felt that he should make a trip to his brother's side, etiquette was one aspect, and more importantly lest he misunderstand, Jing Shao felt that all of these were not as important as Jun Qing's body, and that his brother's side would be fine to go back and explain.
"Your Highness, the Imperial Doctor is here." Zhi Ruoxi came in to inform.
Crown Physician Jiang was not the highest status in the Imperial Hospital, although his medical skills were also good, but how could he not have imagined that King Cheng would name him to come to his residence to see a doctor, obviously there was nothing to cross paths before.
"This ......" Crown Physician Jiang took the pulse and looked at Mu Hanzhang's face, and looked at Jing Shao with some difficulty.
Jing Shao willed the subordinates to retreat, "There's no harm in the Imperial Doctor speaking."
"View Wangfei's pulse, must be the body has a wound and the heart is depressed caused by," Jiang Tai doctor and looked at Jing Shao a glance, this fever is not a big disease, today King Cheng looking for him to certainly have a deep meaning, and then said, "Forgive me for my frankness, although the Wangfei is a man, but in the house on the men in fact more vulnerable to injuries than women, the Prince or pity some good. The king is still pity some of the good."
One sentence made Mu Hanzhang's face turn red, and Jing Shao also touched his nose in embarrassment, "It's this king who's being wilful."
"Your Highness forgive me." Imperial Doctor Jiang was also a little apprehensive, not knowing if his words were to the liking of the king.
"Haha, this king likes a straight-forward person like Eunuch Jiang." After receiving the prescription handed over by Eunuch Jiang and explaining that Mengxi had gone to decoct the medicine, Jing Shao took a string of coral beads out of his sleeve.
"Your Highness, this cannot be allowed." Imperial Doctor Jiang immediately broke out in a cold sweat, he had always been a man of the middle ground and did not want to get involved in the strife of these princes and royal grandsons.
"This is not for you," Jing Shao saw him not to take, impatiently said, "I heard that your son is strong in martial arts, this year has been successful in the martial arts, this is a congratulatory gift to your son." Red coral beads can avoid blood light, is indeed to send people who practice martial arts, Jiang Tai doctor is not good to excuse himself again, besides this prince means to fancy his son, so also can rest assured.
"In that case, the old minister will thank the king for the reward on behalf of the little dog, and have him come to the door to thank him on another day." Hearing this, Imperial Doctor Jiang put away the coral beads and bowed to take his leave.
Jing Shao asked Duofu to send the eunuch away, so he sat back down on the edge of the bed and changed the hanky on Mu Hanzhang's forehead.
"These things let the maiden do is, the king go to rest." Mu Hanzhang said faintly, this person a moment of tenderness may just feel fresh and fun, in fact, not really good for him, a person is not sincere look at the details can be seen, today in the palace that kind of behavior, so that he has just warmed up the heart are frozen into ice.
"Jun Qing?" Jing Shao saw that the morning has been loosened up the person again returned to cold, expected to be the things in the palace to make him sad, he is always impatient to talk a lot, Jun Qing's nature is more something to hold in the heart, it seems that in the future you have to talk more to be able to do, difficult to scratch his head, sighed and said, "Today in the palace, so that you have been aggrieved."
Mu Hanzhang opened his eyes to look at him, this person actually knew?
"It's just kneeling for a while longer, I'm not a woman, I won't be aggravated by my mother-in-law's dismay, Your Highness is overly concerned." The gentle voice was very pleasant to the ear, and the words he said did not carry half a bit of resentment, but Jing Shao just felt that he was angry.
"The people in the capital are laughing at me, saying that I have made great achievements but not to inherit the throne, as a first son is not as good as the palace girl out of the status of the eldest son of the high ......" Jing Shao self-deprecatingly said these words, this breath, he held in his heart for more than ten years, and now say it out, it is really from the heart. The
Mu Hanzhang hidden under the covers of the hand gradually clenched tight, the heart also listened to the more cold, it is true that he was not drunk last night, everything is just simply torture him: "These ministers are aware of, I do not ask for the king of other, but only ask for the king's success when you can reward the minister with a paper of repudiation."

chapters.title: V. Fever
chapters.content:
The letter of repudiation? Jing Shao froze, then laughed coldly: "You are a man, the repudiation does not affect your reputation, but as usual, the next husband can not take the examination, even if I let you go, you have no chance with the examination in this life."
"Then what are you going to do?" Mu Hanzhang sat up and looked at him coldly, if this man wanted to stay to torture him, he wouldn't stand to be beaten.
"I can't inherit the great lineage, and you can't take the meeting examination, so we're even." Jing Shao said in his slightly magnetic voice with a straight face.
"...... Ah?" Mu Hanzhang froze for half a day, cracks appearing on his originally cold and handsome face, his mouth half-open in a rather silly manner, feeling as if he had been lifted high into the air by the neck and then thrown onto a soft cushion ......
Jing Shao saw the man's dumbfounded appearance and found it amusing, and was about to reach out and poke him when Mengxi's voice came from outside: "Your Highness, the medicine for the crown princess has been decocted."
Jing Shao frowned and asked Mengxi to bring in the medicine, Mu Hanzhang collected his expression and bowed his head, Mengxi stole a glance at his face and smiled as she walked over to the bedside.
"Your Highness, let the slave girl serve the princess into the medicine, right?" Mengxi carried the medicine and looked with difficulty at Jing Shao, who was relying on the bedside to stay still.
Jing Shao took the bowl of medicine and waved his hand for Mengxi to go out, turning his head to the outside to, "Duo Fu!"
"In." Dolphin grinned and showed a head in the doorway.
"Guard outside the door." Jing Shao saw his appearance and couldn't help but laugh a little, this Duo Fu was still acting like a child at his age.
"Yes." Duo Fu naturally understood the meaning of his own prince, rushed the maids to do their work, and told the guards to stand at the four corners of the house, and guarded the door himself, making sure that no one could hear the words of the people in the house, before leaning on the pillar and sunbathing with a smile on his face.
"You just won't listen to me finish my sentence," Jing Shao took the medicine in his hand and stirred it with a spoon, "Those words are all said by outsiders, I know myself how many pounds I have, and even if I marry the Queen Mother, I won't be able to sit in that position."
"Your Highness why do you say this?" Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, listening to Jing Shao this tone is to talk with him openly, demeanor and expression does not seem to be hypocritical, guessing that is really their own will be wrong?
Jing Shao handed the medicine bowl to him, "I entered the military camp at the age of fourteen, and have been on the battlefield for so many years, I'm good at fighting, but I don't know anything about governing. Look at me, it's so hard to gather a doctor, how can I compete for the throne?"
Mu Hanzhang took the bowl of medicine, so he bribed the Imperial Doctor in front of himself just to "give an example"?
"Although I understand it myself, who would believe this when I say it? Take today for example, if I defend you in the palace, Father Emperor is bound to think that I'm deep-minded and facile, and it will be even worse in the future." Jing Shao said and couldn't help but sigh, but if he keeps acting defiant like this, fighting to be first in everything, Father Emperor will still not be able to tolerate him in the end!
Mu Hanyang swallowed the black medicinal juice in one gulp, only to feel the bitterness from the root of his tongue to his heart, so even if he is a prince or a grandson, it is not easy for him to lead such a difficult life. Just put down the medicine bowl, a candied fruit was stuffed into his mouth, Mu Hanzhang looked up, only to see that person smilingly wiped the medicine juice on the corner of his mouth. Jing Shao already born handsome extraordinary, usually do not like to smile, this smile up is extraordinarily good-looking.
It was heard that King Cheng was irritable and easy to anger and did not smile, but since last night, this man had already smiled at him many times, Mu Hanzhang sighed softly, perhaps he should try to trust him, after all, there was really nothing left to scheme on himself.
"It's not impossible for Your Highness to want to pull in Imperial Doctor Jiang." Eating the candied fruit in his mouth, Mu Hanzhang spoke.
"Oh?" Jing Shao looked at him with considerable interest.
Mu Hanzhang body fatigue, then leaned on the bedside of the big welcome pillow: "Just his son into the king's banner, luring him to make a big or small mistake, waiting for the old man to come to the door to beg is."
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao looked at him with surprise, the relationship in the Imperial Hospital he is not clear, looking for Jiang Huan because he is famous for his oil and salt, and the mouth is particularly strict, today to give him the benefit is also thinking of letting him give Junqing toned body in the future, if he can pull this kind of person If you can bring this kind of person together, it is really an unexpected pleasure.
He lunged over to the person's chest, "You're really a military advisor! In this way, I can even save money on inviting gatekeepers!" Mu Hanzhang's willingness to bare her heart to him showed that she had accepted him!
"Cough, Your Highness!" Being smashed on by the large man who fell from the sky, Mu Hanzhang was a little out of breath for a moment.
"Hehehe, don't sit there, quickly lie back down, sweating fever can only go down." Jing Shao sniffed, immediately scurried up, stuffed the person into the quilt, also vigorously tucked in the quilt, he himself also lay to the side to bring the person with the quilt into his arms.
Mu Hanyang was made to stare, and when he reacted to have been wrapped into a chrysalis, plus an octopus fixed in the periphery, he couldn't help but laugh and cry, this guy is really an anxious temper.
With his face smothered in Jing Shao's chest, Mu Hanzhang moved helplessly, pulling away slightly.
"Junqing, I'll tell you everything from now on, and you'll tell me whatever you have in mind, so we won't fight." Jing Shao raised his hand to detach the hairband of the person in his arms and rubbed his chin against the top of his head.
"Uh-huh." Mu Hanyang Zhang responded vaguely, covered in warmth, his spirit relaxed again and he was a little drowsy.
"Junqing, on the day of the cave-in I was indeed not happy in my heart, I drank too much wine, and I had thought that since everyone didn't believe in me, I would simply make things bad for no one," Jing Shao narrowed his eyes, this was indeed what he had thought about after he woke up, and now that he knew what had happened over the years, it wasn't impossible to take over that position, "But I changed my mind when I woke up and saw you."
Mu Hanzhang didn't answer, but perked up his ears to listen carefully.
Jing Shao saw that the person in his arms did not make a sound, thought that he fell asleep, gently touched his long hair: "I think that it is quite good to live a lifetime with someone as wonderful as you, and it doesn't matter whether other people believe me or not. I will definitely protect you well in the future, not letting you suffer a little bit of aggravation ......" He was still unclear about what feelings he held for the person in his arms, but he knew that this was the only person who was willing to accompany him to die. In this reborn world, all he saw was full of suspicion and killing at every step, only this person was his only salvation. He would hold him tightly and never let go again.
The low voice seemed like a soft whisper, Jing Shao said this to himself, but he didn't know that the person who was tightly circled in his arms quietly hooked his lips.
When Mu Hanzhang sweating fever has passed the noon, Jing Shao morning sent Duo Fu personally run a second prince residence, and elder brother honestly apologize, said may be later to go over. Although the royal family is populous, but the status of special, the second day of the wedding does not need to worship many people. Jing Shao here, anyway, his interpersonal relations have never been good, so just worship brother's family, now after lunch can not go, then changed into civilian clothes and daughter-in-law beautiful lunch.
Who knows just removed the dishes, Duo Fu will come to report that the second prince and prince consort came, Jing Shao heard this, immediately put down the tea to run outside.
"Your Highness!" Mu Hanzhang pulled him back with one hand, "Change your clothes before going out."
"Oh!" Jing Shao slapped his head, forgetting that his sister-in-law was also there, wearing this body out would be rude, and busily changed his clothes. After waking up did not see yet do not feel, now so soon to see his brother, only to feel a lot of words to say to him, this time again can not be confused.
"Your Highness, I will not go." Mu Hanzhang drew back the hand that Jing Shao had pulled.
"What's wrong?" Paying a visit to his elder brother is also to salute and offer tea, and also get a gift for meeting him, Jing Shao stopped to look at him.
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, "The prince does not go to the second prince's residence because the minister is sick, although it is a brother of his own family, but for this small matter to produce misunderstanding or not worth it."
"Hmm?" Jing Shao froze with his head full of questions for a long time before he realized that Jun Qing was afraid that his brother would see that he was fine and think that he was deliberately not going to the Second Prince's Mansion, hurting his brother's peace. He could not help but smile helplessly and wrapped Mu Hanyang's waist and laughed, "Junqing will speak directly when he has something to say in the future, this brain of mine is not working well."
Mu Hanzhang glanced at him and said in a low voice, "I've taken note of it, Your Highness go quickly." He knew that Jing Shao's feelings towards this elder brother of the same mother were not ordinary, if he said this directly there was a suspicion of provoking their brotherly relationship, now he was an outsider who had just passed through the door, it was better to be careful with what he said.
"Is Jun Qing making a note to speak directly, or is he making a note that I'm not in my right mind?" Jing Shao couldn't help but tease when he saw how quickly he picked up the conversation.
"All written down." Mu Hanzhang's expression remained faint.
Jing Shao see him this kind of calm appearance, inexplicably feel very good-looking, look around no one noticed, steal a kiss on the cheek, quickly flash out the door.
Mu Hanzhang looked at Jing Shao's back and slowly touched the kissed cheek, the corner of his lips couldn't help but curve upwards.
Since the second prince came suddenly, Jing Shao was too late to go out to greet him, so Duo Fu directly invited him to the tea hall of Listening Wind Pavilion. Listening Wind Pavilion is Jing Shao usually guests, reading, play place, already belongs to the inner courtyard, usually only receive close guests. Wang Fu's layout of the front courtyard for the outer courtyard, after the garden is Listening to the wind Pavilion, the Pavilion is divided into the East Court and West Court, East Court is Jing Shao's residence, the West Court live in the female relatives.
The tea hall is arranged quite elegant, exquisite tables and chairs flower table is the style of Jiangnan, four sides in addition to the columns, all carved door panels, a small warm in winter around, summer removed will become a four-sided ventilation of the small thank you. Flower racks with seasonal flowers, beams and pillars entangled in a few slender vines, this time of year has been spitting buds, tender green with yellow, full of vitality.
Tea hall sitting at the top of the man in a dark yellow Prince of the regular clothes, slender, handsome, just so casually sit, have some of the dignified not angry from the authority. Features and Jing Shao has seven points similar, just less than Jing Shao three points of killing, more calm, this person is Jing Shao's brother of the same mother, Yuan's eldest son Jing Chen.

chapters.title: 6: Concubines in the House
chapters.content:
"Brother!" The closer he got to the tea hall, the more excited Jing Shao's mood became, and his footsteps couldn't help but quicken, calling out before he even entered the house.
Jing Chen put down the tea in his hands, frowned slightly, looking at Jing Shao who trotted in, he couldn't help but open his mouth to admonish: "Already a married person, still this kind of fidgety, what a behavior!"
Jing Shao reflexively stopped, and then shook his head and laughed bitterly, since childhood was used to being reprimanded by his brother, as soon as he heard his training, he wanted to run away, but now listen to this "what a behavior" but feel intimate and incomparable, and only hope that he will be able to reprimand himself in this way for a long time. He walked in with a big grin, saw his brother frowning and glaring at him, couldn't help but grin, went up to his brother and sister-in-law to salute.
"Uncle," the sister-in-law Xiao who was sitting on the side got up and returned the salute, saw Jing Chen still cold face and didn't say anything, then smiled and said, "Originally I shouldn't have come, I heard that Dixu's body is not feeling well, and he didn't see to go to the mansion after noon, your brother is not assured, so he brought me here." In the usual family, the morning is to pay respects to parents, brother and sister-in-law, after noon is to recognize relatives, so they come over at this moment although some self-degradation, but it is also reasonable.
Jing Shao naturally also understood the reasoning behind it, hearing his sister-in-law say so, he looked up to see his elder brother who still had a slight frown on his brow, and immediately felt warmth in his heart, his own self in his last life was really blind, thinking that his brother was usually cross-eyed at him because he was looking at him in a bad light, but he didn't pay attention to how much this person had done for him in a place that he didn't know about.
"Brother ......," Jing Shao rubbed up against his elder brother, opened his mouth, and only one word popped out.
Jing Chen froze, surprised to look up at him, since his father's decree to marry the North Marquis of Wei's second son, the brother he loved and protected since childhood refused to call him "brother", meet only called a "second brother", so that he was heartbroken. This day does not expect him to go to see himself, but unexpectedly into the king's housekeeper personally to confess, so that his heart rose some hope, after lunch to see him still do not come, they can not sit down to run over, I did not expect to really have this kind of surprise.
Xiao observed that the two brothers seemed to have something to say and smiled as she got up and said, "I'll go check on Wangfei."
"Sister in law ...... Junqing hasn't gotten up yet, you and brother stay here for a bit, I'll go call him out." Jing Shao was busy stopping Xiao.
"Yo, look at me, all confused!" Xiao was stunned, then chagrined, she clenched the handkerchief in her hand and made a big red face. Princess Cheng was a man, and although she was a sister-in-law, she had no reason to visit his bedside, but rather his elder brother could go to the inner room to see Dixu.
Jing Chen glanced thoughtfully at his wife and rose to say to Jing Shao, "Since Dixu is sick, don't toss him around, I'll go with you to take a look."
Duo Fu on the side heard, busy quietly told the little girl to run faster to inform the princess.
When Jing Shao brought his brother to the East Court bedroom, he saw Mu Hanzhang leaning on the soft couch in the outer room wearing a tunic, covered with a thin blanket. The outer shirt is loose and soft texture, it seems to be worn at home, although it is not too formal, but the sash is tied neatly and properly, not only shows that the person is sick, but also does not seem rude.
Looking at such a situation, Jing Chen secretly nods his head and stops Mu Hanzhang's movement to get up and salute: "How come you got sick on the second day of your wedding?" Jing Chen looked at his own brother, today when he heard that Princess Cheng was sick, his first thought was that something happened in the morning when he went to the palace.
"This ......" Jing Shao coughed lightly and touched his nose, even the thickest of cheeks were a little hot under his elder brother's gaze.
Mu Hanyang Zhang looked at Jing Shao's embarrassed appearance, slightly curved the corners of his mouth: ''Imperial brother need not worry, just caught a cold some fever, drank medicine has been fever.
"Well, yeah, the Marquis Bei Wei's family is too stingy, making the dowry so thin." Jing Shao busily followed and agreed, but did not know that this desire to cover up the words would only make it darker and darker, Mu Hanzhang could not help but roll his eyes.
Jing Chen looked at his brother and sighed, "Come with me to the study, I have something to say to you."
Jing Shao hung his head and was carried away, sneaking back before he left the door and making a pitiful expression towards Mu Hanzhang.
"Haha ......" Mu Hanzhang was amused by his appearance, I can't imagine that the usually reticent and cold person, to his brother in front of the surprisingly turned into a small child, can not help but laugh out loud, elegant as orchid gentleman suddenly unfolded smile, actually can not speak of bright and beautiful people.
Jing Shao saw that he smiled, and smiled so beautifully, so he contentedly followed his brother to the study to be disciplined.
"Concubine asks sister-in-law to be at peace." Xiao couldn't help but frown as she looked at Song Lingxin, who was bowing in front of her, and couldn't help but frown. This person was Jing Shao's side wife, who had entered the door two years ago, and could reasonably be called a sister-in-law, only now that the rightful royal consort had passed through the door, this Song still appeared in the teahall in such a mistress-like manner, dressed in a buff-colored Su brocade dress, with her head wearing a gold phoenix with beads stepping hairpin, and was so flamboyant!
"Why did you come over?" Xiao was still apprehensive about the second prince glaring at her just now, and now that she saw this Song Lingxin was even more upset, and without much politeness, she asked directly.
"His Highness and His Second Highness have something to discuss, my concubine thought that it would be boring for sister-in-law to drink tea alone, so I prepared refreshments in the small flower hall, and came to invite sister-in-law to come over and try some." Song Lingxin said this skillfully, purposely ambiguing the words, sounding as if Jing Shao had greeted her.
Xiao thought about it, Princess Cheng is a man is not good to entertain her, the side room to accompany her to drink tea is nothing wrong, and that the two brothers have been there for so long and not yet come out, there must be a big thing to discuss. So they got up and followed Song to the West Garden.
"Young master, slave girl heard that the second prince consort went to the small flower hall with the side lady to have tea." Lan Ting refilled Mu Hanzhang's cup of tea and said quietly to him.
"Oh?" Leaning on the couch Mu Hanzhang lifted his head from the book, some amused look at the nervous little girl, "Where did you hear it?" Lan Ting is quite resourceful, just young, with him around the time and short, not without some timidity, today even took the initiative to explore the news, naturally have to be slightly encouraged.
"I heard Sister Dream Ruoxi say that when I went to the teahouse to refill the water." Lan Ting bit her lower lip, her face quite a bit indignant; the tone of Mengxi's speech was clearly complimentary to that side madam, and full of gloating over the young master's embarrassment at being hung out to dry.
Mu Hanzhang nodded, "Well done." With that, he moved his gaze back to the book.
"Young master," Lan Ting was very displeased with his own young master's unconcerned attitude, "You don't even know what Dream Ruoxi has said."
Mu Hanzhang lifted her head helplessly and said in a calm tone, "She must have said, 'Wangfei was just married the next day and was overpowered by the side madam, so in the future, she doesn't know who to listen to in the mansion', right?"
Lan Ting's eyes widened in surprise, "Young Master, how did you know?"
Mu Hanzhang laughed lightly and shook his head, this stupid girl had everything written on her face, it was hard for him to not see it.
"Your Highness, His Highness has asked to bring word that dinner will be served with His Second Highness, so you don't have to wait to use it in the house." ZhiXi came in to deliver the message, and in the process asked the servant carrying the food box to arrange the meal in the outer room.
"Got it." Mu Hanzhang put down the book in his hands and sat down at the dining table, he had no appetite with the fever at noon, but now he was really a little hungry.
Zhi Ruoxi personally stood in front of the table cloth food, Mu Huanzhang hold up the rice bowl, looking at the table full of exquisite dishes, really more luxurious than the North Marquis House, and married to the king also do not have to day in front of the mother-in-law to set the rules, if it is a woman married to the Cheng Wangfu, certainly will be very happy, right?
Thinking of Jing Shao's gentle smile, Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but sigh, if she was the commoner daughter of the Marquis of Beiwei, she was definitely not qualified to marry King Cheng, and now she still doesn't know if this is fortunate or unfortunate?
"Zhi Ruoxi, is there a map in this royal residence?" After dinner, Mu Huanzhang asked as if casually with a cup of tea.
"Back to Your Highness, there's a diagram, in the small study, the slave girl will go and look for it." ZhiXi respectfully responded, the small study refers to the study here in the East Garden, not far from the bedroom, and was quickly brought back.
Mu Hanzhang was a little surprised that Zhi Ruoxi was able to go to the study to get something for him, Jing Shao even allowed him to look at the things in the study as he pleased? He didn't believe that without Jing Shao's permission, this girl would dare to just bring it to him. Turning to himself, he felt that he was being overly cautious, and that there might not really be any important secrets in the small study.
Slowly open the scroll in his hand, the precise drawing style is obviously a set of design drawings that have been touched up, the overview of the royal residence is clear at a glance. The royal residence is divided into two courtyards, separated by the garden and listen to the wind pavilion, listen to the wind pavilion includes a tea hall, study, warm pavilion, water pavilion and many other buildings, the backyard is divided into east and west two courts, the east court is Jing Shao's residence, the west court to live in the women's family. Because mu hanzhang does not belong to the female relatives, can not live in the west court, so with jing shao live in the east court.
His eyes traveled through the entire painting, and finally settled on "Shinohara Flower Hall", which should be what they call the small flower hall, located in the center of the West Garden. Mu Hanzhang closed the scroll, he is a man, the side room on behalf of the hospitality brother and sister-in-law should also be, but this is Jing Shao accounted for or the side of the wife Song's own initiative, the significance of which will be very different.
"Your Highness, the two aunts from the Western Garden have come to offer tea to Your Highness." Mengxi walked in through the door and said with a smile, surreptitiously observing Mu Hanzhang's reaction.
"Eh?" Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but slightly frown at his words, King Cheng has a side room and two concubines, which he knew before the wedding, now that the two concubines have come to offer tea, how come the "understanding, in and out" side lady hasn't come yet? Is this a demonstration to him, or is it testing the king's attitude?
The corner of the lips hooked up a cold smile, women's tricks, really boring. Get up and change clothes, let two concubines waiting in the side hall, Mu Hanzhang not slow to change a treasure blue regular clothes, the head did not wear a crown, let Lanting take the same color of the hair band randomly tied, Fang called the two concubines to come in.
ZhiXi couldn't help but frown at the situation in front of her, thinking that this side lady hadn't followed the king to see off the guests, had she? On her face, she smiled and introduced Mu Hanzhang. Dressed in a goose-yellow dress, the soft and charming-looking Liu is the king's mistress, and the turquoise-colored dress, the petite and witty Li is the concubine.
Author's comment: Ancient titles of princes' wives and concubines: (Information from Baidu)
The first rank.
The second grade.
Third grade.
Fourth grade.
Fifth grade.
Sixth grade.
The expression "Dixu" originates from Luo Bingling's "Palace Marriage", because I like this title and can't think of any other suitable one, so I used it ~ "Palace Marriage" is a big favorite, and I recommend you to read it ~ the story of a small attacker marrying a small subject!

chapters.title: 7: The Return
chapters.content:
"Yan Ji pays her respects to Wang Ji, Wang Ji please use the tea." Wang Ji Liu's Ying Ying bowed down, kowtowed to Mu Hanzhang, took the cups and lanterns handed over by the maids, and served them with both hands. A charming face but a low brow and not much expression.
Mu Hanzhang sip tea, rewarded her with a string of South Sea beads, to be received by her party called up.
"Slave servant kowtows to the princess, congratulations to the princess on her wedding day." The light and cheerful tone is very pleasing to the ear, Li is a concubine, can't call herself by her first name, she has to call herself a slave girl. However, she was originally a maid, this one slave girl said extremely smooth.
"Get up." Mu Hanzhang put down his tealight and rewarded Li with a pair of goldfinch chairs. Women's ornaments, his "dowry" naturally does not, the people of the Bei Wei Marquis House will not give him to buy, these are his biological mother secretly gave him the night before the wedding, for fear that he will be belittled by the concubines.
Mengxi looked at the princess so generous, originally waiting to see the joke of the heart only to converge down, and no wonder others say that marrying a commoner than marrying a first daughter is still worth money. The first daughter to get married can only get a dowry silver, the concubine son to get married is able to share the share of a family property.
Mu Hanzhang drooped his eyes, slowly said: "I am a man, in the future you do things and talk to be polite, morning and evening to set the province only need to come to ask for peace, the other does not need you to serve." Clear and moist voice is very nice, not slow rhythm but with an irresistible majesty.
The two of them were busy blessing themselves and answering yes, and Li also put away her playful face.
"If there's nothing else, go back." Mu Hanzhang said indifferently.
Liu Yanji glanced at Li, who rolled her eyes and said with a smile, "Thank you, Your Highness, it's just that Madam hasn't come yet, so the slave girls will wait outside the door so that they can return to the West Garden together." The good show is not yet finished, but can't just leave.
Mu Hanzhang lowered eyes flashed a cold light, the women's bending and twisting made him vaguely impatient, just about to let them go to the side hall to wait, then heard a burst of women's laughter coming from outside the door, "Concubine has not seen the king's master like this over ......"
The sound is getting closer and closer, see Jing Shao first stepped in, his face vaguely has a smile, to see the people in the room, immediately cold face.
No wonder halfway across the side room had to go with him, but it turned out to be late to pay a visit to the Princess to take him as a front, concubines have arrived she has not yet arrived, this is to set the scene to who see? Originally because of talk with his brother in the afternoon and jumping mood, suddenly was Song Lingxin to stir up.
The change in Jing Shao's expression naturally fell into Mu Hanzhang's eyes, and he thought that this side room was really quite favored, and he couldn't help but purse his lips.
"Sisters are all here ah!" Song Lingxin, who was dressed in a brightly colored water-pink dress, said in mock surprise and walked over to Mu Hanzhang and blessed herself, "I hope that my brother will not be offended if I am late for sending the Imperial Concubine."
Brother ......
