Mu Hanzhang heard this title only feel the forehead corner veins jumping, on the theory that the side room can be called the main wife "sister", but he is a man, it should be called "brother", but why does it sound so awkward?
"In the future, you'll still be called Wangfei, and you're not allowed to be called brother." Without waiting for the person in question to say anything, Jing Shao had already spoken first.
"Your Highness?" When Song heard this, she looked at Jing Shao accusingly, calling her brother was her privilege as a side room, and for the king to ask for this was to hit her in the face in front of the crown princess.
Jing Shao obviously did not notice her grievances, muttering in his heart this "brother" called as if he called his lover in general, how to listen to how to stick in the ear. Said also ignore the crowd's reaction, leaning on the soft couch, picked up the book Mu Hanzhang read half of the book to look at.
Song Lingxin was not amused, and had to obediently crouch down to give Mu Hanzhang a half salute, and toasted the tea. Mu Hanzhang gave her a pair of jade bracelets, the color and style are all top quality. Song's look, heart slightly surprised, secretly this North Marquis of Wei commoner son could be in the Marquis House is not rumored to be as unpopular?
Mu Hanyang may not care how these women think, admonished two sentences let them go back to the West Garden, although these concubines are good-looking, but Pepperland Lipstick are their husbands' women, think of it in the heart is very twisted, and then the beauty of the women can not be appreciated.
The house is finally quiet, Mu Hanzhang think face a moment of these women than read a whole day of books are still tired, see the book was Jing Shao grabbed, then let Lanxuan go to find another book.
"Young master, the Bishui Jing Note is in a big box in the storehouse, it's not easy to find it in the dark." Lan Xuan said with difficulty.
When the royal residence was built, naturally there would not be a study room for the "princess", he had many books, and only a few of them could be placed in the bedroom, and the rest were in the treasury.
Mu Hanzhang sighed lightly and waved his hand, "That's just it, go get a random book from the small box." This Lanxuan really can't speak, speaking so bluntly as if she had signaled her to complain in front of the king.
Jing Shao raised his head and saw his brows lightly furrowed, couldn't help but feel a little heartbroken: "No need to look for it, I'm just casually looking at it." Said reaching out to return the book to him, Mu Hanyang only had to walk over to take it, but unexpectedly was Jing Shao a pull to the soft couch.
Mu Hanyang was not on guard and was yanked onto Jing Shao's body, she instantly turned red and was busy struggling to get up, "Your Highness!"
Jing Shao smiled and sat up, wrapping his arms around someone's waist and not letting go, "Sit on the couch, let's watch together."
Zhi Ruoxi saw this and snickered as she led the maids back out, Mu Hanzhang's face reddened even more, the person behind her seemed oblivious, and put her chin on someone's shoulder, "Is it still hard on you this afternoon?"
The place where he rested his chin itched, and Mu Hanzhang moved uncomfortably, "Much better."
"Those concubines don't have to be taken to heart, Li was arranged for me by the palace when I was a child, Yeonji was sent by my eldest brother last year, and I haven't touched her since." Jing Shao hugged the person in his arms upwards so that he could lean on himself and reduce the burden on his waist and stock.
Originally felt that three wives and four concubines was nothing, but now faced with Jun Qing's dark eyes that seemed to be able to see through everything, Jing Shao's heart was inexplicably a little weak and automatically and consciously began to give an honest account.
Mu Hanzhang turned his head to look at him, was this man helping him understand the true status of the women in the inner house so that he could easily control them? Although he really has no interest at all in controlling this group of women, it is indeed useful for his survival here, after thinking for a moment, he slowly said, "The arrival of the Imperial Consort today was a negligence on my part, fortunately, the Side Lady was vigilant, so that she did not slow down her brother and sister-in-law."
"Haha, I also forgot about my sister-in-law and only remembered during dinner." Jing Shao remembered that he and his brother had gotten their words out of the way in the study today, and a smile surfaced on his face again.
It seemed Song had taken matters into her own hands, Mu Hanzhang realized.
Jing Shao lowered his head to see the people in his arms, converging eyes pondering, only to remember that he just boasted Song Ling Xin, the smile on his face was scattered completely, what is so good about that woman, Jun Qing have praised him for his vigilance: "Song Ling Xin her father is the Ministry of the Army, I was afraid of tripping for fear of going out to war, only to lift her over the door."
This said, the tone can not help but get colder and colder, the last life he was framed by the crowd, has been promoted to the Ministry of War Song An but has been shrinking his head and refused to refute a sentence for him, and finally used the means to cheat a seal of repudiation to preserve his daughter, and that woman is also fleeing as if she had left the royal residence. Cats and dogs still know to protect their masters to the death, and that woman, if the woman did not reveal her husband to be imprisoned, must have taken his evidence of guilt to the father to take credit for it.
Mu Hanzhang quietly listened to him, naturally heard his dislike for Song, those handsome eyes had a despondency in them that he himself did not notice, could not help but reach out and stroke the end of his eyes, but did not know what to do.
Jing Shao because the person in the arms of the action of surprise, but do not dare to move, watching him like a cat trying to touch his face, holding his breath for fear of disturbing him. Naihe that person just put his fingertips on the corner of his eyes and then did not move, Jing Shao could not help but slightly incline his head, in that soft palm fell a light kiss.
"Well ...... " Mu Hanyang came back to his senses and let out a soft cry, as if he was scalded, he quickly retracted his hand, and the person also jumped down from the soft collapse, "Tomorrow we still have to go back to the door, early... ...rest early." Pretending to be calm, he finished these words, turned around and went back to the inner room.
Jing Shao looked at his fleeing back and couldn't help but stifle a laugh as he got up and followed him as well.
"Your Highness, my concubine really didn't mean it today." On the carriage back to the Imperial Prince's residence, Xiao looked at her husband apprehensively.
Jing Chen glanced at her and said in a deep voice, "Intentionally or unintentionally, just remember, Jing Shao is my own brother, and I won't allow anyone to destroy him by any means." Not even Father Emperor! The last sentence was not said, Xiao's self is heard out, hastily answered yes, but in the heart is worried, you treat people as brothers, people may not necessarily appreciate.
Jing Chen thought about what his younger brother said in the study, and couldn't help but smile in relief, his own little Shao'er, finally grew up.
Returning to the door in the third dynasty, the two Cheng Wangfufu got up early to freshen up.
"Your Highness ......" Sitting on the carriage, Mu Hanzhang hesitantly opened his mouth, pursed his lips, and swallowed his words.
"Hmm?" Jing Shao turned his head to see him wanting to speak and reached out to take his clenched hand into his palm, "Junqing, do you remember what I said yesterday?"
Mu Hanyang looked up, and met Jing Shao's dark eyes full of tenderness, and his heart suddenly relaxed: "If my father brings up the matter of Jiangnan's salt introduction, Your Highness ...... should not agree."
Salt guide? Jing Shao, after this reminder, remembered that back then, Marquis Bei Wei did want to borrow his hand to get into the salt road business. Salt, since ancient times are controlled by the government, to be exact, is controlled in the hands of a few feudal officials. Jiangnan is out of the salt place, Jiangnan Generalissimo and his friendship, so want to borrow him to ride on the salt road is naturally quite a lot of people, only ...... this is also one of his sins in that year.

chapters.title: chapter viii the marquis
chapters.content:
"There really are people who don't look toward their mother's family." Hearing Mu Hanzhang's words, Jing Shao only felt warmth in his heart and couldn't help but open his mouth to tease again.
Mu Hanzhang pulled her hand back and turned her head to look out the window ignoring him.
Jing Shao laughed, simply lay down on the wide carriage and sighed, "I always do things without thinking, Junqing must remind me more in the future, or else I'll lose this head sooner or later playing with myself."
Mu Hanzhang was silent for a long time, and when Jing Shao thought that he wouldn't speak again, he heard him answer softly. Thus, Jing Shao then wriggled like a big snake and moved to someone else's side, stretching his arm to encircle that strong narrow waist, and rubbed his face against it, "Junqing, tell me about the situation of the Marquis' residence, so that I can have a response."
Being stiffened by the large head behind him rubbing against his spine, Mu Hanzhang could only turn around and tear the person stuck to his body down, so Jing Shao consciously let go of his hand and put his head on someone's lap in a smooth manner.
"...... "Looking down at the guy with a deserving face, Mu Hanzhang only felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
The marquis house has a large population, Mu Hanzhang's father is the current Marquis of Bei Wei, because the old lady is still alive, there is no separation of the family, several uncles also live in the marquis house. They don't have many heirs in this house, Mrs. Bei Wei Marquis has a pair of children, then he is the concubine son, the other concubines don't have heirs.
"Then your father is quite devoted." Jing Shao tilted his head to look at him, just enough to see the graceful line of his chin and the delicate knot of his throat sliding up and down.
"Perhaps ......" on this topic Mu Hanzhang does not want to say more, "the family population is complex, if you are not happy to deal with, just ignore it." These two days he found that Jing Shao for receiving people, especially these powerful and noble people are not good at bending, can not help but explain two sentences again.
He is a prince, who can still bully him? Jing Shao wanted to laugh at him for being overly anxious, but his words turned into, "I know."
Not long after the Marquis of Northern Wei arrived, the two organized their lapels, walking out together. Mu Hanzhang struggled to be Jing Shao clenched hand, but can not compete with him, and can not have a big action, only by him.
"I, Mu Jin, with all the people of Marquis Bei Wei, welcome Your Highness, Your Highness!" Bei Wei Marquis Mu Jin stood at the front, leading the crowd to kneel down and bow.
Originally returned to the door is that the new aunt should pay a visit to the father-in-law and mother-in-law, but if it is a member of the royal family, the Yue family in turn to pay a visit to the new aunt.
Mu Hanzhang looked at the uncles and brothers kneeling in front of him, his heart couldn't tell what it felt like, good thing Jing Shao had been holding his hand, as if to tell him "don't be afraid, I'll back you up". In the past, he always thought of the examination, so that these people can look up to him, now it seems that this goal seems to have been achieved in a strange way, at least, now this Marquis of Northern Wei no one dares to bully him.
Feeling the man slowly return his grip, a smile surfaced in Jing Shao's eyes, and he aloud for the crowd to get up before Marquis Bei Wei led them into the mansion.
Most of Mu Jin's brothers were commoners and could not inherit the title, so standing beside him was his first eldest son Mu Lingbao, who had already asked for a decree to be crowned as the son of the world the year before.
Mu Lingbao looks white and tender, probably because of the new year, he looks a bit fat, Mu Jin accompanied Jing Shao, so he walked beside Mu Huanzhang: "Second brother will go to the inner courtyard to sit with mother at the banquet or will he stay with us in the front courtyard?" His expression was the usual arrogant mockery.
"Elder brother is the son of the world, these etiquettes should be clearer than little brother." Mu Hanzhang did not look at him either, walking slowly towards the front with his frame.
Mu Lingbao look at him through the body dress, temperament, only hate itchy teeth, heart that this kid is not crookedly fall into the nest of blessings?
Mu Jin glared at his eldest son and said to Jing Shao with a smile, "It's still early, please go to the front hall with your majesty and the micromanager to have tea, so that the crown princess can go and meet his mother, then come back to the front hall to start the banquet."
Jing Shao glanced at the person beside him, and when he nodded, he slowly released the hand he was holding, "You're still sick, don't get too tired."
"Yes." Mu Hanzhang answered, smiled gently at him, and followed Mu Lingbao to the backyard, Zhi Ruoxi, Lan Ting, and a few other maids and two small eunuchs also followed, the vastness was quite spectacular.
The series of actions of the two from the car naturally fell in the eyes of Mu Jin, quite surprised to find that Mu Hanzhang was not only not angered, but also very favored. Bei Wei Marquis breathed a sigh of relief at the same time, for relying on the king to find a business doorway more certain, the smile on his face couldn't help but be more brilliant a few points.
"Yo, look, our princess has returned." This voice sounded like that talkative third aunt, and Mu Hanzhang ignored it, walking straight to the main house and standing in front of the door.
"As the crown princess returns to the door, all the ladies and young ladies can just make a half salute." Zhi Ruoxi stood at Mu Huan Zhang's side and said to the crowd in a rather grand manner.
The aunts and cousins in the room were all stunned before they reacted to the fact that this person was already the Cheng Wangfei of the first rank, not the unfavored concubine son.
Northern Marquis of Wei's wife Du smiled and stood up from the main seat, leading the ladies in a blessed salute: "Greetings to Princess Cheng as she returns to the door."
"Mother, please rise." Mu Hanzhang stepped forward to help his first mother up, motioning for the others to get up as well.
For Mu Hanyang's attitude, Mrs. Beiwei Marquis is very satisfied, backhandedly pulled his hand to the main seat with his own seat. Mu Hanzhang looked around, behind Mrs. Beiwei Marquis stand concubines, three of the four aunts are present, only missing his own mother.
"Are you used to living in the royal residence?" Du was not in a hurry to talk about his own mother, and affectionately asked what a first mother should ask.
"Back to mother, everything is fine," Mu Hanzhang heart worry, but can not directly ask out, that is disrespectful to the first mother, "mother recent body can be well?"
Du's body has not been very good since she gave birth to her youngest daughter, and she looks much thinner than the average woman, so even when she smiles, there are a few points of harshness: "Thanks to your filial piety, I'm quite hardy, it's just that Aunt Qiu fell ill the day before yesterday, and without her by my side, I'm not cheap to do anything."
Mu Hanzhang's hand hidden in his sleeve clenched into a fist, but on his face he did not show it, "With mother's care, auntie will definitely get better, the king just happened to let his son bring some snow ginseng back to replenish the body of mother and aunties." Said, signaling the small eunuch behind him to present a box of snow ginseng.
A cold light flashed in the eyes of Mrs. Bei Wei Marquis, smiled and let the maid receive it, "Marquis explained to let you go to the front hall at noon to go to the banquet, we are a group of women you stayed also uninteresting, take advantage of this moment to go to see Aunt Qiu."
When Mu Hanzhang left with his subordinates, Marquis Beiwei's wife's face immediately went cold.
"Yo, this brat has hardened his wings and knows to threaten his sister-in-law with the king." The Third Mistress said with a cold smile, looking curtly at the person on the main seat.
"Nothing can come out of the rummage." Du took a handkerchief and wiped the corner of her mouth, lazily stood up, "Let's go, let's also prepare to open the banquet."
Jing Shao stood with his hands in the study of the North Marquis of Wei, quite interested in a painting on the wall. The long scroll took up half of the wall, on which nine blades were painted, inscribed with a line of words, "...... thought that the treasure weapon nine ...... knives three, one is said to be Lingbao, two is said to contain the chapter, three is said to be the quality of the quality of the dagger; daggers two... ... because of the posture of the fixed name, to inscribe its calyx."
"Your Highness is also a lover of weapons, right?" Mu Jin smiled.
"When a treasure weapon recognizes its owner and is not one's own, it can only be used for fun and enjoyment and cannot kill the enemy." Jing Shao turned around and looked at Marquis Bei Wei with a smile.
"Your Highness is really an expert in the field," Mu Jin smiled, did not pick up Jing Shao's words again, and digressed, "Hanyang has not loved blades since he was a child, and is mute and clumsy in his speech, so if there is anything he has done inappropriately, please don't take it personally with him."
"Jun Qing is good." Jing Shao said faintly, turning his head to look at the painting on the wall again, in the middle of the chapter-containing sword, colorful, colorful like Danxia, and the quality of the sword cross and put, on the inscription of the eight words, "Chapter-containing qualities, Ice Jie Yuanqing".
Mu Jin saw him so calm and relaxed, into this study for an incense stick of time, still not slow to play tai chi with him, not a word to ask the intention of bringing him here, can not help but be a little anxious. Rumor has it that King Cheng is irritable and easy to anger, less patience, but now it seems that this popularity is calm and unhurried, his eyes are as steady as a pool, full of killing and decisive aura of killing, completely unlike a young man who has not yet reached the weak crown.
Mu Hanzhang let Zhi Ruoxi reward him with some silver, then waved away the maid who led the way and walked into Aunt Qiu's small courtyard. The Marquis House is not as big as the King's House, and all the people in the house live in one courtyard, while the concubines can only share a small courtyard with two rooms, and the empty space is just a gap between the house of one aunt and that of the other.
"Qiu Lan, is the second young master in the backyard?" A familiar voice came from the house with a slight cough.
"Yes, I heard that I'm talking to madam." Qiu Lan carries a pot of herbal tea out to change the water, and happens to bump into Mu Hanzhang in front of the door, and can't help but exclaim out, "Second Young Master!"
Mu Hanzhang nodded and lifted the curtain and walked in. The situation inside the house was not as bad as imagined, Aunt Qiu was leaning on the head of the bed embroidering flowers, and when she heard Qiu Lan's exclamation of shock she suddenly zipped her hands.
"Why are you still embroidering flowers when you're sick?" Mu Hanzhang walked over quickly.
Aunt Qiu sucked off the blood beads on her fingertips and looked at him and smiled foolishly: "Just can not see the wind, embroidery may not be a problem, the second young master in the royal residence can be safe and sound ......" said but could not help but shed tears.
"I'm very good, auntie don't worry, the king he ...... treats me very well ......" Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips and said slowly, taking the handkerchief in Aunt Qiu's hand to wipe her tears. "He assigned me a boy guard, allowed me to go out, and did not take his anger out on me."
"Really?" Aunt Qiu was in disbelief, King Cheng was notorious for his bad temper.
"He, in fact, is not quite the same as what everyone knows," remembering the past two days together, Mu Hanzhang's face showed a smile, "I'm really having a good time, Mother ......"

chapters.title: chapter ix. thanks for the gift
chapters.content:
Hearing this "mother", Aunt Qiu's tears that had just stopped welled up again: "It's my mother who's useless, if I wasn't a concubine, you wouldn't have to suffer so much." Over the years, seeing her son having to bow and call him young master, and the child having to go behind someone's back even when he wanted to call his mother, the pain of this is something that no one can understand.
Aunt Qiu was originally the first daughter of a merchant family in Jiangnan, the Qiu family in order to borrow the power of the Marquis of Northern Wei to do business, so she married the Marquis of Northern Wei as a concubine. Originally, with a handful of good skills in calculating accounts, she won the favor of Mrs. Bei Wei Marquis, in the residence of the days can also be lived, every day carefully wait for the lady, just want to be able to live a good son. But now, so understanding to people's heartache of the child but was taken away from the qualification of the examination, married to a violent prince, how can she not very, how not complain na?
Watching the always spirited and cheerful mother become like this, Mu Hanzhang's heart was very bad, and took his mother, who had lost a lot of weight, into his arms: "Marrying the king may be a good thing, and getting into the imperial court doesn't necessarily mean that you can be safe and smooth, mother has to pull herself together, or I'll be worried."
On the way back, Mu Hanzhang had been silent, clutching a palm-sized purse in his hand hidden in his sleeve, which contained the one hundred thousand taels of silver bills given by Aunt Qiu.
"Every year the Qiu family gives the dividends, most of them I have saved, in this house is not much use, are left to you. The royal water is deep, even if that person favors you for a while, it's impossible for him to be in love with you for the rest of his life. With this kind of money, I feel more at ease."
"Jun Qing?" Jing Shao, who had been left out in the cold, looked at him with a pair of slightly drunken eyes open in dissatisfaction, "Did you hear what I said?"
"Hm?" Mu Hanzhang turned his head, a hint of confusion in his beautiful black eyes, which instantly regained their clarity, "I have lost my manners, Your Highness forgive me."
Jing Shao sighed, "It's fine, I'll take a nap." Just now he was saying that he didn't agree to Marquis Bei Wei's request to get involved in salt attraction, but pointed him to another path, it would be meaningless to say this a second time, as if it was a willful show of merit, so he closed his eyes and didn't say any more.
Looking at him gamely leaning in the corner to sleep, Mu Hanzhang was a little too much, reached out and gently pushed Jing Shao's back, "Your majesty ...... leaned against the minister to sleep, there is no pillow in the car." The carriage is bumpy, if he falls asleep like this it is easy to bump his head.
The person who was pushed didn't react and still had his back to him. Is he really angry? Mu Hanzhang went over, "Your Highness?" No reaction, come closer.
Suddenly, the carriage rolled over a stone and lurched violently, Mu Hanzhang fell backward on his back because of the instability of his kneeling body, who knew that the person who was gambling turned around in an instant and pressed him to fall on the carriage, while one big hand padded on the back of his head.
Mu Hanzhang was stunned by this series of changes and froze on the spot not knowing what to do.
"I should be damned, Your Highness forgive me." The driver of the car hastily and panickedly confessed in a loud voice.
"Just." Jing Shao responded, but didn't get up immediately, instead softening his body and putting his head on someone's chest.
"The king ...... king ......" It was only then that he realized how ambiguous the two men's posture was, and Mu Hanzhang instantly reddened, reaching out to push the big furry head on his chest.
"Don't call me Your Highness in private," Jing Shao said disgruntledly, "Look, what's the difference between what you just said and a cart driver?"
"Rites cannot be abolished." Mu Hanzhang said helplessly.
"I don't care," Jing Shao was probably a little drunk, and became capricious like a little child, "Call me Shao."
"The King ......"
"Call me Shao!" Jing Shao braced his upper body and stared straight at the person underneath him, his bright eyes filled with childlike anticipation.
Even if that person favors you for a moment, it is impossible to love you for a lifetime. This person's feelings, in fact, are still blank like a child, but even if it's a child's momentary love for a toy, at the very least this moment, Mu Hanzhang feels that Jing Shao likes him. "Shao ......"
Hearing this sound, Jing Shao satisfied, grasping the person in his arms and narrowing his eyes for a nap. Today's matter is to remind him, the business of the salt guide must be withdrawn as soon as possible, at least must be transferred to under the table first. This thought can not help but hold tightly in the arms of the person, really grasp this person, the heart will be able to get peace and quiet.
Back to the royal residence, Jing Shao climbed into bed to sleep, auntie back to the door, although in the way of his identity did not dare to pour hard, but the Mu family so many of the elders of the clan brothers round a round down, he is also a little overwhelmed.
"Junior Yunzhu, pay my respects to Wangfei." A teenager of about thirteen or fourteen years old knelt down to salute Mu Hanzhang, Duo Fu stood to the side and smiled as he said that this was the boy picked out for him and two guards. Saying this, two hans in guards' uniforms followed suit and bowed forward.
"Yun Zhu is the nephew of Mr. Yun, the housekeeper of the outer courtyard, he is quite resourceful on weekdays, Your Highness will use it first, if it doesn't suit you the slave girl will change it again for you." Duo Fu briefly introduced and withdrew with two guards.
Tossed a day, Mu Hanyang also feel tired, then half leaning on the soft collapse of the big welcome pillow, Yunzhu immediately will be on the table cups and lanterns moved to the soft collapse side of the small table, and carefully moved away from the small table on the incense burner.
Mu Hanzhang smiled and beckoned Yunzhu to follow him, "How old are you?"
"Back to Wangfei, small false age thirteen." Although the age of small, Yunzhu is not the slightest bit timid, has not yet changed the sound of the child's voice brittle, a pair of large eyes are also very dynamic, very pleasing to the eye.
"When did you enter the royal residence? Can you read?" Mu Hanzhang thought the boy was cute, so he took off his shoes and moved his legs up so he could sit on the footrest.
"Small from the age of eight years old followed uncle into the house, this house more or less know some of the things," Yunzhu is not pretentious, sharp in the footrest cross-legged sitting, "small into the house after the uncle followed the reading, although stupid some slow reading, weekdays, those words are recognized, today's small study of the book is small, the organization of the book is small. The books in the small study today are small, if the princess can't find which book just ask the small, will be able to find for you."
Eight years old into the house, then it is basically from Jing Shao out of the palace to build the prince's house from the beginning, Mu Hanyang pondered, this little boy is indeed very useful, wait, the small study? "You mean, my books are in the small study?"
"Yes, this morning before leaving the house the king explained, more chief steward with the little ones busy all day." Yunzhu smiled and said, now the entire royal residence knows that the king is very much in love with this new male wife, he himself follows such a master naturally scenery, maybe even compared to the cousin who follows the king.
Although called a small study, in fact, is not small, from the marquis brought the full two big boxes of books are set down, but also a new shelf of books. Sandalwood desk, qin and chess utensils, calligraphy and painting ornaments, many things are new, are his favorite plain and light color.
Mu Hanzhang lingered in this elegant and luxurious study, his heart couldn't tell what it felt like, except for his mother, no one had ever cared for him so carefully.
Jing Shao in the house to sleep, missed the dinner time, Mu Hanzhang let the kitchen made a bowl of millet porridge and two small dishes to the inner room. The inner room is dark with lights, the bed comes from a slight snoring sound, waved away the subordinates, Mu Hanzhang lit two lamps, slowly rolled up the tent.
"Well ......," Jing Shao grunted as he was slowly awakened by the light before opening his eyes.
"Get up and eat something, it's a bit late, I asked the kitchen to cook some millet porridge, Your Highness eat less so as not to accumulate food." Mu Hanzhang said in a warm voice, draping a coat to Jing Shao who sat up.
Jing Shao froze until he picked up his rice bowl and remained a bit dumbfounded, how did Jun Qing suddenly become so gentle and unguarded?
"The small study, it's beautiful, thank you." Mu hanzhang drooped his eyes, three words and three words, usually if you say a thank you to the king and other polite words are very easy, but these words are awkward to say.
"Jun Qing?" Jing Shao looked at him in surprise, and in a fit of excitement, he grabbed the person's hand that was hidden in his sleeve, "You're finally not calling me Prince anymore."
"The king ...... king ......" Mu Hanzhang's hand trembled, made to forget to speak by Jing Shao's shock.
"Ahem," realizing that he had embarrassed himself again, Jing Shao let go of the person's hand and picked up his chopsticks again, "Just a thank you and that's it? I haven't heard of anyone's family giving a male wife a study."
Mu Hanzhang's originally tense heart sank as she looked up at him.
When Jing Shao saw his face change, he realized that his usual cold tone had scared him, and busily added, "This king wants a sincere thank you gift." Saying that, he pointed to his cheek.
"The king ...... king ......" Mu Hanzhang this time is really do not know how to respond.
"Or, it's okay to let me give you a kiss." Jing Shao came to his ear and said softly in a slightly magnetic voice.
......
After eating that exquisite late-night snack, Jing Shao beautifully wandered over to the small study to dig out his own princess who was hiding. Just now, this person had gotten up and fled before he could ask for a thank you gift.
Looking at the person who was sitting at the table solemnly reading the Da Chen Official Laws, while the tips of his ears were agate-colored, Jing Shao couldn't help but put his fists against his lips to stifle a small laugh, pacing to the person's side: "It's getting late, shouldn't Wangfei go back to her room?"

chapters.title: 10 Peach Blossom Brewing
chapters.content:
"Minister, not sleepy yet." Hearing the words return to the room, Mu Hanzhang's ears turned even redder.
Jing Shao felt that his appearance was really cute, and raised his hand to close the uninteresting law book, pulling him up, "I happen to not be sleepy either, go, I'll take you somewhere."
"Your Highness ......" Mu Hanzhang was pulled by him to stagger to stand up, seeing his excited appearance, he could only follow to the outside, consoling himself that maybe he would forget about that thank you gift in a while.
After leaving the study and going around in circles, he actually walked into the garden.
"Wait for me." Stopping at the bottom of the wigwam, Jing Shao dug into the stone cave, and in no time at all fished out a small basket with a lid.
"What is this?" Mu Hanyang Zhang was a little curious, the garden of the royal residence even hid things, Jing Shao looked as if a child was secretly hiding toys.
Jing Shao hemmed and hawed and didn't reply, only pulling him up the tallest dirt hill in the garden, on which an exquisite octagonal pavilion had been repaired.
"You take it." Jing Shao handed the small basket to the man beside him, and when he took it, he reached out and wrapped the man in his arms.
"Your Highness!" Mu Hanzhang exclaimed, and before he could react, he was already on top of the pavilion.
"This is the highest place in the royal palace," Jing Shao smiled as he took a seat between the tiles and patted the spot beside him, "Come and sit."
Mu Hanyang only had to slowly sit down beside him, the pavilion's roof was slanted, and it always felt like it would slide down at any moment.
Jing Shao thought it was funny to see him being careful, so he reached out and wrapped his arm around his waist, "I'm here, it won't fall."
Being brought to lean on Jing Shao by that powerful arm, Mu Hanzhang moved to sit up straight, seeing that the hand around his waist seemed to have no intention of letting go, he could only let him go. After all, they have worshiped heaven and earth, now there is no one around, do not have to observe the etiquette, even if Jing Shao want to do more excessive things, he is not able to resist.
Seeing that the people around him didn't object, Jing Shao continued to embrace with great generosity, "This Star Picking Pavilion is my favorite place in this royal mansion, and on a clear night, I can see a sky full of stars."
Mu Hanyang looked up with his hand, and really the stars filled the sky, there was no eaves to cover the sky, and in all directions was the firmament, as if he was in the middle of a river of stars, the corner of his mouth could not help but show a smile, "It's so beautiful, I've never seen such a complete curtain of stars before."
He is a commoner son, can not be like Mu Lingbao that nonsense, from a young age in the marquis, everywhere to observe etiquette, line a step of the wrong way are people waiting to see the joke, let alone climb the roof of this kind of thing, was caught, then it is estimated that will be rewarded by the father of a good beating.
"Didn't you ever climb a tree when you were little?" Jing Shao was a little surprised, boys should be very naughty when they are small, he often climbed the tree in the imperial garden to pull out bird's nests when he was a child, he would also climb up to the top of the tree in the middle of the night to look at the stars, and when he was discovered by the palace people, he would be spanked by his mother, but she could not afford to lay down a heavy hand, so the next day, he was alive again to continue to do bad things.
Hear Jing Shao childhood "great achievements", Mu Hanzhang can not help but laugh out loud, did not think that the Hall Prince was so naughty when he was a child, but could not help but envy, he was a child of no one to teach, his mother did not read a lot of books, they will only teach him to plan a plate, read the account, and then was found by his father also sent a good temper, said that the mother taught him, sent him ahead to the clan school to study, not allowed to talk to him more. He was sent to the clan school to study early, not allowed to talk to his mother again.
"Reading so early, no wonder you look like an old man at such a young age." Jing Shao couldn't help but laugh at him.
Mu Hanzhang glared at him like, "Your Highness is not as old as my minister."
"Uh ......" Jing Shao accidentally said out of turn, in his previous life he lived to be more than thirty years old, naturally felt that the current Jun Qing is still small, could not help but embarrassment touching his nose, took a side of the small basket to change the topic, "This is my collection of peach blossom brew This is my treasured Peach Blossom Brew, I only get a small jar of it every year, try it."
Basket is a white porcelain bottle and two small cups of the same color, Jing Shao lifted the stopper and poured two cups, clear wine in the white porcelain cups show a faint pink color.
"Your Highness drank so much at lunchtime, don't drink any more." Mu Hanzhang took a cup and pressed Jing Shao's hand that wanted to drink.
"Haha, that little bit of wine woke up long ago, how many strong wine I have not drunk in the military camp," Jing Shao was not amused, "this clear wine is so light that I can't get drunk even if I drink ten altars."
Mu Hanzhang listened, raised his hand and took a shallow taste of the wine in the cup, the sweet flavor with a light fragrance of flowers, swallowed, lips and teeth will be filled with the fragrance of peach blossoms, could not help but drink the whole cup.
Seeing that he liked it, Jing Shao handed him the bottle, after all, one of his own hands was still placed on someone else's waist, which was inconvenient, "Bei Wei Hou's generations are all fierce generals, why didn't your father teach you to practice martial arts?"
This point Jing Shao has always been very curious, the Marquis of Northway does not distinguish between the first and the concubine, more or less have to learn some martial arts, Jun Qing is not at all.
Mu Hanzhang heard him ask about this, the light in his eyes instantly darkened, silently adding a cup of wine to himself, "I froze my tendons when I was a child, and the doctor said I couldn't practice martial arts."
"What?" Jing Shao looked at him in shock, "How could he freeze?" The son of Marquis Bei Wei's own son, even though his status was not as good as the son of the world, it wasn't so bad that someone would mistreat him, right?
"Fell into the pond on the third nine days ...... " Mu Hanzhang drank the wine in the cup and added another cup, his lips hooked up a self-deprecating smile. Not being able to practice martial arts was a pain in his heart. When he was a child, his father said that his bones were good, but also to teach him the family's gun skills, and then after the doctor said that he could not practice martial arts, his father seldom questioned him, only to see him in the house to plan the disk when he was angry and dropped his small abacus, threw the four-year-old him into the clan school.
Jing Shao frowned, watching him drink from cup to cup, reached out and snatched his cup: "This Peach Blossom Brew is to be savored, which has you drinking like this?"
"Let Your Highness laugh." Mu Hanzhang forced a smile and packed the cups into a small basket, "It's getting late ...... Well ...... " her body was violently pulled over and flung into Jing Shao's arms.
"Who pushed you down?" Jing Shao eyes are rare gloomy, as if in the brewing of a storm, normal big family pond side are built with stone platforms, besides, he a young master ran to the pond to play, do not believe that there is no subordinate to follow, how can you watch him fall into the pond in the middle of winter!
"I fell by myself." Mu Hanzhang lowered his eyes, unwilling to say more. In front of his eyes appeared the lotus pond of the year, the age of the other can not remember, only remember his grandmother gave him a new snow-white rabbit fur cloak, only remember than their own taller than two heads of the little fat man full of pastry crumbs of the hand, and then the cold water, and snowy day gray sky.
Jing Shao looked at the person in his arms and only felt his heart ache, slowly lowering his head, dropping a light kiss on the lowered eyes, and when he opened his eyes in surprise, he didn't stop, kissing his brow, forehead, and cheeks one by one, as if this would save him from that icy nightmare.
"Your Highness ......" Mu Hanzhang stiffened his body and finally couldn't help but make a sound when Jing Shao kissed the corner of his mouth.
Jing Shao lifted himself up, looking at the sky full of stars all falling into the beautiful eyes of the person in his arms, he couldn't help but hold him tightly to his chest, "I will take revenge for you!" Such a beautiful person, he was afraid of hurting him even when he held him in his arms, but someone dared to hurt him like this! Think about how scared, cold and painful it should be for a tiny Jun Qing to be pushed into the water on the third nine days!
Feeling the strength behind him to embrace himself tightly, Mu Hanzhang slowly reached back to embrace, just let him be slightly vulnerable for a moment, slightly sad for a moment, slightly ...... covet this warmth for a moment ......
The next day, Jing Shao changed out of his casual clothes after breakfast, "I'm going out for the day, I don't think I'll be back for lunch."
"Uh-huh." Mu Hanzhang hung the jade pendant on his waist for him, and did not ask where he was going. When they got married, the Emperor exempted King Cheng from the morning court for nine days, so he definitely wasn't going to the court at this moment, and he couldn't be bothered to ask about anything else.
"Will be back before dinner, if you feel bored, it's fine to take two guards out for a stroll," Jing Shao saw that he didn't ask where he was going and couldn't help but say a few more words, "I've heard that garden in the south of the city often has some male wives getting together, turn around and you can also go and have some fun."
"Is that so? This is the first time I've heard of it." Seeing him with a look of "I'll keep talking if you don't answer seriously," Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but smile, finally answering a long sentence.
Jing Shao was satisfied and went out, walked to the outer courtyard and called the housekeeper, Mr. Yun, "Go and find out how the commoner son of Marquis Bei Wei fell into the pond back then."
"Yes, my subordinate will go and do it now." Mr. Yun had a long beard and an immortal look, "Will the king take a carriage or ride a horse?"
"Ride a horse." After saying that, Jing Shao's boy Yun Song walked over with a black stallion.
Jing Shao stroked the oily fur, "Little Black, long time no see."
"Whinny~" the black horse snorted and rubbed against Jing Shao affectionately. Xiao Hei was a wild horse that he had tamed in the grasslands, with a strong temperament, and not a purebred famous horse, but it compared all those generals' famous horses. Because it was much smarter than the average horse, and would avoid obstacles on its own. Back then, if Xiao Hei had been there, he and Jun Qing would not have been forced to jump off a cliff.
However, in that case, he would not have this chance to start over again. As the saying goes, what goes around comes around, and what goes around comes around, so who can say whether it's a blessing or a curse?
"Yesterday, Lord Li visited, saying it was nothing important, and left when he heard that the king was away." Mr. Yun reported the events of yesterday.
"Li Yanqing?" Seeing Butler Yun nod his head, Jing Shao frowned, this man was the one who had the last entry on the blue ledger in the dark compartment, "If he comes again, tell him to wait at the Gathering of Immortals at noon the following day."
"Yes." Mr. Yun answered and watched Jing Shao beat his horse out the door.

chapters.title: chapter xi. the villa
chapters.content:
The black steed carrying the handsome king galloped through the streets, and the people who set up stalls on the streets saw the strange and avoided them.
"See? If you make any more trouble, let King Cheng take you away." The woman selling vegetables threw down her basket and pointed at the figure speeding past to teach the child who kept crying.
Jing Shao strangled his horse to slow down and happened to hear these words, and could not help but frown.
"Rumor has it that King Cheng was tyrannical and killed 100,000 prisoners of war on the battlefield, whose name cured the night cries of children." This was one of those people's reasons for impeaching him back then, killing 100,000 prisoners, how ridiculous, not to mention the battle against the Xiong Nu, he himself only brought 50,000 soldiers and horses, and the entire Xiong Nu army didn't have as many as 100,000 soldiers. When he will be the Hun general and two thousand soldiers surrounded up, persuade them to surrender, those human nature strong, would rather die than surrender, he let the people layer by layer to kill, and finally the general with the people to break out of the siege was killed by him, caught less than five hundred people alive, and each hate chen army into the bone, if not killed will be endless trouble.
As it turns out, rumors have been circulating since this time.
Today's weather was sunny, and the sunlight slipped in through the open window ledges, warming the wide sandalwood desk. Mu Hanzhang sat in front of the desk, holding a ledger and carefully counting his dowry.
North Marquis family is large, but the population is also large, give him a share of the property plus counting a total of less than 30,000 taels. The public account of the mother is read, can not pick what problem. Although 30,000 taels did not shorten him much, but also did not allow him to dip a point of cheap. In addition, the ancestral home, ancestral fields can not give him, the silver family just after the New Year is basically no, divided into his hands are some can not move the manor, fields, only those cash silver is also used to prepare the dowry!
The eastern suburbs of the land he remembered is a piece of barren forest, acacia bushes, jagged rocks, can not plant things, also not suitable for building gardens, basically is a waste. And this vast land, in his "family property" still accounted for most of it. Mu Hanzhang sneer, Du really not afraid of people poke their spine ah!
However, in this way, he basically had no cash silver in his hand now. The 100,000 taels given by his mother was a whole sheet, and he didn't want to touch this money until he had to.
"Your Highness, the side lady has come into the East Garden." Yunzhu scurried into the study and said in a hurry.
"What is she doing here?" Mu Hanzhang frowned and put the account book away in the cabinet. Didn't she just come to ask for peace after breakfast?
"It must be about the center feed, if she says that it will take a few months before she can hand over the account books, you must not agree to her." Yunzhu wrinkled her nose, and there was some dissatisfaction in her tone.
Mu Hanzhang heard this and didn't say anything, but only had Song invited to the small study.
Song Lingxin walked in with a coquettish smile, "I hope Your Highness will not be offended if my concubine comes here unexpectedly."
Mu Hanzhang was impatient to surround himself with her, and after a few polite words, he asked her what was the matter.
"According to the rules, the princess should hand over all the affairs of the home to you when she enters the door, it's just that the royal family traditionally sends out the monthly silver on the first day of the month, and this month's affairs are numerous, so I'm afraid that handing it over to the princess right now would be messy, so I've come to ask for a show of hands from the princess." Song Ling Xin said with a smile.
Mu Hanzhang lowered his eyes, playing with the white jade paperweight on the table in his hands, his thumb unconsciously rubbing the rounded edges, a small habit he had when considering things, "In that case, you continue to be in charge for the next couple of days, and as for presiding over the middle feeder, wait for the king to come back tonight."
Seeing that this person does not sang set, Song Lingxin face green green, and then returned to the smile: "Yes, or it depends on the meaning of the king, concubine said also does not count. There is one more thing ......" said the booklet in his hand and put it on the desk.
"What is this?" Mu Hanzhang glanced at it, there was nothing written on the book cover, just a drawing of a peony flower.
"This is the arrangement for the days of bedding." Song Lingxin said, always feeling that it was a bit embarrassing to face this male Wangfei and say this, yet she had to say, "Concubine has discussed this with her two sisters, and it's all written on it, so please ask Wangfei to take a look at it, so that she can finalize it earlier for the Duo Chief to arrange."
This topic, which made Mu Hanzhang also a little uncomfortable, said that he knew and waved his hand for her to go back to the West Garden.
On the outskirts of the capital, King Cheng Biezhuang.
This mountain villa was given to him by the Emperor, and behind it was a rather high earth mountain with lush grass and trees and running water, which was his summer retreat.
"My subordinate has met Your Majesty!" Entering the manor, a tall man with green clothes and bundled hair was the first to come forward and salute.
"Where is Ren Feng?" Jing Shao handed his horse over to the subordinate who greeted him and asked the green-clothed man.
"The commander is in the martial arts arena, my subordinate will go and call him."
"There's no need, you go with this king to take a look." Jing Shao held his hands in the air and walked unhurriedly through the wooden ring corridor towards the west of the mountain villa.
The area of the villa is much larger than the royal mansion in the city, the entire west side has been converted into a martial arts arena, the center of the arena up a three-foot-high wooden stage, the stage set up weapon racks, eighteen kinds of weapons all kinds of. At this time, two people dressed in gray guard uniforms are fighting on the stage.
One person makes a big sword, one person makes a long spear, you come and go, a group of people under the stage who also wear gray guard uniforms, once to the wonderful place will hoot and holler, very lively.
Jing Shao came just in time to see the one who made the big sword was thrown off the stage by his opponent, a move back to make quite beautiful: "Good!"
"Your Highness!" Only then did the crowd notice the master's arrival and kneeled down to salute, a man in black power suit with a slender figure walked out from the crowd and knelt down on one leg in front of Jing Shao: "My subordinate didn't know that the king had come and had missed the welcome, I hope that the king will forgive me."
"You kid, what are you pretending!" Jing Shao made the crowd get up and whooped him on the head. This black clothed man was the commander in people's mouths, this Buzhuang lived two hundred close guards belonging to King Cheng, and Ren Feng was the commander of his close guards.
"Hehehe ......" Ren Feng smiled and stood up, the scar on his left eye that was pulled from his eyebrow bone to the corner of his eye looked quite fierce, but that round face smiled quite naively, "Last time, Mr. Yun said that my subordinate was too vulgar and didn't know the etiquette, so my subordinate was thinking of to learn the manners of those generals."
Jing Shao raised his eyebrows, "Just you?" After saying that, he again called him a slap, grabbed the collar and dragged to the martial arts stage, "Don't net whole those useless, come to accompany this king to loosen the muscles."
Ren Feng immediately became bitter: "Your Majesty, my subordinate has just fought for two hours."
"Cut the crap!" Jing Shao didn't care about him, throwing him a random weapon and slashing up with his greatsword.
At noon Jing Shao really did not return to the house, Mu Hanzhang ate lunch by himself, then ran to the small study again with great interest and threw the booklet with the peony flower drawing to the side. The shelf of books in the study that didn't belong to him, he hadn't looked at them carefully yet. Jing Shao said last night that this little study would belong to him from now on, and all the books could be read at will.
In addition to some brand-new travelogues and essays seen yesterday, it seems that some of the books have been read, Mu Hanzhang guessed that it was Jing Shao's books that used to be placed here, perhaps not commonly used and did not move it to the large study in the Listening Wind Pavilion. Reaching out, he took a set of books wrapped in blue hardcover and put them on the desk, pulling out one of them to look at.
Surprisingly, it was a military book! But come to think of it, it would be strange if there were poems and songs in Jing Shao's study.
Slowly turning it over, Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but widen his eyes. Between the upright black lines of characters, annotations were densely written in vermilion pen.

chapters.title: XII. Serving in the Bedchamber
chapters.content:
The vermillion fonts on it were slightly childish, and looking at the appearance of the book it was also a bit old, Mu Hanzhang flipped through the whole set of books one by one, so it turned out that he had already worked so hard from a very young age. No wonder Jing Shao was able to defeat the Xiong Nu in his teens, surpassing his two royal brothers and being crowned king in advance.
"Your Highness, I've gone to ask Sister Zhi Ruoxi." Yunzhu bounced in and came over to the desk with a smile.
"What was asked?" Muhan Zhang looked at him and smiled, putting the book in his hand back in its place after loading it.
"In the past, the days for bedding were set by the side lady, twenty days per month for the side lady, four days each for the two aunts," Yunzhu couldn't help but snicker when she remembered Zhi Ruoxi's expression, "These eight days were the days of the side lady's Kwai Shui Zhi."
Mu Hanyang Zhang looked at a thieving smile on the face of the boy, helplessly shook his head, let Zhi Ruoxi a unmarried big girl to say this kind of thing, but also really ......
"But His Majesty goes out to war all the time, and rarely stays in the West Garden in the mansion." Yunzhu was afraid that the Lord would feel uncomfortable in his heart, so he busily added a sentence.
"Man-child, you really know a lot." Mu Hanzhang knocked Yunzhu's head.
"Of course it's more, my uncle said that in a couple of years he will be able to get me a daughter-in-law," Yunzhu shook his head proudly and brought the pamphlet aside, "It's not like Wangfei has a problem with koi water, so why don't we set the king's twenty-fifth day in the East Garden, and give one of them a day for the rest of the three days? "
"How can that work?" Mu hanzhang lost his smile, if it is set like this, I am afraid that the bad reputation of him being good and jealous and not virtuous will soon spread, however, remembering the pain on the day of the cave, he still has palpitations in his heart, if he has to do this for most of the month, it will be too much to bear. Locked eyebrows open the peony flower book, the previous records are in, really with Yunzhu inquired about the same, the book clip a page of paper, is Song's written bylaws, roughly meaning from the fifteenth of the month to separate, the first half of the month so that the king stayed in the East Garden, the second half of the month, the side of the wife of the nine days, the two aunts of three days each.
"Who doesn't have the first wife occupying at least eighteen days? The side lady is really good at calculating." Yunzhu stood aside and watched, unable to resist skimming his lips. Side lady is in charge of these two years, his monthly silver has never been increased, the end of the year red packet is one year less than one year, she brought her own a few accompanying room but everywhere occupies the fat, the royal family underlings have long been dissatisfied with her.
Mu Hanzhang raised an eyebrow, this arrangement wasn't bad for him, so he raised his pen and copied the arrangement of the side lady on the flower book in a timeless and powerful script.
It was already dark when Jing Shao came back, and he first took a bath to wash away the sweat and dirt before changing into loose civilian clothes and coming out.
"Your Highness, Lord Li came again today, and my subordinate replied to him as you said." After dinner, Mr. Yun came over to report to Jing Shao about today's visitors.
"I know." Jing Shao handled a few things and let Mr. Yun go down. Then after stretching, he wanted to lie down on the bed.
"Your Highness, you've just finished eating, you'll accumulate food." Mu Hanzhang stepped forward to pull him back.
"Hmm? I'm tired." Jing Shao was not happy, his body was still sore from the day's fight.
Mu Hanzhang saw no expression on his face, but his eyes were full of reluctance, like a child being forced to get up, and resisted the urge to reach out and touch his head, pulling him to sit on the soft collapse, "Just lean back here to dissipate."
Jing Shao blinked, Jun Qing was concerned about him? Thus, the original displeasure immediately dissipated, pulling his own princess along and leaning on the soft collapse, "It's not just a walk."
Mu Hanzhang lost his smile and sat upwards, and a certain snake charmer obediently plopped down onto someone's lap, "Junqing, press my shoulders for me, they're sore."
"I'm not a maid, I don't know this." Mu Hanzhang said this, but still pressed his hand on his shoulder.
"Hiss~" Jing Shao suddenly sucked in a cool breath when he was pressed to a certain spot.
"Ouch?" Mu Hanzhang was startled, she hadn't exerted any force, how could she have hurt him?
"Well, it's probably green." Jing Shao said with mixed indifference.
"Your Highness went to practice martial arts today?" Mu Hanzhang frowned and peeled back some of his collar just in time to see a large bruise. As soon as appointed, he took over the medicinal oil to revitalize his blood.
Warm and slender fingers dipped in the slightly cool medicinal oil touched the skin, Jing Shao couldn't help but hold his breath, and when that hand rubbed at the injury, he could imagine what kind of good-looking shape that hand without thin calluses was.
Jing Shao couldn't help but grab his other empty hand in front of him, reflecting the light, slender good-looking hand looks flawless, through the glistening jade-like skin can see a few not obvious green veins, root fingers long and slender as jade onions, nails repaired rounded and neat. Put in the palm of the pinch, feel really like, can not help but pull to the mouth, gently nibble a little.
"Your Highness!" Mu Hanzhang was startled and quickly retracted his hand.
"Jun Qing's hands are so pretty." Jing Shao rolled over and looked at him innocently.
Mu Hanyang had no choice but to help him gather the lapels of his coat, "Today Song came to say that she is presiding over the middle feeder, it is now the middle of March, there are many things in the house, I thought that since she is willing to manage it, it would be better to let her manage it for a few more days."
Jing Shao frowned at his words and raised his eyes to look at his expression, but he saw that he still had a gentle unreadable face. Song saying these words at this time was nothing more than not wanting to hand over power, but if she was allowed to continue to hold the center feed, Jun Qing's prestige in the house would suffer greatly, and he did not believe that someone as smart as Jun Qing could not see that. He could not help but sigh, "You are the rightful consort, these should be done by you, if you are impatient, let Duofu handle it, tomorrow I will let Song Lingxin hand over the account books to you."
After saying so much in these two days, Jun Qing was still testing his attitude, Jing Shao felt a little tired, now that rumors of his brutality had begun to circulate in the capital, there was still no one in this world who was willing to believe him. Getting up in silence, Jing Shao did not look at the person on the soft collapse anymore, taking off his outer clothes and climbing onto the bed.
"Your Highness ......" Mu Hanzhang looked at Jing Shao's back, felt some soreness in his heart, realized that his own pretense of cleverness words hurt him, pursed his lips, also followed on the bed, pickpocketed the arm of the person whose back was turned to him, "Your Highness. I don't mean that, to hand over the account book can only be the first year's account book let me first look at, the recent account book or next month to hand over the good, or I'm not familiar with a moment, really will be out of order."
Face the wall and don't talk ......
Wiggle your arms and don't talk ......
Mu Hanzhang moved over and peeked at Jing Shao's face, seeing that the man's eyes were closed, he gently called out, "Shao? Are you listening to me?"
"Did not hear." Jing Shao sidled toward the bed, but with someone lying on top of him, he accidentally gave in to the pressure and slumped over, and in the process buried his face in the pillow and didn't move.
The man on top of her couldn't help but stifle a laugh, "Then I'll say it again, tomorrow I'll have them bring the account books from previous years to look at, and on the first day of next month, I'll have her hand all of them over."
When Jing Shao heard this, he was finally comfortable in his heart, and with a roll over, he backed the person who was pressing himself down underneath him.
"The king ...... king ......" Mu Hanzhang didn't know how to suddenly turn into this ambiguous posture.
Jing Shao frowned, looking at the slightly open pale-colored thin lips, and leaned down to imprint on them.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang stared wide-eyed, not knowing how to react, only to feel that soft warm lips printed on his own, just a slapdash touch, but made him feel that a long time had passed.
"This is the punishment, in the future, if you ever speak to me politely again, say one sentence and take a penalty." Jing Shao smiled smugly.
"I ......" Mu Hanzhang can not speak, had to tilt his head not to look at him, a handsome face is shy a red.
Jing Shao looked at him in this manner, and only felt a stirring in his heart, and couldn't help but kiss him again on the cheek, then followed his face, licking lightly to his chin, and nibbling gently at his neck.
"Uhm ......" Mu Hanzhang's body couldn't help but tremble, and his breathing quickened, "Your Highness ...... don't... ...ah~"
Jing Shao had already torn open his lapel and kissed his collarbone, sniffing and biting on that beautiful collarbone, "Call me Shao!"
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang heard the breathing of the person on top of him gradually become thicker, and the root of his leg sensed the changes in his body, immediately stiffening his body, "Shao... . don't ......"
Hearing fear in his voice, Jing Shao raised his head to look at him and saw his originally blushingly handsome face turn pale, and couldn't help but sigh, rolling over and lying on his side on the bed.
Mu Hanyang pursed her lips, as a wife, it was naturally wrong to refuse her husband's closeness, but the experience of that night was so bad that even though she knew it was wrong, she was silent and didn't open her mouth again, only clutching the corner of the quilt tightly.
The maid saw the hour then extinguished the lights outside, the room instantly darkened, the maid on night duty gently came in to put down the tent, and quickly retreated out.
Jing Shao slowed himself down for a moment, waiting for the heat to fade from his body before he reached out and tugged the still stiff body under the covers.
"I'm sorry ......," Jing Shao heard the person next to him whisper.
Hooking his lips in the darkness, he took him into his arms and said, "Sleep, it's okay."

chapters.title: chapter xiii. the salt guide
chapters.content:
The next day, Mu Hanzhang woke up in Jing Shao's arms, warm breath spraying between his neck, a slender leg resting on top of himself, pressing one leg a little numb.
Uncomfortably moving, the person holding him then slowly woke up, lightly exhaling, "Jun Qing ......" a confused call with a lazy nasal sound.
"Well, it's time to get up." Mu Hanzhang moved again, but unexpectedly, the person holding him did not let go, but instead hugged him into his arms again.
"It's not like I have to go to court, what's the hurry." Jing Shao buried his face into the person in his arms and rubbed it.
"Didn't Your Highness have an appointment with Lord Li today?" Mu Hanzhang wanted to say that the concubine had come to ask for peace after breakfast, so what if she saw the two of them still in bed.
Jing Shao reluctantly dawdled for a while longer before getting up, after he started to conquer San Fan in his last life, he basically didn't have much chance to sleep in such a relaxing manner, and even less so when he got into the prison, there were only cold lapis lazuli boards and dirty hay. So, he found himself becoming more and more paranoid of warm and clean things now.
Look at elegantly put on the coat of Mu Hanzhang, today that a snow-white coat, so that his whole person looks untainted. Jing Shao with one hand on his head, lying on his side on the bed to see a ray of sunlight on the skylight shining on the person who looks like an immortal, thinking in a trance, this person is probably the warmest and cleanest existence in this world!
The appointment with Li Yanqing was at noon, so after breakfast Jing Shao was not in a hurry to go out, sitting on the Luohan bed to accompany his wife to drink tea.
"Madam and the two aunts have come to greet you." Zhi Ruoxi came in to report.
After Mu Hanzhang nodded, Song Lingxin and the two concubines walked in and saluted the crown princess. Seeing that Jing Shao was also there, she naturally bowed to him first.
Yeonji Ryu was slightly slower than the others in getting up, and seemed to be in some discomfort as she fell forward with a wobble.
Mu Hanyang subconsciously reached out to pick it up, but she did not expect Jing Shao to react faster and yank her up, jokingly, she was going to fall into Jun Qing's arms with this fall!
"Your Highness ......," Yan Ji raised a pair of Ying Ying's autumn water eyes to look at Jing Shao, "My concubine's body is not feeling well, and I have bumped into you."
Mu Hanzhang's outstretched hand turned a corner and picked up the cup on the table and took a sip, as if he hadn't seen anything.
Jing Shao frowned, obviously did not see the meaning of autumn water in those beautiful eyes, Yan Ji's fall made him remember that in his previous life, she seemed to be in the garden a fall into his arms, and then he realized that she had an extraordinary appearance, and was very pampered for a period of time, and as a result, when the royal family suffered a disaster, this woman mysteriously disappeared. Now I think, she is the big prince sent, then, when the evidence of those crimes certainly have her a credit.
Yan Ji saw that the king had been staring at herself, she couldn't help but be secretly happy in her heart, on her face she still had a weak look on her face, looking at Song Ling Xin secretly gritting her teeth, this fox charming child!
Li looked at the situation, rolled her eyes, and backed away to stand without saying anything.
"Wangfei, yesterday concubine mentioned that matter ......" Song Lingxin stepped forward and broke the somewhat strange atmosphere in the room.
"It has been handed over to Duo Fu," Mu Hanzhang lowered his eyes, blew the tea froth on the surface, and lightly sipped a mouthful of hot tea, "I have discussed with the king, you are still in charge of this month's affairs, and on the second day of the next month, you will hand over all of the account books in your hands to me."
The smile on Song Lingxin's face instantly froze, and she turned her eyes to Jing Shao, who just turned her head to look at Mu Huanzhang: "Then won't you be busy next month?"
"There are many things to do, if the crown princess wants to take over next month, I'm afraid she'll be busy for a long time in a row." Seeing Jing Shao interjecting, Song's eyes lit up with hope again, and she busily followed suit.
"Since it's a bit busier than now, I don't have much to do around here." Mu Hanzhang said to Jing Shao.
"Then while there's nothing to do this month, I'll take you out for a few days." Jing Shao frowned, and didn't say much between the presence of his concubines.
Song Lingxin's smile became even more rigid, her face was a little green, and she took the two concubines and retreated. Out the door, ruthlessly tugging at the handkerchief in her hand, the two concubines glanced at each other, Li stepped forward and said, "The flower tea I drank at sister's place the day before yesterday, I've been thinking about it all along."
Song Lingxin glanced at them, she used to think that these two women were an eyesore, but now that there was a formidable enemy, these two would have to fight their way to her side first. So, after a few polite words, he invited the two of them to the small flower hall to drink tea.
"A man, getting involved in what inner house feeds, doesn't feel ashamed of the readers!" In the small flower hall, Song Lingxin knocked her cup heavily on the table.
"He's gaining favor nowadays, sister is afraid that she won't be able to compete with him." Yan Ji squinted a pair of fox eyes, her flavorful appearance was far from her previous delicate and incompetent appearance.
"But I've heard that the prince stayed in the East Garden for these two days but did nothing," Li smiled, "He fell ill on the second day of the wedding, and I heard that he was not badly hurt. Moreover, in my concubine's opinion, there must be some kind of agreement between him and His Highness."
"What does this say?" Song Lingxin came down in spirit this time, Li was on good terms with those maids, and the people in the king's house would hand her news.
"I heard that when I drank the medicine that day, the crown princess and the prince had a fight in the house and said something about a letter of repudiation." Li spoke confidently about the news she had inquired about.
"In that case, the king is planning to find a suitable opportunity so that he can retire him?" Yeonji added a handful of firewood at the right time.
"Hmph, if that's the case, once he holds the center feed, it will be easier to find a reason to repudiate him." Song Ling Xin's face reappeared with a smile, so this month's time, she would make good use of it and leave a "perfect" stall for the princess!
And the king, who was missed by a group of virtuous concubines, was glued to his royal consort's side watching others paint.
"Why did Your Highness still have to run out for yesterday's martial arts practice?" Mu Hanzhang saw him looking straight at himself and found a topic to chat with him.
"Looking for a fight," Jing Shao plopped down on the table, curious about the tip of his deft brush, "What are you drawing?"
"A birthday drawing," the wolfsbane between his fingers traveled across the rice paper, "it's my father's birthday next month."
"I didn't let him dabble in salt introduction last time, I sent him to the northwest to deal in horses." Jing Shao remembered the last time he returned to the door and told him in passing.
"Horse trading?" Mu Hanzhang's brush tip lurched, and a black dot was added to the southern mountain stone, and he was busy adding a few strokes to draw it as moss.
"Well," there are some things that can't be said right now, so Jing Shao doesn't intend to explain more, getting up and picking up a pen, "where's the trouble in drawing a birthday wish, I'll draw one for you."
Mu Hanzhang laid out a piece of paper for him to see what he was going to draw. Only to see Jing Shao lifting his breath and waving his brush, swish a few strokes down, an ugly turtle jumped onto the paper.
"This ......" Mu Hanzhang's mouth twitched, "is this a birthday picture?"
"Thousand year old wangba ten thousand year old turtle, isn't this a birthday wishing picture?" Jing Shao was smug.
"Pfft~" although it was disrespectful to his father, Mu Hanzhang still couldn't help but laugh out loud, "If Your Highness were to give this picture to his father, I'm afraid that it would be a laughing matter for people."
"Then let's send you the painting first, and then send me this one when Lady Beiwei Marquis' birthday is over," Jing Shao lifted his own painting and looked at it, and said to Yunzhu who was beside him, "Go and give it to be framed."
"Yes." Yunzhu stifled a smile and rolled up the painting.
Seeing that it was lunchtime, Jing Shao was still staying in the small study, so Mu Hanzhang urged him to go out and do the right thing.
"You come with me, I'll just explain a few words to him, and I'll take you to the outskirts of the city in the afternoon." Jing Shao thought of taking Jun Qing to try the snacks in the south of the city, and to see if the peach blossoms in his brother's manor had bloomed yet. These things that he liked in his last life, he hadn't seen them since he woke up, and he was eager to take Jun Qing to see them.
Mu Hanzhang couldn't wear him down, so she had to change her clothes and go with him.
Upstairs in the Juxian building, Li Yanqing rubbed his hands happily, "Your Majesty ...... this is?" When he saw the unfamiliar face behind Jing Shao, the smile on his face became a little wary.
"This is my residence Qing guest Mr. Jun, may not matter," Jing Shao mixed not cared to pull Mu Huanzhang sat down, "today let you come is to tell you, after this business can not be done."
"Your Majesty!" Li Yanqing was alarmed, looked around and lowered his voice, "Is something wrong?"
"There are some winds in the court, it is better to restrain yourself this year," Jing Shao poured himself a cup of wine, "you go to find Ren Feng, I have told him the specific statutes, he will tell you what to do in the future." Yesterday, I went to the other villa, and then I explained the matter of the salt guide business.
After Li Yanqing left, Mu Huanzhang was silent for a moment and opened his mouth, "Did Your Highness encounter anything in the court?"
Jing Shao looked at him and hooked his lips into a smile, "There's nothing much going on right now, but has Jun Qing ever heard of the legends in the capital?"
Mu Hanzhang lowered his eyes and thought, "Is it about the rumor that King Cheng can cure children's night cries?"
"Uh-huh." His Jun Qing was really too smart for his own good, and Jing Shao felt that talking to him was the least of his troubles.
"This matter has to be treated separately from the symptoms, at the moment need to treat the symptoms first." Mu Hanzhang playing with the wine cup in his hand, slowly rubbing the rim of the cup said.

chapters.title: chapter xiv. the green plum
chapters.content:
Jing Shao's eyes lit up and moved toward his daughter-in-law's side: "What is the standard? What is this?" He really didn't have a clue about the rumors, only thinking that he had collected all the incriminating evidence and kept a lower profile lately, and the rumors would naturally pass slowly.
"The so-called standard, is the rumor itself; the so-called principal, is the person who spread this rumor, or rather, a group of people." Mu Hanzhang looked up at him, seeing that he understood, he continued, "Right now the thing to be resolved is the rumor itself, the so-called multitude of people, the rumor will become true if it's spread more, maybe now father will laugh it off, after a few years it won't be certain."
"Jun Qing!" Jing Shao grabbed the hand that was holding the wine goblet, at this moment he almost thought that Jun Qing was also reborn, but immediately dismissed this thought, otherwise how could he not see the difference between himself and his previous life. But if Jun Qing was not reborn, then his vision and wisdom really should not be underestimated!
"Your Highness?" Mu Hanzhang was uncertain, not knowing how this person suddenly held his hand.
"I'm so happy that you're willing to help me." Realizing that his behavior was a bit abrupt, Jing Shao hurriedly explained, but did not let go of the person's hand.
The person who was grabbed dropped her eyes a little uncomfortably and drew her hand back, "I'm married to you, who else can I help if not you?"
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao looked at the person in front of him, this person has the talent to help the world, but entrusted to marry him, not only did not harm him, but also willing to do this to help him plan, the previous life of his own is really stupid and unattainable. Can't help but reach out and hold Mu Hanyang tightly into his arms, "In this life, if you don't give up, I Jing Shao will not be responsible for you."
Mu Hanzhang flabbergasted leaning on his chest, do not understand why this person suddenly so excited, heart that this is not the place to talk, he deliberately interrupted himself? Think about here is a restaurant, crowded eyes, their next words really can not easily say, so also stopped the words: "We, first eat it."
"Yes, you must be hungry, come eat first." Jing Shao then remembered that the two of them hadn't eaten lunch yet, Li Yanqing ordered a table of good food, he himself hadn't moved a single chopstick before he roared off to find Ren Feng, the food was not eaten again it should be cold.
The two of them had eaten and were in no hurry to return to the house. Jing Shao pulled his own princess on the street leisurely walk to eat. Both of them are handsome extraordinary people, a cold and handsome, a warm as jade, but also in the street hand in hand, (although the Jing Shao forced to pull people do not let go,) attracted passers-by have side-eye.
"Where are we going?" Mu Hanyang Zhang helplessly let him pull him along, and it was not good to call him Your Highness outside, so he only omitted the title.
"Go to the south of the city." Jing Shao said as he turned into a store, weighed two pounds of fried melon seeds, and pulled him around the alleys, finally finding a rather old looking store.
The store has no name, only a wooden plaque hanging on the wall with two lines, "Lang rode a bamboo horse to get a plum around the bed."
Crossed the threshold, into the store, the store is made of bamboo, wiped spotless, the store floor is not paved with bricks, all the land, the four corners of the house is actually planted with live bamboo, it looks very elegant and serene.
"Good place." Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but praise it.
"Hahaha, the gentleman doesn't mind the simplicity of the small store, he must be a man of elegance." A rather cheerful woman's voice came from the back door, only to see a woman wearing a plum red zong dress and about thirty years old walk in from the backyard holding an altar.
"Miss Mei, don't come back well." Jing Shao seemed to be familiar with the place and greeted the boss's wife with a smile.
Mei girl? Mu Hanyang Zhang some strange look at the people around him, this woman is clearly wearing a woman only wear zong skirt, moreover, has already Xu Niang age, how to still call people Mei girl, when it is frivolous!
Jing Shao returned his innocent look and pulled him over to the liquor cabinet.
"You kid, still so no big deal." The boss's wife put down the wine jar and walked behind the high counter, "What can I get you?"
"A small bottle of green plum wine and two more wine goblets." Jing Shao took out a piece of silver and put it on the bamboo counter.
"Take it!" The boss's wife collected the money, put a bottle of wine and two wine cups into a small bamboo basket and threw it to him, looked up and glanced at Mu Huanzhang, smiled and said, "This gentleman is a bit strange, but your temperament is extraordinary, certainly a scholar, next time you come to buy I will give you a cheaper calculation."
Jing Shao was instantly displeased and wrapped the person beside him into his arms, "He's my new wife, don't even think about hitting on him!"
