"Get lost, get lost, next time I'll charge you twice as much!" The boss's wife instantly changed her face, taking the bamboo strips and smacking them on the counter, Jing Shao laughed and took his own princess to leave quickly.
"This store ......" Mu Hanzhang frowned, feeling so strange.
Jing Shao laughed and shoved the paper bag holding the melons into his hand, carrying the plum wine himself and freeing one hand to continue pulling him along, "It's a very long story."
The woman's name is Mei, is an orphan girl, and his neighbor's man is also an orphan, the two grew up with each other, the girl has a family brewing skills, so they brewed wine at home, the boy will take out to sell, to maintain their livelihood. The man joined the army at the age of sixteen and promised to marry her after he had built up his career. In the Jing Shao from the army, the man has become a pioneer, always silly to send him silver are saved, said to go home so that he can marry his green plum girl. Unfortunately, in Jing Shao's second year in the army, the man died in battle, and the plum girl never married.
After finishing this story, the two had already walked to a peach blossom forest, March is the time when peach blossoms are in full bloom, when Mu Hany Zhang came back to his senses, he saw the peach blossoms burning all over the place, a vast expanse of bright pink color, which continued all the way to the edge of the sky.
"It is very beautiful ......," Mu Hanzhang said softly, the scenery is very beautiful, the story is also very beautiful, but it is a pity that the end of the story is just like this full of peach blossoms, and in the end, it can only be zeroed down with the wind.
Jing Shao saw that he was a bit depressed and hugged him from behind, resting his chin on someone else's shoulder, "Brother Wang is a good person, when I first entered the barracks I couldn't eat the rough meals in the barracks and starved for a few meals, he didn't know that I was a king, but he still secretly caught small birds to roast for me to eat." Therefore, he had been secretly taking care of this Mei girl.
"Your Highness is actually very kind." Mu Hanzhang slightly raised the corners of his mouth.
Jing Shao secretly smiled, kindness? He did not feel that this word had anything to do with him, he was merely returning favors and avenging them. But if this could change Jun Qing's impression of him, then let him think so.
Pulling his own princess towards the depths of the peach blossoms, it wasn't long before an exquisite little pavilion was revealed in front of him.
"Such a nice place, why don't we see others coming?" Mu Hanzhang unwrapped the paper package and poured another cup of green plum wine for each of the two.
Jing Shao smiled, this garden was his elder brother Jing Chen's private garden, naturally no one dared to just come in. Just now, Jun Qing was listening to the story too attentively and didn't even notice that they entered a small moon gate, which was still guarded by guards on both sides.
Mu Hanzhang heard, only to understand the reason why he brought himself here, here outsiders can not enter, surrounded by very empty, naturally not afraid of people eavesdropping, so they continued the unfinished topic in the gathering of immortal building.
"If Your Highness really has no intention of taking the throne, then there is no hurry to salvage this reputation," Mu Hanzhang picked up his wine cup, which was made of bamboo and not worth much, but was very interesting, "but you can't just let it circulate, the best way to do this is to use blackmail as a means to combat blackmail!"
"What do you mean?" Jing Shao couldn't help but lean forward when he heard for the first time that there was such a way.
"The people spreading rumors are nothing more than being jealous of the king's achievements, then they will find a rival that the king hates and make up some bad words about him to spread, true or false doesn't matter, just as long as it's hard to hear," Mu Hanyang's beautiful eyes narrowed slightly, looking a little bit crafty, "The people don't care if it's true or false, as long as it sounds appalling will be happy to pass it on, and by then, the rumors about the prince will naturally be forgotten."
Jing Shao's eyes widened, it seemed that Jun Qing had guessed that the source of the rumor was one of his two brothers, and possibly the step-queen, and since they could make things up, so could they themselves!
"Hahahahaha, what a word to wake up the dreamer, Jun Qing, you are much worse than me!" Jing Shao laughed out loud, but at the same time, he was also glad that if it wasn't his stupid concubines that helped succeed the Empress, but the person in front of him, he was afraid that he would have died many years earlier in his previous life.
"I am merely discussing the matter." Being spoken to like this by Jing Shao, Mu Hanzhang was a little uncomfortable, subconsciously increasing the force of rubbing the rim of the cup, but unexpectedly the edge of the bamboo was not carefully polished, and a thin bamboo gimlet stuck into his fingertip, the sharp pain caused him to knit his brows, and when he looked down, a rounded drop of blood had already risen out.
"Jun Qing!" Jing Shao immediately scurried over and clutched the injured hand, skillfully pulling out the spikes.
"Hiss ......" ten fingers, Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but suck in a cool breath as more beads of blood bubbled up from the wound, but Jing Shao's next action made him forget to even exclaim in shock.
Jing Shao looked at the jade onion-like finger that kept bubbling with blood, and painfully took it into his mouth, licking away the beads of blood and sucking it gently twice more to prevent any fine thorns from remaining in the flesh. When he raised his head, Mu Hanzhang's face was already red to the point of dripping blood, and when he saw him looking over, he lowered his eyes in panic.
Jing Shao then realized how ambiguous his behavior was, taking advantage of the peach blossom petals fluttering in the wind behind him, he only felt that the blushing person in front of him was as beautiful as a peach blossom fairy. He couldn't help but embrace his own princess, who was about to go up in smoke, and pressed the back of his head and kissed him.
"Well ......" the touch of the burning lips in their own lips rolling over and grinding, was sneak attacked Mu Hanzhang did not resist much, only, when a soft and smooth thing into the mouth to try to pry open his teeth, he was really frozen,. "Your Highness ...... hmmm ......" Just when he wanted to open his mouth to speak, that flexible guy took the opportunity to drill in, and gently swept over the soft upper jaw. The body was provoked by this unfamiliar feeling, Mu Hanzhang did not know where the strength came from, a hand pushed Jing Shao out.
Jing Shao was not on guard, but was actually pushed out of the pavilion with a hand, subconsciously reaching out to grab the peach tree, but unexpectedly that branch was infested with insects, and it broke with a click. Thus, the handsome and majestic, war hero, kind hearted, wife molesting Cheng Wang Qianyi ...... fell to the ground!

chapters.title: chapter xv. madness
chapters.content:
Two people in the outside play a day, back to the royal residence day has been dark, and has passed the dinner time. The West Court because of the residence is female, the key to fall much earlier than the East Court. Mu Han Zhang will be exempted from a few concubines tonight, so as not to delay the West Court side of the key.
A bucket full of hot water was prepared behind the screen, and the water was spiced with spices imported from Fenpang and sprinkled with a layer of fresh peach blossom petals.
Mu Hanzhang watched Jing Shao undress and prepare to take a bath, so he picked up a book and sat down on the Luohan bed to wait for him to finish washing himself, but was grabbed by Jing Shao, "Junqing, you dropped me on the floor today, my butt is still hurting at this moment."
"Chen ......" remembering today's events, Mu Hanzhang's face reddened again, had apologized to him in the afternoon, how come this person is still unforgiving.
"An apology has to be sincere," Jing Shao grabbed the person's hand and dragged it behind the screen, "I have injuries on my body, so help me bathe."
Mu Hanzhang stared at him with wide eyes, the first time I heard that hurting the buttocks made it inconvenient to take a bath, "I ...... I won't ......"
"It's fine, I'll help you wash too." Jing Shao beautifully stripped off her clothes and took the lead in jumping into the bucket of water, looking at the Princess who was still frozen in place and not moving, she patted the barrel, "Come in quickly, or else you'll be punished for helping me apply medicine in a while."
Paint the medicine? Mu Hanyang bit his lower lip, in bed to him that place to apply medicine, or in the bath tub in the naked relative, two relative comparison, it seems that which is quite dangerous, but applying medicine if he can wear clothes ......
"Jun Qing?" Jing Shao looked amusedly at his own princess as she bit her lower lip in agonizing thought, only to find it adorable and very cute.
"Then ......臣还是帮王爷擦药吧." After saying that, he ran out without looking back.
"Pfft~" Jing Shao laughed out loud as he plopped down on the side of the tub.
When Mu Hanzhang also finished his bath and changed into fresh silk clothes and came out from behind the screen, he saw a certain prince wearing only an undershirt and no petticoat, lying on his bare butt on the bed and reading a book on military affairs with great interest.
"The king ...... king ......" Mu Hanzhang's face immediately reddened, how this person is so ......
"Jun Qing!" Jing Shao saw that his own princess had finished her bath and came out, so he busily dropped the military book in his hands and obediently handed over a small bottle.
Mu Hanzhang couldn't, only had to climb inside the bed, poured some medicine in the palm of his hand. Looking at the perfect curve in front of him, there is a little bit of bruise on both sides, the rest of the muscle is well-proportioned, at first glance it is full of explosive power, and then look down, the two long and slender legs straight and together, the streamlined muscles make these legs look full of the beauty of danger and power.
The slippery medicinal juice slipped from between his fingers, dripping onto that round and inviting place, Mu Hanzhang then came back to his senses, peeked at Jing Shao, realized that the man wasn't looking at him, exhaled softly, and attached the palm that had the medicine poured onto it.
When that warm and soft hand caressed himself, Jing Shao regretted it, the touch was so wonderful that his body quickly reacted to his own Wangfei's kneading, and he couldn't help but secretly cry out, now that Jun Qing hadn't yet dispelled the fear of the cave, how could he solve the fire that this had caused?
"It's applied." Mu Hanzhang climbed out of bed and put the medicine bottle away, also letting her somewhat heated body cool down.
"Uh-huh." Jing Shao answered sullenly, still lying still.
"Your Highness, sleep." Seeing that he didn't move, Mu Hanzhang could only crawl inside the bed again and cover him with the quilt.
"Well, I have medicine behind me, so I'll sleep on my back tonight." Jing Shao buried his face in the pillow and made a fool of himself by sleeping on his back all night.
The next day, Jing Shao went out early to go to the second prince's mansion to discuss yesterday's ploy with Jun Qing with his brother, and Duo Fu, according to the Wangfei's instructions, carried the accounts of the past years to the small study.
"Your Highness, this is the accounts of the last three years, do you really want to read them all?" Yunzhu swallowed as she looked at the foot-high ledger.
"Uh-huh." Mu Hanyang Zhang just faintly responded, dividing the account book into three parts by year, starting from the earliest year.
"The books of accounts are for Mr. Accounts to read, why do you need to bother?" Yunzhu was a bit puzzled, if the crown princess wanted to learn how to manage the household, just go and ask the multiple chief stewards, or see how the side lady does it.
Mu Hanzhang glanced at the frowning little scribe and smiled without saying anything. The account book contains a lot of useful things, the house's food, clothing, human relations, subordinate mobilization, all can be seen in the account book. In fact, the governance of the country is also so, look at the account books of the Ministry of Revenue, you can know whether the monarch is mediocre, whether the dynasty is prosperous.
"I heard that Mrs. Side was taking inventory of the storehouse yesterday, and spent the morning inside with a few subordinates." Yunzhu took advantage of Mu Huanzhang's tiredness of watching and drinking tea to whisper to him about the news he had poked around.
"I know." Mu Hanzhang touched Yunzhu's head and rewarded him with a handful of the pine nut candies he bought yesterday. At this time of the year, the inventory of the treasury must not match the accounts with the actuals.
"Wangfei's monthly silver for March was not allocated by the account office at all, yesterday I went to collect the rice paper and almost didn't get it." Yunzhu ate a pine nut candy, talking about this matter is a bit indignant, fortunately the princess is a man, with the king living in the East Garden, and the East Garden of all the expenses are counted in the king's sub-case. If it were a woman who married in, wouldn't she even have nothing to eat!
Mu Hanzhang heard the words, just remembered, their hands also really no cash silver, if there is something urgent will not be good to do.
Accounts for a moment and a half can not finish, Mu Hanyang lunch and rest a nap, before returning to the study.
"Your Highness, you're back!" When he exited the bedroom, he met Jing Shao who walked in quickly and almost bumped into him.
Jing Shao looked straight at him, his eyes a little red and not looking quite right. After seeing who was in front of him, he reached out and grabbed him by the wrist, turning around and heading out again.
"Your Highness ......唔...... "Mu Hanzhang was pulled by him and stumbled, almost falling, stumbling as he pulled him to the front yard.
The subordinates came over to see what was going on, whispering about whether or not the princess had annoyed the king.
Without a word, Jing Shao pulled Mu Hanzhang and rolled onto his horse, clamping down on his horse's stomach, Little Black hissed and rushed out like an arrow.
The steed galloped on the official road outside the capital, and in a trance he seemed to have returned to that snowy day when he was fleeing before he was reborn. These warm and restful days had made him temporarily fade into oblivion, what kind of mood he had reopened his eyes with.
Mu Hanzhang, who was crouching behind him, sensed the violent rage in his heart and slowly hugged his waist tighter. Feeling the strength in his waist, Jing Shao stretched out a hand to hold those two overlapping hands, all the way into the capital's suburbs of the courtyard, ignoring the courtyard of the guards who exclaimed, driving a small black all the way to the martial arts stage. Tap footsteps leaped onto the wooden platform, drew a long spear, did not look at the stage is who, caught people on the fight.
"Your Highness!" Ren Feng who was demonstrating the moves to his subordinates on the stage was startled and subconsciously raised his hand to catch the move, when he saw that it was Jing Shao, he panicked and retreated three steps back, unexpectedly Jing Shao rushed directly over, Ren Feng turned around and drew out a baguette and managed to block the club that came splitting from his head.
Jing Shao fought as if he was fighting for his life on the battlefield, and in no time, he threw Ren Feng, who was afraid of hurting him, off the stage. Without an opponent, he continued to dance his spear on the stage. The silver-colored spear was like a swimming dragon, cutting out a silver residual shadow in the air.
Mu Hanzhang frowned as he looked at the people going crazy on the stage, and in a low voice instructed Ren Feng to take the others and leave the area for the time being.
The sun slid down from the mountain, and the sky, which had been somewhat overcast, began to drizzle thinly. Xiao Hei had already been taken to the stables, and the people around the stage had all dispersed, Mu Hanzhang looked at the person on the stage who was still dancing with a silver spear and slowly walked up.
"Your Highness, it's getting dark." Mu Hanzhang stood on the stage and said calmly with a voice that did not rise and fall.
“嗖嗖嗖～”破空之声没有任何停滞，雨珠被枪头的红缨出，旋转着四散开去。
Mu Hanzhang clenched his fists, turned around, drew a broadsword, and flung it over, "Jing Shao, calm down!"
"Clang!" A sound, the sound of the gun head colliding with the steel blade, roused Jing Shao's sanity, the movement of the dancing gun paused for a moment, Jing Shao looked up at him, "ah~" hissed up to the sky, and leapt up high, the silver gun splitting on top of the wooden stake, splitting it into four pieces.
The silver spear fell to the ground, and gurgling blood dripped down Jing Shao's fingers, mixing with the pattering rain and quickly turning a light red color.
Mu Hanzhang ran over and cupped his right hand, the tiger's mouth was cracked and blood blisters were rubbed on his palm, he took out a handkerchief from his sleeve and pressed the wound that kept bubbling blood. Jing Shao tilted his head back to look at the sky, rainwater falling in his eyes and sliding down his cheeks.
"Junqing ...... they killed the mother ...... my mother ......" Jing Shao said softly, his voice was not loud, not loud, not loud. Like a murmur, Mu Huanzhang is heard clearly.
Exhausted Jing Shao slipped and fell to the ground, Mu Hanzhang squatted down and slowly took him into his arms, "Shao ...... what happened?"
"Junqing ...... Junqing ......" Jing Shao buried his face in his shoulder, today his brother listened to his ploy, gratified to find that his younger brother had finally grown up, he told him some things that he had not previously told him things that he hadn't told him before, and among them, it included the real cause of Empress Yuan's death.

chapters.title: chapter xvi. lack of money
chapters.content:
After an hour of rain in the courtyard, Jing Shao didn't speak or move, Mu Hanzhang quietly stayed with him, holding him and sitting in the rain for an hour, waiting for him to calm down before dragging him into the house to bathe and change his clothes.
Although the courtyard was Jing Shao used to practice, but is a royal courtyard, the things should be complete, and there are hot springs living water. Jing Shao's main courtyard inside there is a large hot spring pool, but because of the rain can not wash the open air, it will be in the house of the small pool to soak away the cold.
"Ah-choo!" Mu Hanzhang coaxed Jing Shao to drink a bowl of ginger soup, but he himself sneezed.
"You also quickly drink a bowl." Jing Shao handed him the ginger soup, while he himself took a cloth towel and wiped his hair, only then did he remember that Jun Qing's body was not in good shape, and had been frozen when he was a child, and that although the rain in the spring was not cold, sitting in the rain for an hour, the average person would get sick, not to mention him. Thinking about this, busy pushing Mu Hanzhang to go to the hot springs to soak for a while.
"My body is very good," seeing Jing Shao's intentions, Mu Hanzhang guffawed, "I used to kneel in the rain for three hours without getting sick, not to mention ......" Seeing Jing Shao's face change, Mu Hanzhang realized that he had spoken out of turn again, and was busy pulling him to bed.
Because it was built for rest and play, the bed in the other courtyard was much wider than the one in the royal residence, Jing Shao crawled toward the bed twice and came over to lie down next to Mu Hanzhang, his eyes hidden with anger: "Why?"
"At that time, the milkmaid made a mistake, and I was trying to save her," Mu Hanzhang leaned against the large cushions cascading over the head of the bed, bandaging the wounds on his hands with the cloth and medicine he had just found, "Isn't it normal for a child to be punished for kneeling?"
At that time, the nurse's son was caught stealing from the house, and the lady wanted to throw them both out. When he fell into the lake, it was the milkmaid who took care of him without any clothes to save his life, the lady did not give her a way out, in the final analysis, it is still not good to see him as a commoner's son. Kneeling for three hours, or grandmother can not stand to see, only to save the nanny and her son, only to drive them to the manor.
Jing Shao sniffed, the corner of his mouth pulled up a bitter smile, "Yes, I even knelt in front of the Palace of Diligence for a day and a night."
Mu Hanzhang covered the person beside him with the quilt and slid down himself, supporting his head with one hand and lying on his side to look at him, "A day and a night?" King Cheng is the first son of the orthodox family, but in the palace, he is not as happy as he should be?
"At that time I insisted on going to the military camp, father said if I could kneel in front of the Palace of Diligence for twelve hours he would let me go," Jing Shao laughed self-deprecatingly, "Without mother to protect me, my brother and I were not as well off in the palace as the eldest prince born to a favored concubine, all I could think of at that time was that I wanted to go and lead the troops, to hold the military power, and to kill all these people who bullied me to kill them all!"
Mu Hanzhang furrowed his brows and put his hand on the top of Jing Shao's head to gently caress it, but did not speak.
The gentle touch makes Jing Shao comfortable to squint his eyes, took a deep breath, smelled the light fragrance of Jun Qing's body, let the manic mood gradually calm down: "When I was a child, my mother would personally make me a small clothes, and would also make a particularly tasty osmanthus cake, I broke her most beloved orchid, she beat me up, and she cried before I cried, hugging and asking me if it hurt! ......" said Jing Shao's eyes moist.
Men don't cry lightly, just because they haven't reached the sad place. Like Jing Shao such a strong person, shedding tears will cause more and more heartache. Mu Hanzhang looked at this kind of Jing Shao, only feel pity incomparable, slowly lowered his head, in his tightly knitted eyebrows fell a light kiss.
Jing Shao opened his eyes to look at him and rolled over to bury his face in Mu Hanzhang's chest, afraid that he would see his wretched appearance.
Mu Hanzhang lay down, held him in his arms, and gently stroked him on his back, like soothing a wounded beast, over and over again, relentlessly caressing him. Exhausted Jing Shao, in such a beautiful touch gradually fell asleep, the
''Little Shao'er, you're about to have a brother or sister ......''
''Even with a younger sibling, Little Shao'er is still Mother's favorite child ......''
'Out of red! It's a big red! Who's screaming in the chaos? Where is Mother?
''Shao, don't be afraid, it's okay, it's all in the past ...... ''Whose voice is so nice, the scene full of blood and red in front of his eyes gradually dispersed, leaving only a gentle face, handsome and unparalleled people smiling at him in the slightly cool spring rain. The nightmare never appeared again, the dense dream world is only a piece of peace.
The next day, when Jing Shao woke up, the person beside him who had comforted him all night had not yet woken up, tilting his head to look at that person's quiet sleeping face, remembering that gentle light kiss last night, which was only recalled now. Although the kiss only reached between the eyebrows, but let his heart leap. Slowly came over and dropped a kiss on the bottom of the eyes that had a faint green shadow.
Mu Hanyang slowly opened her eyes and saw a handsome face close at hand, she was in a trance for a moment before coming to her senses, "Your Highness ......"
"I've said it before, no calling me Your Highness in private, one penalty for calling me once." Jing Shao disgruntledly placed a heavy kiss on his lips.
Mu Hanyang blushed to bear this "punishment", this person how so many names? "But single call a 'shao' word is so awkward, you have no epithet ...... that, do you have any nickname?"
"Mother and elder brother both call me 'Little Shao'er'." A certain prince rather cheekily contributed his nickname.
Stimulated by the sticky name, Mu Hanzhang's mouth twitched and turned into a light smile, "'Little Spoon', this name is indeed good."
"It's 'Little Shao'er'!" Jing Shao said in dissatisfaction.
"Well, Little Spoon, then I'll call you that from now on as well." Mu Hanzhang patted his head, and got up straight away to start getting dressed.
Jing Shao's eyes widened, was he, himself, being molested by his own princess?
When Jing Shao returned to the Royal Mansion, he was stopped by Mr. Yun and told to deal with the evil consequences of yesterday's downtown horse-riding. Mu Hanzhang was very unrighteous and went back to the East Garden to catch up on his sleep.
"Your Highness, the matter you asked me to look into has a clue," only after finishing a bunch of chores did Mr. Yun bring up the news that had just come in, "It's about the matter of the princess falling into the water when she was a child."
Beiwei Marquis underlings three years a change, after many years, many people who know have not been in the house, even if some in, on this matter is also secretive, which seems to be a taboo of the Beiwei Marquis. Mr. Yun sent people after a few weeks, inquired about the childhood care Mu Huanzhang's nanny, even in the North Marquis name of a farm, from the mouth of the nanny complete hear the end of the matter.
When the North Marquis old lady to the two grandchildren each made a woolen cloak, Mu Lingbao a fox skin, Mu Huanzhang a rabbit skin. Because Mu Hanzhang born good-looking, Mu Lingbao felt that his brother on the cloak than his good, hard to grab over, tearing between him into the lotus pond. At that time, there were two cousins, three children cooing and holding the grabbed the woolen cloak ran away, leaving only three-year-old Mu Hanyang in the pond with thin ice struggling, but fortunately the nanny rushed to a hand to fish him up, and then sick for half a year, only to pick up the life back.
"Bastard thing!" After Jing Shao heard this, he raised his hand and dropped the cup in his hand, I think Mrs. Marquis Bei Wei must have whisked and released her subordinates in order to preserve his son's reputation, forbidding anyone from mentioning it again. An unjust person who kills and maims his hands and feet, the royal family will not agree to him to become the son of the world.
Pacing around the room with his hands behind his back, he turned to Mr. Yun and said, "Now there are two things for you to do, one, go and find out Mu Lingbao's usual whereabouts, hobbies, people he befriends, and places he frequents; and two, find someone to spread the word around the capital that the fourth prince, Jing Yu, likes to eat raw meat, and don't say much else."
Mr. Yun understood about the first thing, but what was this Fourth Prince's preference for raw meat?
"Doesn't Jing Yu like the raw fish meat imported from the East? But it's just a matter of omitting the word fish, just go and do it." Jing Shao hooked her lips and smiled coldly. It was just a matter of blackmail, who wouldn't? He could turn killing 500 descended soldiers into killing 100,000 prisoners, so I wonder what this Fourth Prince's little fetish will be rumored to be, it's really something to look forward to!
After Jing Shao let the news out, he stayed at home every day to accompany his wife, practicing his sword and reading books, enjoying these rare days of leisure, while Mu Huanzhang also finished reviewing the three years' account books of the royal family in a few days.
Looking at the monthly routine on the account, the side lady's is fifty taels, then his monthly silver as the main consort will be at least eighty taels, so that the matter of not having any cash silver on hand will be solved, Mu Hanyang closed the last account and let out a light breath, this is much more than his monthly salary as a lifer.
"Yunzhu, you take this and run, go and collect my last month's salary," suddenly remembering that he still had a salary to collect, Mu Huanzhang handed over a document to Yunzhu, although it was very meager, at least it was a piece of income, "the money you collect will be counted as yours."
"Really!" Yunzhu immediately came to life, "Thank you, Your Highness!" As soon as he pulled the piece of paper and put it into his pocket, he ran out joyfully.
"Young master!" Lan Xuan hurriedly ran in.
"What's wrong?" Muhan Zhang gestured for her to speak slowly.
"Today, Grandma Zhou s youngest daughter ran to look for you, and was stopped by the guards at the side door, and the slave girl spoke ...... with her at the door," Lan Xuan said in a hurry, but she was incoherent.
"What's going on?" Mu Hanzhang frowned, "Did something happen to her family?" Grandma Zhou was referring to his milkmaid, having a young daughter run to him who was already married, she must have encountered a difficult situation.
"Her son broke his leg the day before yesterday, there is no money for medical treatment, the people in the manor said that their family is old and disabled, they can't work for nothing and eat food, they want to drive them out." Lan Ting, who came later, was busy taking over the conversation, otherwise Lan Xuan's stupid mouth would not have pissed the young master off for good or bad, "She came to find you, because she wanted to borrow some silver from you."
"I know, you guys go down." Mu Hanyang pursed her lips, there is no cash silver in her hands, there are some jewels in her dowry, but pawning her dowry when she just got married is hitting her husband in the face, and it is something she can't do.
In the garden, Jing Shao was dressed in a white suit, a long sword danced in a flowing stream. After practicing a set of swordsmanship, Jing Shao withdrew his momentum, just in time to see his own princess standing by the rockery, threw his sword to the maid at the side, and while taking a cloth towel to wipe his sweat, he walked over to Mu Huanzhang's side, and seeing his appearance of wanting to say something, he smiled softly and said, "Junqing, is there something wrong?"
Mu Hanyang pursed her lips, lowered her eyes and whispered, "Can you, lend me a hundred taels of silver?"

chapters.title: XVII - Rumors
chapters.content:
Jing Shao froze for half a day before reacting to the fact that his own princess was borrowing money from him. Unable to help but furrow his brows, he pulled up Mu Hanzhang and went to the study of the Listening Wind Pavilion, taking a small box of ebony and gold to him, "You can take these first, and tell me again if it's not enough."
"Nurse's family had an accident, I don't have any cash silver in my hand," Mu Hanzhang lowered his head, "When the manor collects the rent, I'll give it back to you." While saying this, he opened the box, inside there are about one hundred taels of gold and silver each, and a stack of silver bills, each one thousand taels, a total of five.
"Say that again!" When Jing Shao heard this, his fire rubbed off and he reached out to pinch Mu Hanzhang's chin, forcing him to look at himself.
Mu Hanzhang was startled, dumbfounded, looking at the fuming Jing Shao, realizing that it was wrong to face her husband and say that she would pay back the money, pursed her lips and said, "My manor had a bad harvest, and I'm afraid that these 5,000 taels, for 10 or 20 years, won't be able to pay back the money."
Obviously is not pay back the words, Jing Shao's mood is strangely good up, but still pinch his chin shook: "Something on the come to find me, raise you originally is my responsibility." After saying that, in that still pursed lips on a kiss, before Yiyizhen went out to continue practicing sword.
Mu Hanzhang looked at the ebony box in his hand and sighed lightly.
Taking out a hundred taels of cash silver, letting Lan Ting take one of the guards on a trip to the farm, Mu Hanzhang looked at this rather generous pocket money, and his mind came alive. Marquis Beiwei's property, either a barren forest, or a bad harvest of the fields, the capital of the store is not one.
Mu Hanyang's own mother is a merchant origin, although did not learn from his mother to argue, recognize those skills, but look at the account, the ability to operate is still there. Jing Shao gave this five thousand taels, enough for him to plate a restaurant in the capital, only part of it to buy a small store is also good, at least not to sit empty.
The ebony box will be put away, Mu Hanzhang decided to go out in the next two days to see what suitable business can be done, a gentleman in the world, when there is the basis of life.
I have an idea, Mu Hanzhang mood will be better, of course, there is another thing that makes him happy, that is, today is the fifteenth of March, according to the last roster, today Jing Shao when to go to the side of the lady's room. These nights, Jing Shao always pestered him with kisses and hugs, the same is a man, he knows how easy it is to hold on, so every day is afraid, until Jing Shao fell asleep to rest assured that sleep.
After dinner, Jing Shao again came to his own Wangfei's side to consume food, Mu Hanzhang made a wink towards Duofu. Duofu wrinkled his bun face in embarrassment, and coughed lightly, "Your Highness, the Wangfei fixed the roster a few days ago, today you should go to the side lady's courtyard."
Jing Shao raised his eyes to look at the frowning Duo Fu, "Roster? How was it finalized?"
"The first half of the month is in the East Garden, the second half is in the West Garden, nine days for side wives, and three days each for concubines." Mu Hanzhang took out the roster and showed it to him.
Jing Shao frowned, "I'm not in the mood tonight." After saying that, he yawned and climbed into bed.
Mu Hanzhang can not, heart that he may be practicing the sword for a long time, so he did not think too much, read a book for a while also went to the bed. Which know just went up, was Jing Shao a roll over underneath.
"Your Highness ......" Mu Hanzhang's body instantly tightened.
Jing Shao raised his hand and tugged, the tent immediately dropped. Mu Hanzhang more nervous, hands on the shoulders of Jing Shao, this person did not say that tonight is not interested in it?
Feeling that the reaction of the person underneath him was very interesting, Jing Shao slowly moved over and gently sucked kisses on the side of his neck, then looked up at him, only to see his eyes tightly closed and his long, slender eyelashes trembling non-stop. Unable to bear to scare him anymore, he rolled over and took him into his arms, "If you let me touch it, I'll let you go tonight."
Hearing such blunt words, Mu Hanzhang's face quickly reddened, "Touch ...... touch where?"
"Well ...... last time I kissed here," Jing Shao one finger on that beautiful collarbone spinning, felt the body in his arms afraid of itching shrink, gently tugged some of that soft lapel, "just a little bit down, okay? "
Mu Hanyang bit his lower lip, embarrassed and did not know how to answer, Jing Shao then took him as a default, and beautifully put his wolf claws into the lapel of someone else's coat. With thin callus big hand in that white chest gently caress, Jing Shao while sighing the skin feel really good, while touching the location of the two small beans.
"Mmm...... "Mu Hanyang turned her back to Jing Shao, one hand gripping the bed sheet tightly, letting that hand roam around her body, until two fingers suddenly pinched a small bean, "Hmm... ...Don't ......" a burst of numbness and itchiness exploded from that point, his body trembled uncontrollably, and he finally couldn't help but press down on that strange hand.
For touching turned into a pinch, Jing Shao did not have the embarrassment of being caught in the bag at all, smiled and kissed the person in his arms perspiring forehead, gave him a good cover and gathered into his arms, rubbed beautifully before going to sleep.
In this way, for several days in a row, every night, Jing Shao was either tired or said he was late, anyway, the end result is to stay in the East Garden again. Mu Hanzhang guessed that Jing Shao may not like Song, so he did not rush him again, but only to consider the next month to the two concubines to share a few more days.
Originally March 18 Jing Shao should go back to the court, but he went to the book and delayed a few days, so the morning of March 20, His Royal Highness the King of Cheng is still in his wife's bed huffing and puffing.
Waking up early in the morning, for the big hand that had run to his chest again, Mu Hanzhang could only sigh helplessly, reaching out to take it out of his lapel and slowly sitting up.
Being moved, Jing Shao reached out in a daze, hugged someone's waist, and rubbed over to continue sleeping with his eyes closed.
"Aren't you going to the other house today? Still can't afford it?" Mu Hanzhang helplessly pushed him.
"There's no rush." Jing Shao muttered, burying his face in someone's waist.
"Tomorrow it's time to go to court, it's better to finish things today," Mu Hanzhang looked at one of his exposed ears and couldn't help but reach out and tug on it, "That Ren Feng doesn't sound like someone from the capital, how did he become your commander of the close guards?"
"He was originally a warrior who traveled the countryside, and only followed me in the right direction because of a lack of money." Jing Shao opened his eyes and lay down flat.
Jianghu? Those legendary warriors in novels? These actually exist? Mu Hanzhang heard this and couldn't help but get curious.
"Jianghu really exists, it's just not as exaggerated as in the books," Jing Shao rolled over and got out of bed, stretching, "Next time I'll take you to see those Jianghu warriors." He was going to ask Ren Feng to start recruiting the capable people in the Jianghu, according to the experience of his previous life, in the 14th year of Hongzheng, that is, next year, the three-fold fight will start, before that, he must be prepared for everything.
Jing Shao went out to go, and Mu Hanzhang, who had nothing to do, also took Yunzhu out for a walk.
The main street in the capital was bustling with activity every day. From big liquor stores, pawnshops, and antique stores, to small art sellers and candy blowers.
"Young master, it's getting late, let's find a place to eat." Yunzhu touched the hungry flat alone and proposed, it was not good to call the princess outside, so he called the young master along with Lanting and the girls.
Mu Hanzhang smiled and looked at the gluttonous Yunzhu, "Where to eat?"
"Naturally, it's the Retrospective House," Yunzhu immediately came to the spirit, "this moment to go just right, and then later on every seat."
Although Mu Hanzhang do not often go out, back to the flavor of the building or heard of, only two years ago to open the restaurant, because of the cooking of the Central Plains food is particularly delicious, business has been very red-hot.
Taste of the building in the decoration is not very exquisite, good in clean and neat, tables and chairs placed quite a lot, must be because of good business to add more tables. Two people sat down soon, the surrounding began to sit one after another, not long to full.
"Young Master, do you know who the owner of this place is?" Yunzhu came to Mu Hanzhang's ear and whispered.
"Who is it?" Mu Hanzhang took a sip of tea, and his gaze fell on the young shopkeeper behind the counter with his head bowed as he counted the accounts. The man was tall and had a strong face, but he was wearing an emerald green tunic, which was really strange.
"That person is the male wife of the minister of the household department." Yunzhu mysteriously said, the Ministry of households is the South, handsome is handsome, is a little short, while his male wife is a northern man, looks tall and powerful, the colleagues in the court did not less that the Ministry of households jokes.
"Oh?" Hearing this, Mu Hanzhang's eyes lit up, since the wife of the Minister of the Household can open a restaurant, then he should not have anyone gossiping if he opens a few stores, right? Thinking this way, Mu Hanzhang had a few thoughts of making friends with this boss, but he didn't know how Jing Shao's relationship with the Minister of the Household was, so it was better to go back and ask him about it.
"Hey, have you heard? There's a recent rumor that the Fourth Prince enjoys eating human flesh." A person at the neighboring table lowered his voice and spoke to his companion.
"It's not that disgusting, I heard it's like eating the placenta, that one's a great tonic, some powerful people eat that too." A person next to him corrected.
"Haha, you all ah don't know as well as I do," the person at the other table heard their conversation, laughed, mysteriously came over and said, "This fourth prince was born a little weak, and back then there was a Taoist priest who said that he had to eat a bowl of raw baby meat every year in order to live for a long time. "
Mu Hanzhang lowered his head and sipped his tea silently, the people of the Chen Dynasty were open to marrying male wives and discussing court politics, so rumors about the royal family were able to circulate quickly. It was just that I didn't know what news Jing Shao had allowed to be spread, but it had become so bizarre!

chapters.title: chapter xviii - the little chamberlain
chapters.content:
On March 21st of the 13th year of Hongzheng, King Cheng returned to the court.
Jing Shao stood in the splendid hall, looking at each and every familiar or unfamiliar face in front of him, only to feel that it was like a lifetime ago. That year, he was kneeling in the center of the hall, listening to everyone counting his sins.
The Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue accused him of selling salt quotas, the Secretary of the Ministry of Public Works accused him of building a large number of buildings, and even the royal historian accused him of killing prisoners and deceiving the people. But more than anything else, he is a traitor to the emperor and intends to plot against the emperor. The faces of those people have seen one by one, the Duke of Maoguo is the future father-in-law of the four emperors, Yongchang Bo is the successor's own brother, the Ministry of households and the Ministry of Public Works, two ministers are the emperor's people, and the rest of them are mostly followers.
After the relatives on the side of nature is to suppress, as for the two ministers, Jing Shao will aim at the household department standing behind the minister of the household department of the minister of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Ministry of the Interior, that year, he is willing to say a word of justice, in addition to his brother's people is the small minister. He is a clear stream of a faction, people are not rigid, is five years ago, the new scholarship, straight career all the way up to the minister, but until the Jing Shao accident have not been promoted again, perhaps this person can be pulled together, for the position of Shangshu.
Jing Shao was pondering when his elder brother standing beside him suddenly touched him with his elbow and jerked his head up, realizing that his father and all the ministers were looking at him, and that the Imperial Historian Fan Jie was standing in the center of the hall.
"Rumors of the Fourth Prince." Jing Chen clenched his teeth, his lips unmoving, and gave him the hint in a soft voice.
Jing Shao understood, stepped forward and said, "My son thought that the words of the foolish people are nothing more than idle talk after tea, not enough to worry about." The answer could be described as moderate, and Emperor Hongzheng turned his gaze back to Jing Chen.
Jing Chen stepped forward and said, "The ancient saying goes, 'Hoven phrases come to the nest, and there is no wind in the empty cave. If the one who is entrusted with it is true, then the wind is different.'' Since there are such rumors in the folklore, there must be a reason for it, it's better to clarify it as early as possible so as not to tarnish Fourth Imperial Brother's reputation."
The meaning of the brothers' answers contradicted each other, and it was obvious that they did not know beforehand, and even if they did, they had not discussed it, so Emperor Hongzheng nodded his head in satisfaction, "Jingyu, tell us yourself what is going on?"
Fourth Prince Jing Yu out of the line, kneeling at the bottom of the stairs, said: "I am afraid, only because a year ago the East Japan tribute some fresh sea fish, cut into thin slices of raw food is enough fresh, I think the children feel delicious and then more use some, do not want to be in the house of the underlings mistakenly rumor, which has caused a storm in the city. My son is guilty."
The fourth prince into the dynasty time is still short, responsible for tributes to all things, overseas rare things naturally got a lot.
"The royal family is the example of the world, your every move will naturally be noticed by the people, how can you be so obsessed with the things of the mouth and stomach?" Emperor Hongzheng was a bit annoyed, it was most taboo for people in the royal family to be too paranoid about anything.
"Fourth Imperial Brother is really blessed with a mouthful, this kind of rare thing is something that my son has never seen before." Eldest Prince Jing Rong said with a smirk, causing Emperor Hong Zheng's frown to tighten, the tributes from the foreign countries, except for the emperor, no one had the right to enjoy them at will. The meaning in the Grand Prince's words was quite profound.
"Father forgive me, that fish I only got two at mother's place, I really didn't crave it!" Jing Yu glared at the Grand Prince who didn't mind, and busily kowtowed to explain.
"Hmph!" Emperor Hongzheng snorted coldly, the fact that there would be such rumors in the capital was, in his opinion, entirely the result of the Fourth Prince's flaunting of good deeds, and as for the matter of the tribute, it really should be thoroughly investigated.
In the end, Emperor Hongzheng decreed that the fourth prince would be grounded for a month to face the wall. Although this punishment was not serious, in Emperor Hongzheng's mind, a bad impression had been formed, and that was enough.
Jing Shao spread this rumor, originally wanted to cover up the rumors about himself, by the way, disgusted the fourth prince and the stepmother, did not expect to develop into such an effect, really is a pleasant surprise. Quietly glanced at the side of the expressionless elder brother, suddenly thought, perhaps when they decided on this "topic", brother has already considered.
After the court, the two brothers did not say a word, looked at each other and went their own way. Jing Shao while sighing brother really more suitable for that position than their own, while thinking of going back to talk to their own Wangfei said today's things, by the way, kissing and touching ......
"Your Highness, going straight back to the royal residence?" The driver asked as he pulled back the curtain.
Jing Shao thought about it, he got up early in the morning, so he ate a bowl of porridge and a pancake, thought about it and said, "Go to Hui Wei House for breakfast."
"Your Highness, the House of Recollection is not open in the morning." Yun Song reminded.
"It's fine, just go." Jing Shao put down the car curtain, leaning on the soft pillow to rest his eyes. This soft pillow is mu hanzhang specially ordered people to put up, think jing shao get up early will be sleepy, so also can sleep in the car for a while.
It's true that Hui Mei Lou doesn't buy breakfast, but the owner of the place comes early to open the door and clean up the store, and prepares breakfast for her husband, who is returning from the court.
Ministry of household minister surnamed Xiao, name far, word Hengzhi. Speaking of which, he and the second prince consort mother's family - Dingnan Marquis Xiao family is the same clan, but has been five services outside the distant relatives, Xiao Yuan is noble, has been reluctant to climb this relative.
The House of Returning Flavors only had one door open, and a fellow was sweeping the floor in front of the door alone, as Jing Shao walked in with his hands behind his back.
"Hengzhi, you're back." The tall boss dressed in a greenish-blue cloth came out from the back kitchen with a cage of steaming buns in his hand, and froze for a moment when he saw Jing Shao, then laughed, "Sorry customer, Hui Taste House hasn't opened yet."
"Good day ma'am," Jing Shao greeted with a smile, "I'm Xiao Yuan's fellow officer, and I've come to discuss a matter with him."
Mrs. Squire frowned slightly, letting Jing Shao sit down, giving him the xiao long bao in her hand to eat, and serving a bowl of boiled sticky rice porridge out.
"Madam is really good at craftsmanship, I also married a male wife, but not as handy as Madam." Jing Shao ate a bun, the thin as white paper crust melted in his mouth, the fresh and fragrant meat filling with soup, when he bit into it, his lips and teeth were suddenly fragrant.
"I can't read much, I only know how to cook, Your Ladyship is a person with great wisdom, never compare with a vulgar person like me." The boss smiled and said.
Jing Shao froze, this person actually knows his identity, and then smiled: "Mrs. really intelligent, I do not know how to call?" Male wives and female wives are different, in the end, it is still a man, others can be completely direct to ask his name is not an offense.
"Your Highness is too polite, my surname is Zhou, with a single name, the word Jing." Zhou Zhuan's rather bright personality was very much in Jing Shao's favor, and he couldn't help but chat with him a few more times.
Thus, when Xiao Yuan swung back in his sedan chair, he saw a certain prince with whom he had little interaction, eating his own dunked dumplings, drinking rice congee from his own tavern, and chatting happily with his own wife, and only felt the veins on his forehead jutting out, "My humble servant has met His Highness, the King of Cheng!"
"Haha, Lord Xiao is back. I was passing by, so I came to your house to dine. These buns are so delicious, Lord Xiao is truly blessed." Jing Shao said as he stuffed the last dunking bun into his mouth, and Ula said, "Brother Zhou, is there any more?"
"There." Zhou Zhuan smiled and turned around to get the buns from the back kitchen.
"What's the matter with His Majesty?" The fair-faced young retainer's face was now darker than the bottom of a pot. Does this person know any etiquette at all, in front of him as his husband, he still dares to call his wife "Big Brother Zhou"! The two of them shouldn't have known each other before, right?
"It's nothing really, it's just that I heard that Lord Xiao and your wife are very affectionate," Jing Shao paused for a moment, raised his eyes to look around, and came to Xiao Yuan's ear, lowering his voice, "This king just wants to ask you for some advice on how to make a male wife no longer fear the matter of bed brother. "
Xiao Yuan froze, looked at Jing Shao quite sincere face, pull down the corners of the mouth slowly raised up: "So it is so, then the king is looking for the right person ......" So, the usually reticent Lord Servant, suddenly turned into the Ministry of Rites, the minister of ceremonies, talking to Jing Shao about the topic of "how to conquer a man's wife". Jing Shao talked about the topic of "how to conquer a man's wife".
When Zhou Zhuan came out with two drawers of buns, he saw the two of them coming together to mutter, occasionally snickering a few times, helplessly shook his head, dotingly glanced at Xiao Yuan, who was red with excitement, and turned around to the back kitchen to direct the small workers to pack today's ingredients.
Sometimes friendships between men are built in an instant, such as Xiao Yuan and Jing Shao, and by the time they left after breakfast, their conversation had turned:
"Heng Zhi, you should ask Big Brother Zhou to take my Junqing out for a walk sometime in the future, I'm afraid he'll be bored alone."
"Don't worry, Your Majesty, it's on me, have you memorized those methods I told you?"
"Well, I'll buy you a drink if it works out."
Jing Shao left contentedly, and Xiao Yuan prettily wandered to the back kitchen to see his own wife.
"What did you talk to King Cheng about? Your face is all red." Zhou Zhuan pinched his own prime minister's chin and took a closer look.
"Humph!" Xiao Yuan shook off his hand and said angrily, "I still want to ask you, what did you say to him before I came back? Why did he call you Big Brother Zhou on his way out?"
"Let me give you a kiss and I'll tell you." Zhou Zhuan hugged him in a gesture to kiss.
Xiao Yuan was busy pushing away the lady who was a head taller than him, and grumbled under his breath, "If you don't tell the truth, you'll be punished for wearing water-pink clothes tomorrow!" After saying this, he flung his sleeves and walked out.
"I don't have buff colored clothes." Zhou Zhuan said helplessly, every time he overdid it, this person would ask himself to wear all sorts of colorful clothes, causing everyone in the entire capital to know that the owner of the Tasteful House had a strange nature.
"I'll buy it for you when I get off duty!" Xiao Yuan waved his hand and headed for the Ministry of Household in a rather good mood.
"I didn't do anything ...... last night," Zhou Zhuan muttered, and then he hooked a bad smile, since he was going to wear the color of water pink, he had to make a good profit tonight.
Jing Shao returned to the royal residence, thinking about the various methods Xiao Yuan had introduced to him towards the East Court, and just before he reached the door of the small study, he heard the shrill voice of the side lady Song: "The rules of the royal residence are such that even the king consort can't break this precedent, or else this royal residence will be in disarray in the future."
"But it's just an underling's side yard for temporary residence, and their expenses will just come out of my allowance." Mu Hanzhang's voice was still gentle, but it could be heard that there was already some hidden anger.
"Wangfei said it really lightly, forgive me for speaking frankly, Wangfei married over on the eighth day of March, this month there is simply no points, let concubine from where to deduct?" Song Lingxin's voice that didn't budge an inch sounded a bit shrill, and made Jing Shao, who was originally in a good mood, instantly burst into flames.

chapters.title: XIX - Clowns
chapters.content:
"Shut up!" Jing Shao walked in with a cold face.
Song Ling Xin, who was standing in the center of the study with one hand on her waist, swallowed back the breath she had originally raised in her chest.
Mu Hanzhang sat in front of his desk, frowning slightly, when he saw Jing Shao come in, the look on his face eased a little and he stood up to give him a salute, "Your Highness has returned."
Jing Shao walked over to Mu Hanzhang's side and glanced at Song Lingxin and the two maids behind her, "Song Lingxin, what kind of attitude is this towards the crown princess?"
"Your Highness ~" Song Lingxin screamed in aggravation, took a deep breath and said, "My concubine is for the peace of the royal family, the crown princess he ......"
"You shut up!" Jing Shao felt a headache when he heard Song Lingxin's shrill voice and turned his head to the person beside him, easing his tone and asking, "Junqing, what's going on?"
Mu Hanzhang lowered her eyes, pursed her lips and said, "Nurse's health is not good, there is no one to take care of her in the farm, I want to receive her and her son into the Wang Fu's servant's room for a period of time, and let them go back when Zhou Da's leg injury is healed." The warm and pleasant voice spoke without haste, very comfortable to listen to.
"Your Highness, the royal residence has always refrained from entering outsiders, this is the rule, once the crown princess starts this, in the future, won't it be possible for anyone who wants to stuff this place?" Song Lingxin argued with reason, in her opinion, among the royal family, the most taboo thing is to have other people's spies in the mansion, as long as you hold this point, you don't believe that the king will stand on Mu Hanzhang's side.
Jing Shao frowned.
Song Lingxin saw that she got to the point, a hint of complacency flooded her heart, "The concubine is in charge of the inner house's large and small affairs, so she has to be responsible for this inner house, and the subordinate's rooms are all at the back of the West Court, so if any person of unknown origin comes in, it's impossible to say what has happened."
The West Garden is living in the concubine female family, the so called accident, naturally refers to some bad sounding ...... Mu Hanzhang slowly clenched his fists, Song Lingxin spoke so, it is clear that he is insulting him.
"Slap!" Before Mu Hanzhang could speak, Jing Shao's slap had already slapped Song Lingxin's face.
Song's eyes widened as she looked at Jing Shao incredulously.
"Since you can't manage the inner house well, you'll hand over all the account books to the crown princess today." Jing Shao said coldly.
"Your Highness!" Song Lingxin covered her face, not understanding how she was suddenly beaten when she clearly had the upper hand and had her right to be the head of the house taken away from her on the spot, she couldn't help but raise her voice and shrillly say, "Concubine is looking out for the sake of the royal family, how could you do this to concubine! Wangfei is simply not good at governing the royal household! The roster set the rules, and during the nine days that the concubine served in the bed, the king didn't go even for a single day! Who would listen to such a person if he holds the center feeder!"
"Enough! From today onwards, the side lady is grounded for a month!" Jing Shao rubbed the corners of his distended forehead and looked at Song, who was still struggling and screaming under the persuasion of his subordinates, and waved his hand, "Pull it out! Without this king's permission, you are not allowed to step out of the courtyard."
The guards outside the door walked in, and the two maids persuaded Song Ling Xin to pull and tug and walk out.
The room was finally quiet, Jing Shao sighed and picked up the half-drunk tea on the table from Mu Hanzhang and swallowed a large mouthful.
"I was a bit anxious when I received the news early this morning, and I was momentarily ill-considered." Mu Hanzhang saw him drinking from his own cup, and in no hurry to stop him, so he did not say anything more, but for the matter of receiving the nurse to the royal residence, it was indeed he who had not thought it through well.
"You are the crown princess of this house, what you say cannot be questioned by others," Jing Shao laughed and gently wrapped his arms around him, "I didn't go to the West Garden these past few days, Song Lingxin is just using the topic to give play to it."
Mu Hanzhang pursed her lips, "I can take the milkmaid to the manor that I accompanied ......"
"No," Jing Shao touched his soft and smooth long hair, "received to the mansion, if you want to let them live all the time can also, go to the Marquis of Bei Wei House to discuss, count them as your accompanying room is." The dowry not only includes property, but also includes some accompanying rooms, Jing Shao knows that Jun Qing's accompanying rooms are very few, since his nurse's family is his trusted, stay in the mansion for him to call is a good thing.
Mu Hanzhang looked at him steadily, slowly came over and put his chin on Jing Shao's shoulder, "Little Spoon, thank you." Husband's support is very important for the status of the first wife and the management of the inner house, now Jing Shao is completely on his side, even obvious favoritism, how rare this kind of treatment is in the house of princes and lords, no one is more aware of it than him.
Jing Shao was thrilled at Mu Hanzhang's initiative to get closer, only feeling the numbness and itchiness on his shoulder where he was in contact with him, he couldn't help but reach out and hug him tightly, "Fool, we're husband and wife, what are you thanking me for? If you really want to thank me, give me a kiss." Originally sensational words, said to later become unorthodox again.
Mu Hanzhang heard this and gently pushed him away, "His Majesty just said no thanks." After saying this, he turned around and went to get the account book, completely ignoring Jing Shao who froze in place.
Her own princess, really, is getting worse and worse!
After dining at the royal residence at lunchtime, Jing Shao wandered over to the Ministry of War where he was posted.
The defense of the Xiongnu returned, his brothers are in the six ministries, Hongzheng Emperor let Jing Shao to his favorite Ministry of War to. The eldest prince in the Ministry of Industry is responsible for all construction matters, his brother in the Ministry of Rites is responsible for all major ceremonies, banquets, the fourth prince in the Honglu Temple specializing in tribute matters of the foreign countries, are some of the positions that can do the facts, can make a splash.
And he is in the Ministry of War, said to serve, in fact, there is no real power, just hanging high there, the Ministry of War people do not like a prince in the head of the finger, he used to be very tired of these paperwork, every day to come to swing around to deal with two things on the go.
"Your Majesty!" Seeing this great Buddha arrive, the Minister of Military Affairs was busy greeting him with a smile.
"Lord Sun go and get busy, this king is just here to take point." Jing Shao said with a wave of his hand, walking to his seat and casually picking up a few documents to read.
Sun Shangshu was also used to him being like this, and after a few polite words, he went to busy himself.
Not come for a long time, Jing Shao's desk did not pile up much paperwork. The following news up, urgent Sun Shangshu are dealt with, only some not too urgent will give into the Ministry of War not long Jing Shao processing, so many days he did not come, most Sun Shangshu will be approved for him.
Pick up a booklet on the table, this is the Ministry of War in the preparation of this year's military pay, which has already counted the number of specific food and pay for each garrison. There are also two folders, one of the request to lay off soldiers, that the Huns have been defeated, do not need too many soldiers in recent years; the other reported that the southwest of the Miao border near the invasion of barbarians, please the court to send troops to suppress.
The first one was fine, but this second one looked rather urgent and was also on his desk, suggesting that someone wanted him to come up with an idea as soon as possible.
"Your Highness, this zhangzhi only arrived today, and the situation seems to be more serious than it was at the beginning of the month." Song An, the Minister of War, came over and said.
Jing Shao nodded slightly and began to look through that army payroll.
"As far as I know, this barbarians are nothing more than roving bandits, and only because of the incompetence of the Governor of Yunnan and Tibet, they are losing ground." Song An came closer and whispered, "Your Highness can request to lead troops to hang the bandits, this is a good opportunity to easily make a merit."
Jing Shao looked up, frowning at him. Song An was Song Ling Xin's father, and was considered the closest to Jing Shao in the Ministry of War. It was the same in his last life, when he received the first zhangzhi a month ago, this man advised him to lead the troops to the front. At that time, he was in a bad mood, the fourth day of the wedding on the troops went to war, the just passed the door and is still sick Mu Hanzhang left alone in the royal residence. Now it seems that Song An persuaded him to go to war, not all to let him make a success, most likely to let him cold princess, so as to protect her daughter's position as the head of the family.
"The Governor of Yunnan and Tibet is also not a dry meal, which in this world can be easily obtained military service?" Jing Shao snorted, not counting on continuing to discuss this issue with him.
This expedition to Yunnan and Tibet seems to be an easy errand, in fact, it is not, the southwest side of the environment is complex, these soldiers who are always in the Central Plains are difficult to adapt. Back then, he led his soldiers to go there, but the result was that he suffered a big loss just after he went there, miasma and poisonous insects were all deadly enemies, and he himself almost died there. That so-called small group of roving bandits made him fight for three whole years, not only was he reprimanded by his father, but he also missed the best time to conquer San Fan, a real effort that was not pleasing to the eyes.
Song An smiled sardonically, "I heard that Ling Xin made Your Highness angry today, this daughter has been spoiled by me, Your Highness should not be general with her."
"Humph!" Jing Shao slammed the account book in his hand onto the table with a bang, causing the people around him to look sideways and quickly avoid their gazes, "But it's just a small matter in the inner house, why does Lord Song need to talk about it here." This Song Lingxin is really fast-talking, what happened in the morning was spread to her mother's house after lunch. Thinking about this, his heart became a little tired of it.
Seeing Jing Shao's impatience, Song An accompanied him with a smile and said a few words, then he slipped away.
Sent off the nagging Song An, Jing Shao re-picked up the folders to see, this hard work this time he will never lead, there are these time might as well be at home with his wife, such a good opportunity should be given to the big brother or the fourth emperor brother is.
After hanging out at the Ministry of War for the afternoon, Jing Shao still left early according to the habits of his previous life so as not to attract attention. Hiking to the south of the city to buy some marinated snacks, and to the alley to carry a bottle of plum wine, back to the royal residence just in time for dinner.
"Where is Wangfei?" Back in the East Court bedroom, the meal had already been set up, but there was no sign of Mu Hanzhang.
"Back to Your Highness, the crown princess is still governing in the small study, Mengxi has already gone to invite her." Zhi Ruoxi replied as she helped Jing Shao change.
"Your Highness has been waiting for a long time, I'm late." Mu Hanzhang said somewhat apologetically.
Jing Shao frowned and cupped his chin and kissed him, "Let's eat."
Mu Hanzhang stunned for a moment, only to react to the "words politely punished", but now the room is full of subordinates, this person is not even a little bit of consideration! A handsome face quickly red, busy waving his hand to let the maids retreat.
"What are you busy with?" Jing Shao pushed the bought lo mein in front of Mu Hanzhang for him to try, while he himself poured a cup of green plum wine for each of the two.
"Suddenly taking over the affairs of the inner house, there is no need to be a little busy." Mu Hanzhang picked up a piece of marinated chicken wings and took a bite, although he said this, his tone was very confident, Jing Shao heard that he could solve it by himself, so he did not intend to ask.
After dinner, Mu Hanzhang pushed Jing Shao who climbed onto the bed again, "Tonight it's time to go to the West Court side, today's words of the side lady you have heard, if you have been lodging in the East Court, this inner house is afraid to be unsettled."
Jing Shao reluctantly sat up and dragged his own princess, who was babbling non-stop and wanted to push him towards others, onto the bed and pressed her sharply underneath him, "I drank too much tonight, I don't have the strength to move." After saying that, he lay down on his chest and didn't move.
Mu Hanzhang rolled his eyes, someone who can drink two pounds of roasted knives would be intoxicated by a small bottle of plum wine as light as white water? Find a reason to find a reasonable one!

chapters.title: XX - Misunderstandings
chapters.content:
"To sleep, you always have to take off your clothes." Mu Hanzhang helplessly pushed the person on top of him.
"I'll help you take it off." Jing Shao, who was still limp, instantly got energized and sat up and started to undo the clothes and belt of the person underneath him.
"I ...... will do it myself." Mu Hanzhang was busy pulling the hand that was tugging at the sash around his waist.
Jing Shao smiled at his words and lowered the tent, sitting to the side and staring straight at the others.
Mu Hanzhang's face turned even redder, quickly stripping off his outer and middle clothes and burrowing under the covers. Jing Shao looked amused, and also took off his own clothes and burrowed in, fishing the person over and kissing his forehead.
Xiao Yuan told him that he must treat his male wife gently and respectfully in bed, and that kissing is more effective than groping, because it will not make him feel ashamed. Kissing from the forehead to the center of the eyebrows, and then to the slightly cool tip of the nose and soft lips, the person in his arms closed his eyes somewhat nervously, but did not resist.
Jing Shao secretly said that this method is really effective, gently pull open that snow white inner shirt, the lamp outside the bed is not yet extinguished, through the light coming in through the tent, can clearly see that delicate throat knots, beautifully shaped collarbone. Holding back from putting his claws on it, he instead propped himself up on the bed and leaned down to kiss along his chin, licking across the white neck. That lovely throat knot slid up and down a bit, Jing Shao hooked his lips and continued down.
The white chest was slightly thin, but it wasn't as skinny as one would expect, instead it had nice smooth lines of muscles, and two little pink beans shyly shrunk their heads. So beautiful, I want to touch it! Jing Shao swallowed his saliva and moved over to take in a pink tender.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang bit his lower lip, numbness, itchy, warlike feeling instantly spread all over his body, wanted to push away the person on top of him, but felt pity from his gentle movements, only to clench the sheets underneath his body, and in his heart he told himself to hold back for a little while longer, and satisfy him a A little bit. Let that uncomfortable and comfortable feeling, the tide like a one by one impact on their own bodies.
Feeling the indulgence of the person underneath him, Jing Shao couldn't help but become even more agitated, taking the small thing in his mouth and gently crushing and biting it.
"Ah ......唔...... "Mu Hanzhang's body began to tremble slightly, too much sensation forcing him to arch his body.
Jing Shao got a response and couldn't help but get a little carried away, reaching down and touching the two rounded pieces through a layer of snow satin.
"Well ...... don't ......" Mu Hanzhang instantly came to his senses and violently shrunk his body upwards, opening his eyes to look in horror at the person who was frozen with one hand on the bed.
The two stared at each other for a moment, and Mu Hanzhang, who had half propped up his body, lowered his head in some embarrassment. Jing Shao was stirred up by this sudden change of heart, immediately lost interest, secretly annoyed at himself for being too hasty. Sighing, he rolled over and lay down on his side, face facing the wall and getting angry with himself.
Mu Hanzhang see him angry, slowly clenched the hands of the quilt corner, and slowly loosened, and again clenched, pulled over to Jing Shao cover, their own silently lie down, staring at the top of the tent dazed. Yourself this appearance, again let him disappointed it ......
Ruminating all night, Mu Hanzhang didn't fall into a deep sleep until the dawn.
On the following day, that barbarian invasion report was indeed brought to the court by the Secretary of the Ministry of War.
"Jing Shao, what do you think of the southern barbarians' fighting strength?" This zhangzuo Emperor Hongzheng had read it yesterday, the reason why he asked Jing Shao's opinion first was because Song An, the minister of the Ministry of War, had proposed on the approval of the proposal to let King Cheng, who had just returned from a victory, lead the troops forward.
"My son thinks that although the southern barbarians are mountain villagers, but since they can fight over the Governor of Yunnan and Tibet, they naturally have their own strengths, so they should not be taken lightly." Jing Shao spoke truthfully, laying out the fact that this matter is difficult, while implying that this is an opportunity to take credit.
Emperor Hongzheng slightly converged his eyebrows, could not tell if he was happy or angry: "What do the ministers think?"
The courtroom was silent for a moment, and there were people who came out to offer advice.
Some people say that the southern barbarians are a desolate place, and the mountains occupied by a few unruly people are not rich, so it is better to let them go. Immediately someone refuted, said so what is the national prestige, the king's prestige, must send troops to suppress.
Then there are those who say that the terrain of Yunnan and Tibet is complicated, and the people in that area are ignorant, so we must send a courageous and resourceful general to go there, not only to suppress the rebellion, but also to appease the people.
A time the courtroom noise into a pot of porridge, shut up in addition to the Hongzheng emperor, will only stand in the first three princes. Jing Shao glanced at the side of the elder brother and the eldest prince, which remembered that the fourth prince was grounded, if the fourth prince is smart enough then should take the initiative to ask for war, if it is too smart ...... eyes drifted to the eldest prince who wanted to speak, Jing Shao drooped eyes flashed a cold light, then we will see who is more unlucky for these two people a little bit.
Finally, Emperor Hongzheng stopped the people's quarrel and concluded, "Although the southern barbarians are barren, they are also the land of Dachen, and I will never allow the kingdom laid down by Taizu to fall by the wayside, not even one inch!"
"Your Majesty is holy!" The group of ministers knelt on the ground.
"As for the candidate for commander-in-chief and the number of troops to be ordered, the Ministry of War will discuss a statute, and will discuss it again tomorrow at the court! Retreat!" Emperor Hongzheng finished his speech, and with a wave of his sleeve, he turned around and walked away.
Jing Shao and his brother looked at each other and returned a heartfelt smile.
Woke up this morning, saw his own princess is still sleeping sweet, will quietly over him to dress to the court. Because of the late start to eat in a hurry, Jing Shao took two meat cakes to bring, in the carriage nibbled on the occasion of the happy, his elder brother suddenly drilled into his carriage, told him yesterday, the Ministry of War in the submission of the report, Sun Shangshu found Song An wrote a proposal to the King of the constitution of the expedition.
While cursing Song An for taking matters into his own hands, he also lamented that his elder brother really had a vast network of people. So he discussed with his brother and simply acted eagerly, so that his father felt that he had colluded with his father-in-law to ask for this errand, so that he would not assign this task to himself.
The brothers got off the court, still without a word of communication, out of the palace door and went their separate ways.
"Hengzhi, the way you taught me is really useful." Jing Shao, who had once again run to Hui Wei House to rub breakfast, was happy to see Xiao Yuan and patted him hard on the back. Last night was a half-hearted attempt, but overall it was a step forward.
Poor Servant Xiao, a scholar, was almost spit out blood by the king who practiced kung fu for years, but on his face, he smiled boldly: "That's right, what I said definitely works." Then he pulled Jing Shao to eat buns while bragging about how he used gentle means to make his tall and powerful wife subdue under him.
Wearing a buff colored coat, Zhou Zhuan stood by the back door and sighed helplessly, signaling the second to send the rice porridge to the two. Last night, I bullied my own husband very much, or first do not come forward to make him angry, and their own clothes are too embarrassing, today or see fewer outsiders good.
Mu Hanyang woke up in the morning and found that the seat beside her was already cold, then she realized with a shock that she had overslept and did not wait for her husband to get up, she could not help but feel a little chagrined, now that person should be even more angry, right?
Jing Shao went out for a day and didn't come back for lunch.
After Mu Hanzhang finished dealing with a few important matters, he held the account book and started to be dumbfounded, how to look at how to read in. Until Yunzhu came to report that the milkmaid's family had moved over, only then did she return to her senses and hurried over.
The subordinates lived in the long house and a few small courtyards between the east and west courtyards and the back door of the royal palace, and Duo Fu specially had a three-room small courtyard vacated for the royal consort's nanny's family to live in. Grandma Zhou packed up the house with a smile on her face, but when she saw Mu Hanzhang, who was dressed in fancy clothes and had a straight posture, she couldn't help but redden her eyes.
"Young master didn't sleep well last night." Renewing her old ways for half a day, Grandma Zhou took Jing Shao's hand to carefully look at his face.
"Uh-huh." Mu Hanzhang responded absentmindedly.
"Could it be that the king he ......" Grandma Zhou worriedly looked at the little young master that she had brought up since childhood, having lived for so many years, she naturally knew more. The pleasure between men, the bearer of the party will inevitably be more hard, see his color is not good, expected that he must have suffered last night, heartbroken to fall tears again.
"I don't blame him," Mu Hanzhang saw that the nanny misunderstood, so he busily opened his mouth to explain, "His Highness treats me very well." For some reason, he just didn't want people close to him to misunderstand Jing Shao.
Seeing that the nanny did not believe it, Mu Hanzhang could only sigh, "It was me ...... who made him angry."
Jing Shao a day without home, really not on purpose, originally he was planning to even the Ministry of War pointing to escape past, go home to eat lunch and take a nap, nah just dabbed breakfast, was sent by the other courtyard guards to stop, said Ren Feng has an urgent matter to look for him.
