Ren Feng was originally a jianghu people, in the road of fame is not bad, just the old mother at home, mixing jianghu is really not stable, they will be gold pot wash their hands after Jing Shao, so as to earn money to support the mother, and then marry a daughter-in-law. And the jianghu that bloody place, can earn money is indeed a minority. Therefore, when Ren Feng sent out the news of King Cheng recruiting talents, soon there are many people come to apply, and today Ren Feng hurriedly looking for Jing Shao's reason, because a martial arts quite famous character appeared in the recruitment team.
When Jing Shao finished settling the affairs of the other manor and returned home, it was already dinner time, and his own princess was sitting in front of the dining table, fidgeting.
Today, Nurse told him that King Cheng is after all a normal man, and is just at the age of blood, no matter how much he favors him, it is impossible to put up with his repeated refusals. Even if he doesn't like those concubines in the West Garden, there are countless people in the capital waiting to climb into his bed, and one day he will like someone else ......
Thinking that Jing Shao would smile gently at someone else in the future, Mu Hanzhang felt a soreness in his heart, so much so that he was so engrossed in his own contemplation that he didn't even notice Jing Shao walking up to him.

chapters.title: XXI. Opportunities
chapters.content:
Jing Shao rarely saw his own Wangfei's dazed look, felt interesting, came over to take advantage of people's surprise, and pecked lightly on those slightly pursed lips.
"Ah!" Mu Hanzhang was startled, realizing it was Jing Shao, she couldn't help but glare at him, "What's this for, Your Highness?"
"It's rare to see you gawking." Jing Shao smiled and sat down next to him, Zhi Xi served the two of them soup and rice and retreated.
Mu Hanzhang picked up the soup bowl and silently took a sip, feeling that tonight's soup had a special fresh flavor.
"Junqing, do you want to learn concealed weapons?" Jing Shao ate a few mouthfuls of food, and when he saw that Mu Hanzhang was just holding his bowl and drinking soup, he gave him a piece of fish.
"A concealed weapon?" Mu Hanzhang looked at him with some confusion, "Why did you suddenly think of this?"
"There is a chivalrous man in the jianghu who is good at using concealed weapons, people call him the Ghost Nine Knives," Jing Shao smiled, remembering the man's appearance, he did look quite like a ghost, "this man went to the Buyeon today to apply for a job."
Although Mu Hanzhang had never heard of any Ghost Nine Daggers, but since they were famous warriors in the Jianghu, how could they put themselves under the command of a prince, and weren't those people meant to stay away from the imperial court?
Jing Shao smiled, seeing that he liked to drink that soup, so he gave him another bowl: "Nowadays, mixing with the jianghu can't earn a few dollars, if these warriors don't want to do some murdering and overstepping, their lives will be very strained."
Legend has it that hundreds of years ago, martial arts really prospered, and at that time, martial arts allies were even able to fight against the imperial court. However, nowadays those great martial arts in ancient times have long been lost, the so-called martial arts masters are not much different from the first grade guards in the palace, besides, most of those who are good at martial arts will go to take the martial arts exams, and there are not many real martial arts masters.
It was just that some capable people still existed, such as those who specialized in concealed weapons like the Ghost Nine Blades.
"All concealed weapons have to be practiced from a young age, besides, I can't practice internal force, even if I learn it well, the power will be greatly reduced." Mu Hanzhang thought about it, but still shook his head and refused.
Jing Shao nodded, but in his heart, he was thinking of having the Ghost Nine Daggers make a few concealed weapons that could be used without internal force for Jun Qing's defense some other day.
After dinner, the two sat on the Luohan bed and drank tea, talking, "clang" sound, Mu Hanzhang hands of the cups and lanterns suddenly fell to the ground.
"Jun Qing?" Jing Shao hurriedly put down the cup in his hand and held his constantly trembling hand, "What's wrong with you?"
"I ...... well ......" Mu Hanzhang's face changed greatly, stood up prancingly, his feet were soft and almost fell down, and he was embraced by Jing Shao.
The breathing of the person in his arms began to become rapid, and sweat seeped out from the corners of his forehead, Jing Shao was anxious and shouted at the door, "Duofu, quickly go find a eunuch!"
"No...... no...... need......" Mu Hanzhang leaned over him, biting the tip of her tongue hard to keep herself calm, "It's the ...... aphrodisiac|drug!"
"What?" Jing Shao's brain buzzed, why would he get hit by this kind of medicine when he was fine?
Duo Fu, who was called in, just happened to hear the words and panicked, kneeling on the ground, "Your Highness! Slave ...... slave servant ......"
"Check! Within one hour, give this king a clear investigation!" Jing Shao roared angrily, picking up the person in his arms and heading towards the inner room.
Duo Fu wiped the sweat from his forehead and turned to go out to gather the guards.
After Jing Shao made sure that he didn't have any symptoms of poisoning other than a feverish body, he helped him take off his outer clothes and put the man on the bed.
"I'm fine ...... well ......" Mu Hanzhang bit her lower lip uncomfortably, clutched her pillow tightly with one hand, and looked at Jing Shao prayerfully, "Little Spoon, can you ...... go out for a while first ...... Well ......"
Jing Shao looked at the person whose face was flushed and who was lying on the bed panting sharply, he only felt a tightness in his lower abdomen and couldn't help but pounce on him, "Junqing, don't be afraid, I'll help you to get rid of the medicinal properties so that it won't be difficult anymore."
"I ......唔...... "Mu Hanzhang glared at him, he was hit by the spring | medicine, but not the soft tendons scattered, the body still have strength, and energy is quite strong, which need others to help! He is still strong and energetic, so he doesn't need any help from others.
Jing Shao smiled, after the worry, tonight's events he more or less guessed what was going on, annoyed, but a little happy, perhaps this is a good opportunity ......
Reaching out to hold the hand that clutched the pillow, entwining the soft, slender fingers with his own, Jing Shao leaned down to bite a reddish ear, and with his other hand, he picked the sash of his middle garment in three or two strokes and pressed his slightly cool hand against the pinkish-colored chest and pressed down on a small bean and crushed it up with force.
"Ah ...... don't ......" Mu Hanzhang's body is now very sensitive, where can it withstand this kind of treatment?
"Junqing, don't be afraid, I won't make it to the end, trust me." Jing Shao said soothingly in a slightly hoarse voice in his ear, raising his hand to gently stroke the top of the hair of the person underneath him, gently and earnestly locking eyes with him.
Mu Hanyang Zhang looked fixedly at the eyes of Jing Shao, remembered the words of the nanny today, such a proud son of heaven, but for their own repeated patience. Do not want this kind of gentle eyes will look at others, then they should do something ...... to this person, themselves, is not without feeling ...... heart clear, only feel in front of the eyes open and clear, Mu Hanyang slowly loosened the bite of the lower lip, lightly nodded.
Jing Shao, as if he had been pardoned, kissed the lips that had been bitten out of the teeth, one hand comforting the pitiful little bean, the other hand reaching downwards, through the silky snow satin, gently holding the little Junqing who was refreshed by the drugs.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang raised his head from the suddenly intensified sensation, and Jing Shao obediently bit down on the knot of the throat that was sliding up and down, at the same time increasing the force in his hand.
Gripping Jing Shao's shoulders tightly with both hands, Mu Hanyang slowly closed her eyes, a clear tear sliding down the corner of her eye from the overly intense feeling.
Fortunately, that drug was only to make the man excited and didn't have any other effect, and by the time Little Junqing spat out his essence, the drug was basically gone. Jing Shao kissed the sweaty forehead of the man in his arms, placed him back on the pillow, and kissed him hard again before taking a deep breath and sitting up.
"Little spoon, you ......" Mu Hanzhang opened his eyes, pulling Jing Shao who wanted to get up and leave, just now he obviously felt that this person also excited.
"I'll go to the purification room." Jing Shao thought about going to the tub to solve his problem.
"I ...... let me help you ......" Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, and the red color that had just receded once again crept onto his handsome face.
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao looked at him in surprise, then took advantage of the person before he recoiled, quickly took off his own clothes, pulling a slender and glistening hand attached to the small Shao. Cupping the face of the person underneath him who had parted because of shyness, he sought out those two pieces of softness and pasted them again.
For a while, the red roped tent was warm, and I didn't know what night it was.
After tossing and turning for nearly an hour, Jing Shao wrapped his arms around the person in his arms who kept gasping for breath, and lay down on the bed contentedly, gently caressing the long smooth hair one by one.
Mu Hanzhang buried her face in that broad chest and glared at him breathlessly. Just now, this person took advantage of his own inattention to sneak attack again, causing himself, who had just deflated once, to deflate once again along with him. At this moment, he only felt that his body's strength had been drained, and he was too lazy to move.
"If you're tired, go to sleep first, I'll go out and take care of this matter." Jing Shao beautifully hugged his wife and took a shower, casually putting on a piece of clothing and heading out.
"I'll go with you." Mu Hanzhang put on his coat, this matter should be a matter of the inner house, when it was right for him to handle it.
There was a room full of people standing in the outer room, a cloaked woman kneeling in the center, crying, Duo Fu saw Jing Shao come over and secretly sighed in relief.
"Your Majesty! Your Highness! I didn't do it, I really didn't do it!" The woman with disheveled hair swooped over and knelt at Jing Shao's feet tugging at the hem of his coat, it was actually Aunt Li!
"The slave girl checked, the medicine was put in the soup, it was some aphrodisiac and aphrodisiac spring|pill, according to tonight's roster, when it was Aunt Li who served the bed." Duo Fu reported the results of the thorough investigation.
The whole soup from the kitchen to serve on the table, there is no problem, then it is in the end on the table after the drug, and can access to the people, only the East Garden bedroom close to wait for the few maids.

chapters.title: chapter xxii. farce
chapters.content:
There was a problem with the close maid, and this matter was much more serious than a concubine using tricks to compete for favor!
Jing Shao cold eyes looked at kneeling on the ground Li, male wives over the door, concubines under the son is the eldest son of the concubine, although can not inherit the title, but can inherit most of the family property, it is no wonder that these concubines will be anxious. Only, they seem to forget that this aphrodisiac spring|pill is not only useful to the king, it is just as useful to the king consort who is a man ...... Thinking about this, there is some subtle stealing in the heart.
"Duo Fu, according to the rules in the royal residence, what should be done about this?" Mu Hanzhang sat down beside Jing Shao, and thought that this concubine of the royal family was really bold, and this kind of thing was not even rare in the Beiwei Marquis' residence.
"Back to Wangfei, a concubine who steals an aphrodisiac drug is to be beaten to death with a messy stick." Duo Fu wrinkled his bun face and answered honestly. This rule, still set by the side lady, was originally sent to the nunnery.
"Your Highness, it really wasn't the slave girl! The slave girl has been with Your Highness for five years, and has never used such tactics!" Li's immediately screamed when she heard that she was beaten to death with a messy stick.
In response to Li's incessant crying, Jing Shao frowned helplessly and waved his hand, "Drag it out."
"Wait." Mu Hanzhang stopped the guards' dragging movements and slowly walked to Li's front, not looking at the woman kneeling on the ground, but just coldly sweeping over a circle of subordinates, "Aunt Li has been with His Highness for many years, and must have a wide range of connections in this residence, as far as this consort knows, only the maids in this East Court, those who have made good friends with Aunt Li are more than half of them." The implication is that she is not to be blamed for this matter no matter what. This is the first time Mu Hanzhang use "this consort" this title, gentle and pleasant voice with love | things after the languor, but it makes people feel shiver.
In order to investigate this matter, Duo Fu to the entire Wang Fu people are gathered over, the East Court of the maids are basically present, heard the words have kneeled down do not dare to make a sound, and Aunt Li is not familiar with the secret happiness, and befriended with the apprehensive, received the benefits of the head is full of cold sweat.
Li did not expect this will be so serious, and served for many years the king did not remember the old love, has long been scared, shivering kowtow: "slave girl know wrong, slave girl was lard blinded heart, but this is all the side lady's idea ah! Wangfei grace, spare the slave girl's life!" Li only now reacted, the side lady this is a two birds with one stone plan, if the matter is successful, can let the royal family know that the king and the princess does not have a husband and wife; if the matter does not work, can take the opportunity to get rid of her as an eyesore of the concubine. Why did I listen to her advice?
"Bitch!" Jing Shao snorted coldly and ruthlessly dropped the cup in his hand, right in front of Aunt Li, "Go and bring Song Ling Xin here!"
Duo Fu was busy telling two maids to go to the West Garden and call the side lady who was still grounded.
"Even if it was the side lady's idea, the one who has the ability to drug is only you, Aunt Li." Mu Hanzhang cold face continued to analyze, this matter absolutely can not be easily uncovered, the entire royal residence of the inner house is now a big problem, today dares to put down spring | medicine, tomorrow should be poisoned. Since Jing Shao let himself manage the inner house, he has to give him a safe and worry-free home!
Li wanted to argue, looked up and met Mu Hanzhang's eyes that seemed to be able to see through everything, opened her mouth but could not argue, out of instinct, she felt that not telling the truth now would only be worse, but she felt that telling the truth would be the same death.
"If Aunt Li can tell how this poison got into His Majesty's soup, I will spare your life." Mu Hanyang turned around and sat back down next to Jing Shao, Auntie Li was a little unsure as she looked up at the two men sitting in the upper seat, when Mu Hanyang saw that she didn't believe her, she turned her head to look at Jing Shao.
Jing Shao returned a smile to him, "The affairs of the inner house, you make the decision is."
When Aunt Li heard these words, she was like a tranquilizer, shivering and reaching out, pointing to a person in the crowd - Mengxi.
"Your Highness, it wasn't the slave girl who did it, the slave girl was wronged! The food has always been out of the slave girl's hands!" Mengxi was already in a cold sweat from listening to the conversation she had just had, and when she saw it pointed out to her, she just felt weak and crawled forward on her knees a few steps.
In the East Garden house, the day after Mu Huanzhang married over, the work was divided up, with tea and water going to Mengxi, candles and beds going to Miaoxi, meals going to Zhi Ruoxi, and Lanting and Lanxuan supervising the sweeping and scrubbing. When Mengxi said this, she meant to point out that Zhi Ruoxi did it.
Zhi Ruoxi has been silent, is the idea of the same is a sister in the house, can not help but also do not want to fall on the well, now this person all disregard for the face, they do not have to pity her, a few steps forward on his knees, toward the Mu Huanzhang kowtowed and said: "Today is the slave girl negligence, Miao Ruoxi today is not feeling well, slave girl set up a good meal, after the Wangfei is still in the small study, slave girl let Dream Ruoxi to go to please, but she said that the Wangfei on her! She said that the princess was unhappy with her, and without thinking too much about it, she let Dream Ruoxi stay behind to look after the food. It was only because of the slave girl's negligence that this happened, so please punish the princess."
When Mengxi heard this, she couldn't help but scream, cursing ZhiXi's bloody mouth, but ZhiXi just lightly refrained from responding.
Dream Ruoxi broken mouth, usually to the West Garden to pass the news is also her, because there is no big deal has not been much care, Mu Huanzhang lowered his eyes, things have been very understandable, as for the medicine is from where to come, after the investigation is not too late. Picked up the cup on the table, slowly and methodically took a sip, slowly said: "Drag Mengxi out, caning!"
"No~ Your Highness spare your life! Your Highness! Your Highness! The slave girl has served Your Highness for many years! Your Highness!" Mengxi struggled and was dragged out, not long after, a scream came out from the courtyard, Song Lingxin rushed to the East Garden is, was seeing this scene, could not help but white face.
Ignoring the shouts in the courtyard, Mu Hanzhang just drank tea slowly and methodically, Jing Shao looked at such a Jun Qing, only to feel that he was so beautiful with this killing aura! Mu Hanzhang felt that person looking over the line of sight, the heart is a little uneasy, he will not feel that he is cruel and cold-blooded? Quietly clenched his sleeves, slowly turned his head, and was confronted with a pair of beautiful eyes full of gentleness and appreciation, and couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. How to forget, this person in the battlefield killed countless people, and how will not understand him this as?
Seeing Song's arrival, Mu Hanzhang put down his cup, slowly scanning a circle of people, stood up: "Since the king's residence as a slave, we must abide by our duties, the king's benevolence has not been harsh treatment of the subordinates, you think you can do whatever you want?"
"Slave maids don't dare!" All of them knelt down, their foreheads pressed to the ground to show their fear.
"Tonight all of you go stand in the courtyard for an hour, take a good look, in the future, if any of you dare to commit a misdemeanor, that's what you'll get!" After Mu Hanzhang finished speaking, he didn't let the crowd get up, his eyes shifted to Aunt Li who was already paralyzed on the ground, "Duofu, go and make arrangements, tomorrow, send Aunt Li to a nunnery, take her hair and cultivate her."
"Yes!" Duo Fu, as the only one standing, was busy bowing in response.
Song Lingxin heard, secretly relieved, expected to provoke Li's is just a sentence that no one can prove words, look at the situation, called himself most likely to knock some just.
The fact is also true, Mu Hanzhang really do not have evidence, so he turned his eyes to Jing Shao, asking him what he means.
Jing Shao frowned, now looking at this side room is a hundred times not good, these days in the court so passive, all rely on this talkative side room and her self-interested father! Can't help but snort coldly: "Song's fiddling with right and wrong, unauthorized delivery of news to the outside of the royal residence, this king will go tomorrow to ask for a decree to be demoted to concubine consort!"
Ignoring Song Ling Xin's cries and screams, Jing Shao stood up with some headaches, these women in the inner mansion, none of them are heartless, if he wants to live a few more years in this life, he has to stay away from these scourges. Raise his eyes to look at a white dress of his own Wangfei, that handsome face is gentle and quiet, suddenly have a kind of the world are turbid, only a scoop of clear drink illusion. He couldn't help but reach out and put his arm around him, waving his hand for Duo Fu to lead the crowd to the courtyard to watch Mengxi reflect, while he took his own Wangfei back to his room.
From this day onwards, Mu Hanyang's position as the unshakeable wife in Cheng Wang Fu was established. The original chaotic house, in the next few months, gradually by Mu Hanyang governance in order, the last life of the King Shao is like a dragon's lair of the royal residence, finally turned into a home can sleep peacefully.
In the courtroom, the matter of who to send to conquer the southern barbarians had been argued for several days, and Emperor Hongzheng had not expressed his opinion.
Jing Shao in the Ministry of War point of time, quietly revealed that this is a good opportunity to build up, he is very eager to fight for the meaning.
Jing Chen caused someone to spread the news that both the Grand Prince and the Third Prince wanted to lead the army to the Fourth Prince, who was still grounded.
While the people on all sides argued, the three imperial princes who were still on the court remained silent.
"The emperor's son to go on the expedition, for pacifying the people's hearts, educating the barbarians is indeed useful," Hongzheng Emperor swept his eyes over the following three sons, the eldest prince bowed his head to see the emotions, the second prince's eyes are calm and frank, Cheng Wang frowned his face to show some impatience, "Who are the three of you willing to go? "
Hongzheng emperor remembered last night the queen's words, the heart is a little tired, said what "the third prince unruly, high merit is easy to be born against the heart, the eldest prince is from a lowly background, the second prince a scholar, and the fourth prince as the first son but no military service." The world does not feel their son is not good parents, Hongzheng emperor as an emperor, his own son how to teach lessons can be, but can not allow others to say a word is not.
"My son is willing to go!" The Grand Prince sniffed and immediately stepped forward.
The crowd immediately focused their gazes over, Jing Chen's face was expressionless, and Jing Shao was stoic.
"Jing Shao, why don't you want to go?" Emperor Hongzheng frowned, didn't this person say the day before that this was a good opportunity to get credit?
"Reporting to Father, my son met a jianghu magician the day before yesterday, he gave my son a fortune telling and said that my son is not fit to lead an army in the last three months, and that he will surely lose if he goes out to war." Jing Shao said with a serious face, "I can't tarnish the majesty of Da Chen just for the sake of coveting a moment's success!"
"What a bunch of nonsense!" Emperor Hongzheng violently slapped the armrest of the dragon chair.
Jing Shao panicked and knelt on the ground: "My son is foolish, father rest his anger."
Hongzheng Emperor angry straight blowing beard: "You know that you are stupid, then go back to copy the Art of War ten times, copy not finished not allowed to go to court!"
"Yes." Jing Shao kowtowed and received his punishment, the ministers had sideways glances, this King Cheng was really broken.
"Pass on my decree, and have Grand Prince Jing Rong lead the troops to exterminate the southern barbarian rebels, and depart in three days!" Emperor Hongzheng gave his decree and glared at Jing Shao, who was still kneeling, and flung his sleeves away.
Ignoring the ministers who were whispering behind him, Jing Shao hung his head and walked out of the palace, returned to the royal residence, and wilted and arched into the arms of his own princess.
"What's going on here?" Mu Hanzhang put down the ledger in his hands and patted the guy who was rubbing around in his arms.
"Junqing, I've been punished by Father, I'll have to stay away from the court for a while." Jing Shao smothered his face in someone else's chest, "Let's go to the other house and stay there for a while, the other house has hot springs, so we don't have to bathe in the tub every day."
"...... "Mu Hanzhang looked helplessly at the guy in his arms who was secretly tugging at his lapel, the other courtyard and hot springs were what he really wanted to talk about, right?

chapters.title: 23: The Temple
chapters.content:
"There are still a lot of things going on in this mansion, not to mention that Father Emperor punished you, yet you immediately ran off to another courtyard to play, won't that cause people to criticize you?" Mu Hanzhang sighed and pushed the guy in his arms away slightly, picking up the account book again to look at it.
Jing Shao followed his force and fell onto the soft collapse, "Father asked me to copy the Book of War ten times, it will take at least a month to finish it, so I can't stay bored at home all the time, right?"
Mu Hanzhang glanced at him, only pretending not to hear, and put the scrutinized account book aside, instead picking up a roster of the royal family to look at, "There's something I need to ask you about."
Although Li's drugged thing is solved, but the drug is from where to come, today only have a brow, involved in this matter of the subordinate's name are circled one by one, there is just one person is more special.
"Yeonji?" Jing Shao couldn't help but frown when he heard this name, "Keep this matter under wraps beforehand, and deal with it when the Grand Imperial Brother leaves for his expedition three days later." Liu Yan Ji was sent by the Grand Prince, although he knew that she had problems, but the Grand Prince rushed to deal with the Wang Ji he sent when his expedition was imminent, it would inevitably cause gossip.
"I do have an idea," Mu Hanzhang pursed her lips, glanced at Jing Shao, and said with some hesitation, "Is it true that Your Highness has never touched her?"
Jing Shao sat up and rubbed his nose in embarrassment, "Why would I lie to you about something like that?"
"What I mean is that the Fourth Prince's grounding order will be lifted next month, and it's only natural that Your Highness, as an elder brother, should send a congratulatory gift." Mu Hanzhang lowered his eyes and slowly said.
Jing Shao's eyes lit up, "You mean, give her to Jing Yu?" Concubines a little bit of concubines are all can be given away, since the grand prince send a scourge in his side, he can completely give the scourge to others, although these years the grand prince and the fourth prince two go close, but also face and heart is not the same, there is such a ready source of information, do not believe that the grand prince do not have to use.
This is a beautifully executed move!
"Junqing, you're too smart!" Jing Shao excitedly took his own princess into his arms and kissed her.
"Your Highness ......" Mu Hanzhang pushed him away, his ears tinted a layer of pink, he was talking about business, why is this person not in shape?
Two people finally discussed the results, involved in the delivery of medicine underlings all disposed of, first not move Yeonji, when the fourth prince released in mid-March, it will be sent to him.
In the afternoon, Jing Shao hugged his own princess and rested a beautiful nap, and then followed him to the small study, one to deal with the affairs of the inner house, and one to copy the book of war.
The Book of War is the beginning of the founding of the country, the Great Ancestor with four bachelor compiled the general description of the art of war, set the essence of the art of war for thousands of years in one, is indeed a good book, just Jing Shao looked at the full set of books half a foot high, or a bitter face. This ten times copy down, I'm afraid that a month can't finish copying.
Mu Hanzhang glanced at just copying three pages on the table on the immobile guy, the wonderful Ruoxi made a good tea pushed him: "the House of things can be arranged in the next few days, the first three days of April there is a temple fair, when we go shopping, accompanied by the way you go to live in a separate house for two days." When the first of April is over, and the new maids and boys are picked on the second day, there's basically no big deal.
Jing Shao heard, immediately happy, drink a mouthful of tea and start copying again, not long but can't sit still: "I'll go practice sword for a while and then come back to copy." After saying that, he threw down his pen and went out.
Mu Hanzhang lightly smiled and shook his head, knowing the son is not like the father, the emperor punished Jing Shao copying books, is to know that he does not love to write can not sit down. Took him to copy half of the book, staring at the full of powerful words for a moment, put up the pen then break the line to write up.
When Jing Shao returned, he found that the book that he had originally copied only five pages had turned into more than thirty pages, and those extra words, the strokes and force were actually exactly the same as his own!
"Junqing, did you write this?" Jing Shao grabbed the book and found his own princess sitting at the dining table serving soup.
Mu Hanzhang nodded slightly, "When I was a child doing homework for my elder brother and two cousins, I learned to imitate other people's fonts."
"But can anyone's writing be imitated?" Jing Shao excitedly held his hand, knowing that those who could imitate words would be able to forge letters, which would be too useful on the battlefield!
"As long as it's not too strange." Handing the bowl of soup over, Mu Hanzhang didn't understand why he valued it so much.
"Junqing ...... you are truly a rare treasure!" Jing Shao was silent for a moment and said slowly.
"But some of the skills are not on the stage," Mu Hanzhang smiled, he will be those imitation of words, accounting, are readers disdain, "I just learn too much, Mr. not allow me to be successful in the next year will go to the test." Said here, the eyes of the God could not help but dim, he was seventeen years old in the lifts, Mr. feel that his fire is not yet, let him wait for another three years, but did not expect that this three years into forever.
Seeing him sad, Jing Shao didn't know how to comfort him, so he could only digress, "Tomorrow don't let them prepare breakfast, I'll take you to eat at Hui Wei House, Xiao Yuan and his wife are both very interesting."
The next day, when he arrived at the Huiwei Building Jing Shao regretted it, because as soon as his own princess and Zhou Zhun met, they talked about doing business with each other, and the boss of Zhou, who was all in emerald green, even warmly invited Mu Huanzhang to attend the monthly gathering of men's wives, so that he and Xiao Yuan, who had also been left out, could only look at each other and eat wontons without a word.
It was the third day of April, and the temple fair in the south of the city was bustling with activity. Stalls, sellers of art, seek signatures, monkeys, a crowd of people, to name a few.
Jing Shao pulled his own princess in the crowd. April weather has begun to heat up, the two wore the same color of azure silk clothes, Jing Shao buttoned a pair of embedded gemstone silver wrist guards, Mu Huanzhang outside a wide-sleeved gauze, the same handsome two people in the pile of people quite eye-catching.
The roadside is full of selling snacks and knick-knacks, Jing Shao bought a serving of fried dumplings, veggie dumplings made of flour, tofu, bean sprouts and other dough, fried golden brown in a frying pan, drizzled with a layer of sauce, looks very tempting. Poked a bamboo stick and handed it to the mouth of his own princess, Mu Hanzhang frowned, eating on the road is not what a gentleman does, it's very rude, but he didn't want to brush off his good intentions. Looked around, quickly opened his mouth to bite down the balls, crispy balls with fresh sauce, but surprisingly delicious. Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but bend the corners of his mouth.
This series of expressions naturally fell into Jing Shao's eyes, and he was about to tease a couple of times, when suddenly a déjà vu figure flashed out of the corner of his eye. Suddenly looked up, only to see a figure dressed in pink dress hidden into the crowd, a flash of side face made him greatly shocked, could not help but drop the pills in his hand, turned around and chased out.
"Little spoon ......" Mu Hanzhang watched as he let go of his hand and chased a pink woman away, drowning in the crowd without a trace in no time.
"Yo, Your Highness can even go out, why don't you bring a guard?" A familiar voice came from behind, Mu Hanzhang frowned, this frivolous and annoying voice, once he heard it, it was his cousin Mu Yangwen.
"Second brother also came to the temple fair ah, why are you alone?" Turning his head to look, it was indeed his elder brother, Mu Lingbao, and two cousins, Mu Yangwen and Mu Huafeng.
Jing Shao chased after him for a short distance, and the man had already disappeared.
"Your Highness, who are you looking for?" The guards hidden in the crowd came over and asked.
"You two go and look for a woman dressed in pink with a vermillion mole on the corner of her eyebrow, she should be called 'Ruoyi'." Pointing to the two guards for them to find, Jing Shao then remembered that he had left Jun Qing behind and ran back in a panic. There were so many people at the temple fair, and Jun Qing was so good looking, so it would be bad if he met a rogue or a wandering woman.
Sure enough, when he returned to his original position, he saw three men surrounding Mu Hanzhang, his back to him could not see what he was doing, but look at the expression of his own princess, pursed lips look obviously angry. Jing Shao was filled with anger, walked over and grabbed the collar of the man who was talking, shone a punch in the eye socket, and kicked one of the men on either side of him to the ground.
Mu Hanzhang's eyes widened, his mouth half-open as Jing Shao wrapped his arms around him, "Junqing, are you alright?"
"Little spoon, they ......" Mu Hanzhang looked at the three people who fell to the ground, the corner of his mouth twitched a little.
"How are you guys doing your job? See Wangfei being molested and still not come out?" Jing Shao scolded the two guards behind him, and looked down at the three "dengtu" on the ground, the two covering their stomachs seemed somewhat familiar, and the one who climbed up with one eye green seemed to be his great-uncle--Mu Lingbao?

chapters.title: 24 - Ruoyi
chapters.content:
The temple stroll ended early because of the encounter with the three Mu Lingbao, on the way back, Mu Hanzhang sat on the back of his horse, remembering how those three people were clearly beaten up just now but still had a smile on their faces, he couldn't help but want to laugh.
Looking down and seeing the way the person in his arms pursed his lips to hold back a smile, Jing Shao decided to find a chance to beat those three up a few more times in the future. When Mu Ling Bao pushed his younger brother into the water, those two cousins were also present, so when this year's Sanjiu, let people throw them into the river to take a dip as well.
The King Cheng's Residence was in the east of the city, and the piece of barren forest that the Marquis of Northern Wei had given him was also in the east of the city. Riding Little Black out of the city not far, in front of the eyes appeared the deserted forest full of rocks and stones. Mu Hanzhang glanced sideways at the contemplative Jing Shao, still thinking about that pink-clothed woman? Thinking of his reaction at that time, the upward curved corners of his mouth slowly pursed into a line. "Little spoon ......"
"Hmm?" Jing Shao looked back down at him.
Who is that woman? To ask the words to the edge of the mouth and swallowed back, Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, turned his head to look at the barren forest: "What do you think this barren forest planted to make money?"
"Barren forest?" Jing Shao raised his head to look at the forest, snorted, "This kind of forest, with more rocks and less soil, also can not run a horse to hunt ......" Said Jing Shao here, Jing Shao suddenly pulled the reins, stopping to look at a barren forest in front of him in contemplation.
This forest has at least three hundred acres, all messy rocks and mixed forests, as well as dense short trees and weeds, so that you can't even see what's going on inside, making it a good place to canton troops! Moreover, this place is only twenty miles away from the capital! It's a pity that all the land on the outskirts of the capital is owned by the owners, when the Great Ancestor fought for the world, he divided the land around the capital to several founding princes. If he were to openly buy this useless barren forest, he would certainly arouse suspicion.
"Jun Qing, do you know who owns this forest?" If there is this forest, a lot of things will be better, if there is an eventuality in the future, there will also be a guarantee, even if it takes some effort, Jing Shao also wants to get this piece of land.
Mu Hanzhang lowered his head and sighed softly, "This forest is now the majority of my family property."
Jing Shao froze for a moment, then smiled broadly and planted a kiss on the cheek of the person in his arms, "Jun Qing, you are truly my lucky star!"
"Hmm?" This time, it was Mu Hanzhang's turn to freeze.
"I'll trade you a hundred acres of good land in Qi County for this barren forest, okay?" Jing Shao lightly kicked the horse's belly, causing Little Black to run in joy.
"If you want to use it, just take it." Mu Hanzhang felt that Jing Shao was trying to help him with this useless land, "It's just that a hundred acres of good land in exchange for this thing is a million times too much."
"It makes, this barren forest is worth more to me than a thousand acres of good land!" Jing Shao laughed lightly and wrapped one arm around the person in his arms, making Little Black run faster.
In the evening, the two guards who had been sent out by Jing Shao to find someone returned.
"Subordinate is incompetent." The two guards kneeled down to apologize.
"That's just it, perhaps this king has misread it." Jing Shao waved his hand for them to go down, frowning and pondering himself. The woman he saw at the temple fair today did indeed resemble Ge Ruoyi.
The reason why Jing Shao paid so much attention was because this man was a key to pacifying San Fan.
The first time Jing Shao saw Ge Ruoyi in his previous life was at a banquet at the fourth prince's residence, and this woman's performance of "Butterfly Lovers" was so memorable that he remembered it vividly. So much so that when he saw her at the Southeast King's royal residence a few years later, he recognized her at once. She had a blood feud with the Southeast King, came to the capital to sue the royal court but was intercepted by the fourth prince, escaped from the fourth prince's mansion and mixed into the Southeast King's mansion by whatever means, and became the Southeast King's favorite concubine.
When Jing Shao led the troops to pacify San Fan, although the Southeast King was lustful and greedy for money, he fought in the war but was not ambiguous at all, Hongzheng eighteen years that almost took his life an arrow, is to pay tribute to the Southeast King's generals. When he thought he was going to be folded in the southeast, suddenly came the news that the southeast king died violently. And the Southeast King, it was in the hands of this weak-looking little woman that he died!
When Mu Hanzhang came to tell Jing Shao to go bathe, he was seeing his expression immersed in memories and couldn't help but quietly clench his sleeves.
Regarding Ge Ruoyi's whereabouts, there had been no news coming in, so Jing Shao put it behind him for the time being.
With his own Wangfei helping to copy books, Jing Shao was relieved to spend his days in the courtyard practicing martial arts with Ren Feng, and in the evenings, he soaked in the hot springs and drank wine with Jun Qing, and had an exceptionally pleasant time. He finally realized why Mu Lingbao's trio always bullied Mu Hanzhang, the feeling of having someone to do his homework for him was really great.
Originally agreed to just stay for two days, but it turned out that Jing Shao didn't want to go back once he stayed.
April 9, the North Marquis of Wei birthday, in addition to Mu Hanzhang hand-painted birthday map, Jing Shao also sent a thick gift. Beiwei Marquis Mu Jin saw Jing Shao than the last time but also warm, but for Jing Shao implicitly pulling together the intention is still vague past. Jing Shao also do not care, he knows the North Marquis of Wei this old fox hold is what mentality, so pull together when the posture is also put very high, did not force.
To the crowd's surprise, the fourth prince Jing Yu also came to wish birthday, but Jing Yu put down the gift and Mu Jin pleasantries for a while and left, because he is still in the confinement, specially let the mother ask for the grace to run out of half a day. The capital of these princes and lords of the family are less and have in-laws, the Marquis of Beiwei and the Queen's mother's family Yongchangfu is no exception, so the fourth prince to ask for the grace to the Marquis of Beiwei birthday celebration is also said to be the past.
Mu Hanzhang saw that his father was even more enthusiastic about the fourth prince than Jing Shao, and only felt cold in his heart, so he told his father that Jing Shao was also being punished, and could not stay for long, so he pulled him away.
"Junqing, I'm fine." Jing Shao sat in the carriage, looking at his own princess who was cold-faced, feeling warm in his heart, the only person who would be angry because he was wronged, other than his mother and brother, would be Jun Qing.
"The fourth prince has reached the age of choosing the right consort, it just so happens that the first miss of the Beiwei Marquis House has not yet married, my father ......" Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, his father knows that Jing Shao is not in the same faction as the fourth prince, and still makes such plans, although this can protect the Beiwei Marquis House to all, but so thick and thin is really let a person's heart chills.
"Junqing," Jing Shao took him into his arms heartily, "Born in a family of princes and lords, there are some things that should not be forced."
Mu Hanzhang sighed, softened her body to lean against Jing Shao's chest, and said softly, "I know ......"
"Whinny~" The walking carriage suddenly braked, and the two people in the car violently fell forward. Jing Shao quickly hugged the person in his arms tightly and supported the bottom of the car with one hand, so that he didn't bump into it.
"Your Highness forgive me, I deserve to die." The driver of the car was busy voicing his apologies.
"What's going on?" After seeing that the person in his arms was unharmed, Jing Shao raised his voice to inquire.
"The horses of the Fourth Prince and the guards suddenly stopped, the little one couldn't stop in time." The driver lifted half of the curtain to show them the situation ahead.
Only to see a woman dressed in pink holding up a bloody certificate and kneeling in front of her horse, Jing Yu, who was dressed in a dark yellow imperial prince's regular clothes, was sitting on his horse, and after hearing what the woman said, he suddenly jumped off his horse and walked towards the woman.
"Oh no!" Jing Shao let go of the person in his arms and quickly jumped out of the car, rushing to the woman before Jing Yu and grabbing her arm, "Ruoyi, I finally found you!"
"You ......" the woman kneeling on the ground is Ge Ruoyi, originally heard that today's birthday of the Northern Marquis of Wei, she took the petition to stop a person who seems to have the highest status, how could she expect to suddenly rushed out of a man dressed in a moonlight-white Chinese dress suddenly grabbed her, but also called out her The girl's name, only to make her scared to stay on the spot.
"Third Imperial Brother, you recognize this woman?" Jing Yu frowned, "She just said she was going to sue the Imperial Court."
"She ah, is a dancer I met in the desert," Jing Shao pointed to his head, "Fans, some unclear here." Without waiting for Ge Ruoyi to argue, Jing Shao knocked the person unconscious with a hand slash and threw him to a guard.
Jing Yu heard this and looked Ge Ruoyi up and down, seeing that although this woman was haggard, she could not hide her beauty, and was indeed a rare beauty. He didn't doubt Jing Shao's words, because this woman did just say her name was Ruoyi.
"Some other day my brother will send you a better one." Jing Shao smiled and patted Jing Yu's shoulder, and the two of them made a few false pleasantries before going their separate ways. Jing Shao turned around and exhaled, letting the guards send Ge Ruoyi back to the other courtyard first.
In the afternoon, Mu Hanzhang sat in the study to continue to help Jing Shao copying books, in front of his eyes non-stop floating Jing Shao after seeing that woman's expression. Yesterday left him and chased him out, and today it's the same again, and after lunch he went to see that woman ......
Sore heart unbearable, back to God, only to find that copy the wrong line, only to tear the page to start again, again pen, but uncontrollably even wrote three "shao" word!

chapters.title: 25 - Jealousy
chapters.content:
"Tomorrow, this king will appeal to father, but you shouldn't get your hopes up too much." Jing Shao looked at the color of the sky, and when it was time to accompany his own princess for dinner, he put down his tea and got up, ready to go.
"Your Majesty's great kindness, my daughter thanks in advance on behalf of the entire clan." Ge Ruoyi flung herself to her knees and kowtowed to Jing Shao.
Jing Shao sighed and turned to walk out. Southeast king in the end is the southeast of the soil emperor, the great ancestor will be the southeast of the fiefdom to him, is to give him full authority to govern, even if the Ge family has a great injustice, to the overall situation, father will also put down this matter. But what should be done is still to be done, the handle of the Southeast King, although the moment can not be used, can always be used in the future, now reported to the father, is also considered a merit.
Mu Hanzhang often forgot the time when copying books these days, so Jing Shao went to the study first to find him. The study is empty, only half of the books copied on the desk by the wind blowing rattling. Jing Shao walked up to the book closed and put it away, turned his head and saw a few paper balls under the table, picked up one to see, there is nothing written on it, only three big ink dots, can not help but lose a smile, I think Jun Qing copying the book is also tired of copying, tomorrow is better to copy yourself so that he can also go to play for a day.
"Where is the crown princess?" Jing Shao reached the dining table and still saw no sign of his own Wangfei.
"Back to Your Highness, the crown princess said she didn't have an appetite, so she went back to her bedroom." Yunzhu answered honestly and did not reply according to the rhetoric given to him by Mu Hanzhang. In Yunzhu's little teenager's heart, the gentle Wangfei was obviously already sad, but also had to make up a set of sayings to persuade the thin-skinned Prince to eat first, where in the world was such reasoning?
"No appetite?" Jing Shao frowned and turned towards the bedroom. Jun Qing had always eaten on time, suddenly she had no appetite, could it be that she was sick?
The bedrooms of the separate courtyard included bedrooms and a backyard, where a hot spring pool made of white jade took up most of the entire courtyard. A stream of living water was drawn from underground, bubbling and overflowing from a thousand-layered lotus carved out of green jade. This hot spring pool was Jing Shao's favorite place in the entire Buyeon, and there was a person in charge of replacing the seasonal flowers in the open space beside the pool every season, and today there were a few dwarf peach trees in blossom planted.
Mu Hanzhang half lying on the edge of the pool, reaching out to catch the slowly falling peach blossom petals. Smooth white spine exposed to the surface of the water, by the dense mist dazzled out of the seemingly illusionary appearance, crystal water droplets along the outstretched fingertips, across the palm of the remnants of the red, with pink petals fell into the pool together.
The remnants of the red into the water, but the falling flowers have the intention, the flowing water has no mercy ......
When Jing Shao came in, he saw this scene, and immediately felt his mouth dry up, quickly took off his own clothes and jumped down.
"Plop!" With a sound, a huge splash of water hit his face, Mu Hanzhang subconsciously raised his hand to block it, and before he could return to his senses, he was embraced by the person who suddenly appeared underwater.
"Ah!" Mu Hanyang exclaimed, and after seeing who it was, she couldn't help but sigh, "Why doesn't Your Highness go to dinner?"
"This is what I should ask you," Jing Shao wrapped his arms around the person in his arms and didn't let go, because of the water, the skin under his hands was abnormally smooth and tender, he couldn't help but sneakily touch it twice, "Is your body uncomfortable?"
Mu Hanyang pursed her lips and gently pushed away Jing Shao who was getting closer and closer, "I'm fine."
"Still saying it's fine," Jing Shao reached out and wrapped his arms around the person again, kissing on those tight lips, "I know you're upset, didn't Xiao Yuan's wife invite you to go to the garden in the south of the city tomorrow? Tomorrow you just go and play, I'll copy that book."
Mu Hanzhang looked up at Jing Shao with a smile in his eyes, this tenderness of his even though it is true, but it will not be so for him alone. Lowering his head and looking at the foggy water without saying anything, the peach blossom petals that fell in the water swirled with the microwaves in the water and slowly sank into the pool.
Jing Shao scratched his head, not knowing what was wrong with him, "Junqing, if you have any difficulties just tell me ......"
Mu Hanyang pursed his lips, took a deep breath, "Today that girl ...... the king intends to seal the king's concubine or ......" This said, that kind of soreness bubbled up again, could not help but slightly knit up his eyebrows.
Jing Shao froze for a long time, only then reacted, the self Wangfei this is ...... jealous? A tug over the people who are sad, looking for that light-colored lips ruthlessly kissed up.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang did not resist much at first, but when a slippery thing probed into his mouth, he could not help but reach out to push him, unexpectedly, he was held tighter in return, and the hand behind him began to slowly caress and knead between his waist and femur.
As the long kiss ended, Mu Hanzhang was a little out of breath and leaned against Jing Shao's shoulder to catch his breath.
Jing Shao took a deep breath, holding him in the water and sat down, gently caressing the spine of the person in his arms to help him calm his breathing. "Ge Ruoyi she ......" felt the body in his arms stiffened, couldn't help but hook his lips, in that water vapor fumigated into pink earlobes gently bite, "she is the southeast of the fiefdom of a merchant family's young lady, the southeast king looked on Ge family The Southeast King fell in love with Ge family's firstborn son and wanted to snatch him as a molester, I'm not sure what happened in the middle, anyway, then the Southeast King killed Ge family's entire clan, and that man, Ge Ruoyi's brother, died of unbearable humiliation."
"Is she really here to sue the Imperial Court?" Mu Hanzhang looked up at him.
"That's natural, this woman has a great use, I can't let her fall into the hands of the fourth prince," Jing Shao frowned, lying to Ge Ruoyi that set of so-called deceased person's words of trust, naturally it doesn't make sense here in Jun Qing, not knowing how to explain it then he didn't intend to say much, "Anyway it's not what you think, I will in the future I won't take any more concubines, much less side consorts."
Looking down at the person in his arms, those beautiful black eyes snapped wide at the words, "You don't have an heir yet, how can you say something like that?"
Jing Shao looked at him with a smile, "I've already taken a male wife, whether I have an heir or not is not important, besides, since I've seen you, it's hard for anyone else to catch my eye."
"Little spoon ...... you ......" Mu Hanzhang looked at him in shock, a prince unexpectedly does not want an heir! Is he making his heart clear to him? The sourness in his heart was replaced by a sudden sweetness, and he slowly put his chin on Jing Shao's shoulder, "I ...... also ...... like you! I also like you! This sentence is ultimately not good enough to say.
However, Jing Shao did understand his own princess's unfinished words, and lowered his head, kissing those reddened lips deeply. This time, Mu Hanzhang didn't resist anymore, but instead slightly opened his mouth and let him in. Jing Shao naturally will not negatively affect this beauty, hooking the soft tongue intertwined in his mouth, one hand gently caresses the back of the neck of the person in his arms, one hand slowly kneads down from the shoulder, sliding above the chest, pinching a small bean in the water, gently pressing and kneading up.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang shuddered at the provocation and almost bit Jing Shao's tongue. Jing Shao let out a light laugh and swept over one of his legs, making him face him as he straddled between his legs.
Because the hot springs were soaked without an inch of clothing, now in this position, it made the slightly lifted little Junqing and the spirited little Tiny Shao stick together, and Jing Shao wrapped the blushing self Wangfei into his arms again, causing the two little ones to greet each other affectionately.
"Hmm ......" Mu Hanzhang stifled a grunt, and little Junqing was completely refreshed by the impact.
Jing Shao pulled over a slender, glistening hand and interlocked it with one of his own, wrapping the two little ones in it, while at the same time lowering his head to contain a small bean that had already been pinched and reddened, sucking and crushing it.
"Ah~" With her chest and bottom being taken care of at the same time, Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but raise her head, and when Jing Shao suddenly accelerated the movements of his hands, she shook her head somewhat unable to bear it, the crystalline droplets of water flinging into the water along the raised wet hair, indescribably tantalizing.
Mist filled hot spring pool, for a while, only the sound of gurgling water and the occasional overflow of gasps of surprise, the peach blossom petals in mid-spring drifting down with the wind, stirring up a circle of fine ripples, blushing a pool of spring water.

chapters.title: chapter xxvi. the party
chapters.content:
The next afternoon, Jing Shao sent his own princess to the House of Flavors to let Zhou Zhuan take him to the capital's monthly gathering of men's wives. Zhou Zhuan today did not wear bright clothes, a dark blue robe looks much more stable.
"Boss Zhou, Jun Qing is in your care." Jing Shao arched his hand towards Boss Zhou.
"Your Highness, don't worry about it." Zhou Zhuan was already a bright person, and older than them all, so after becoming familiar with him, even Mu Hanzhang followed suit and called him Big Brother Zhou.
Mu Hanzhang looked at Jing Shao who was as nagging as entrusting a small child, and smiled helplessly, "Your Highness, don't worry about going back is, I can still lose it?"
Jing Shao scratched his head and rolled onto his horse, the male wives in the capital who attended this party were mostly from prominent families, but with Jun Qing's wisdom he should not suffer any losses. So rest assured that the carriage and Yunzhu left behind, he rode Xiaohei to find his elder brother to drink tea.
The south of the city had a good view, and many princely families had gardens here. The monthly gatherings were mostly in the ink garden of the Duke of Maoguo's family.
Second son, concubine son can marry a male wife, this is an unwritten rule, do not have to abide by, but the Duke of Maoguo family traditionally will be established as a rule of the family, even if you do not like the man, the concubine son must also take a male wife. So the capital of the princes and lords of the house, Maoguo Gongfu's male wife is the most.
Into the ink garden, you will hear a sound of silk and bamboo, through the layers of bamboo, a wide water salon in front of us, the water salon above the tables and chairs, refreshments, the bank of a woman playing music, a stringed zither, two bamboo xiao, the ghost into the ear, beautiful.
"This is a place of elegance." Mu Hanzhang looked at the several people sitting quietly listening to the music on the water pavilion, originally worried that the scene as lively as the women stringing together had not appeared, and could not help but feel secretly relieved.
"Big Brother Zhou is here." Upon seeing Zhou Zhuan, several people rose and bowed politely.
"This is?" The man at the head of the water pavilion was dressed in a light blue tunic, his age was about twenty-five to twenty-six, similar to Zhou Zhuan, with handsome features, except that there were deep lines between his eyebrows, when it was due to frequent frowning.
"This is Princess Cheng, Prince Mu." Zhou Zhuan smiled and introduced him to the crowd. Male wives usually didn't like others calling them madams and young grandmothers, so they referred to each other as dukes.
"Greetings, Your Highness." Hearing this, several people looked at each other and came forward to salute.
"There is no need for all of you to be so courteous on such an occasion." Mu Hanzhang humbly and courteously asked the crowd to rise.
"I've heard that Duke Wen Yuan has an extraordinary demeanor, and when I see him today, he really lives up to his name." The man at the head smiled gently and motioned them inside.
"But it's just a young man's frivolity, the false name gained in the poetry meeting." Hearing this person call his former name, Mu Hanzhang felt that it seemed to go back to the past, to participate in the reader's poetry meeting situation, the mood could not help but happy up, to the person in front of him also gave birth to a few feelings of closeness.
Zhou Zhuan introduced Mu Huanzhang one by one, the one at the head is surnamed Lin, the male wife of the second young master of the Dingnan Marquis family. The other few are basically the families of court officials.
"Why don't we see the Duke Maoguo Mansion?" Zhou Zhuan asked Duke Lin.
"They went to the forest in the back with the Prince of the Marquis of Yongchang to fight chickens, we didn't want to go and join in on that fun, so we're here listening to the music." When Mr. Lin spoke, he would naturally frown, looking rather sad.
"What's wrong this?" Zhou Zhuan couldn't help but open his mouth and ask when he saw Mr. Lin's worried brows.
"The second young master insisted on marrying a first lady from an official family as a concubine," Zhang Gongzi, who was stoned on the side, opened his mouth to speak on his behalf, "Lin Daoguo's life is already difficult, and then marrying a concubine with a high birth ...... hei ......"
Mu Hanzhang slowly sipping tea, quietly listening to a few people chatting with you and me, these men are all read, and speak more implicitly, all to the point, but this only words, he can still hear, most of the male wives are not doing well at home.
Husbands were mostly commoners and were sometimes forced to take male wives. Moreover, few sons were brought up with male wives, most of them did not know how to run a household, and once a concubine had an heir, it was even more difficult to manage. Therefore, if the husband does not have a preference, even if they can do each other like guests, trapped in the inner house to wear down the will of the man, it is difficult to get what they want.
"I heard that King Cheng requested an order last month to demote the side wife to a concubine consort, how did Duke Mu do it?" That talkative Duke Zhang suddenly directed his words to Mu Hanzhang.
"Everything is the king's intention." Mu Hanzhang put down his tea and said lightly, not intending to say much about his own family's affairs.
"Why are you kid like a woman now, always prying into these family matters." Zhou Zhuan huffed and slapped Zhang Gongzi's head, stopping the conversation.
Mu Hanzhang picked up his cup again, he found that although Zhou Zhun's husband was only a small minister, and he himself was only a restaurant owner, but his reputation was very high among these noble men's wives, and all of them honored him with the title of "Big Brother Zhou". In addition to his own bright and easy-going behavior, the fact that Xiao Yuan has been married for seven or eight years and has not taken a single concubine is the reason why everyone really admires him. A male wife who can't leave an heir, but can follow the example of the Hedong lion, controlling his husband not to take concubines, really needs some extraordinary means.
"Yo~ I thought who is this gentleman in full fancy clothes, but it turns out to be Hanyang!" A conspiratorial voice came from outside the water pavilion, the crowd looked up and saw five or six men circling out from behind the bamboo forest with a few attendants, marching towards the water pavilion with great vigor.
Mu Hanzhang frowned and recognized the person who spoke as Du Yinghao, who had been his classmate for five years. The head of the Mu family's academy was a clan uncle who had won the scholar's prize, and because of his fame, other relatives in the family would also send their children to study. This Du Yinghao is the nephew of Mrs. Beiwei Marquis, because he is not used to Mu Huanzhang being praised by the teacher, so he is always against him.
"I haven't seen you for two years, I thought you had gone to take the countryside exams, but it turns out that you married into the Duke of Maoguo Mansion." Mu Hanzhang sat still, glanced at the overbearing Du Yinghao, and continued to drink tea blandly.
"Hmph, even though you won the Lift, you were still married off by your aunt?" Du Yinghao coldly grunted, the Du family was not a distinguished family, even though he was the first second son, he was used to climb up the ladder to marry the third young master of the Duke of Maoguo family.
"Don't be rude!" Du Yinghao was about to say something else when he was stopped by his own second sister-in-law at the side.
There were three male wives in the Maoguo family in this generation alone, and they all took their seats after saluting.
"Yesterday, I went to the Bei Wei Marquis' mansion to celebrate his birthday and saw something quite interesting." Du Yinghao saw that even though Mu Hanzhang was married off, he was still the object of others' admiration and respect, and his heart was so uneven that he couldn't help but want to stab him twice.
Tired of playing the crowd while drinking tea and chatting, heard this and asked him what was the matter.
"King Cheng saved a very beautiful woman under the hooves of the Fourth Prince's horse," Du Yinghao smiled at the expressionless Mu Huanzhang and intentionally lengthened his voice to say, "I heard that King Cheng liked it so much that he directly raised it to the aliyah as a foreign room."
Hearing this, the original lively atmosphere instantly cooled down, the people are awkwardly silent do not know how to answer. In their hearts, they said that the original Wangfei Cheng is not very favored, heard that the King of Cheng for his relegation of the side room, but this turn of the eye and find a foreign room.
Mu Hanzhang looked at Du Yinghao who was looking at the joke with a funny face, he only felt funny, this person is still this childish even after so many years. Looking at the sky, "It's getting late, I'm staying at the other house these days, I need to go back earlier." Saying this, he put down the tea and got up to say goodbye.
The King Cheng's Residence is in the east of the city, and the Ink Garden is in the south of the city, which is really a bit far away, so it's not good to stay, and all the people got up to see them off.
"Third brother Xu doesn't know any better, please don't be offended, Your Highness." Sent to the outside of the Mo Garden, the second son of the Maoguo family made amends to Mu Hanzhang.
Mu Hanzhang smiled, but did not answer, Yunzhu drove the carriage over and was about to get on, when a burst of hoofbeats came from not far away.
"Whinny~" with a clear neigh, the black steed braked sharply in front of the crowd, the man on the horse was upright and handsome, it was the thin-skinned King Jing Shao of Cheng that people just said.
When the crowd saw the visitor, they all knelt down and saluted, "Greetings to His Highness, King Cheng."
Waving his hand for the crowd to get up, Jing Shao saw that his own Wangfei was already standing in front of the carriage and smiled lightly, "I'm afraid that it's not a good idea for you to return late, so I've come to pick you up."
"I'm watching the hour." Mu Hanzhang hooked his lips and watched as the man slowly drove his horse over and extended a hand to himself. He didn't want to be too intimate in front of outsiders, but his afterglow skimmed Du Yinghao's jealous expression, and ghostly put his hand in his palm, borrowing the force of the man on the horse, he rolled over and sat in front of Jing Shao.
"Yunzhu, you send Brother Zhou back before returning to the other courtyard." Mu Hanzhang gave an explanation to the boy beside the carriage, and after saying goodbye to the crowd, he left with Jing Shao in a dashing, dusty manner.
Du Yinghao reddened his face in anger, Duke Lin and the others also showed envious gazes, and only Zhou Zhun was happy for having no money to sit in the Huagai carriage.
From that day onwards, the news that King Cheng greatly favored his royal consort quickly spread in the upper circles.
Given that the set of "Book of War" is really too thick, a person copy, the fastest will take a month, in order to both play and can appear to admit their mistakes good attitude, Jing Shao and Mu Huanzhang began to copy together. Every morning a practice martial arts, a deal with internal affairs, together in the afternoon in the garden set up a table to enjoy the flowers, copying books, evening together to soak in the hot springs, the day is very pleasant.
About Ge Ruoyi thing, Jing Shao wrote a folding up, waiting for three days have no news. This day just ate lunch, is holding their own princess lying in a rocking chair in the sun, Jing Shao was a decree declared into the palace.
"What do you think about the southeastern matter?" Emperor Hongzheng asked Jing Shao, who was kneeling behind him, with his hands behind his back, looking at the mountain and river map in the imperial study.
Jing Shao carefully worded: "Ge family is not a big family, this matter in the southeast area may not have spread, just that woman came to the capital to sue the imperial court, the son of the minister also do not know how to deal with, only to report in full to the father."
Emperor Hongzheng nodded and did not let Jing Shao get up, still looking at the map of mountains and rivers in front of him that took up an entire wall, "Do you know why Taizu sealed the vassal kings?"
"The previous dynasty was unkind in its governance, the Great Ancestor fought the world with the three anti-king, and the first to break the capital city was the emperor," Jing Shao tilted his head and looked at the map that he had looked at countless times in his previous life, the southwest, the southeast, and the Huainan three pieces of land, counting the pacification of the Southern Barbarian Rebellion, he had fought for a whole ten years, "The Great Ancestor was kind and benevolent, and after he got the world, he sealed the southwest, Southeast and Huainan three hereditary vassal kings."
"Fiefdom thing, I am not willing to care more." Hongzheng emperor's back to Jing Shao see not expression, but Jing Shao know what his father is thinking, said aloud: "Although the southeast for the fiefdom, but also my great Chen's land, the people of the southeast, but also only recognize father an emperor."
When Emperor Hongzheng heard this, he violently turned around and stared tightly at Jing Shao, who was kneeling on the ground, and Jing Shao slightly lowered his head, letting him glare at him.
After a long time, Emperor Hongzheng suddenly laughed aloud, "Worthy of being my son! Hahaha!" Walking over to Jing Shao's side, he patted his shoulder and said in a deep voice, "San Fan, is a trouble to my heart, only, it's not the right time yet."
Jing Shao's pupils suddenly tightened, but on the face is not show, kowtowed: "I understand." Father's meaning was that now was not a good time to pacify the three clans, and this matter needed to be suppressed first. No wonder in the previous life, Jing Yu dared to blatantly withhold her as a royal concubine, and finally forced her to take revenge herself, and no wonder Jing Yu dared to be the first to come forward and propose the withdrawal of the clan. But it turned out that at this time, it had already gotten an affirmative answer from Father.

Sooner or later, the three feud is to start, Hongzheng Emperor's so-called time is not yet arrived just because there is no reasonable reason, just robbing the people of this one is not enough to put forward the withdrawal of the clan. The previous life is because of the Jing Shao in Yunnan and Tibet war in danger, Hongzheng Emperor ordered the Southwest King to send troops to reinforce, unexpectedly the Southwest King to the Southwest hardship and encountered a natural disaster on the grounds that the court first grain and grass money and then send troops, provoked the emperor was furious, ordered the withdrawal of the feudal. At that time, the great effort just destroyed the southern barbarians Jing Shao, not yet returned to the capital, and then received the decree to wield the army to the south, directly to the Southwest fiefdom.
This life already does not need him to go to level that out of the effort of the southern barbarians of the chaos, then the war of the three clans or the sooner the start the better. Jing Shao was pondering on the back of his horse, and when he came back to his senses, Xiao Hei had already walked to the Second Prince's Mansion.
"You kid, still thinking about the fresh grass in brother's mansion." Jing Shao amusingly pulled Xiao Hei's ears, just out of the palace into the second prince's mansion, will certainly cause suspicion, was about to turn his horse, met Jing Chen who came back from his lower post.
"Standing in front of the door for what, why don't you go in?" Jing Chen got down from the sedan chair, he saw his own younger brother in front of the door boredly pulling the horse's ears, the older brother who felt ashamed couldn't help but frown. This capital dares to street horse, only his brother who is not careful, this moment in front of their own door to daze, is not it again broke some trouble?
Jing Shao rolled over and dismounted, scratching his head, "I wanted to find someone to drink with, and without realizing it, I walked to my brother's door."
Jing Chen glared at him, "So old, always thinking of running and drinking, what a shame!"
Jing Shao smiled and handed his horse over to his elder brother's attendant to hold, walking side by side with his brother himself, "Go to the House of Returning Taste, it's the closest to here."
Jing Chen rubbed the corner of his forehead and told the sedan bearers to go back to the mansion, while he himself and Jing Shao walked on foot towards the House of Returning Flavors.
It is not yet time to eat, back to the flavor of the building not many people, Jing Shao tube in a dark red silk dress Zhou boss asked for a elegant room.
"Do you know who this Zhou Zhuan is?" Jing Chen couldn't help but frown when he saw that the two were very familiar with each other.
"Of course I know," Jing Shao poured a cup of tea for his elder brother, "Xiao Yuan is from the Qingliu school, but he is not rigid, elder brother can try to win him over."
"It's good that you have a sense of proportion." Jing Chen nodded, today an official from the Ministry of Ceremonies said that Princess Cheng and Squire Xiao's wife were very close, it was expected that King Cheng must have some involvement with Xiao Yuan, seeing as his own brother understood the stakes, he did not intend to intervene.
Since I saw my brother, I simply said what happened in the palace, so that my brother has a number in mind. As for Ge Ruoyi's matter, Jing Shao is a little difficult, father's meaning is, to the overall situation, this matter is not enough to constitute a reason to attack the southeast, even if the war is declared out, but also is just the icing on the cake, and deal with it will let the people think that the court does not care about people's deaths and lives, weak and incompetent. As for how to dispose of this woman, but it is all left to him.
"If you are inconvenient, just send her to my residence for your sister-in-law to control." Jing Chen proposed, because Princess Cheng is a man and can't be watched over all the time, and Princess Cheng's side wife has been relegated, although the second prince's consort isn't gentle and considerate enough, she does have a knack for managing the inner house.
Jing Shao furrowed his brows, Ge Ruoyi was the key to pacifying Southeast, he snatched her up because he didn't want the Fourth Prince to delay her from killing the Southeast King so that he could have fewer years to fight. But this could not be explained to his elder brother, he could only shake his head and said, "This person is still useful, I will go back and discuss with Junqing."
Jing Chen nodded, he was very satisfied with the disciple Xu who had passed through the door not long ago, learned and humble, just enough to help Jing Shao who was not good at scheming tactics.
As they were talking, a noise from downstairs interrupted the two.
"Two gentlemen, have a word!" Xiao Er was so anxious that he was sweating profusely to dissuade them, but the two people who were struggling together did not listen to persuasion at all.
Jing Shao opened the door and took a look, only to see two men dressed in flashy clothes fighting in the lobby, neither of them very good at kung fu, fighting without any demeanor to speak of. The taller man seemed to have the upper hand, knocking the other to the ground.
Jing Shao looked at the person who fell to the ground some familiar, fixed his eyes to look carefully, is not precisely just a few days ago to see the Mu Lingbao it? One eye is still green. As for the other ......
"Duke Maoguo's son," Jing Chen saw that he couldn't recognize him, so he spoke out to remind him, "The Empress released a rumor the day before yesterday that she was going to choose a proper consort for the Fourth Prince, and both the Duke Maoguo and the Marquis of Beiwei's residence have first misses who are still unmarried."
Jing Shao heard this, suddenly realized. Can not help but snort out a laugh, the North Marquis of Wei their family played a good calculation, but it is a pity that the queen of the previous life is interested in the Miss Maoguo Gongfu, and finally he was wronged in prison, the fourth prince of this old man but the credit can not be ignored.
"If Marquis Bei Wei marries the stepchildren, you will be more distant from their family in the future, and mention less about matters in the imperial court in front of Dixu." Jing Chen hid the door, lest the people downstairs see Jing Shao, after all, his great-uncle was being pressed and beaten up, but this brother-in-law didn't help, it doesn't look good to talk about it.
When Jing Shao heard his brother's words, his heart became a little uncomfortable, in his opinion, Jun Qing was more worthy of his trust than anyone else, but his brother was also for his own good, so he coldly snorted and said: ''Mu Ling Bao, that full sister, is the same as him, being spoiled by Marquis Bei Wei's wife, the stepchildren, even if they want to pull in the Marquis Bei Wei again, they probably wouldn't want to allow Jing Yu to marry a woman of this caliber.
Jing Chen heard this and murmured, "If Miss Mu is really what you say, why don't we ......
"Brother!" Jing Shao immediately interrupted his elder brother, "Although the military power in the hands of Marquis Bei Wei is not as good as Duke Maoguo's, his military power is in the Northwest, and he is now preparing to peddle horses in the Northwest, which is much more useful than Duke Maoguo."
"Is that so?" Jing Chen listened and frowned for a moment in thought, "In that case, I will have someone reveal Miss Mu's condition to the Empress."
Jing Shao sniffed and secretly sighed in relief. He believed Jun Qing, but couldn't explain it to his elder brother. Jun Qing was already having a hard time in that family, and if the Fourth Prince were to marry the Marquis of Bei Wei, in the future, when the two parties were at loggerheads, how would someone as meticulous as Jun Qing be able to handle himself?
Back at the aliyah, it was already dark.
Jing Shao walked into the bedroom, saw Mu Hanzhang wearing a plain civilian clothes, leaning on the soft collapse quietly reading a book, soft candlelight hit his face, is that kind of quiet and beautiful. Can not help but hook up the corners of the lips, see this person, only feel the courtroom flurry of disturbances, the courtroom under the plotting and scheming, all dissipated.
Slowly walking over, burying his face into his own princess's chest, deeply inhaling the faint fragrance of his body, Jing Shao relaxed his body and slowly closed his eyes, reborn in a life full of bloodshed, only by his side would he feel at peace. This person is the only salvation that God has given himself.
"What's wrong? Got a lecture from Father?" Mu Hanzhang touched the big head on his chest.
"No, running for a day a little tired just," Jing Shao looked up at him, such a warm and handsome appearance, with that green one eye round face Mu Lingbao completely unlike, suddenly remembered back to the door the day in the North Marquis of Wei's study to see that painting, "Jun Qing, your family this generation is not all according to the ancient nine weapons to take the name of the ?"
"This family's lineage is like this, the three of us siblings are the names of the three precious swords." Mu Hanzhang said in a warm voice, his father's love of famous weapons had become obsessive, even the names of his children were taken in this way.
The ancient nine weapons, the knife three, one is said to be Lingbao, two is said to contain the chapter, three is said to be quality.
