Jing Shao frowned, "Then Miss Mu's maiden name is 'Mu Quality'?"
Mu Hanzhang nodded, "Why did you suddenly remember to ask this? Is it because the Fourth Prince is going to choose a consort?"
"I'm just curious," Jing Shao moved forward, "If your sister looks like Mu Ling Bao, I'm afraid it'll be hard to marry her."
"Which is not that bad." He glared at the person who was talking nonsense on him, but thinking about Mu Lingbao's face turning into a woman, Mu Hanzhang himself couldn't help but laugh out loud.
The next day, Jing Shao found Ge Ruoyi, who was staying temporarily in the small courtyard.
It had to be said that the freshly changed Ge Ruoyi was indeed beautiful, and one could imagine what kind of beauty the son of the Ge family, the one who had made the Southeast King want to get the entire Ge family even if he had to kill them, was.
"The current situation is like this, the Southeast King is killing people in his own fiefdom, and the court can't care much about it, even if this matter goes to be investigated, he casually presses a big charge on the Ge family's head, and at the most, it will be considered as a tyrannical government for him." Jing Shao sighed lightly.
The hope in Ge Ruoyi's eyes instantly darkened, and a pair of slender, soft hands gradually clenched white.
"Some words shouldn't be said, but this king can tell you, sooner or later the southeastern fiefdom court will take it back, it just takes some time." Jing Shao looked at her like this, slowly clasped his hand on the short sword at his waist, the southeast king's temperament he already knew, the assassination matter to find someone else is the same, although it will cost a little. But if Ge Ruoyi doesn't know what's good for her, keeping her is a scourge.
"Your Highness is willing to run for my daughter, it is already a great favor, my daughter also knows that this revenge can not be avenged overnight," Ge Ruoyi was silent for a long time, and suddenly knelt down and kowtowed to Jing Shao, "Many thanks to your Highness for taking care of me in these past few days, and I will definitely repay you for your great kindness in the future. "
Jing Shao slowly loosened the hand clasped on the knife, this woman is not only courageous and resourceful, but also see things more transparent than the average person, back then when he saw her covered in blood in the Southeast King's Palace, he had a sincere admiration for this persistent woman, this is also the reason why he is not willing to swindle and take advantage of the situation, but rather the truth, after all, Ge Ruoyi is just like his own self in his previous life, he fought with all his might, and in the end, he lost all of it.
"This king gives you two ways, one, wait in the capital, no trouble, in a few years this king will naturally give you an explanation; two, this king let someone teach you the secret weapon method, help you sneak into the southeast king's mansion, you go to take revenge yourself." Jing Shao quietly gazed at Ge Ruoyi who was kneeling on the ground, his tone was calm and solemn, "If you don't know how to choose, wait for you to figure it out and then come back to this king."
"I choose the second path!" Ge Ruoyi gave an answer almost immediately.
"You must think clearly," Jing Shao frowned, "If you don't go, this king can find you a good family to marry."
"My daughter will never back out, please fulfill your majesty!" Ge Ruoyi kowtowed three times to Jing Shao, fearing that Jing Shao would not give her this opportunity.
Out of the small courtyard door, Jing Shao saw Mu Hanzhang standing under the peach blossom tree waiting for him.
"How did you anticipate that she would definitely choose the second one?" Jing Shao asked, this statement was the result of last night's discussion with his own princess.
Mu Hanzhang smiled, picked a peach blossom and threw it into the water: "Yang Hua into the water, still rootless, it is better to do that wildfire, even if it destroys itself, but also burned out the enemy."
When Jing Shao heard this, he only felt enlightened. For him, if he were to live a new life without the ties of Jun Qing and his elder brother, I am afraid that he would also be like Ge Ruoyi, who would defy all odds and kill all of his enemies, even if he had to topple the kingdom and the mountain.
Turning to late April, the fourth prince's confinement finally ended, and under the persuasion of the Empress Dowager, Emperor Hongzheng also approved of the matter of choosing a proper consort for the fourth prince.
The response given by Jing Shao, who was still copying books at home, as the elder brother, was to send his beautiful Wang Ji. When it is a congratulatory gift to celebrate the lifting of the ban, it is also a reparation gift for robbing his younger brother of his beauty.

chapters.title: 28 - A rainy day ahead
chapters.content:
The fourth prince received this congratulatory gift can not be happy at all, know that Yan Ji is the year the big prince to give Jing Shao, now Jing Shao original gift to him, this hot potato but he can not push out. Because the elder brother can send younger brother beauty, but no younger brother to send elder brother concubine reasoning, and under him, is no more adult brother.
Jing Shao's book actually finished copying a long time ago, just lazy for a long time do not want to go to the court.
Mu Hanzhang urged him to go back as early as possible, "The court is changing rapidly, and now that the Fourth Prince is back in the court, it's better to be careful."
Thus, leaving Ge Ruoyi with the Ghost Nine Daggers to learn concealed weapons, and explaining that Ren Feng had secretly tidied up the barren forests in the eastern suburbs, Jing Shao reluctantly packed his bags and returned to the royal residence with his own princess.
The fourth prince returned to the court on the third day, King Cheng Jing Shao also completed ten times the "book of war". Hongzheng Emperor in the court looked through once, asked the questions, all answered, the dragon heart was pleased, rewarded Cheng Wang tribute satin ten, pearl a bucket.
The courtiers all said that although King Cheng can not inherit the great system, but the holy favor will not decline. Only Jing Shao knows that his father rewarded his position on the matter of the three feuds, but it is just a pat on the back to the right place.
Tribute satin is a good thing, Jing Shao is ready to Jun Qing and himself to do a few new clothes, as for this bucket of pearls is not much use, now the king's residence in the female family members left Song Lingxin one, or he saw it is bored, so let Mu Huanzhang with this bucket of good pearls back to the North Marquis of Wei a trip to be divided into those seven aunts and eight aunts.
Mu Hanzhang know that he is trying to give himself face, naturally will not brush off his good intentions, and let Duo Fu went to the storehouse to pick a few gifts to bring, leading Yunzhu back to the Marquis of Beiwei House.
A bucket of pearls, a handful for each of the aunts and uncles, a handful for each of the sisters, twenty for each of the several aunts, and the remaining half to honor the grandmother and half to go to Mrs. Bei Wei Hou.
"Yo ~ this is a tribute pearl, each one is round and full, I've only seen a few of them at my mother's place." The talkative Third Aunt rambled on and on as she held the pearl in her hands and loved it.
The rest of the aunts and sisters also hung a smile on their faces, and called the royal consort affectionately with every mouthful.
Aunt Qiu's body has recovered, standing behind Marquis Lady Bei Wei and looking at her son, who is dressed in a gorgeous suit and through and through, she is finally a little more relieved.
Bei Wei Marquis wife is from the beginning of the cold face, did not say two words, began to reprimand Mu Huanzhang: "You are a man, can not keep the heir, for the wife is more to be virtuous! Now the king has no heir, but you put a bunch of concubines to send out all, say out I have no face, know is you young and unintelligent, don't know also think I will not teach my son."
Originally fluttering with the fourth lady said the pearl soup of the third lady, heard the words suddenly stopped talking, that slightly sharp voice stopped, the whole hall are quiet. Although Beiwei Marquis wife is the first mother, but Mu Huanzhang is now the Prince Consort, rank higher than the Beiwei Marquis wife, the crowd is a little embarrassed do not know what to do.
Mu Hanzhang slowly put down his cup, looking at Du with some amusement, she would say these words, nothing more than because Jing Shao sent the Fourth Prince a royal concubine, afraid that her daughter would be aggrieved if she married there. She really took the Fourth Prince as her son-in-law!
"Mother is overly concerned. Since son learned the four books and five sutras, the one who taught son is the clan school gentleman, even if son can't do the three obediences and four virtues, the ladies in the capital won't laugh at you." Mu Hanzhang slowly rubbed the rim of his cup, meaning to say, "The affairs of the Cheng Wang Fu, has always been the king's master, mother's tantrums against her son will not help."
Bei Wei Marquis wife will be in the hands of the cup heavily knocked on the table, staring at him for a long time, and suddenly slowed down the tone of voice: "Not I say you, since you have married, you have to think about the husband's family. The king is young, you have to be more persuasive. Since you can't carry on the great lineage, you have to leave yourself a way out. If the quality can marry the fourth prince, the king and the fourth prince is a brother-in-law, what if there is something in the future, there is also a way back."
When Mu Hanyang heard this, he only felt ridiculous. Does Du think she is a three year old child? Is the brother-in-law more intimate than the brother? In the royal family, the brothers are also cruel to each other, the relationship of a brother-in-law is worthless. Can't help but sneer: "Sister's marriage, I'm a married out of the elder brother which can make the decision? Moreover, this matter is the Queen Mother's final say, even if the Prince is willing to also useless."
"You ......" Bei Wei Marquis Mrs. gas can not speak, but Mu Huan Zhang said every word in reason, the daughter's marriage is not yet settled, said more impact on her reputation, dry stare for a long time, only to stop.
Mu Hanzhang is a man, although it is the mother's family, but also can not sit in the inner house for a long time, estimate the time, the North Marquis of Wei almost should come back from the court, then get up to say goodbye to see his father.
Meanwhile, a major event took place in the courtroom on this day.
The king of the south-west petitioned that the tribute sent to the capital from the south-west fiefdom had been robbed, and the borderlands were in distress, requesting that the tribute be reduced this year.
"How do the ministers see this matter?" Emperor Hongzheng asked in a deep voice, holding the Southwest King's light yellow-colored seal.
"Southwest near Yunnan and Tibet, where is now in chaos, the tribute was robbed is really helpless, in my opinion, this tribute can be reduced." The Minister of the Ministry of the Interior said, weighing his words.
"Dare to rob the tribute, this group of hairy thieves is really rampant, according to my opinion, we should send troops to go and besiege and recapture the tribute." The Minister of War said indignantly.
"This year's summer residence repair, urgently need to use the southwest of the marble, such as if the tribute reduction, but also have to let the southwest to send some more marble." Ministry of Public Works for is, thought June marble can be sent, there is no purchase of other stone, and now even if re-sent, it is estimated that July to arrive in Beijing, and then how to rush work for fear of delaying the days of the Emperor's summer vacation.
The ministers argued with each other, but Emperor Hongzheng's frown was getting deeper and deeper, his gaze sweeping to the three imperial sons, "What do you three have in mind?"
The fourth prince has just returned to the court, eager to show himself, see his father is not happy, step forward and said: "I heard that the southwest was hit by a spring drought, the people are in distress, and now the tribute was robbed is to add to the frost, reduce the tribute, although it is helpless, but to the people of the Southwest to show the benevolence of the son of heaven."
Emperor Hongzheng's eyes were deep, unable to see his joy or anger, and he had nothing to say about the fourth prince crossing over his two elder brothers to open his mouth first, turning to look at the second prince who had lowered his eyes and remained silent: "Jing Chen, what do you think?"
Jing Chen stepped forward and bowed, "The court is not greedy for money to pay tribute, but to deter the three clans to show the might of heaven. Tribute on the way, suddenly robbed, the blame in the southwest, not the court. Therefore, I thought, the tribute can not be reduced!" The voice is steady and strong, not anxious, one sentence at a time, sound, the noisy court hall was silent.
The sternness in Emperor Hongzheng's eyes slowed down, revealing a color of relief, but he didn't say anything and continued to look at Jing Shao, who was full of impatience, "Jing Shao, what do you want to say?"
"Hmph, from the southwest to transport tribute into the capital, the road traveled at all but Yunnan and Tibet! And half of the tribute is a thousand kilograms of marble, which mountain bandits can not think of will go to rob these tributes?" Jing Shao just stood in place, also do not salute, open mouth to say, a look by the crowd angry to the appearance.
Hearing such blunt and rude words, Emperor Hongzheng, instead of being annoyed, hooked his lips, "Do you understand?"
The final result is that Emperor Hongzheng sent someone to investigate the robbery of tribute, as for the candidate is not mentioned in the court. The Southwest King sent marble material to the first, as for the matter of reducing the tribute, temporarily suppressed not to mention.
After retiring from the court, Emperor Hongzheng called the second prince Jing Chen alone to the imperial study.
Jing Shao patted the frustrated Fourth Prince on the shoulder and turned around to pull the Marquis of Northern Wei who was about to go home.
"What is your majesty's instruction?" Mu Jin politely walked out side by side with Jing Shao.
"Your father-in-law is overstating things, today Jun Qing is returning to the Marquis, I'll go with you on the way to pick him up and take him back." Jing Shao lightly laughed.
"Hanyang went to the Marquis' residence?" When Mu Jin heard this, he couldn't help but reveal a slight smile, "That's great, Your Highness will stop by and have lunch before going back."
"Then I won't be polite, just in time to have a drink with Marquis. I've been thinking about the Northwest Spirits from last time." Jing Shao laughed, letting Marquis Bei Wei go first and turning himself onto his horse.
Mu Jin looked at the respectful but not unkind Jing Shao, and then glanced at the Fourth Prince who was walking with his head down not far away, he couldn't help but frown slightly and turned around to get into the carriage.
North Marquis of Wei old lady a few years ago the health is not good, always sick in bed, basically do not see guests.
Mu Hanzhang went to pay his respects to his grandmother and presented the expensive medicinal herbs he had brought. The white-haired old lady took his hand and talked for a while.
"Grandmother is old, can't control things, you married into the royal family, speak and do things should be cautious, for the husband should also love and care, you are already married, it is one honor and one loss, do not hold grudges. King Cheng in the royal family is not easy, Yuan Queen is still in the time, he is what a light, and now live what days? People's hearts are made of flesh, if you treat him well, he won't treat you harshly." The old madam had spent her entire life in a royal household and could not understand things better.
"Sun'er understands, grandmother doesn't need to worry, the king treats Sun'er very well." Mu Hanzhang held the old man's hand with both hands, and a burst of warmth welled up in his heart. Since childhood, his grandmother loved him, although not as much as the first grandson, but never too much bias, some people are difficult for him, the old man is also trying to protect, so that he suffered a lot of grievances.
The old lady is old, after talking for a while, some physical strength, Mu Hanzhang served grandmother to sleep, and then retired. Just walked to the front yard, met a group of cousins returning from school.
"Yo, this is not the princess, why, in the king's residence suffered aggression back to her mother's home to cry?" When Mu Yangwen saw Mu Hanzhang, he habitually wanted to stab him twice. The few younger brothers behind him couldn't help but laugh when they heard this.

chapters.title: chapter xxix - balm
chapters.content:
Mu Hanzhang looked at the arrogant Mu Yangwen with cold eyes, slowly walked over, raised his hand and "snapped" a slap on his face, which was smiling proudly.
Mu Yangwen was slapped and slowly turned back, "Mu Hanzhang, you dare to hit me!"
"Pah!" Another slap that completely blindsided Mu Yangwen.
"I am your elder brother, how can you call me by my first name? Hasn't Third Uncle ever taught you what filial piety and fraternal duty are?" Mu Hanzhang looked condescendingly at his cousin who had stumbled from being hit.
"Mu Hanzhang, don't go too far!" Mu Huafeng, who was on the side, saw his brother being beaten and raised his fist to strike.
The two guards behind Mu Hanzhang drew their waist swords with a brush and pull, frightening the crowd to take half a step back in unison, and some of the younger brothers cried out directly.
"Stop it all!" Marquis Bei Wei's muffled voice came from behind as he angrily walked over.
The group of people from the Mu family, who would usually tremble in fear when they heard the family head's voice, heard it today, but they were relieved in unison.
"Jun Qing!" Jing Shao rushed over with quick steps and wrapped his royal consort into his arms, "Are you alright?"
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, but how can not help but slightly upward, how to look at this situation is that he is teaching others, right, this guy is really ......
Seeing that the person in his arms was fine, Jing Shao turned his head to look at Mu Yangwen, who was covering his face, and Mu Huafeng, who had forgotten to put away his fists: ''Marquis, not to mention that Junqing is my royal consort, in the Beiwei Marquis' residence, is it not necessary to honor one's brother and sister? The filial piety and fraternal etiquette of the Mu family is really an eye-opener for this king!"
Mu Jin was infuriated with a burst of green and white on his face, pointing at his two nephews, "You two, go and face the wall with Shizi, each copying the filial piety fifty times, and you're not allowed to eat dinner if you don't finish copying!"
Mu Yangwen wanted to say something else, but was glared back by Mu Jin with a glance, and could only follow his brother as he turned to leave.
"Slow down!" Jing Shao let go of his own princess and drank in the two, "The laws of the family are indistinguishable from the laws of the country, what is the offense for disrespecting the princess?"
The two brothers did not have a backbone without Mu Ling Bao by their side, glancing at each other, it was only now that they realized their fear and looked at their own eldest uncle for help.
"Your Highness, calm your anger, little children don't know any better." Mu Jin was also somewhat unable to get down, and glanced at Mu Hanzhang, who was standing half a step behind Jing Shao.
Seeing this, Mu Hanzhang went forward and pulled Jing Shao's arm, persuading him in a gentle voice, "It's just that, they are all brothers, the king should not be angry."
Jing Shao sniffed and patted the glistening and slender hand: "Wangfei does not care about it, today's matter is just a matter of fact, in the future, if you let the king see anyone disrespectful to Wangfei, don't blame the king for turning his back on you!"
The group of cousins all shrunk their heads, and with Mu Jin's approval, they left in disgrace.
"Third brother, didn't eldest uncle send someone to say that there is a guest for us to accompany today, so he gave us half a day's vacation? Why don't we accompany the guest again?" The youngest brother asked in a low voice.
"Shhh~" The brothers on the side were busy covering his mouth and disappeared into the atrium in a puff of smoke.
"The old minister is not strict in ruling his family, letting Your Highness laugh at me." Mu Jin sighed, looked at Mu Hanzhang who stood beside Jing Shao with an upright posture and extraordinary demeanor, and couldn't help but feel a little despondent, the first son of the Mu family's generation, there was not a single one who was competitive! Nowadays, it seems that the one who has the most style of the Mu family is this commoner son who has already been married off.
When he returned to the royal residence in the afternoon, Mr. Yun hurriedly greeted him, "Your Highness, today His Highness the Second Prince sent someone to let you hurry over as soon as you return."
Jing Shao frowned, and Mu Hanzhang said, "Brother must have something urgent to find you, so go quickly."
Jing Shao nodded, turned around and mounted Xiao Hei and ran out again.
Mu Hanzhang went back to the house to rest a nap, just got up, heard Yunzhu said Zhou Zhuan visit, busy dressed to listen to the wind pavilion of the tea hall.
"Big Brother Zhou has been waiting for a long time." Mu Hanzhang apologized.
"I'm just here, the kind of business at the Retrospective House, I won't be free until after midday." Zhou Zhuan smiled brightly.
Mu Hanyang Zhang was relieved when he heard this and asked him what was the matter.
"Last time you did not say that you want to open a small store?" Zhou Zhuan drank a mouthful of tea, the tea drinks in this royal palace are all tribute tea divided by the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the market can not buy the very best, on the food and drink is quite concerned about Zhou Zhuan naturally tasted out, could not help but drink a few more mouths, "The capital should have all, small stores if not old, business is not good to do, unless there can be some rare contraptions."
"Rare contraption?" Seeing that he liked the tea, Mu Hanzhang gave Yunzhu a wink, and Yunzhu turned away in understanding.
"Well, to say that there is a shortage in the capital and that it sells well, I did see one thing when I was in Jiangnan," Zhou Zhuan said, unable to keep a narrow smile from flashing across his face, "I suddenly thought of it last night when I went to bed."
"Oh?" Mu Hanzhang was a bit curious, something that was available in Jiangnan but rare in the capital, why hadn't anyone sold it yet?
Zhou Zhuan laughed softly and took a sip of tea before spitting out two words, "Balm."
"Balm?" Mu Hanzhang froze, what was that? He hadn't really heard of it.
"Haha, this thing is very good in Jiangnan, I followed my husband to the capital, only to find that people in the north seldom use this, the street sells only that kind of flavorless scented oil." Zhou Zhuan's lips hooked up a bad smile, carefully recounting the beauty of this "balm".
There are a few famous workshops in Jiangnan that mix seasonal flowers into their balms, and there is a wide variety of them. Unlike oil, balm can be carried in a box and is very useful when it is melted by heat. Just something small, the price is not high, the merchants do not see this small profit, refused to go so far to sell. The northern flowers are few, there is no workshop to do this ......
Mu Hanyang listened to half a day, finally heard out what this is a thing, a handsome face can not help but red a thorough. The so-called balm, that is, when the man lubricates the grease used in good times, businessman heavy profit, this kind of thing although in the capital of the many male wives is very good to sell, but can not help the road is far from the profit is thin, so far, fewer people selling.
Zhou Zhuan sent a box of unopened balm to Mu Huanzhang, Mu Huanzhang see his face frank look, the same man, secretly said he was coy. Then suppressed the embarrassment, frankly accepted, and let Yunzhu bring the tea as a return gift.
Zhou Zhuan also did not excuse himself, quickly took the box of tea, explaining that if he thought about it, although to find him, and then went back to busy Hui flavor building business.
Jing Shao rushed to the Second Prince's residence and couldn't help but feel a little worried when he learned that his father was sending his elder brother to investigate the robbery of the tribute.
"Father is giving me the opportunity to be crowned king, it's a good thing, it's better than going to war like my eldest brother did." Jing Chen saw his younger brother worried and felt very relieved in his heart.
The Southwest King is a cunning person, he has done it, certainly left a backhand, Jing Shao no matter how the elder brother said, the frown is not spread: "Father intends to send how many soldiers?"
"It would have to be a secret visit to be poorly understood, so I was only given four guards and a third-ranked accompanying officer." Jing Chen said.
"How can this work?" Jing Shao almost jumped up, in his opinion his elder brother's kung fu is not good, only giving four guards, in case he meets some mountain thieves he can't deal with them, not to mention the Southwest King who is holding a heavy army! "I'll order five hundred men for you, follow from afar, and show up again if you encounter anything."
"How can five hundred people hide, no way!" Jing Chen refused without even thinking.
After a long time of bargaining, finally the brothers each took a step back, Jing Shao sent two martial arts masters to follow his elder brother, and the other point fifty soldiers first dispersed to the southwest, waiting for dispatches.
Leaving the second prince's residence, Jing Shao still felt uneasy, letting Yun Song make a trip to the courtyard, explaining that Ren Feng had picked two top experts to come.
When he returned to the East Garden bedroom, he saw his own princess sitting alone under the lamp, holding a delicate little box in her hands and fidgeting.
Quietly walking over, a grabbed that box, turned in his hands, "What is this?" Opening the lid of the box, inside was a kind of translucent cream, a fragrance overflowed, not sweet and greasy, on the contrary, there were a few tantalizing.
"This ...... this is ......" Mu Hanzhang was startled, and when he came back to his senses, he quickly reddened his face, "Today, Brother Zhou sent a sample of goods. "
"Oh?" Jing Shao raised an eyebrow, slowly coming up to his own princess's ear and blowing into that onyx-colored ear, "Then why is your face red?"
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, glared at Jing Shao, snatched the box from his hands, turned around and went back to the inner room to ignore him.
Jing Shao froze, his own Wangfei even learned to be naughty to him? Holding his fist against his lips, he smothered two laughs and followed into the inner room.
He naturally recognized that thing, although no one in the capital to sell, but the Ministry of Internal Affairs will buy every year. The law stipulates that only allowed to marry a male wife, not allowed to take male concubines, but this is not much constraint on the son of heaven, there is no shortage of male concubines in the palace. Moreover, he is a prince to marry a male wife, the palace will naturally reward a lot of this kind of thing, on the two of them bed in a small cabinet, there are several boxes of good balm.
When he entered the inner room, he saw his own princess gamely lying on the bed with her clothes on, facing the wall and ignoring him, her exposed ears still flushed with pink color.
Jing Shao endure laugh pounced up, put the bed into the arms of the person: "do not tease you, this thing the capital is indeed rarely sold. If you want to do this business is actually very good to do, the Jiangnan Generalissimo and I make good friends, every ten days have letters sent, I asked him to bring some over every time on the good."
"How can that be? If he refuses to accept the money, won't it become a bribe?" Mu Hanzhang turned his head and frowned, this kind of small thing is not worth a few dollars, whether it is from the perspective of a friend or a vassal, the Jiangnan Generalissimo will definitely not want that capital. He just wants to find a camp, if this brings trouble to Jing Shao it will not be worth the loss.
Seeing Jun Qing so for his own sake, Jing Shao could not help but kiss the corner of his mouth, "This you can rest assured, that guy is famous stingy, absolutely will not be less than a penny of the tube you want money, maybe even ask for an extra road fee, I can have to kill the price with him."

chapters.title: 30: Southwest Emergency
chapters.content:
With a source of goods, opening a store would be easy. Mu Hanzhang asked Zhou Zhuan to identify a two-room store on the street where the Tasteful House was located, and asked Mr. Yun to go to the famous carpenters and silver stores in the capital to customize a batch of exquisite wooden boxes and silver boxes.
"What does the princess want these boxes for?" Yunzhu asked Mu Huanzhang holding a bunch of well-made boxes, these boxes are exquisitely crafted, even more expensive than those balms, wouldn't the Wangfei lose money by doing this?
Mu Hanzhang took a silver box and smiled without saying anything, letting Yunzhu carry these to the yard of the nanny's family. Jiangnan sent the balm, mostly with a bamboo tube, iron box, the price is not high, even if you raise the price, the best can buy a hundred or ten wen. But change the exquisite box is not the same, the capital city officials and dignitaries are mostly, the more expensive things the more people buy.
Turning to the middle of May, the store has been taken care of. When the second shipment arrives, Mu Hanzhang's small store selling balm will officially open.
Elegantly decorated store, half-hidden by bamboo curtains, with a bamboo plaque at the door, inscribed with three elegant and powerful characters "Mo Lien Ju".
The word "Mo" means the ink garden where the male wives often go, and "Lotus" means fragrance. Because this month's party, Mu Hanzhang took some wooden boxes of balm to give to those male wives, one by ten, ten by a hundred, to the opening day, the buyers, watching the crowd, almost blocked the door.
Different from the general store opening, to firecrackers, lion dance, mu hanzhang let people invited the capital in the famous musician to play in front of the store, the sound of music, incomparable elegance. People see this situation, also not good clamor, only quiet on the sidelines to watch.
The store's balm is divided into several grades, there are iron box, wooden box, silver box, the price difference is very far, the iron box is only a hundred or ten wen, the wooden box to one to two silver, silver box will be dozens of taels or even hundreds of taels.
Since the elder brother went to the southwest, Jing Shao will have to face the fourth prince alone every day in the courtroom, even a password to the people are not, very unhappy, so much so that every morning is bedridden do not want to go to the court, always have to mu hanzhang called three or four times before they are willing to climb up.
However, the last few days, Jing Shao suddenly began to like to go to the court, because the southwest urgent report, the eldest prince in Yunnan and Tibet in danger, life and death is uncertain. The eldest prince will write daily report back to the capital, but now has been more than ten days without news.
Today, the Governor of Yunnan and Tibet's report was sent to us, and only then did things become clear. As soon as the Great Prince entered Yunnan and Tibet, he was eager to attack the southern barbarians and did not listen to advice. The southwestern forest is full of miasma, soon after the army entered the mountains, there were many soldiers and generals fell sick from inhaling miasma. Last month, the Grand Prince led his troops into the mountains and was caught in a bitter battle, and has yet to return. This three thousand miles of expedited delivery over, also delayed seven or eight days, the eldest prince is alive or dead is not known.
"Father, for the sake of today's plan, we need to immediately send troops to rescue, otherwise, the eldest brother is in danger!" Fourth Prince Jing Yu kneeled on the ground and said urgently, regardless of whether it was true or not, that hyun's appearance of wanting to cry was sincere and incomparable.
"It's too late to send troops now, they must be deployed nearby." The Minister of War said in a deep voice.
"Waste!" Emperor Hongzheng was so angry that he slammed the zhang in his hand on the ground.
The court was silent for a moment, the prince went to war, originally to deter the southern barbarians, pacify the people, now the eldest prince just arrived a month into a bitter war, but also in danger of uncertainty of life and death, the opposite to the court to bring unlimited trouble. The courtiers do not say on the face, but the heart is to feel that this big prince is really incompetent.
"Father rest his anger, my son has a solution." Jing Shao saw that the time was almost up before he took a step and bowed.
"Speak." Emperor Hongzheng took a deep breath and looked at Jing Shao.
"The southwestern fiefdom is closest to Yunnan and Tibet, and my son has heard that the southwestern troops are strong, so why don't we have the king of the southwest send troops to reinforce the eldest royal brother." Jing Shao lowered his head, hiding the cold light in his eyes. The Southwest King's character, with which he had been maneuvering for several years, he was more than clear, cunning and careful. If he is allowed to send troops, he will definitely push back and forth. Southwest from the capital of three thousand miles, even if only one excuse, this back and forth coupled with the time delayed on the road to send troops, at least one month, at that time can not live, we have to look at his big brother's destiny.
Emperor Hongzheng frowned, he was also very skeptical about the southwestern tribute matter, letting the Southwest King send troops just so that he could take this opportunity to see if the Southwest King really had a rebellious heart. Appreciatively looked at Jing Shao a glance, Hongzheng Emperor issued a decree, that is, ordered the Southwest King to send troops to reinforce the eldest prince, to pacify the southern barbarians of the chaos. If the rescue of the great prince, can be exempted from the Southwest the rest of this year's tribute.
Jing Shao mood quite good to return to the king's mansion, saw his own Wangfei sitting on the soft collapse smiling eyes curved look at the account book, can not help but be some hand itch, the account book snatched away: "Look at a book of accounts on the happy into this, could it be that this book of accounts is better than I still look good?"
Mu hanzhang looked at the more and more thick-skinned guy a glance, also not annoyed, "If compared with people, you are since better looking than anyone else, but ......" lengthened the tail end of the voice, taking advantage of the Jing Shao grinning, a hand will be snatched over the account book, "This account book is not a person ." Said, and looked up.
Today just opened, business has been red beyond red, the cost of those things is not high, is the box more expensive, but add up to less than 30% of the selling price, really earn a lot.
"Hmph!" Jing Shao disgruntledly pounced his own princess on the soft collapse, "Eldest royal brother is in distress in Dianzang, I don't know if he's dead or alive."
"Yes?" Mu Hanzhang heard this, before taking his eyes off the ledger.
Jing Shao gave a general account of the events in the court, and sighed lightly, "If the Southwest King angers Father, the removal of the clan will be near."
Mu Hanzhang narrowed his eyes and said softly, "In this situation today, the removal of the clan will inevitably lead to a fight, will Your Highness go?"
Jing Shao sat up, took a deep breath, slowly nodded: "If it is a war, will certainly go, only I, have the certainty to pacify the San Francisco!" Bright candlelight reflecting Jing Shao resolute side face, with the pride that can not be hidden, calm and powerful voice, as if already in the battlefield, facing three hundred thousand generals, boldly declared war!
Mu Hanzhang fixedly looked at him, pursed his lips, a long time Fang said, "You are a capable person, it is I who dragged you down." This person, has no less than the great-grandfather's generalship talent, only a pity that he was not born at the right time.
"Jun Qing!" Hearing these words, Jing Shao s heart inexplicably ached, back in the year on the cliffs of the Sealed Moon Mountain, Jun Qing this is this said, you are a capable person, it is me who has dragged you down ...... can not help but raise his voice.
Mu Hanzhang was yelled at by him, looked up to see, and was met with a pair of slightly red eyes, realized that he had said the wrong thing, and immediately panicked: "Little spoon ...... I ......"
Jing Shao wrapped the rambling man into his arms and embraced him tightly, as if to strangle him into his flesh and blood, "Don't you dare say that again, do you hear me!"
Feeling that the arms around himself are still tightening, Mu Hanzhang was strangled by the raw pain, could not help but frown, but did not cry out in pain, just reached back to embrace him: "I remembered, and will not say so ...... hmmm...... "Said to the end, or can not help but stifle a grunt.
Jing Shao then woke up and let go of his hands in a panic, "Did I hurt you?"
Mu Hanyang shook his head, but was forced by Jing Shao to peel off his shirt. He saw the original white upper arm was strangled out two deep red marks, and gradually towards the blue and purple change. Jing Shao was so distressed that he brought medicinal wine and rubbed it carefully for him. The rubbing changed the flavor, the original heartbroken eyes gradually darkened, dipped in the medicinal wine fingers slowly slid to the shoulders, and from the shoulders to the chest.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang was busy clutching the hand that was spinning on a cherry red, and looked around, this is still the outer room, the maid will come in at any time, but not here.
Jing Shao, however, had no intention of stopping, as he wrapped the person into his arms, containing an ear that was flushed with pink color: "Junqing, shall we round up today?" The situation on the cliff swept through his mind over and over again, his heart aching beyond measure, he wanted to possess the person in his arms, wanted to become one with him, so that he could confirm that he was still alive, living in his arms; so that he could confirm that this was not a yellow dream, and that all of the misery had not yet happened!
Mu Hanzhang heard the words, such as by lightning struck wide eyes, round ...... round room? Married more than two months, in addition to the night of the wedding, they really have not done in the end. On the one hand, he was afraid of the kind of pain that rips the body apart, and then Jing Shao know that he was afraid has not been forced, he pretended not to know the past.
Turning his head to look at the person holding him, that pair of handsome eyes, in addition to the usual tenderness and pity, there is also a trace of trepidation, the action of kissing him is also a little flustered, seems to be in a hurry to confirm what. Mu Hanzhang know if he is not willing, he will not force himself, but looking at today's Jing Shao, he really can not bear to refuse. Big deal, again endure a night is, as long as can let him no longer so sad.
Mu Hanzhang was silent for a long time, and when Jing Shao was ready to give up, he slowly nodded and whispered, "Go back to bed ...... okay ......"
Jing Shao was stunned for a moment, picked up the person in his arms, "miso" stood up, used light energy to run to the inner room, "bang" kicked on the door!

chapters.title: 31 - Shocking News
chapters.content:
Jing Shao placed the man in his arms on the bed, felt him shivering slightly, kissed his cheek soothingly, and raised his hand to lower the tent. Remembering that Xiao Yuan had said that being in a darker environment could reduce the tension and shame of a male wife.
The light on the bed dimmed all of a sudden, Mu Hanzhang slowly opened his eyes and quickly closed them again, only his body wasn't as tense as it was just now. A warm hand unwrapped the crown of his head, gently caressing between the hair on top of his head, a kiss as gentle as water landed on the forehead, traced across the tip of his nose, and sought out his lips. Compassionate touches, testing, gradually turning into light sucking and nibbling.
Jing Shao felt the person in his arms some gasping for air, a little support body, through the weak light, only to see the person underneath the clothes scattered, long hair spread out, slightly red with a handsome face kept gasping for breath, the beauty is beyond compare.
The snow satin undershirt was ripped open, revealing a glistening jade-like chest, but the sleeves are still on the arm, half covered, adding to the style. Jing Shao looked at the beauty in front of him, only to feel his mouth dry, leaned down to contain a small bean.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang whimpered at the provocation and immediately pursed her lips.
Jing Shao glanced at his shy self-consort, lowered his head and continued to savor the small bean that had already been bullied into redness, and reached out to pinch the other one, lightly twisting and pressing it, gradually increasing the force.
"Hmm ......唔...... "Mu Hanzhang trembled his body, had to open his eyes and look at the roof of the tent to distract his attention, preventing himself from making such a shameful sound, how could he not help that the person on his body seemed to see his intentions, bullying those two poor little guys more and more, even gently pulling outward with his teeth in his mouth.
"Ah ...... don't uh ......" Mu Hanzhang reached out to push him away, but her wrists were clutched and pressed to her head.
Jing Shao kissed his way up his chest to his chin, nibbled on a cute ear, pressed down on the wrist that was trying to resist with one hand, and stroked one hand over the small, tactile belly, circling and lightly tracing it before his calloused hand burrowed into the soft silk-lined pants like a spirit snake.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang twisted his body, but could not avoid that nimble hand, was held by him a lifeblood, suddenly no strength to resist, only to take a pair of beautiful eyes to look at the bullies.
Jing Shao saw his own princess looking at himself pitifully, his heart instantly softened into a puddle, let go of his wrist, lowered his head to kiss the lips that had been nibbled into a luscious color, let him wrap his arms around his neck, his hands quickly faded off those shirts, and fumbled around the bed for a while, grabbing a delicate white jade box.
When Mu Hanzhang saw what was in his hand, his handsome face, which was originally peach-colored, suddenly reddened completely.
Jing Shao lightly smiled and kissed him, "This is the tribute from Jiangnan, how much money can't buy it." Opening the white jade box, the balm inside was crystal clear and bright, obviously much more valuable than the best balm of Mo Lian Ju. Digging some of the ethereal balm on his fingertips, he probed towards the long coveted place.
Mu Hanzhang lightly bit her lower lip and closed her eyes, her long slender eyelashes could not help but tremble slightly.
"Junqing, look at me," Jing Shao looked at this, his heart couldn't bear it, and with his other hand he gently caressed his lips to save that poor lower lip, "don't bite, and don't hold back, if it hurts, just say so, huh?"
Mu Hanyang opened her eyes, looking at Jing Shao's sweaty handsome face, those beautiful eyes are full of tenderness and compassion, such a person will not hurt himself. The fear in his heart gradually disappeared, loosened his tightly bitten lower lip, and lightly nodded.
Long, slender fingers with cool balm, gently kneaded for a moment and slowly probed in.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang inclined his head and clutched the bed sheet underneath him. The feeling of a foreign object intruding was not pleasant, and with the movement of that finger, it gradually ceased to be so unpleasant, but then proceeded to squeeze in two more.
"Is it hard?" The sweat on Jing Shao's face dripped down his chin onto the chest of the man beneath him.
Mu Hanzhang nodded and shook his head again, that burning, tingling feeling, couldn't tell if it was hard or something else.
Seeing that the person underneath him had already adapted to three fingers, Jing Shao could no longer hold back, pulling up those slender legs and carefully breaking in.
"Ah ~" Mu Hanzhang stifled a grunt will not be able to make a sound, clutched the sheets underneath, a pair of glistening hands clenched knuckles white, and even shivering slightly, a long time before slowing down this mouth up, raised his head backward, a drop of tears along the corner of his eyes slipped down, trembling and crying out softly for pain, "Well ...... pain ...... ah ......"
"Junqing, don't be afraid, relax." Jing Shao wasn't having a good time either, not daring to make a move, kissing his eyes delicately and gently stroking his arched spine until he had eased through the excruciating pain, and only then did he move slowly.
"Well ...... ah ......" Mu Hanzhang tightly frowned, ready to suffer another night of torture, who knows that with the body of the person's slow and gentle movements, the pain gradually subsided, replaced by a An indescribable feeling, until Jing Shao touched a certain place, a burst of amazing pleasure instantly attacked the whole body, making the original pain grunt suddenly changed a tone.
Jing Shao hooked his lips when he heard this wonderful soft hum and moved with relief.
"Aha ~ ah ...... well ...... there ...... don't ...... ah ...... "By the end of the day, Mu Hanzhang didn't know what he was saying. Only remember as if plunged into a boundless dream, in a lonely boat, with the huge waves rise and fall, do not know the name, do not know what is now and what is now and what is now.
Holding the person who had passed out in his arms tightly, Jing Shao curved the corners of his mouth in satisfaction, this person was finally completely and utterly his own, this existence that was the warmest and cleanest to him was now firmly held in his arms, and no one could take it away from him.
Perhaps when he just woke up, it was out of the pity and guilt of his last life that he wanted to treat him well, and also because of the memory of his last life, he subconsciously wanted to hold on to this only life-saving straw that made him feel warm and safe. But now, these days together, his knitted brows and smile are pulling his own gaze, that warm and stoic figure, has gradually walked from the eyes to the heart. When you become one with it, you only feel that there is nothing happier than this in this world.
As the saying goes, the hibiscus tent is warm for the spring night, and from then on, the king does not have an early morning court.
Mu Hanzhang habitually opened his eyes on time and couldn't help but frown, his body was exhausted as if he hadn't slept all night, and his waist and femur were very sore, so he couldn't help but grunt lightly. After carefully thinking about what happened last night, his hazel eyes instantly woke up, and his clear and handsome face was quickly colored with a scarlet red.
Don't know how to face the person behind him holding him tightly, Mu Hanzhang closed his eyes, intends to continue to sleep, waited for a long time but didn't see the person behind him awake, afraid that he missed the hour of the court, only to use his elbow to push the sleeping guy.
"Hmmm ...... Junqing ......," Jing Shao grunted, nuzzling the person into his arms again, rubbing against the long, silky hair before continuing to let out a light snore.
"Your Highness, change up." Duo Fu waited outside the door for a long time without seeing any movement in the house, so he only knocked on the door.
"Well ...... not going today ......" Jing Shao was upset at being woken up.
"Recently the dynasty is not peaceful, do not be capricious." Unable to do so, Mu Hanzhang could only yank away the arm on his shoulder and rolled over to push him.
Jing Shao reluctantly opened his eyes and saw his own Wangfei slightly frowning, showing a fatigued handsome face. Frozen for a moment, the corners of his mouth gradually grinned, holding the person over and kissing the slightly swollen lips, "I'm going to the court, you sleep some more."
Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but glare at him as he watched the corners of that mouth have a tendency to grin behind his ears.
Jing Shao gave another kiss on that exasperated cheek before he smiled and rolled out of bed to get dressed. On his way out, he didn't forget to tuck in the corner of the quilt for the person on the bed, and put the bed curtains back in place before reluctantly walking out of the inner room.
"Your Highness is in a good mood today." When he met Xiao Yuan in front of the palace gate, because Jing Shao's springy face was just too eye-catching, Servant Xiao couldn't help but ask.
"Servant Xiao!" Jing Shao saw Xiao Yuan and dragged him over, "I really don't know how to thank you, how about this, tomorrow, I'll buy you a drink!"
"So, Your Highness is getting what you want?" Xiao Yuan looked at Jing Shao's smug look and suddenly felt piercing.
"Thanks to those tricks of yours, it's just too effective!" Jing Shao hemmed and hawed and used his elbow to pestle Squire Xiao's itchy flesh.
"That's right, listen to me!" Xiao Yuan dryly laughed twice, "However, with this recent situation, it is better for Your Highness not to go to court with this expression on your face."
Jing Shao heard this, suddenly woke up, his big brother is still alive or dead, can not smile to the court, busy thanked Xiao Yuan reminded, change a heavy expression to take the lead to go to the palace.
Xiao Yuan looked at Jing Shao's back somewhat despondently and sighed softly, when will his own mother be able to be as supple and obedient as Wangfei Cheng. Quietly rubbing his aching waist, Servant Xiao grunted in dissatisfaction, letting him wear emerald green today is considered cheap, should let him wear goose yellow!
Mu Hanzhang missed breakfast once he slept, the king explained that he was not allowed to disturb the princess, and the subordinates in the East Garden did not dare to call him. Duo Fu wrinkled a bun face to cope with the stewards who came to the house, for the sleeping princess to deal with the trivial matters of the house.
At the same time, this day, after the Empress officially began to give the fourth prince to choose the right consort, so that the duchess of the daughters of the dukes and marquises to be married to take turns handing cards into the palace. The name is to enjoy the flowers, in fact, is to see each other.
In the spirit of the first look at the easiest to remember, Mrs. Beiwei Hou first handed the card, the same day with their own daughters into the palace to go. And the same positive, there is the Duke of Maoguo wife. And I don't know for what consideration, even let the two families at the same time to the palace.
Jing Shao down the dynasty would like to go home, but was called by his father to the imperial study, discussing a half a day of Yunnan and Tibet terrain, the situation in the southwest.
"I heard that you sent two guards around Jing Chen." Emperor Hongzheng's words changed, suddenly mentioning the second prince who had gone to the southwest on an unannounced visit.
Jing Shao, who had long grass in his heart, suddenly had a ling, and lowered his eyes and said, "I saw that there was not much available manpower beside my second imperial brother, so I lent him the two guards who were good with their hands."
Emperor Hongzheng gave him a deep look and slowly said, "Thanks to is good hands, come back for a heavy reward."
Jing Shao's pupils suddenly shrunk, and he violently raised his head, "Father, second royal brother, he, but what happened?"

chapters.title: 32 - TESTIMONIES
chapters.content:
"Jing Chen was attacked on the southwestern border." Emperor Hongzheng took a secret letter from the table and looked at him with a deep gaze.
"Second Elder Brother he, is he injured?" Jing Shao asked in shock, seeing Emperor Hongzheng's calm appearance, he realized that his brother should not be in fear of his life, and only then calmed down a little.
Emperor Hongzheng narrowed his eyes and handed him the letter in his hand, "Read it yourself."
Jing Shao quickly opened the thin piece of paper, skimming over the polite words, and anxiously looking for the word "peace".
"...... Fortunately, the guards gifted by the third imperial brother to fight to the death to protect, the son of the court is not in any serious trouble, and will return to the capital in the next few days ......" Seeing this line of words, Jing Shao exhaled, which read from the beginning, and returned the letter to the Father.
The meaning of the letter is that things have already had a brow, for the assassination is just a word, but to Jing Chen's nature, both so said, then certainly is ferocious and dangerous. Jing Shao slowly clenched his fists, if it is the southwest king sent people, a blow will not be sure to do it again. Southwest from the capital of three thousand miles, this way and do not know what will be changed. Thinking about this, only feel upset.
"Father, 3,000 miles of high mountains and long distances, my son has the audacity to ask my father to allow me to bring a team of soldiers and horses to go and receive my second royal brother." Jing Shao knelt on the ground and said earnestly.
"Jing Chen has already said that there is nothing wrong, so get up." Emperor Hongzheng sat back down on the dragon chair, picked up the zhang folders on the table and started to read them.
"Father!" Jing Shao refused to get up, not to mention the fact that that person, the Southwest King, had always been one to do nothing, and once this matter came out, someone might take advantage of the opportunity to lay a black hand on him, and the Southwest King would be the one to take the blame anyway.
After waiting for a long time, Emperor Hongzheng glanced at Jing Shao, who was still kneeling, and sighed helplessly, "I've already sent someone there!"
Hearing this, Jing Shao Fang put down his heart. He sent over to protect his brother's fifty soldiers and generals will certainly still follow, after this matter will certainly appear out, plus father sent people, unless blatantly sent soldiers and horses to chase, should not be dangerous again.
Jing Shao out of the imperial study, is encountered Hongzheng emperor's personal eunuch An Xian, with a small eunuch serving tea, seems to have just come from the pantry, see Jing Shao busy bowing and salute.
"Eunuch An," Jing Shao smiled politely, "still so hands-on after all these years."
"His Majesty's living and drinking is not the slightest bit sloppy, the slave girl is always uneasy about these hairy children, just have to watch everywhere, let the king laugh." An Xian, perhaps because of the reason of always worrying, is not like the usual old eunuchs like the blossom, walking is also tigerish.
Outside the imperial study, there are many people and it is not good to inquire about anything, Jing Shao said a few words and left.
"Almost twenty years old, you can't use your brain to think about anything other than leading troops to war." Emperor Hongzheng took a sip of the tea made by An Xian and said.
An Xian carefully glanced at the Emperor's expression and said with a smile, "Doesn't the Emperor just love His Majesty's straightforward nature?"
Emperor Hongzheng put down his teacup and slightly hooked his lips, "It's quite a sentimental one." He did not tell Jing Shao that the assassins could not kill all of them and could not find any clues. Today, if Jing Shao first asked who committed the assassination, then he would not be able to get away from this suspicion. Fortunately, this son did not let himself down. Although like a child as often as temper tantrums, to brothers and sisters is not ever harbor harm.
Jing Shao out of the palace gate, saw two carriages toward the side door line, expected to be a female family members into the palace, also do not care, riding on the small black back to the king's house to go.
Those two, were none other than the carriages of the Marquis of Northern Wei and the Duke of Maoguo.
"The dog's son was ignorant and injured the World Son the day before yesterday, I wonder if he is better now?" Duke Maoguo's wife laughed lightly, but the expression on her face was not at all apologetic.
"Early a few days on the matter, ma'am is not the day before yesterday know?" Bei Wei Marquis Lady looked at her with cold eyes, Duke Maoguo Shi Zi injured Mu Ling Bao, just verbally accompany a not, so many days, their house did not even send over a subordinate to visit, it is clear that it is a bully.
As soon as the two met, they started to go toe-to-toe, the two young ladies standing behind them also quietly sized each other up, and the palace maid sent by the Empress to greet them saw them and only restrained her eyes.
Jing Shao returned to the Royal Mansion, not yet at noon, into the East Garden, Duo Fu on the bitter face to welcome up: "Your Highness, the Princess has not been up, the slave girl did not dare to call people to disturb."
Jing Shao saw his fat white face wrinkled together and couldn't help but laugh at him, "Didn't you used to be in charge of the inner house? Who are you showing this face to?"
"Your Highness does not know, this inner house is now being managed by Wangfei, the daily affairs are more than twice as much as before, the slave girl looks at that account book and has a headache." Duo Fu really admire the Wangfei, every day so many accounts, affairs, but all can be divided clearly, there are problems with the account at a glance can see, now the stewards do not dare to fool, back to the matter is also nothing, he dealt with this morning, only feel a head two big.
"You're just used to being lazy, look at other people An Xian, they don't even have this fat." Jing Shao said as he had already reached the bedroom door, waving his hand to stop Duo Fu who wanted to continue complaining, and gently pushed the door in.
The windows of the house were closed, the light was much dimmer than outside, and the light blue tent was closed tightly enough to see the beauty of what was not inside the bed.
Jing Shao changed out of his court dress and slowly pulled open the tent. The person on the bed was sleeping peacefully, one arm was resting outside the brocade quilt, revealing half of his shoulder, his white skin was imprinted with dots of red marks, very attractive. Climbed onto the bed, tucked the arm that was drying a little cold back into the quilt, lay beside him, even with the quilt into his arms, kissed on that sleeping handsome face.
Mu Hanzhang frowned, slowly opened a pair of hazy beautiful eyes: ''You came back ......'' slow tone, with just woke up nasal voice, lovely very.
Stealing a scent on those still swollen lips, Jing Shao hugged the person toward his arms again, "Is the body still uncomfortable?"
Mu Hanzhang slowly woke up, his body's weakness had gotten better, only his waist and femur were still a little sore, he looked up at the person holding him, and moved his head to his shoulder to find a comfortable position, "His waist is a little sore."
Jing Shao froze, Jun Qing this is ...... pampering? Jing Shao, who had managed to digest this fact, immediately sat upwards, allowing his own princess to lie on his chest and knead his waist through the covers.
Powerful big hands, pinching up through the quilt, the force was just right, relieving a burst of soreness, very comfortable. Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but narrow his eyes and quietly hooked his lips at an angle that Jing Shao couldn't see.
"Brother was assassinated," Jing Shao told him about today's events while rubbing, "Do you think it could be the Southwest King?"
Mu Hanzhang frowned and said after a moment of silence, "No."
"Why?" Jing Shao on the way back, carefully combed through the things that happened at this time in his previous life, at that time he was fighting the southern barbarians in Yunnan and Tibet, but he still knew the major events in the dynasty, and hadn't heard of any assassination of the imperial guards.
"The matter of the tribute being robbed was already fishy, and the Southwest King would mention this reason in a dignified manner simply because he has long been clear about the situation in Yunnan-Tibet." Mu Hanzhang converged his eyes and said, "He just wants to reduce the tribute and doesn't want to start a war."
Jing Shao kneading hand paused, will recently happened all wear up to see, suddenly suddenly suddenly. Because the southwest near Yunnan and Tibet, so the situation of the southern barbarians southwest king is most clear, he knows that the court attacked the southern barbarians is likely to want him to send troops, and do not want to lose the southwest king on the first to find a reason to reduce the tribute, if the court to let him go to war, we must use this as a condition, if not to let him go to war, they will make up for the tribute is.
If it is not the Southwest King who kills, but these two brothers of his want to fish in troubled waters, this is a good thing, as long as they are away from the Southwest, it is not good to frame them, and they will not dare to take risks again. But ......
Since Junqing can see it, then the father must see it clearly, and today he called him to go to the imperial study ...... to think about it, Jing Shao could not help but break out in a cold sweat, and the father is testing him!
Mu Hanzhang saw him reveal a bitter smile and couldn't help but feel a little heartbroken, "What you said today, Father will definitely not be suspicious."
Jing Shao lowered his head, saw his arms full of worry looking at himself, went over and kissed on that beautiful eyes: "I'm fine." The so-called father, in fact, when called the royal father, no matter when, are first for the emperor, and then for the father! After eating the loss of one life, this life should have woken up long ago.
The next day, the Marquis of Northern Wei sent someone to deliver the melons shipped from the northwest.
"Marquis Bei Wei's wife would even send us melons, it's really rare." Jing Shao pinched a piece of cut melon, the melons grown in this Northwest ripened early and were bigger than those in the Central Plains, and tasted very sweet. Marquis Bei Wei's military power is in the northwest, where he bought a lot of land to grow melons and fruits.
"I heard from the underling who delivered the melon that mother came back from the palace yesterday, and the smile on her face hasn't stopped." Mu Hanzhang handed him a bamboo stick and couldn't help but evoke a cold smile when he spoke of that first mother who didn't know how to restrain herself.
The Empress rewarded the Mu family miss a pair of jade bracelets, but only rewarded the Maoguo Gong family miss a purse, Du felt that the position of the fourth prince consort in all likelihood is her own daughter, coincidentally, the northwest of the melon shipment, so they were in a good mood to send them some.
"How do you know all this?" Jing Shao was given a look at his own princess's wet fingertips and had to wipe his hands to eat with a bamboo stick.
"There's that fast-talking third aunt, now I'm afraid that the entire Marquis Beiwei residence knows about it." Mu Hanzhang sighed, the underling who delivered the melon was familiar with Lan Ting, and when he saw her, he talked about this matter incessantly, at this rate, in less than three days, I'm afraid that everyone in the entire capital will know that the Mu family's young lady is going to be the fourth prince's consort.
"Your third aunt is really something, next time you want to spread rumors about Jing Yu, let her do it!" Jing Shao couldn't help but stifle a laugh, this Third Lady must have a grudge against Marquis Lady Bei Wei.
"Nonsense again." Mu Hanzhang helplessly shook his head, but think about it this third aunt can't help but really intentional. If Mu quality is married to the fourth prince is okay, at most let people say Bei Wei Marquis wife flamboyant; if it is not married, Bei Wei Marquis House this time can be a big loss of shame!

chapters.title: 33 - Position
chapters.content:
So after two days, in many to the north marquis house to visit the public monarchs and duchesses implicit congratulations, the north marquis wife realized that the whole capital know! Exasperated and there is nothing to do, only to call the third lady to the front and scolded severely.
"Sister-in-law, it's not my fault!" The Third Mistress cried and said in a slightly shrill voice, "Wasn't I happy for the quality? I only talked to a few maids around me, not to mention that I wasn't the only one present that day, so how can I be blamed?"
"How dare you? The other day I told you to keep this quiet, even if it's a sure thing, there's still a possibility! You are good, out of the door to say out, but also afraid that others do not know the same!" Beiwei Marquis wife angry straight shaking, this regardless of success or failure, she is bound to lose face, if the Empress heard to go, I'm afraid that will feel the Beiwei Marquis House superficial, along with the quality of the disliked, this may be really yellow.
The third wife heard, also do not cry, immediately cold face: "Sister-in-law, this matter even if I am not right, you can not take the tone of reprimand concubine this kind of lesson me it!" There is no superiority between sisters-in-law, she just can't stand to see Du's smug face. Her husband is also the first son of the old marquis, so why should Mu quality be able to marry the prince's grandson, but not her daughter?
Not to mention the Marquis of Northway in the days of the chicken and dogs, a few days later, when Miss Maoguo Gong Gong again into the palace, the Marquis of Northway up and down only completely exploded. But it turns out, the Queen gave that purse, loaded with the palace jade plate.
"The commoner son of Marquis Bei Wei has already married King Cheng, and he still presumes to marry his daughter to the Fourth Prince, where in the world is such a good thing?" Duke Maoguo's wife said to Lady Yongchangbo.
"Wasn't she afraid that the concubine's son would be too smart to threaten the World Son, so she rushed to marry him off? Now it's good that she's lifted a stone and smashed her own foot!" Mrs. Yongchangbo laughed, "Our two families' relationship will be even closer in the future."
"That's right, in the future there will be even more reason to go to your home to touch the cards!" Duke Maoguo's wife also laughed along with him, Yongchang Bo is the Empress's own brother, Duke Maoguo's miss married the Fourth Prince, the two families are tied together.
Today is because the peonies planted by Mrs. Marquis Dingnan have bloomed, and the ladies of all the mansions are invited to come and enjoy the flowers.
"Why don't you see Sister Du here?" Lady Marquis Dingnan was a sequel, younger than most of the ladies.
"She ah, I'm afraid she won't be going out in recent days," Mrs. Yongchangbo laughed as she held a handkerchief to cover her mouth, "Has the Second Imperial Consort returned to her mother's home recently?"
Mrs. Dingnan Marquis smiled and said, "She has a lot of things going on in her house, so I didn't call her today." Knowing that they were trying to find out about the second prince, Mrs. Dingnan Marquis didn't intend to say much about her own family's affairs, and digressed in a couple of sentences.
Since the discovery of Duo Fu can handle the house alone, Mu Hanzhang began to gradually spread hands, and tasted the sweetness of Jing Shao even more excessive, every night pestering their own princess for pleasure, until Mu Hanzhang can not stand, only a few days to stop. And Duo Fu can only face a bunch of like a wolf like tiger steward wrinkled bun face every day.
"Brother will not walk at night, maybe he will only arrive at the capital at night," Mu Hanzhang helped Jing Shao to fasten his wrist guards, seeing Jing Shao's anxious face, he sighed and said, "At least eat breakfast before you go."
Brother returned today, just in time for the Muzhu not have to go to court. From the southwest back, certainly go south of the city, Jing Shao thought to go by the way to the east of the city to take a look at the barren forest, but since yesterday is still in the neighboring provinces, today will not return early. Reaching out to help his own Wangfei on the crown of the tassel to stroke positive, Jing Shao smiled and said: "good, I ate dinner and then go."
"Then I'll go back to Marquis Bei Wei's mansion today, my father sent a message for me to go back when I have time these two days." Yesterday, because Jing Shao fooled around during his nap, causing him to sleep all afternoon, he was not able to go back. Thinking about this, he couldn't help but glare at Jing Shao again.
Jing Shao was uncertain when he received a glare from his own princess, so he lowered his head and bit an ear.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang busily pushed him away and looked around, Fang sighed in relief, fortunately Jing Shao drove all the maids out in order to enjoy dressing his own Wangfei.
Jing Shao rode Xiao Hei to the eastern outskirts first, easily bypassing the layers of rocks and overgrown trees and entering the depths of the barren forest. Here there was a group of soldiers leveling the land with hoes and hammers, the number of people was small, only twenty to thirty, so the speed was slow.
"Your Highness," Ren Feng saw Jing Shao arrive and put down the sledgehammer in his hand to welcome him, "the manpower is too small, to level out the land that can be demarcated, I'm afraid that we won't be able to finish it by the end of the year."
"There's no rush," Jing Shao dismounted, climbed up a high rock, and raised his eyes to look around, full of barren forest, "Don't move these trees around." Said jumped off the stone, re-turned on the horse.
"Yes." Ren Feng reached out to help, but Jing Shao avoided it.
Looking around the circle of soldiers who were working with their heads down, Jing Shao said in a deep voice, "If anyone leaks half a word on this matter, kill without pardon!"
Mu Hanzhang sent away Jing Shao, went to the Marquis of Northern Wei House. When he entered the mansion, he realized that the atmosphere of the whole house was not right, all the subordinates lowered their heads and narrowed their eyes, quiet and unusual. The butler brought him directly to the study of Marquis Bei Wei, his father Mu Jin is waving a brush to write a big character, strong and powerful penmanship seems to penetrate the back of the paper. Mu Hanzhang looked down, is a large "firm" character.
"Has father encountered any difficulties?" Mu Hanzhang carefully looked at the direction of the words and could see the struggle and annoyance in the heart of the person who wrote them.
"Can you see anything?" Mu Jin looked up at him when he saw him looking at his words.
Mu Hanzhang converged his eyes, "Father has always been decisive, this time hesitant, but it is a matter of great importance."
Mu Jin put the pen into the pen wash and sighed, "You have been smart since you were a child, and you see through everything. This time, it was father who was greedy."
"My son originally thought that when father decided to marry my son to King Cheng, he had already made up his mind," Mu Hanzhang raised his hand and rolled up the pair of characters, re-laying a piece of white paper, "The battle for the Crown Prince, is originally an undying and unending situation, how can you have a two-way street?" Taking a pen from the brush holder, he dipped it in ink and offered it to his father with both hands.
Mu Jin looked at it for a long time, caught the pen that was handed to him, and after a long time, he laughed: "An get both? Well said!" Lift the pen, waving the brush, this time without any hesitation, a "firm" word written smoothly, one breath.
This time the matter of selecting the Prince Consort, Beiwei Marquis and Maoguo Gongfu is considered to be a complete feud, the Empress borrowed this matter ruthlessly hit the face of the Beiwei Marquis, in order to knock the Maoguo Gong adhere to the middle way. Mu Jin realized that when the Empress chose to become a Wangfei named his second son, is already intended to give up the Beiwei Marquis, but he could not see through.
"I intend to formally raise Aunt Qiu as a concubine next month," Mu Jin put away his pen and looked up at his second son, "The concubine consort of the Cheng Wang House is the first daughter of the Minister of the Ministry of Military Affairs, and you're the main consort, so it's only right that you should have a higher origin."
Mu Hanzhang froze, did not expect Mu Jin would be for so he considered, although he knew that this is the means of the Marquis of Northern Wei to indicate his position, still could not help but slightly moved, bowed and saluted, "Thank you father for your compassion, the son on behalf of Auntie first thanked."
Xiao Hei ran too fast, not long to the city south of thirty miles of the long pavilion, Jing Shao sat in the pavilion, bored to pull grass to feed Xiao Hei, straight until dusk, only to see a green carriage from the distance slowly approaching.
Jing Shao immediately mounted the small black ran over, rushed to the carriage, scared the driver jumped, the guards protecting the front of the car brushed and pulled out the belt knife: "Who is ...... the king!"
Jing Shao waved his hand, "Why are you arriving now?"
"His Highness is injured and doesn't dare to walk too fast." The guards explained.
Jing Shao frowned, jumped onto the carriage and quickly drilled in, seeing the situation inside immediately filled with anger: "Brother!"
Jing Chen leaned against the wall of the car, his upper body since the shoulders wrapped a circle of white cloth, straight to the waist, saw Jing Shao, could not help but frown: "All said not to let you come to pick up, why do not you listen!"

chapters.title: 34 - Acacia
chapters.content:
"To be injured so badly and still say it's alright!" Jing Shao frowned tightly, reaching out to pinch the white cloth, wanting to see his brother's injuries but afraid of hurting him, his fingertips stopped three inches away from the fabric and didn't dare to go forward.
Jing Chen has never seen this kind of careful younger brother, always serious face can not help but appear cracks, to the mouth of the reprimand how can not speak, raw reach out, rubbed Jing Shao's head: "Indeed not seriously injured, is the wound is long, not good package, only to wrap such a large area."
Jing Shao froze, in his memory, his brother has never been so intimate with him, when he was a child jumping up and down to pull out the bird's nest, fishing carp, elder brother already every day face in the study reading, see him to say the most is "how to behave"; mother died when he cried his heart out, his brother just kneeling in front of the spirit of not crying and not speak, and when he went to pull his sleeve, only to get a "no interest thing, just know crying"  so he has always thought that he is not close. When he went to pull his brother's sleeve, he only got a sentence "no interest in things, just know to cry"...... So in his last life, he always thought that his brother was not close to him.
Until he met his elder brother who came to visit him in the prison, that calm and powerful voice, Jing Shao still remembers it vividly, "You're my only brother, even if I put everything I have into it, I'll never let you die!"
Past events echoed in his mind, Jing Shao felt his nose a little sour, if he hadn't been re-living his life, he wouldn't have known how much his brother had done for him in places he didn't know. Rubbing a single finger under the bridge of his nose, Jing Shao pulled out a jade vial from his pocket and shoved it into Jing Chen's hand, "The car is bumpy, go back and let sister-in-law apply it for you."
Jing Chen looked at the small bottle in his hand, green jade-sheng, when it was rewarded to him by his father before Jing Shao's expedition, he frowned and said, "This is life-saving medicine, this is just a superficial wound for me, you take it back." Saying that, he wanted to stuff it to him, but Jing Shao quickly retreated to the carriage door.
"I still have there, this bottle you take, do not want to use it with me, I also rest assured that some," said Jing Shao lifted the curtain ready to go out, "I came out to pick you up, ran a big circle around the capital, when no one knows, as for the father, his old man in the heart of the mirror like, hidden is useless. "
Jing Chen held the green jade vial in his hand, watched his younger brother's posture upright as he rolled onto his horse, lightly shaking the reins to leave in the dust, slowly curved the corner of his lips, his little Shao'er is really getting more and more understanding.
Beiwei marquis house even if it is his mother's house, it is not appropriate to keep the crown princess for dinner, so when Jing Shao returned to the king's house, Mu hanzhang had already returned. The table set a sumptuous dishes, a soft silk plain clothes of his own princess sitting at the table, waiting for him to eat. This kind of someone waiting for you to come home feeling is too good, Jing Shao can not help but go over, in that handsome face kiss.
When the surrounding maids saw this, they lowered their heads.
Mu Hanzhang a handsome face suddenly red through and through, surrounded by subordinates, this person is this kind of do not know to restrain, can not help but glare at him: "Quickly go to change clothes, full of mouth is dirt!" Said and felt that this is not good, sounds more like flirting, can not help but secretly chagrin.
Jing Shao stifled two laughs with a single fist against his lips and turned around to go to the purification room to wash his face and change his clothes.
The weather had begun to heat up at the end of May, so Jing Shao changed his clothes, took the cup Miao Ruoxi handed over, and gulped it down.
Mu Hanzhang gave him a bowl of green bean soup and waved his hand for the maids to go down, "Have you seen your elder brother?"
Jing Shao took the bowl of soup and took a sip, nodding, "Brother is injured, so the carriage goes slower."
"Is the injury serious?" Mu Hanzhang frowned.
Jing Shao ate a mouthful of food, felt the flavor was good, so he gave his own princess a chopstick in her bowl as well: ''Skin wounds, it shouldn't matter.
Mu Hanzhang looked at the dishes in the bowl, and seeing Jing Shao's face as a matter of course, he didn't say anything, picked up the bowl and ate.
