Anyway, since the marriage, the king did not serve him less, just every time this time he would be glad in his heart that this person did not treat him as a woman to make him call, but respect him and love him, really do not dare to imagine, if Jing Shao was like the other husbands, how difficult his life would be.
Adhering to the etiquette of food without words, Mu Hanzhang then stopped talking and concentrated on eating. Jing Shao had eaten two pieces of marinated beef at noon, and was really hungry at this moment, picking up the bowl and eating quickly.
Mu Hanzhang saw him starving like this, could not help but be a little surprised, when Jing Shao picked up the third bowl of rice, for fear that he would be propped up, had to reach out to stop him, saw Jing Shao show a look of still wanting to eat, cried and laughed and said, "You ate too quickly, do not know hunger and fullness, and eat too much late in the evening to build up your food."
The two of them are men, the East Garden's rice bowls are large bowls, usually Jing Shao eat two bowls will be very full, this moment eat too fast to feel out, if you eat the third bowl, the night will be unable to sleep.
Jing Shao also knew this, so he obediently put down his chopsticks, drank another small half bowl of green bean soup, and waited for the maids to come and clean up before realizing that he was somewhat propped up. Mu Hanzhang sighed, drank tea and then took him to the garden for a walk to eliminate food.
The evening breeze in mid-spring carries a slight heat wave on your face, and you can smell the lingering scent of the sun's scorching rays in the scent of the flowers.
"Father said that Auntie will be raised as a concubine next month." Mu Hanyang Zhang walked under an acacia tree and looked up, the tree was full of pink flowers, brocade like smoke.
"That's a good thing, you can call your mother in the future." Jing Shao saw him looking at the flowers on the tree, reached out and lightly leapt, handing a handful of night acacia in full bloom to his own princess.
"What's the point of picking a flower that's blooming just right?" Mu Hanzhang looked at the flower in his hand and didn't pick it.
"Pepper flowers for beauty." Jing Shao said smugly.
Mu Hanzhang glared at the king, who had begun to be immodest again, "The first time I've heard of it, this flower of bitterness can still be given away."
Jing Shao scratched his head, the acacia was called bitter flowers, bitter flowers mean that the husband's change of heart, really bad symbolism, busy threw away the hands of the flowers, reached out to yank a branch of leaves to Jun Qing hands.
"What's this for again? Sending flowers is just fine, who sends leaves?" Mu Hanzhang turned the branch full of green leaves in his hand, the leaves were closed and there was nothing to see, he couldn't help but laugh at him.
"The Acacia leaf opens by day and closes by night, and they love each other, I take it to give you, that is, I want to be in the same heart with you for a lifetime, and to be happy together for the rest of your life." Jing Shao said with a straight face.
Mu Hanzhang stunned for a moment, looking down at the night tightly closed acacia leaves, did not expect Jing Shao will actually say such words, a moment do not know how to answer, just a touch of redness quietly jumped on the handsome face, reflecting the clear moonlight, looks more and more beautiful.
Jing Shao looked a little infatuated and couldn't help but reach out and wrap his arms around him, seeking those two thin lips and kissing them.
"Well ......" Mu Hanzhang hummed lightly, but did not resist much, that sentence "a lifetime of concentricity, the world together", let his whole heart rose to full, also want to do some intimate things, let This feeling is prolonged some more.
The next day, the second prince returned to the court, with a wound standing above the hall. Emperor Hongzheng pity the second prince is not yet healed, give him a seat.
The emperor was furious about the attack on the imperial guards and ordered a thorough investigation. In addition, Jing Chen also brought a shocking news. The southwestern tribute is not robbed by any mountain bandits, but by the king of the southwest himself, and all the tributes are still parked at the border of the southwestern fiefdom, near the official road leading to the capital!
And I do not know whether it is coincidence, or man-made, the Southwest King put off the rescue of the great prince of the folders also arrived in the capital yesterday. Southwest King in the folding said that the southwest suffered a spring drought this year, many parts of the grain harvest, but also meet the tribute was robbed, adding insult to injury, the Southwest Royal House has been cut back to help the people, there is no mobilization of the army to go to Yunnan and Tibet's ability to plead with the court to first allocate grain and grass.
"Deceitful!" Emperor Hongzheng juxtaposed Jing Chen's zhengfu with the Southwest King's copy and slammed it hard onto the jade steps.
"The Southwest King is truly too arrogant!" The rigid imperial historian Fan Jie stood out, shaking with anger.
"Your Majesty, calm your anger, the most important thing now is that the eldest prince is still in Dianzang, his life and death are uncertain, the Southwest King refuses to
To send out troops, we must hasten to mobilize troops from other places to go." Without looking for traces, the Minister of War exchanged a glance with Jing Chen and stepped forward to remind him.
"The Southwest King knows that the Grand Prince is not good at fighting, so he dares to blatantly deceive the court today and hold the tribute reduction hostage, according to the opinion of the minister, he should deploy his famous generals to go to Yunnan and Tibet." Song An, the Minister of the Ministry of War, sniffed, and busily stepped forward to follow, and glanced at Jing Shao if he had a point.
Jing Shao only hated Song An for taking matters into his own hands again, and took a half step back without a trace.
"The number of southern barbarians is not large, it is not worth the trouble at all, the reason why the Great Prince is in danger is only because he is not familiar with the environment of Yunnan and Tibet. I thought that as long as the rescue of the great prince can be, do not need to send another famous generals, spend some time will be able to attack." Marquis Mu Jin of Bei Wei who seldom spoke suddenly stood out, his calm and powerful voice instantly shocked the noisy crowd.
Emperor Hongzheng glanced at Mu Jin and nodded slightly. This generation's Bei Wei Marquis, when he was young, he was stationed in the Northwest for many years and fought in many battles, he relied on his own skills to keep his title, his words naturally had a high level of prestige.
So, Hongzheng Emperor issued a decree, rebuked the Southwest King, and asked him to immediately send troops to rescue the eldest prince, for the reduction of tribute, the allocation of food, all refuted, not a word! At the same time, the deployment of Shu troops, from the other way to rescue.
"Mother, I heard that father is going to raise Aunt Qiu as a concubine!" Mu Ling Bao, whose grounding had ended, came rushing to the main room in a flaming hurry.
"Yes!" Bei Wei Marquis wife pined a lot, the emperor has issued a decree, the fourth prince consort selected as the Miss Maoguo Gongfu, June under the decision, July is unlucky, scheduled to finish the marriage in August. Du has now become the laughing stock of the entire capital, so ashamed that she didn't dare to go out for nearly a month.
The fourth prince's June decision, Bei Wei Marquis June on lifting Qiu, is to tell the people plainly, Bei Wei Marquis later on on the side of the Cheng Wang, they, all these people, from now on will have to look up to that commoner's son.
"How can that work?" Mu Ling Bao slammed the fruit plate on the table, "After lifting the side room, Mu Huan Zhang will be the side room son, if I die, he can also inherit the title!"
"What nonsense!" Marquis Bei Wei's wife slapped Mu Ling Bao's back, "You are the son of the world by divine decree, no one can take this title away from you! He's already married to King Cheng, how can there be any reason for him to return to his mother's family to take the title!"
"If King Cheng became the emperor and repudiated him, wouldn't he be able to assume the title!" Mu Ling Bao was slapped by his mother and sat down on the Luohan bed with a thud, raising his voice.
"Hmph, if King Cheng wants to be the emperor, do you think he still lives to ascend the throne day?" Bei Wei Marquis people laughed coldly, the emperor who married a male wife shall not be allowed to carry on the great lineage, even if King Cheng finally seized the throne by extraordinary means, keeping a male wife is dishonorable, naturally, this person should be wiped out in the history books.
Mu Lingbao froze, then cheered up, "Mother is really far-sighted!"
"If you were a bit more successful, I wouldn't have to go through all this trouble!" Mrs. Bei Wei Hou took her finger and fiercely pummeled his forehead.
Qiu, who came to deliver the account book, stood flabbergasted outside the door, and when she came back to her senses, she had already broken out in a cold sweat!

chapters.title: 35 - Guessing
chapters.content:
Aunt Qiu looked around and saw that Yanhong, the eldest maid who had been sent away by Madam to serve tea, was coming from one end of the corridor, so she busily retreated sharply for two steps, turned around and turned into the back of a corridor pillar, and waited for the maid to reach the door before she slowly stepped out.
"Aunt Qiu, come to deliver the account book." Yanhong saw her and smiled, Aunt Qiu will be the side lady next month, everyone in this house is much more polite to her now, "The eldest young master is inside, I'll help Auntie send it in."
"Thank you, Miss." Aunt Qiu smiled and handed her the account book in her hand, turning to leave.
The two inside the house stopped talking when they heard the maid's voice, and when the person entered the house, Du asked, "Yanhong, who's out there?"
"When the slave girl walked to the door, she happened to run into Aunt Qiu coming to deliver the account book, and let the slave girl hold it back." Yan Hong smiled and placed the account book on the table.
Mrs. Bei Wei Marquis frowned, today let Aunt Qiu in the side hall to review this month's account book, the maids are kicked out is to forget her, fortunately Yan Hong back in time. Let Yanhong go out to guard outside the door, Du looked up to Mu Lingbao said: "You are not too old, son will run down the ground, do not spend the whole day with the group of fox friends hanging out in the kiln! If you don't have time to practice more martial arts, you can save yourself the embarrassment of fighting with Duke Mao's family again!"
"That day can't be blamed on me, that bastard played a dirty trick!" Mu Ling Bao saw his mother talking about herself, immediately became unconvinced, "What are you afraid of, that kid Han Zhang can't learn martial arts, even if I just practice I'm still better than him!"
Aunt Qiu returned to her own small courtyard, only feeling upset. She had thought that the king had treated Huanzhang well, and that his life was better than that of the Marquis of Beiwei's residence, so she had not asked for anything more. But he had forgotten about the royal seizure of the throne! Cheng Wang how brave and good at fighting, even the capital of the yellow mouth children know, such a person is really willing to be a lifetime prince? Or a prince who has no first son, and whose heir can't take the title.
With the intention of finding her son to talk to him, but she is still a concubine who is not allowed to go out of the second door, Qiu sighed and summoned her maid Yan Cui, asking her to send a letter to the Mo Lien Residence.
"Auntie, the second young master's store is ...... selling balms, how can the slave girl enter?" Yan Cui immediately reddened.
Aunt Qiu glared at the noisy maid, "Letting you in, you have to go to the Houfu gate! Give this to the Wang family's oldest, who is driving the cart, and leave the rest to you."
For the second prince southwest attack investigation has been no clue, the Da Lisi judgment of the identity of the assassin should be folk wild assassins, is the so-called jianghu people, for the sake of money don't want to die kind of. But Jing Chen is micro-suited to go, know his whereabouts only a few guards around him, four guards are sent by the emperor, two are King Cheng's people. The people in the court do not say, but in their hearts they all suspect that the assassination of the second prince must be related to King Cheng!
"At first, King Cheng insisted on assigning you two guards, but now that I think about it, there are really many suspicions!" Mr. Chen, the Qing guest in the Second Prince's residence, said sincerely.
Jing Chen, who was recuperating at home, sat at his desk and frowned at the words, "That doesn't need to be said, Jing Shao won't harm me."
"Your Highness! In the royal family, brotherly love is as thin as paper, even if they are blood brothers, they can't be trusted! King Cheng's great achievements in battle, married to a male wife must be in the heart of the disobedience, I heard that he is in front of the crowd very favor the princess, this is incredible! May I ask if Your Highness is taken away from the qualification to carry on the great lineage, can you still be as comfortable as King Cheng?" Mr. Chen was unforgiving.
"Enough!" Jing Chen knocked the cup in his hand heavily on the table, "Those unwarranted speculations about Jing Shao, don't mention them again!"
After chasing away the chattering group of handlers, Jing Chen rubbed his brow somewhat wearily, took a pen and began writing a folded document.
"Your Highness, Mr. Chen and the others are also doing this for your own good, it's always right to keep an extra eye out." Second Prince Consort Xiao walked in with a bowl of summer cooling herbal tea, hesitated for a moment, but still couldn't help but say.
"What are you meddling in the affairs of the court?" Jing Chen glanced at her, unwilling to say more with her. Xiao could never understand his love and care for his younger brother, and after saying more Jing Chen was annoyed and didn't want to explain anymore. Women are short sighted, many things cannot be understood with her.
It was just that, even the staff of his house suspected Jing Shao, and the people in the court must have suspected him in no small number. Jing Chen's frown deeper and deeper, this time, no matter who did it, really very powerful. If he died the best, if he can't die, just to frame Jing Shao, whether it is bad Cheng Wang reputation or let their brothers against each other, are not losing money.
"The assassin thing, pursue it will only be unfavorable to you," early in the morning, Mu Hanzhang to Jing Shao tied the jade belt of the court dress, uneasy to explain, "today if someone against you, you put on filial piety and brotherly love righteousness loudly scolded him, never move out all kinds of reasons to refute, those civil officials you can not say them. " Know Jing Shao these days in the court aggrieved, Mu Hanzhang although heartache, but also can only persuade him to swallow this breath.
"I just can't help it, this is eight to nine times Jing Yu's doing! Let him get the advantage to go?" Jing Shao said angrily, this matter father's heart when is clear, just suffering from no clues, mouth say no evidence.
"Even if it is the fourth prince to do, kill brother is a great crime, they dare to do is well prepared," Mu Hanzhang sighed, "brother if you want to keep you, will certainly be on the folding to beg father not to pursue this matter, you only need to remember to do not impulsive is."
Jing Shao walked outward unhappily and turned back again without taking two steps, hanging his arms and burying his face into his own princess's shoulder, "It's annoying, I don't want to go today!"
Mu Hanzhang helplessly looked at the big guy hanging on, raised his hand and patted him: "Do not be capricious, go quickly." Jing Shao grunted and did not move, look at the hour is not early, afraid that he was late, only to warmly said: "Yesterday, brother Zhou bought a tank of shrimp, at noon I go to the Ministry of War to pick you up, let's go back to the flavor of the building with lunch."
Jing Shao sniffed, immediately had the spirit: "That said, I will point a dawning in the Ministry of War, Si Zheng can come out."
Mu Hanyang looked at his own prince windy out the door to go, lightly laughed and shook his head, how more and more like a child, still have to use food coaxing before willing to go out to do the right thing.
This morning morning, the fruit is not Mu Hanzhang expected, those who are the civil officials beat around the bush, insinuating that Jing Shao suspected, Jing Chen recuperating from injuries are not in the court, the fourth prince has been lowered his head and did not say a word.
Jing Shao listened to his own Wangfei's words, not to refute, but to take the brotherly love, filial piety and fraternal duty, scolding those civil officials for their evil intentions.
Emperor Hongzheng looked at the angry red-necked Jing Shao, did not say a word, waiting for Jing Shao scolded, only slowly opened his mouth: "This time the second prince was assassinated, if not into the king's guards desperately protect, has long been a lot of bad luck. You can not find out the results, on the groundless speculation, when I am a three-year-old child?" Said will be a zhang folding thrown to stand in the jade steps under the feet of the imperial historian.
The rigid imperial historian Fan Jie was the one who spoke the most vigorously, and was shocked by the emperor's majestic voice, so he had to kneel down and pick up the zhengzhi on the ground.
That folding is the second prince handed yesterday, in which the words earnestly persuade the father not to pursue this matter, because the most suspicious is the two brothers, as a brother really can not bear to see such a situation.
"The second prince of the house is kind and generous, this time went to the southwest, find out the southwest tribute thing, the credit is not to be missed, with the sealing of the king of Rui, and so on Jing Chen healed, the Ministry of Ceremony to pick a day it." Hongzheng emperor flung his sleeve and left, on his way out, he looked at the two sons on the court, his eyes were deep and meaningful.
Mu Han Zhang used breakfast, with Yunzhu out, first to the ink lotus residence around. Although this ink lotus residence is he opened, but this kind of thing out is not good to hear, the public has been said to be someone else opened, Cheng Wangfei just mixed shares.
Since the ink lotus residence opened, business has been very hot, the capital also some people can see that this business earns money, but no one dares to get involved, only because this ink lotus residence hung the name of the Cheng King's House, and the King's domineering and unreasonable is notorious.
"Brother Lin." Not long after Mu Hanzhang entered the store, he saw a familiar figure walk in, it was none other than Mr. Lin from the Dingnan Marquis' family. The Marquis of Dingnan was the Second Imperial Concubine's maiden family, and to put it mildly, the two of them were still relatives.
"Duke Mu ......" Duke Lin saw Mu Huanzhang here, and was a little embarrassed, "The box you sent ...... last time Well, I was not ashamed to let my subordinates come to to buy this, only to come here myself while the hour is early."
Lin Gongzi's husband is Dingnan Marquis family commoner son, the Marquis is still not separated, naturally, will not let him this male wife to hold the center feed, so to do what is ultimately not very convenient.
Mu Hanzhang heard the words, since he heard his difficulties, turned his head to look at the store furnishings. The common people are not so careful, men come to buy also can not see is a husband or wife, so it does not matter; just this royal family's male wives, but there are many inconveniences. So the cheap iron box in the store sells the most, the most expensive silver box can also be sold to those in order to curry favor with the beauty of the broad dude, but the most lucrative wooden box of balm did not originally envisioned a good sale.
"If Brother Lin is inconvenient, you say a quantity, at the beginning of each month I send someone to give a tightly wrapped package to send to the mansion, just say that it is something I send is." Mu hanzhang thought of this, his mind was alive again, this kind of stuff from the royal family will be sent by the internal affairs department on time and in quantity every month, then these princes and marquises who are inconvenient to come and buy but also need it very much, they can be allowed to pay the silver on a regular basis, and then give it to the house on a regular basis every month.
"This is a great solution to my big problem." Duke Lin was very happy to hear this and immediately gave a deposit.
From the ink lotus residence out, look at the time is still early, mu hanzhang on foot to go to the ministry of war office. Traveled to the front of the Ministry of War, just is Si Zheng, see a silhouette on time from the door out.
"Your Highness, this is not yet finished, why are you leaving?" Shangshu Sun chased out helplessly with a pamphlet.
"You make up your own mind is, I have urgent matters, let's talk later!" Jing Shao waved his hand impatiently and looked up to see his own Wangfei standing outside the door, a light green colored robe looked so good on him that he couldn't help but run over with a wide grin.

chapters.title: 36 - Removal of the Clan
chapters.content:
Sun Shangshu watched as King Cheng ran towards Princess Cheng, then said excitedly, "Junqing, let's go eat prawns! It should be sold out if we go late!" Is this what is called an emergency? And why would the cold-faced King Cheng, who was rumored to be ferocious and violent, show an expression that smiled like a flower?
Mu Hanzhang saw the bearded Minister of War standing awkwardly in front of the door, and apologetically greeted him, "His Highness left in a hurry in the morning and didn't eat, so please don't be offended, Lord Shangshu."
"Your Highness is overstating things." Only then did Shangshu Sun come back to his senses and politely returned the salute to Princess Cheng, as it was already customary for King Cheng to leave after a nod anyway.
Mu Hanzhang smiled and took his own king to eat.
The hour was still early, and there were basically no guests in Hui Wei House. However, Boss Zhou, who opened the door early every day, had already cleaned the store and packed all the ingredients that should be prepared.
Jing Shao asked for an elegant room on the second floor facing the street.
"The crabs are not yet fat at this time of the year, let's wait until September to eat them." Because there wasn't much business at this moment, Zhou Zhun, who was dressed in bright pink, personally came to give them their order.
The two of them were already not surprised by Boss Zhou's dress.
"I want one catty of white burnt brine shrimp, one catty of salt baked shrimp, two catty of Hui Wei shrimp, one pot of flower carving, and two bowls of rice." Jing Shao looked at the menu and said, anything with the word "houmei" is the signature dish of houmei building, because it has not been able to buy fresh prawns, this dish can rarely be eaten.
"You can't drink strong alcohol when eating sea shrimp, let's serve you a pot of tea." Zhou Zhuan reminded.
Jing Shao frowned, eating good food without wine always felt like something was missing.
Mu Hanzhang saw, called Jing Shao's boy Yun Song, let him go to the south of the city Qingmei girl there to buy a bottle of plum wine: "light wine can solve shrimp poison, brother Zhou why not also buy some light small wine to, will be able to sell well."
"That's a good idea," Zhou Zhuan sniffed happily, "Where is that green plum wine you mentioned?"
Mu Hanzhang informed him of the location, even a restaurant owner like Zhou Zhuan didn't know about that Green Plum Wine, so it seemed that that Plum Girl's business was really bad. Since Jing Shao was prepared to take care of his green plum girl for that big brother Wang who had died in battle, it would be much more useful to find a business outlet for her than to go and buy her wine at regular intervals.
"Jun Qing, you really know how to do business." Jing Shao peeled a white burnt shrimp and put it in the opposite person's bowl.
Mu Hanzhang picked up the shrimp meat dipped in the sauce and took a bite, laughed softly and said, "When I was a child, I heard that the children and grandchildren of public officials seldom pass the examination, and even if they do, it is not easy for them to join the government, so I quietly learned some business skills from my aunt, and I thought that if I couldn't be a government official, I would be able to take over my family's business."
The family of public officials is generally not the examination of merit, they look up to the royal grace, for the official also have to wait for the royal grace, by the study of the origin of the examination of merit, often will be ostracized by the Qingliu, it is difficult to promote.
Jing Shao listen to his easy to say, but can hear the hardship contained in these three or two sentences, the Marquis Count all belong to the martial arts, a can not practice martial arts heir, naturally, will be looked down upon by the people in the family, not to mention a concubine born of a commoner son. Thinking about this, Jing Shao again thought of Mu Lingbao, but unfortunately the weather is getting hot, to throw him into the river will have to wait a few more months.
"This shrimp fried thoroughly, eat with shell to have flavor." Mu hanzhang clamped a flavorful shrimp to Jing Shao's bowl, "After a meal, let's go to the second imperial brother's residence to take a look at it, I've prepared all the gifts, and I'll let Yunzhu go back to fetch them in a while." Since Jing Shao today has emphasized filial piety and fraternal duty in the courtroom, to visit the sick elder brother is no longer suspected of being partisan. Even if you don't believe that the traitors are provoking, the so-called three people make a tiger, falsehoods become true if you say too much, the two brothers still need to see each other from time to time.
Jing Shao also intends to go to the second prince's house today to tell his brother the good news that his father is going to give him the title of King of Rui. But every time empty-handed to go, but also by the way to bring home some good things Jing Shao then realized that to go to his brother's home is to bring gifts!
When they went there, Jing Chen was discussing things with a few staff members in his study, and when he heard that Jing Shao had come, he simply let him in.
There were three people in the room, none of whom Jing Shao had seen much of, and Mu Hanzhang, who stood beside him, quietly observed the expressions of a few people, and then lowered his eyes; the three people seemed to be very nervous about them suddenly coming in, and one of them was clearly carrying a faint sense of hostility.
"Let's stop here today." Jing Chen frowned slightly and waved his hand for the three to go out.
Jing Chen glanced at Mu Hanzhang, and under Jing Shao's gaze that signaled that there was no harm, he then converged his eyes and said in a deep voice, "You did a good job in the courtroom today."
Mu Hanzhang was slightly surprised in his heart, he had planned to leave first, unexpectedly these two brothers talked about the affairs of the court right in front of him, this side shows that these two brothers really treat him as someone who can be trusted, or even someone who is plotting with them to seize the throne. Turning his head to look at Jing Shao, the other party returned him an unhindered look.
"Given the current situation, the Southwest King has already angered Father, the removal of the clan will happen sooner or later, but you can't mention this. I'll let the others in the court mention it first, and in a couple days I'll return to the court and present a charter to Father." Jing Chen showed Jing Shao a pile of folded paper.
"Does this method work?" Jing Shao looked at half a day, the overall method is to say that the immobilized soldiers withdraw from the clan, the above dense and very cumbersome. In his previous life, he was in Dianzang, and did not know if anyone had mentioned the peace and withdrawal of the clan, but with the nature of the Southwest King, this battle must be fought.
"Brother-in-law take a look as well." Jing Chen signaled Jing Shao to give something to Mu Huanzhang.
"Brother called me Huanzhang is," Mu Huanzhang took over the charter, quickly read it once, narrowed his eyes and pondered for a moment, "This method is feasible if the feudal king's troops are not strong."
Jing Chen nodded slightly and looked at Jing Shao, "If there is a war, do you want to go?"
"Go!" Jing Shao said decisively, "This time is a good opportunity to get military power, drag on for a few years, at least half of it can be controlled." Once the war of the three clans began, it is not certain how many years it will fight, Jing Shao even if he knows the death throes of the various feudal lords, but also does not intend to immediately finish the fight, the bird is dead, the rabbit is dead and the dog is cooked, the last life made a mistake he will not repeat the same mistake again.
Mu Hanzhang listened to the conversation between the two brothers and narrowed his eyes. If there was a war, Jing Shao would not return for years, right?
The next day, the great prince finally had news, was rescued by the Shu army, fortunately not dead, temporarily in Dianzang recuperation. As for the Southwest King, the troops did not Shu army fast, this move completely angered Emperor Hongzheng, many ministers took the opportunity to propose the withdrawal of feudalism. So argued for several days, when Jing Chen returned to the court, but also directly on a withdrawal of the constitution.
Jing Chen proposed to lower the title of the withdrawal of the clan, that is, today's vassal king or county king, to the next generation down to the Duke of the country, and then the next generation will be cut to the Marquis ...... Hongzheng Emperor believes that this method is feasible, but the face is not obvious, only to the ministers to mention again and again, before agreeing to the withdrawal of the matter of the clan.
Thus, the matter of Yunnan and Tibet has been put aside for the time being, but the matter of removing the clan has been put on the agenda.
In June, Aunt Qiu raised her side room, and Marquis Bei Wei invited Jing Shao and Mu Hanzhang to go to the ceremony.
"Auntie sent someone to give me a letter the other day, asking me to meet her after today's ceremony." Mu Hanzhang sat in the carriage, remembering the letter that her mother had sent to the Mo Lian Residence.
"There must be something physical to say to you," Jing Shao laughed softly, "Just go ahead and go, I'll be waiting for you in the front hall."
The side room ceremony is not complicated, but mainly involves changing the concubine's body contract to a marriage contract, and then paying homage to the elders and suing the ancestors.
By becoming a side room, Qiu moved into a really small courtyard, and the house was more than a little more spacious than before, with a small kitchen of her own.
Mu Han Zhang looked at a pink dress mother, although it has been the age of the mother, but still elegant, Jiangnan women's intelligence and gentleness in her body is undoubtedly.
"Mother ......" Mu Hanzhang was able to call so in front of others for the first time, and Qiu couldn't help but wet her eyes when she heard the word.
"Son ah, my son ......" Qiu pulled her son s hand, tears like broken beads, one by one slipped down. For twenty years, she did not dare to call her son by his name, he is the young master, and she is just a humble concubine, it should be her who bows to the young master when they meet.
The maids in the house saw this and retreated.
"What did Mother want to find me for?" Mu Hanzhang took the handkerchief from her mother's hand and wiped her tears.
Qiu took the handkerchief in her son's hand and dried the teardrops on her face in three swipes, and sighed softly, "I can't help but think wildly in this inner house. There's one thing I've pondered for a long time, and I still think I should talk to you about it."
Mu Hanzhang quietly listened to his mother's concerns and couldn't help but smile and say, "Mother don't worry, he doesn't want to sit in that position."
"How can anyone not want to sit in that position?" Qiu frowned, seeing that Mu Hanzhang seemed to believe in Jing Shao, "Even if he doesn't have that heart, but he's a Prince, but he doesn't have an heir to carry the title, how can he be willing to do that? Moreover, he is still so young, there will still be plenty of opportunities to go out and fight in the future ......"
The other Mu Hanzhang did not listen to it, but the last sentence is heard clearly. Recall that day in the second prince's house to hear the words, Jing Shao to use this campaign to master the military power, the three feudal kings are not oil lamps, at least three to five years to return to the capital, is it necessary to wither in the king's mansion to wait for him for three to five years?

chapters.title: 37 - Summoning
chapters.content:
In the sixth month of the thirteenth year of Hongzheng's reign, the imperial court sent the royal historian Fan Jie to the southwestern fiefdom to read the imperial decree on the reduction of the feudal rule. The king of the southwestern part of the country was not convinced and wrote a letter of defense.
In July, the King of Southwest China beheaded the court envoy and made himself King, shocking the court! Emperor Hongzheng then decided to send troops to pacify the southwest!
"I heard my Duke of State say that the southwest land is treacherous, easy to defend and difficult to attack, and now that the Southwest King is quite cunning and makes good use of strange troops, it's very difficult to deal with." Mrs. Duke Maoguo quietly said to the Empress.
Following Empress Wu looked at the pomegranate flowers in full bloom in front of her and frowned slightly, "This time, the Emperor is going to deploy 100,000 troops, so I'm afraid it's not a good idea to let King Cheng go."
"Southwest that sleepy place, to win the war is not easy," Mrs. Duke Maoguo carefully recalled her husband's explanation of the words, "the withdrawal of the matter of the clan once started, I'm afraid that the three clans have to be withdrawn, and so on the fight against the king of huainan and then let the fourth prince to go, Jiangnan is flat, as long as the soldiers and horses enough to be able to attack. "
The Empress sniffed and nodded slightly.
Mrs. Maoguo Duke secretly relieved, southwest of the land is easy to defend and difficult to attack, the war will not know to which years to go, their own daughter has been fixed with the fourth prince, if just married husband on the expedition, is not to keep the widow, and so the fourth prince has long been old, and then licked a few side consorts of high origin, even if in the future when the queen days are not good.
"There is one more thing that my concubine does not know whether to speak or not." Duchess Maoguo clenched her hands together, somewhat hesitant.
"There are no outsiders here, so what is there to say inappropriately." The Empress raised her hand and picked a bright red pomegranate flower, the corner of her lips hooked up a cold smile, back then, she was also this careful to serve Empress Yuan, saying everything is "I have a matter I don't know when to speak or not to speak", but because of wearing a pomegranate flower, it was pointed out that it was against the system, and Empress Yuan punished her to kneel in front of the Feng Yi Palace for an hour on a day of three ambient temperatures!
"I heard that the month before last, King Cheng sent the fourth prince a royal concubine," Mrs. Maoguo Duchess carefully glanced at the Empress's expression, saw that she was not angry and then went on to say, "Originally, these things should not be in the hands of the concubine, but next month the fourth prince will be married, and there are rumors in the capital that the fourth prince is very much in favor of that woman today. ."
This news also do not know how to leak, anyway, the North Marquis wife is aware of, everyone said that the fourth prince is not married to the concubine, explicitly and implicitly sarcastic her daughter married to the fourth prince's house is not a good life. Now that the original because of the election of the prince consort of the face of the woman, and a very happy expression mixed in the ducal women, straight to the Duke of Maoguo Mrs. angry to two did not eat the meal.
"There is this?" The Empress crushed the pomegranate flowers in her hands and took the silk handkerchief in the hands of the palace maid and wiped her hands, "Turn around and call Jing Yu to ask about it, don't worry, the Palace will not let the Royal Consort be aggrieved."
July's weather was already hot, Jing Shao was sweating profusely after practicing with his sword for a while, took off his wet clothes in three or two tries, ran naked under a tree, took the wet cloth towel in Zhi Ruoxi's hand and wiped his face, then sat down next to his own princess.
"The sun is poisonous, don't practice." Mu Hanzhang, who was sitting on the rattan bed to cool off, handed him a piece of watermelon.
Jing Shao nibbled the watermelon in his hand in three or two strokes before he felt cooler: "This watermelon tastes icy cold, it's really soothing."
"Your Highness had the slave girl town it in the well early in the morning." Miaoxi smiled, replacing a plate of freshly cut ones on a small table.
Yunzhu replaced the fan with a larger one and fanned hard behind the two.
"I was just practicing my sword when it suddenly occurred to me that Father sent Fan Jie, surely on purpose." Jing Shao ate another piece of watermelon.
"How can I see that?" Mu Hanzhang leaned against the back of the couch and turned a page of the booklet in his hand.
"Fan Jie that person will not talk around the corner, father early disliked his share of the book sour gas, not moving to blood splash Pan Longzhu to a dead admonition, is to take him nothing to do." Think of the Southwest King that treacherous villain will be Fan Jie shivering with anger, Jing Shao can not help but stifle laughter.
Mu Hanzhang glanced at the king who didn't mourn for the loyal martyrs in the slightest, and helplessly shook his head, "This time, dying for his country, it's also a fulfillment of Lord Fan's wish to remain famous for the rest of eternity."
Jing Shao ate three pieces of watermelon, wiped his hands, and leaned backward against his own princess, looking at the dots of daylight leaking down from the treetops and the cool breeze, only feeling drowsy.
"What did father keep you for today?" The large head on his body was just resting on the small of his back, and his long breath kept spraying on his lower abdomen, Mu Hanzhang uncomfortably moved his body so that Jing Shao was resting on his lap, and waved his hand for the maids and Yunzhu to back off.
"Hmph, talking about getting me another concubine! The stepchildren still really want to have the nerve to make me marry her niece!" Jing Shao coldly grunted in dissatisfaction, the stepchildren just couldn't stand the fact that he had given Yan Ji to Jing Yu, and now they were going to marry off the commoner daughter of Yong Chang Bo to disgust him.
Mu Hanzhang's hand with the book paused, "So what did you say?"
"I told ...... you," Jing Shao realized that he had been switched, so he rolled over in dissatisfaction, put his face against Jun Qing's belly, and deliberately rubbed the tip of his nose there, "I only like men, and nowadays I'm not interested in female Can't bring myself to be interested."
"Hmmm ......" the feeling of rubbing through the fabric was rather clearer, Mu Hanzhang hummed lightly and ducked back, "How can you say that? Father should be angry."
"It's better than letting them stuff me with women." Jing Shao nastily chased after him and lightly pressed Little Junqing with the side of his face.
Mu Hanzhang frowned and moved that big head with both hands, moving it to a jade pillow on the side, beautifully called heat!
Jing Shao grimaced in dissatisfaction and jumped up to take the lance at the side and practiced again.
Mu hanzhang looked at so hard Jing Shao, gradually convergence of the smile. Father a few days ago, alone summoned Jing Shao, expedition to the southwest of this matter basically has been non-Jing Shao, just, the expedition is imminent, he these days, but not the slightest bit of parting sadness. Perhaps, leaving home to fight for Jing Shao has been a common meal, but see him a heart only think about the appearance of war, the heart still can't help but feel sad.
"Your Highness, Your Highness, there are people from the palace." Duo Fu hurriedly ran into the garden.
"What man?" Jing Shao withdrew the silver spear in his hand.
"It's Duo Lu from Empress Dowager's palace." Duo Fu dissatisfied wrinkled his bun face, he and Duo Lu were in the same batch to enter the palace, when he followed Empress Yuan as the chief administrator, Duo Lu was just a small eunuch in Shufei's palace, now that Shufei became the successor empress, that kid dared to put up a fight even when he saw him.
"Invite him in." Mu Hanzhang handed his coat to Jing Shao, and soon, a thin eunuch walked in, saluting both of them, but with a look of arrogance that could not be concealed.
Jing Shao frowned, "The eunuch has come, but is there something wrong with the mother?"
"Empress Dowager's decree, declaring that Princess Cheng will immediately go to Feng Yi Palace." Duolu's slightly shrill voice was quite difficult to hear in the ears.
"This hour?" Jing Shao frowned, it was just after noon, did the Empress not need to take a nap? Calling Jun Qing in such a hurry was definitely not a good thing.
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, because he is a man, married after the Empress has never called him into the palace, today Jing Shao just rejected the Yongchang Bo commoner daughter as a side room, the Empress called him into the palace in a hurry, must want to start from him here, or perhaps just can't be angry enough to want to take the air out of him. "I change clothes will come, eunuch wait a moment."
"Wait!" Jing Shao pulled back Mu Hanzhang, who was going to change into his court dress, and looked coldly at the empty-handed Duolu, "Did Mother say what it was about?"
"This slave girl doesn't dare to inquire," Duolu knew that King Cheng was a tough opponent, so he softened his tone and said, "The Empress only declared the Wangfei, so she must be just chatting with the Wangfei about her family, Your Highness doesn't need to worry."
Jing Shao does not believe that the Empress declared Jun Qing at this time is to talk about family life, but the Empress decree to summon, and did not explicitly say what it is for, can not be blatantly disobeyed, turn around and follow their own Wangfei into the house, take out the Prince of the court dress began to change: "I'm with you to go together."
"How do you enter the palace at this hour?" Mu hanzhang busy stop his movement, he is going to Feng Yi Palace, without being declared, if it is the morning and evening to go to pay respects to the mother and the queen is still reasonable, this hour Jing Shao into the palace, I am afraid that it is going to cause trouble, "Don't worry about it, there is something I can cope with it myself." Nadolu specially emphasized the meaning of only declaring Cheng Wangfei alone, that is, not allowing Jing Shao to follow.
Jing Shao watched coldly as his own consort followed Duolu on the carriage from the palace, and pulled Miao Ruoxi to say, "You go with the consort, and once something happens, go to the South Study to find me immediately!" Miao Ruoxi was a palace maid, familiar with the roads of the palace and resourceful.
Hearing this, Miao Xi nodded heavily and quickly followed.
South study is the place where the underage imperial sons read, is also this hour Jing Shao can only hang out. Hongzheng emperor has always attached importance to filial piety and fraternal duty, also encourage them to these adult prince have time to teach younger brother, just the emperor heart is really difficult to measure, they if they go to the diligence, and there is a suspicion of pulling these brothers, so the four of them out of the palace to build a house after they are seldom to go to the South Study Room.
Once the carriage was far away, Jing Shao mounted Xiao Hei and followed from afar, waiting for the carriage to actually enter the palace gates before turning his horse's head and going in through another side door.
"Your Highness, why have you entered the palace at this hour?" Xiao Qian, the commander of the guards who came to inspect his post, saw Jing Shao and came forward to greet him. Xiao Qian was a distant relative of Marquis Dingnan's family and had some friendship with Jing Shao.
"Xiao Qian!" Jing Shao put his arm around Commander Xiao's neck and pulled him aside, stuffing him with an egg-sized gold pirogue, "In a moment, if a maid runs out of Feng Yi Palace towards the South Study, please give a favor, I'll take the blame for anything that happens."
Xiao Qian was still a little hesitant, heard the last sentence will put down the heart, put the brave into his arms: "The king rest assured, a small matter." The palace maid in the palace walk is common, if not the nobles in the palace account, but also did not stop the reason not to go.

chapters.title: 38 - Kneeling
chapters.content:
Feng Yi Palace in front of the main hall are paved with lapis lazuli, empty without any grass and trees, alabaster stone steps magnificent atmosphere, just in this quiet afternoon, walking on it gives people a deep sense of depression.
Mu Hanyang followed the eunuch leading the way to the front of the main hall, perhaps the reason for the hot weather, the Empress is not in the hall, but in the corridor put a phoenix couch, two palace maids holding a long-handled peacock fan in the couch behind the slow fan. After the Empress in a colorful gold phoenix dress, sitting on top of the phoenix couch, straight looking at Mu Hanzhang step by step on the jade steps.
"My humble servant has met the mother, mother a thousand years old, a thousand years old, a thousand years old!" Mu Hanzhang calmly walked to the corridor and kneeled down to salute.
The Empress picked up the cup, sipped lightly, and took a handkerchief and elegantly nodded the corners of her mouth, before she said without haste, "Get up, quickly give a seat, this is the heart of King Cheng, in case of kneeling bad the Palace can not afford to compensate."
Mu Hanzhang narrowed his eyes, as if he could not hear the sarcasm in the Empress's words, and thanked her courteously and thoughtfully, sitting on the square stool moved by the palace maid.
See Princess Cheng completely did not expect that kind of panic, let sit on the seat, behavior, etiquette so that people can not pick a trace of fault, but let mention a breath ready to reprimand the Queen, hard swallowed back.
Jing Shao into the south study, underage young emperors have ended the nap, but also did not start the afternoon homework, just all quiet in the house to study homework, waiting for the husband to come. Because the weather is getting hot, Hongzheng Emperor exempted the imperial sons of the afternoon martial arts class, all changed to the literary class.
Standing outside the study, looking at these little children less than ten years old each looking serious as they held the books in their hands, Jing Shao remembered the situation in the southern study when he was a child. At that time, mother was still around, and every day at this time, she would have fresh fruits and melons brought in, not only for him and his brother, but also for his eldest brother and Jing Yu. Jing Yu always feel that the hands of others than his good, relying on their own young often want to change with his brother, brother will not be with him will be changed with him, but it is not used to their own, make too much noise will swing his fist to beat him.
Then the successor came to power, and there were no more melons and fruits to eat in the afternoon. From then on, there was a long period of time when no new prince was born in the palace, and when the eldest prince left the palace to build a residence, only the three of them were left in the study. Jing Yu every day someone will specially send snacks melon and fruit, but they are all unique ......
"Third Imperial Brother!" A milky cry called back Jing Shao's thoughts, and when he looked down, a little fat boy who only reached the base of his leg was tugging at the hem of his coat, it was none other than Seventh Imperial Prince Jing Yi.
Jing Shao reached out and touched his head, calling out "Jing Yi", and the little fatty immediately smiled without seeing his eyes, "Third Emperor Brother, you still recognize me!"
"It's not like we haven't seen each other for a few years, how can we not recognize each other?" Jing Shao cried and laughed as he picked him up, "Have you grown fat again?" Because Jing Yi grew up to be a fat boy, that's why Jing Shao remembers extra clearly, the other younger brothers are not common, so if someone else pulls him, they can only project the ranking based on the age.
"Third Imperial Brother ...... "The few people in the room turned around when they heard the commotion and all followed suit and stood up.
"I'm just stopping by, you guys read." Jing Shao waved his hand for them to sit back down.
"Third Imperial Brother, I heard that you defeated 100,000 Huns, I wanted to hear you talk about how you fought when I saw you in the New Year, but you were sitting at the front and I couldn't get through." Jing Yi was emboldened by being hugged by his royal brother, and did not return to his seat after being put down, tugging at Jing Shao and not letting go of his hand, wanting him to talk about the battlefield exploits. The other emperors didn't say anything, their eyes were also full of expectation.
"Third brother, are all Huns full of beards?"
"Third Imperial Brother, are there wolves in the desert?"
"Third Brother ......"
When Emperor Hongzheng came in, he saw Jing Shao surrounded by several imperial brothers, rarely showing a few moments of being at a loss for words, and couldn't help but ease his face.
"Back to mother, not taking a side consort is the king's intention, I have no knowledge of it." Mu Hanzhang bowed his head slightly in a polite manner, and to the Empress's meaner words than one just answered in a warm voice, not saying a single word.
"You're older than His Majesty, can't you advise me? Seeing that this is about to go to war, there is still no son and a half daughter, if there is an eventuality, such a high Prince title will not have no one to follow in his footsteps? At least you have been a successful candidate, why are you so insensitive?" The Empress slowly fiddled with the tea in her cup with the lid, saying that she only likes men, is it possible that all the concubines in the Chengwang Mansion in the past were just for show? Today in the imperial study, the emperor just mentioned a sentence to let Jing Shao niece as a side room, he said he does not like female color, clearly is to hit her face!
What do you mean there's an eventuality? What do you mean, there's no one left? The most taboo to say these before the expedition! Mu Hanzhang, who has been responding patiently, heard this, slowly clenched his fists hidden in his sleeves: "The Prince's title is not hereditary, even if it's a side child, it can only bear the Zhenguo General ......."
Empress Dowager fiercely knocked her cup on the small table, "What do you mean by this? Is this blaming this palace, blaming the emperor?" The surrounding palace maids heard this and knelt down.
"I don't dare." Mu Hanzhang hurriedly got up and knelt on the ground.
"What else would you not dare to do? As a royal consort, you ostracize your concubines, are jealous and exclusive, and now you don't allow the Prince to keep an heir, so it's really a bold and presumptuous thing to do!" The Empress' words could be described as aggressive, and every word was heartbreaking. Mu Hanzhang just silent not to say anything, now this situation, the queen is obviously annoyed, more said more wrong.
After receiving the handkerchief handed over by the palace maid, she wiped her tea-stained hands, glanced at Mu Hanzhang kneeling on the ground, and sighed lightly, "This palace doesn't want to make things difficult for you, but since you married into the royal family, you have to think about it for the sake of the royal family. This way, you go to kneel on that jade step platform, when you think about it, when to get up again."
Mu Hanzhang heard, can not help but secretly bitter smile, want to understand? The Empress didn't say anything about letting him reflect on anything, so why did she say she wanted to understand?
Jade steps platform is the jade steps in front of the temple above the piece of flat land, alabaster stone in the hot sun exposure for several hours, has been sunburned like charcoal. Mu Hanzhang elegantly light lifting hem, rules and regulations kneeling in the center of a stone plate. Summer afternoon is the time when the sunlight is the strongest, baking □ outside the skin, can soon feel the pain.
The queen let the palace people get up, over a cup of freshly brewed tea, slowly and methodically drank up, leaving Cheng Wangfei alone kneeling to be punished. She would like to see, this Cheng Wang and Cheng Wangfei in the end how much "love than gold".
Miaoxi stood behind a row of courtesans secretly anxious, but had no chance to leave.
Sweat along the handsome face slides over the graceful line of the chin, dripping down on the hem of the purple court dress, Mu Hanzhang drooped his eyes, without any trace of shrinking his hand into the sleeve. The sun is in the south, only sunlight can get to his spine, not so much as to sunburn his skin, just suffering from the court dress is more than one layer, soon to be drenched in sweat, hot slate will be hot bit by bit seeped into his body.
Mu Hanzhang pondered the Empress's purpose in singing this today, in order to divert her attention and alleviate her body's perception of pain. Today, Jing Shao directly refuted the matter of the side room, the Emperor did not force, the Empress consciously embarrassed, she wanted to use this way to let the people know that the matter of the inner house of the Harem, or her say; also knocked Jing Shao, do not talk nonsense.
When the Empress drank the second tea, she finally could not help but get up to go to the toilet.
Sweat hanging on the slender eyelashes, the scene in front of him was suddenly tinted with a seven-colored halo, Mu Hanzhang thought with bittersweet joy that perhaps the Empress merely wanted to vent her anger, and she herself didn't know how she was going to end it. Unfortunately, he is a man, not those blood deficiency and shortness of breath concubines, I guess the sun until the sun goes down can not be out of the sun. Should I pretend to faint so that I can find a step for her?
Miaoxi took the opportunity to follow the water room to change the tea of the courtesan back away, turned the corridor quickly flashed to the side, when no one noticed, quickly ran out. The road in the palace, which she had traveled every day since she was a child, had long been familiar to her, but today the road leading to the South Study seemed extraordinarily long. Miaoxi was sweating with anxiety, but did not dare to run too fast for fear of being suspected by the guards. That kind of gentle as jade modest gentleman, the king usually can not even say a word of heavy words, but in this hot sun kneeling on the stone plate, the king knows will not be heartbroken to death!
"My son is bent on stabilizing the four directions for my father, as for the heir royal grandchildren, there are two royal brothers, what's more, the fourth royal brother is going to get married next month," Jing Shao saw that his father was in a good mood today, and remembering first that Jun Qing was still in the Feng Yi Palace, he put on a loyal and honest face, "My son has been married to the crown princess for less than four months. Now really still like tight, really don't want to accept a newcomer."
"Hahahaha ......" the third son who only knows to lead soldiers and fight wars, now even know the taste of love, Hongzheng emperor heard this, can't help but openly laugh.
"Your Majesty! Master Wang!" Miaoxi stumbled in and was stopped by the guards in front of the study door.
Jing Shao and Emperor Hongzheng both turned their heads to look at the words.
"Miaoxi!" Jing Shao knew something had happened to Jun Qing when he saw the expression on the visitor's face, and immediately changed his color.
"What's going on?" Emperor Hongzheng frowned and signaled the guards to let her in.
"Slave girl kowtow to Your Majesty!" Seeing that Emperor Hongzheng was there, Miao Ruoxi flung herself to her knees, kowtowed and burst into tears, "Please Emperor, save the Wangfei! The Wangfei is being punished for kneeling in front of the Feng Yi Palace, and has already been kneeling under the hot sun for an hour!"
"Your Highness, that maidservant from King Cheng's residence has disappeared," Duolu looked around and quietly whispered in the Empress Dowager's ear, "The slave girl has just heard that King Cheng has also come into the palace, and is in the South Study Room."
The Empress Dowager snorted coldly, "With her going, this Palace would like to see how capable he, King Cheng, is!"
Mu Hanzhang kneeling is not far, naturally the words of the Empress heard clearly, can not help but secretly anxious, if Jing Shao regardless of breaking into the Feng Yi Palace to, this crime can be big!
"Your servant ＼ slave girl has met Your Majesty, long live the Emperor, long live the Emperor!" The guards and palace maids at the bottom of the Jade Steps suddenly knelt down in unison and called out three times for long live.
When the stepchildren sniffed, their hands shook, and the green jade tealight slid to the ground with a crisp sound.
"Jun Qing!" Jing Shao excused himself from his father and rushed up the jade steps in three or two steps.
When Mu Hanzhang heard the sound, his face, which had been lowered, lightly hooked up a cold smile, since the Emperor had come, he would do neither, and simply make a big deal out of it. So, weakly raised his head, glanced at the ever-approaching Jing Shao, and with a hoarse voice lightly called out, "Your Majesty ......", then his eyes closed, and he softly fell backward!

chapters.title: 39 - Forgot to mention
chapters.content:
Jing Shao watched Mu Huanzhang fall down, only to feel his heart being pulled up fiercely, using his light power to take a fierce step forward and hold the person tightly in his arms. "Junqing, Junqing ......" The person in his arms was soaked to the skin, and his sweaty handsome face was as pale as paper.
"Quickly move to the couch!" Emperor Hongzheng didn't let the Empress, who was half-squatting in salute, get up, pointed to the cool phoenix couch under the corridor, signaled Jing Shao to carry the person over, and said to Anxian, who was beside him, "Summon the Imperial Physician!"
Jing Shao carefully placed the person on the phoenix couch, took the herbal tea handed over by the palace staff, brought it to those dry and cracked lips, and slowly fed it down. Miaoxi took the fan at the side and fanned herself while wiping her tears.
"Father ......" Jing Shao pulled his own Wangfei's hand, angry eyes red, turned his head to look at the Hongzheng Emperor behind him, before he finished, suddenly the hand in his palm pinched him, and immediately stopped his words, and turned back to look at the person on the couch.
This situation in the eyes of Emperor Hongzheng is Jing Shao has been angry, want to say something, but taking into account the identity of the mother can not accuse, can only want to speak and then stop to swallow the words, how a "aggrieved"! Hongzheng Emperor frowned, sat down on the chair moved by the palace people, looked to some embarrassed half-squatting on the side of the Queen: "What's going on?"
"Back to the emperor, I called Cheng Wangfei to talk today, how can this child speak impulsively, still do not know repentance, I let him kneel to reflect for a while ...... I really do not know Cheng Wangfei a man, body is so weak ...... "The queen did not expect to Cheng Wang will find the emperor, originally a sentence is not right, she as a mother of a country has the right to punish Mu Hanzhang. Just people now give kneeling fainted, but also happened to give the emperor saw, there is a willful fault-finding, harsh treatment of stepchildren suspicion.
Emperor Hongzheng deeply looked at the queen, today's matter, he heart is very clear, usually she remedies one or two favored concubines, in order to maintain the peace and quiet of the harem, he also turned a blind eye to ignore. Only, now the king is on the march, but she is so harsh treatment of the king's consort, clearly is to add to his chaos!
"Jun Qing, where is it hard?" Jing Shao saw the person on the couch slowly open his eyes, and busied himself by coming over to inquire in a low voice.
Mu Hanzhang looked at Jing Shao and squeezed his palm again, lightly shaking his head, signaling him not to talk nonsense.
Jing Shao blinked and took the wet cloth towel handed over by the palace maid and gently wiped his cheeks and forehead, silent and not speaking, and Emperor Hongzheng did not pick up on the Empress's words either. There was silence in front of the main hall of Feng Yi Palace, only the sound of cicadas chirping in the distance.
The Imperial Doctor appeared at the right time, breaking the oppressive atmosphere. The white bearded doctor of the Imperial Hospital took a look at Mu Hanzhang's face, and silently took his pulse, and took out a few pills from the medicine box for him to take, and then turned to Emperor Hongzheng and said, "Your Majesty, looking at the Princess's pulse, when it's the summer heat that enters the body, coupled with the faintness caused by the lack of blood flow. Now that you have woken up, take the pills to get rid of the summer heat, rest for a day will not be a big problem, just ......."
Hearing the word just, Jing Shao immediately pricked up his ears and asked anxiously, "Just what?"
"Wangfei's tendons and veins seem to be more fragile than the average man's, and her body is not as robust as normal people," the doctor was honest, "I'll prescribe a pair of medicines, and drink them once more in the evening, or else the summer heat won't be dispelled cleanly, and I'm afraid I'll be left with a dizziness problem."
Hongzheng Emperor thought of Mu Huanzhang's whitened face on the second day of the wedding after kneeling for a long time, nodded slightly, and said to Jing Shao, "You guys go back first, it's not convenient to change in the palace."
Jing Shao wanted to say something else, but was stopped by the person in his arms.
Mu Hanzhang owed his body laboriously, "Thank you, Father Emperor, for your compassion."
Emperor Hongzheng waved his hand and said to Jing Shao, who was obviously full of anger, "The matter you mentioned just now, I promise that I will give you an explanation for today's matter later."
"Yes!" Jing Shao sniffed, bowed, picked up his own princess, and turned to leave.
Only after Jing Shao's family left did Emperor Hongzheng look at the somewhat apprehensive step-queen, "As the mother of a country, your handling and temperament are not as good as two juniors. If you do this, how can King Cheng still be assured of keeping Princess Cheng in the capital!"
The Empress sniffed and jerked her head up, "Your Majesty, it has been a rule since ancient times that when a general is away, his family stays in the capital!"
"You still know the rules?" Emperor Hongzheng snorted coldly, raising his hand and slamming the cup in front of his stepdaughter, "What did I say in the imperial study before noon? You've all turned a deaf ear!"
"Emperor! Concubine ......" The Empress then realized that she had already caused trouble for the sake of a momentary pleasure, and had also left a bad name in the Emperor's eyes for not knowing what is right. Cheng Wangfei is a man, can not stay heir, she persuaded the emperor the day before yesterday to let Cheng Wang marry a side consort, stay a heir, so that Cheng Wang has a tie, to prevent him from born against the heart. Although the emperor agreed, but also said that the king's nature is strong, can not be forced, this matter can not be forced.
Emperor Hongzheng rubbed his brow and pointed at the stepchildren kneeling on the ground, "You go to the spirit of Empress Yuan and reflect for three days! Think about what you said when you were enthroned that day, and how you treat Jing Chen and Jing Shao today?" After saying this, he got up and flung his sleeves away.
Out of the Feng Yi Palace, look back at the golden bricks and tiles behind him, Hongzheng Emperor sighed lightly, if the Queen Yuan is still there, it must be the harem dynastic hall will be spared a lot of wind and waves ......
"I'm fine, don't worry about it." After taking a bath and changing into a soft, thin undershirt, Mu Hanzhang leaned on the bed and looked at Jing Shao, who was busy, and couldn't help but advise.
"Drink the medicine." Jing Shao still had a fear of the doctor's words, "I'm afraid I'll be left with dizziness", so he made sure to supervise him to finish the medicine.
Mu Hanzhang was unable to do so, and could only take the bowl of medicine, tilted his head and drank it down, and before he could taste the bitterness, a bowl of clear water was handed over. "This medicine is incompatible with honey, you can't eat candied fruit, drink some water."
Mu Hanzhang raised his head and looked at the serious looking Jing Shao, only feeling warm and itchy in his heart, obviously a grumpy and careless person, but so meticulous about his affairs.
Jing Shao looked at Jun Qing whose face was still a little white, his heart ached so much that he turned around to bring the medicinal oil and slowly rolled up his pants leg. The white knees already had bruises from kneeling, in addition to hot bumps from the stone slabs, and he couldn't help but frown.
"This rubbing can't be medicinal oil, otherwise the pimple won't go down." Mu Hanzhang looked at it and felt that the pimple itched very uncomfortably, and couldn't help but scratch it with one finger.
Jing Shao looked at the original beautiful knee into this kind of green and red, and can not help what help, slowly bent down, in that injured place fell a light kiss, lying on the legs of his own princess, holding his waist sad.
Mu Hanzhang reached out and touched Jing Shao's head, "I'm not that delicate, by the way, what did you mention to Father Huang today?" The so-called face to teach the son back to teach his wife, father is obviously do not want to reprimand the queen in front of them, but when leaving that "promise", obviously is the compensation for Jing Shao.
"Oh, the expedition is next month, I want to go to the barracks tomorrow and familiarize myself with those generals first." Jing Shao buried his face in that soft inner shirt, greedily inhaling the faint fragrance of his own princess' body, that dry and warm flavor that made people can't help but want more.
"Will you go tomorrow ......?" Mu Hanzhang froze, originally thinking that it would take another half a month before they parted ways, not realizing that it would be this fast.
"Well," Jing Shao sat up, seeing his own princess' face was not right, and thinking that he did not understand, he explained, "I am used to getting acquainted with the generals before going on a journey, so as not to mess up right on the way. It's just that now the army is only fifty miles away from the capital, father will agree to me going, it's really an unexpected pleasure."
Mu Hanyang Zhang heard the excitement in his words, slowly lowered his eyes: "You don't know when to return this go, you ...... have never thought that we are about to part?" Tightly pursed lips, do not want to see Jing Shao's expression, Mu Hanyang don't look away, this person, nowadays is still like a child, simply do not understand the pain of parting.
Jing Shao's eyes widened, he had never thought of separating from Jun Qing! Not to mention that the capital this chaotic place is very unsafe, the previous life Jun Qing is in the king's house in the body is getting worse and worse, he simply do not rest assured; more importantly, if he let him a day can not see his own Wangfei, afraid of simply do not have the heart to fight the war! But ...... he had always thought that his own Wangfei knew, the original, himself, actually, forgot to say, ?
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao looked at the lowered eyes of his own consort who was sad, the afterglow of the setting sun reflected in his handsome side face, long eyelashes in the bottom of the eyes to leave a fan-shaped shadow, very lovely, could not help but move in his heart, a hand to hold the person into his arms. "Junqing, tomorrow will go to the military camp, later afraid of ...... us tonight, enjoy doing it once."
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips slightly, silent for a moment, slowly reached out and hugged Jing Shao. His physical strength has never been as good as Jing Shao, often a night to be a little more often, will not be able to eat. And this kind of thing to do over the body of the two are not good, so if not special, he has not allowed Jing Shao more than twice a day.
We're about to leave, so let's indulge him.
Jing Shao felt the compromise of the person in his arms, naturally he would not be polite, stripping the person in his arms of his clothes in three or two strokes. Afraid that he would touch his knees, he stuck himself between his legs and leaned over to drop fine, dense kisses on that slightly despondent handsome face.
"Well ......" underneath the body is a jade mat, Mu Hanzhang only reached out and clenched the round pillow under the neck, this kind of thing, no matter how many times you do it, just into | into the time is always inevitable pain.
Jing Shao kissed away the beads of sweat on the forehead underneath him, lightly biting the neck that was slightly curved up and tilted, moving gently and slowly, waiting for the person underneath him to get used to it, and only then gradually speeding up his movements.
Mu Hanzhang clung to the shoulders of the man on top of him, letting the searing hard iron ride through his body, a little more, a little more, so that he could remember what it was like and spend the rest of the months and even years of his life remembering it.
Mu Hanzhang trembled his body, trying to avoid the increasingly harder movements, the succession of terrible pleasures made him a little overwhelmed, but the things inside him seemed to see his intentions, exclusively chasing after the place that drove him crazy, constantly grinding.
"Ah ...... I can't ......唔...... "Already don't know how long, Mu Hanzhang has long been unable to bear it, the Slender legs kept slightly trembling.
The person underneath him frowned because he was burned by the scorching heat and seemed to be in pain, his body kept twitching, at the same time, the little Junqing that was attached to his belly also spat out the essence, Jing Shao only felt how it wasn't enough, and the little Xiao Xiao Shao that had just taken a break was energized again.
Mu Hanzhang, who was still trembling slightly, couldn't help but frown when she felt the change of that guy inside her, and pleaded in a slightly hoarse voice, "...... I don't want it ......"
"One last time, I promise." Jing Shao kissed his eyes that held thin tears.
Mu Hanzhang looked at him, thinking that he would be separated tomorrow when he opened his eyes, he sighed softly and slowly nodded his head.

chapters.title: 40 - Camps
chapters.content:
When Mu Hanyang woke up, it was already three rods of sunrise.
The whole body is like falling apart, everywhere is not sore, even open your eyes feel laborious, and even feel that the body is still constantly bumping and shaking. Mu Hanzhang thought in some trance, Jing Shao that bastard, how many times did he do last night? He only remembered that when he was so tired that he passed out, that guy was still tossing and turning on him.
A burst of ears came from the sound of a wooden wheel pressing over the stones, the long slender eyelashes trembled, slowly opened a pair of hazy eyes, Mu Hany Zhang confused and stunned for a moment, felt that the roof of the tent today is a little strange, as if it is the roof ...... of a horse carriage!
Only then did Mu Hanzhang realize that something was wrong and struggled to get up, the soreness in his waist made him unable to help but frown, and he could only barely sit up against the wall of the car.
The carriage was exquisitely furnished, the whole bottom of the carriage raised on a high platform, all covered with thick upholstery, and above it a layer of green jade mats; the walls of the carriage were embedded with shelves and small compartments, with a few books and an incense burner; and in a recess in front of the door there was a small table with his shoes, and on the small table there was a water-bag and two cups.
Underneath the body is a comfortable green jade mat, surrounded by several pillows of different sizes, all carefully wrapped with a layer of jade mat, Mu Hanyang slightly squinted his eyes, reached out to open the curtains of light-colored tulle, and saw that outside the car on top of a handsome black horse, was sitting on his own prince who should have already gone to the barracks!
Jing Shao was riding Xiao Hei in a refreshed manner, last night's doing was really enjoyable, causing him to get up late himself, he couldn't bear to wake up Jun Qing who was sleeping soundly, so he directly carried him to the pre-prepared carriage, and handed the royal residence over to the wrinkled bun-faced Duo Fu and Mr. Yun, and then he beautifully brought his own Wangfei towards the barracks which was fifty miles south of the city.
Suddenly feeling a line of sight, Jing Shao turned his head to look at the carriage, and saw the handsome face of his own princess appearing at the window, and busily waved his hand to tell the driver to stop the carriage, and jumped off Xiao Hei to get into the carriage.
"Awake from your nap?" Jing Shao smiled and poured a glass of water and handed it over.
Mu Hanzhang didn't pick it up, but leaned against the wall of the car and watched him quietly.
"Ahem, don't sit like this," Jing Shao was looked at with some weakness, took off his shoes and climbed up, yanked aside a large welcome pillow, hugged his own royal consort who was aching and limp, and let him lean against it, ingratiatingly feeding the cup to his lips, "Drink a mouthful of water first, and the meal Yunsong will be delivered in a while. "
"Where are you taking me?" Mu Hanzhang rarely didn't push back, drinking the entire glass of water right from Jing Shao's hand, still quietly staring at him.
"Hehehe, my army is lacking a military advisor, so you have nothing to do in the capital, why don't you come with me to the southwest?" Jing Shao scratched his head and turned around to pour another glass of water.
"When the general is away, the family must not leave the capital." Mu Hanzhang narrowed his eyes, looking at the cup handed to him, his hand on the welcome pillow slowly rubbing the rounded jade piece.
"The royal family is not there is a concubine, which you do not have to worry about," Jing Shao proudly said, "I was going to secretly take you away, I did not expect to mention yesterday with the father, he even agreed, as long as you do not let others know that the identity of your consort is."
The dust raised by the rumbling ...... carriage fell on the king who was still carrying his shoes, and it was quite a bit of depression.
Jing Shao stood frozen in place, only half a moment later remembering to put his shoes on. He, surprisingly, had been driven off the carriage by his own princess, and was still so miserable that he hadn't even put on his shoes!
Turning his head to look at a certain mount that had also been left behind, Blackie was boredly tugging a leaf and chewing on it in his mouth, and when he saw his master looking over, he snorted unkindly with what sounded very much like a gloating laugh.
"How dare you kid laugh at me!" Jing Shao indignantly grabbed Xiao Hei's mane and rubbed it vigorously against that big head, "You don't have a daughter-in-law yet! It's still not as good as me!"
The carriage traveled slower, and by the time it arrived at the barracks, it was already dusk.
The camp was on an open plain, surrounded by tall poplar trees. Tents were neatly arranged, torches snapped on iron pots, and spear-wielding soldiers patrolled among the tents in groups.
"Your Majesty!" The soldiers on the lookout saw Jing Shao riding on Xiao Hei, and busily signaled the people below to open the wooden fence.
"Greetings, Your Highness King Cheng!" Several great generals in armor ran over, kneeling and saluting in unison.
"All get up!" Jing Shao jumped off his horse, patted the person kneeling at the very front, and without waiting for the crowd to get up, he turned around and walked to the carriage, slowly lifting a bit of the curtain, "Junqing, come down." Then, curtly, he stretched his hand over.
The man in the car obviously did not appreciate it, a lift the curtain, Woody walked down.
A few generals watched as the king invited out a handsome and extraordinary man from the carriage, dressed in a light green wide-sleeved Chinese dress that stood out in a group of people full of armor and soldier's uniforms, and his elegant and scholarly aura was out of place in the surroundings.
"Your Majesty, who is this?" The man at the head of the group was about thirty years old, with a stout figure and looked quite fierce.
"This is my military advisor, Mr. Jun Qingjun." Jing Shao smiled and introduced the crowd.
The master of the army? Several generals look at each other, the king with troops, never heard of also with the military division, this is not the world in chaos, but also to have to settle the country's generals of the talent to plan the world.
Mu Hanzhang lightly swept through the crowd and raised his hand to hold his fist, military generals have always been displeased with the literati, and these people would naturally be hostile to the sudden appearance of the military commander, so he was not surprised by their instantly cold eyes.
Jing Shao frowned slightly, but he couldn't say anything at this time, introducing the people one by one to his own princess.
The man at the head was Zhao Meng, General Zhao. The two men following behind, the cold-faced one was the Left Guard, and the smiling one was the Right Guard.
