"Before the king said anything beforehand, the last general did not prepare the military division's tent," Zhao Meng looked up and down at the weak Mu Huanzhang, his tone was quite disdainful, "I can only condemn the military division to deal with the soldiers for a night first."
"There is no harm in it, the Military Counselor will just live with this king." Although he knew that General Zhao was making things difficult for Jun Qing, but it was exactly what Jing Shao wanted, he was busy pretending to be generous and said.
"How can that be? If someone else lives in His Majesty's tent, it's overstepping the rules!" Zhao Meng said gruffly.
"Live wherever you want," Mu Hanzhang slowly opened his mouth, his voice warm and calm, very good to hear, "General do not have to be difficult, feel free to arrange a tent for me is."
"Hehehe, ordinary tents are dirty and smelly, how can a tender skinned person like the military counselor be accustomed to living in them? If you don't mind, come and live with me." The Right Guard smiled and came up.
Jing Shao heard a head of fire, a slap to the right guard's head: "Nobody fucking thinks, the military division will live with this king."
After saying that, he didn't care about the crowd, pulling Mu Hanzhang's arm and dragging the person to the biggest one tent.
Zhao Meng looked at the backs of the two men, snorted coldly, and turned to leave.
The Right Guardian skimmed his lips and said to the Left Guardian, "This Military Counselor is so good looking, that old boy Zhao Meng even gave up making things difficult for people."
The Left Guard glanced at him and silently turned away.
"Hey hey, why did you leave without waiting for me?" The Right Guard waited for half a day without an answer, turned his head and saw the Left Guard's figure fading into the darkness, and busily raised his feet to chase after him.
The king's tent prepared for the king is really much more spacious than the other tents, summer did not lay the carpet, the cold air on the ground at night turned up very cool. Wooden platform paved a very wide bed, the countryside night cool, but did not pave the mat, a bed of soft and smooth brocade quilt spread on it, for the body sore Mu Hanzhang is really a great temptation.
Looking at his own Wangfei who entered the tent and flopped onto the bed, Jing Shao touched his nose and slowly came over, a pair of hands tentatively caressing his waist: "Does it still hurt?"
Mu Hanzhang glanced at him, "Next time, the king will not know if he comes to try it himself."
Jing Shao dryly laughed twice, sensible shut up, seriously in the waist and femur pinch up, thin summer clothes can penetrate the body temperature under the material, soft satin clearly depicts that wonderful lines, a pair of big hands rubbing can not help but slide down a little.
"Tomorrow have someone prepare another tent for me." Mu Hanzhang also did not look at him, so he lay down on the pillow and said coolly.
"No!" Jing Shao refused without thinking, and the hand that had just caressed a piece of roundness obediently moved back to his waist.
"Which military division has been living with the king." Mu Hanzhang yawned a small yawn, after a bumpy ride in the car, he couldn't sleep well when it was hard on his body, so he was a little sleepy at this moment.
"A military division is to be with the marshal so that they can discuss war matters at any time!" Jing Shao straightened up and said, "It's been like that since ancient times."
Mu Hanyang rolled his eyes, he read all the history books, never saw which dynasty and which generation have this kind of rules, lazy to argue with him, the waist is very comfortable when heavy and light kneading, then quietly let him pinch for a while, in Jing Shao thought he fell asleep, suddenly asked softly, "Why did you lie to me last night?"
"Huh?" Jing Shao was startled, scratched his head and said, "I didn't say a word of panic! Originally is, will soon be in the army, the future marching, fighting to save physical strength, it is really difficult to have the opportunity to make out!"
"It's good that Your Highness knows this, so go sleep with General Zhao tonight." After Mu Hanzhang finished speaking, he rolled over and yanked the brocade quilt aside, facing inward and no longer paying attention to him.
"Junqing ......," Jing Shao called out pitifully.
"Your Highness, are you asleep? Not asleep come to the center tent and drink!" Zhao Meng called loudly from outside the tent.
Jing Shao rubbed the corner of his forehead with a headache, wanting to scold him away, but afraid of noisy people around him, he only walked out, "What's the noise, this king is sleepy, I won't drink tonight." After saying that, he was going to drill back in again.
"Your Majesty, the last general has something to say." Zhao Meng took Jing Shao by the hand and dragged him into the distance.
"Speak!" Jing Shao shook off General Zhao's hand and said impatiently.
"The end will not know where this military master king is looking for, just this southwest all the way to the difficult and dangerous, he is afraid that this body is not able to eat, and a paper scholar, if you do not know how to fight but also blindly command, I'm afraid that it is going to be a mistake." Zhao Meng practicing martial arts people, speak in full breath, this did not walk two steps, lying in the tent Mu Hanzhang naturally hear clearly.
"This king has his own measure," Jing Shao frowned, sighed and said, "I know you are not convinced now, but you can't be too arbitrary about people and things, I'm not forcing you to take him as a military advisor right now, and after a while, we'll talk about it. Just one thing, Mr. Jun was invited by me with great difficulty, even if you are not convinced, you are not allowed to do anything disrespectful to him, and even more so, you are not allowed to put him in danger! If anything happens to him, this king will never forgive him lightly."
"Che, the last general is not so bad as to be in trouble with a defenseless scholar," Zhao Meng felt that he was being belittled and snorted coldly, "Only if he tells me what to do, don't expect me to have patience with him either!"
"Alright, alright, less nagging, get lost, this king is going to sleep." Jing Shao waved his hand, coaxing people like he was chasing flies.
"Your Highness, are you really not coming for a drink?" Zhao Meng took two steps, then turned back to the deed and said, quickly running away before Jing Shao raised his foot to kick him.
When General Zhao left, Jing Shao glanced despondently at the king's tent behind him, not daring to go in immediately, but only aimlessly scattering his steps in the camp.

chapters.title: 41 - Blackie
chapters.content:
At night the barracks is very quiet, patrolling soldiers will not say a word, so the three generals in the center of the tent noisy boxing sound is especially obvious. These three people all fought with him against the Huns, used to the kind of debauchery in the desert, now in the suburbs of the capital also do not know to restrain, back to clean up their behavior. Jing Shao shook his head and slowly walked towards the distance.
Now that the attack on the southwestern fiefdom was a full three years earlier than in his last life, the advantages he had were very obvious. The original east-conquering general who was always against him was sent to reinforce the grand prince, and his father didn't send anyone else to govern, so there were a lot of things he could do. Just a time a thousand things, do not know where to start.
"Whinny~" Blackie, who was chewing grass in the stables, tilted his head in greeting when he saw his master.
Jing Shao came back to his senses, not realizing that he had actually walked to the stables, and simply stood in front of Xiao Hei's food trough, rubbing the big black head that was almost blending in with his surroundings.
Blackie tossed his head in dissatisfaction and moved to the side, continuing to graze.
Being thrown out of the tent by the princess is bad enough, how come even the horse dislikes him? Jing Shao grabbed Xiao Hei's ears, "Don't eat it, this king has no place to sleep, and you're still in the mood for extra food!"
Xiao Hei raised his head, chewing the grass leaves in his mouth while staring at his own master with a pair of big dark eyes. Because Xiao Hei was the king's favorite horse, the horse herder would prepare fresh grass for him individually every day, and his food was not half a star better than other horses that ate hay.
For Jing Shao's behavior of pulling his ears from time to time, Xiao Hei had long been accustomed to it and continued to crunch and chew.
Jing Shao and small black stared at for a long time, but really can not stare at a pair of horse eyes, only to give up. Grasping the pillar sideways sat on the wooden fence, dragged to a grass in the mouth, the grass stems some slightly bitter, only the white place has a little sweet, also do not know how the small black ate so cheerfully.
"Xiao Hei, when this battle is over, I'll find you a daughter-in-law," Jing Shao looked up at the bright moon in the sky, the moon in the countryside seems to be extraordinarily clear and cold, in his previous life, he never had the leisure to enjoy the moon in this way, every day he thought about formations, practicing soldiering, practicing martial arts, and seizing the throne, and he lived to be thirty years old and was still that tired, when he was really not worth it, and fed the grass in his hand to Xiao Hei, the "You say you want a stallion or a mare?"
"Whinny~" Blackie looked at the lone blade of grass in his master's hand, sprayed him with hot air, and turned to go to sleep in the shed.
Being completely disliked by his mount, Jing Shao could only leave the stables and tiptoe back to the king's tent. The person on the bed was lying on his side, with one hand resting outside the brocade blanket, sleeping extremely well, and seemed to have changed his movements since he left.
Jing Shao quietly took off his coat and lifted the corner of the blanket to get in.
Mu Hanzhang moved, perhaps because he was used to Jing Shao being around, and was not woken up.
Jing Shao hooked his lips, carefully placing his arm, which was resting on the outside, under the covers, and then slowly putting his own arm through, trying to take the man into his arms.
"Hmmm ......" the person in his arms let out a light hum, startled Jing Shao, paused for a moment to see that the person did not wake up, only then assuredly tucked him in the corner of the quilt, and then contentedly buried his face into his own Wangfei's neck nest, deeply inhaled a breath of Junqing's body's light fragrance, lightly rubbed against it, the Beautifully closed his eyes.
Jing Shao's body is good, always touching the bed, so he did not see, the person in his arms slowly hooked the corner of his lips.
The next morning, Mu Hanzhang woke up early because he slept long yesterday. The sunlight shines on the white tent, the pattern on it is clearly visible, stunned for a moment, before remembering that he is no longer in the royal residence, but in the barracks. The person beside him was still sleeping soundly, contentedly snoring tiny snores, hot air sprayed on the neck nest, blowing a few strands of hair that fell there, a little itchy.
Mu Hanzhang moved and turned to face Jing Shao, looking at his sleeping face. Originally thought to be separated for a few months or even a few years, it is a lie to say that it is not sad, and even have already made plans, if he does not return for a few years, he will go to do business near the battlefield, did not think that this guy had already counted on it.
Stretching out a slender finger, pointing at Jing Shao's handsome nose, Mu Hanzhang couldn't help but bend his eyes, for that nasty little tactic of Jing Shao's, he had long since stopped being angry, except that this fault couldn't be spoiled.
Jing Shao felt an itch on his nose and opened his eyes in a daze, seeing a glistening jade-like finger, he opened his mouth and bit it, licking at the rounded finger.
Mu Hanzhang retracted his hand and silently watched Jing Shao fully open his eyes.
"Hey, Jun Qing, you're awake." Jing Shao selectively forgets the punishment that he should go and sleep with a certain smelly and hard general, and moves over to give his own princess a kiss on her soft lips, "The hour is still early, I'm going to go and practice, so I'll come back to accompany you with breakfast when the morning practice is over."
Jing Shao didn't wait for the person in his arms to cross-examine him, so he jumped up and put on his clothes, changed into a moonlight-white power suit, washed his face and ran out.
Mu Hanyang slowly sat up and looked at Jing Shao who fled as if he was also fleeing, and couldn't help but laugh out softly.
Around also can't sleep, Mu Hanzhang got up and put on his clothes, the king's tent put a delicate wooden box, is yesterday from the carriage unloaded, most of the things put inside are his clothes and customary some things, it looks like Jing Shao really is already prepared for a long time.
"Your Excellency is awake." Yun Song came in to deliver tea, saw Mu Hanzhang fully dressed, and was busy bringing water to wash his face and rinse his mouth. Outside can not disclose the identity of the princess, he is not a military man can not be called military division, so he called Gongzi.
"You also follow the expedition?" Mu Hanzhang took the cloth towel Yun Song handed him to wipe his face, on the theory that a king's mansion boy like Yun Song can't be brought along.
"I just stayed in the camp this half month to run errands for the king and his son, and will return to the king's residence when the army departs." Yun Song smiled and said, "Yun Zhu clamored to come along yesterday, but the king didn't let him."
"Are you familiar with this military camp?" Mu Hanzhang nodded slightly and took a sip of the tea.
"This barracks is the king's personal guards, I have been here a few times." Yun Song answered honestly.
Mu Hanzhang heard this and frowned slightly, lifting his hand to lift the door curtain, the earthy scent of the early morning flooded his face, invigorating one's spirit, "In that case, you accompany me around the camp."
At this hour, almost all the soldiers had gone to the schoolyard to drill, and only some soldiers from the miscellaneous battalion were working, and the fire in the iron basin had already gone out, emitting wisps of green smoke.
From the mouth of Yun Song learned, this camp about more than five thousand people, are directly belonging to the Jing Shao's troops, weekdays are not here, but in a hundred miles away from the Qi County. This part of the people is to fight the Xiong Nu Jing Shao cultivated the first elite, from the northwest return to unloading the military power, the emperor extraordinarily grace to this five thousand people and Qi County, a large area of land alone rewarded to the King of Cheng.
Speaking of Qixian, Mu Huanzhang think up Jing Shao to be brought to him for the barren forest of the hundred acres of good land, listening to the underlings who went to look at the land, that piece of manor is really a good land, very fertile, there are soldiers in the help of cultivation, but it turned out to be Jing Shao's barracks are located.
"Second Brother Wang, why is this porridge getting thinner and thinner?" Two small soldiers carried a large wooden bucket and put it on the open space in the middle of the four tents with a whimper.
"Aren't there still steamed buns? There's a soup to drink." The man known as Wang Erge carried a large basket of steamed buns and placed it by the barrel.
Mu Hanzhang curiously walked over to take a look, the three of them looked at him with strange eyes and exchanged glances with each other, last night it was all over the barracks, the king had brought a good looking military commander and even slept in the same tent with him, so needless to say, this one must be the one.
"The military master got up so early." Wang Er saw that the king's personal boy was following him, so he couldn't pretend to be invisible, so he opened his mouth to greet him.
Mu Hanzhang nodded slightly and asked in a warm voice, "Is the daily breakfast always like this? Why don't you see any dishes?" He is now only a military advisor orally appointed by Jing Shao, the so-called military advisor priest, only considered a strategist, no official position, so for these soldiers can not be too pose.
"Hey, it's good to be able to eat, what else do soldiers care about dishes." Wang Er made a wink towards the two small soldiers behind him, "We still have to carry the food, military master turn around by yourself."
The little soldier who carried the bucket wanted to say something, but facing a clean and tidy military division, he seemed to be a little embarrassed, wiped his hands twice on the big apron on his body, and ran away after Wang Er in a puff of smoke.
"Second Brother Wang, do you think this military division is so good looking, is it really as they say, is it the king's concubine ......"
"Hush ...... don t talk nonsense in broad daylight." Wang Er was busy covering the mouth of the little soldier.
When Mu Hanzhang returned to the king's tent, Jing Shao had already taken a bath and was sitting at the dining table waiting for him. The king's breakfast wasn't much richer than an ordinary soldier's, just an extra plate of fried greens and a dish of peanuts.
Seeing Mu Hanyang frown slightly, Jing Shao realized that Junqing may not be used to eating this, some apologetic: "The days in the barracks are just a little bit of hardship, if you don't like to eat, I'll let the royal family's cook follow ......"
"Eating with the generals is what you should do," Mu Hanzhang sat down in front of the dining table and picked up the rice bowl, "I'm just wondering, the Ministry of Revenue didn't allocate less silver to you this time, how come this barracks is still so hard."
"Silver?" Jing Shao bit into a steamed bun, "With so many people in the army, no amount of silver is enough to spend."
Fear of him eating and talking will bite his tongue, Mu Hanzhang pursed lips, no longer say more, but the heart is thinking that these two days have to check the accounts of the army. Generals eat bad in the second place, if someone is greedy ink military pay, when the army to pull out the Ministry of households to send people to manage the account, the problem can be a problem.
"Your Highness! Your Highness, it's not good!" A junior soldier suddenly ran to the front of the tent and yelled, "The little black horse seems to be sick!"

chapters.title: 42 - Uva Ursi
chapters.content:
"Xiao Hei?" Jing Shao was startled, put down his dishes and ran out. He was fine last night, why did he get sick early in the morning?
"Your Highness!" Mu Hanzhang took a look at Jing Shao's half-eaten meal, sighed helplessly, and got up to head towards the stables as well.
"Whinny ......" in the stables Xiao Hei is grumpily panting, the grass in the trough is scattered all over the place, being trampled under its feet, and the horse herder is sitting crouching on the side covering his stomach, obviously being kicked by Xiao Hei.
So spirited, where does it look like he's sick? Jing Shao let the few soldiers and generals who were trying to pacify Xiao Hei dodge away, lightly kicked the pillar, leapt onto the horse's back, and yanked on Xiao Hei's reins. "Whinny~" Xiao Hei instantly stood up and chirped, knowing that it was his master who had come, finally stopping his tossing and turning, puffing hot air, but still stomping his feet non-stop.
"Junqing, don't come over yet," fearing that Xiao Hei's tantrum would hurt him, Jing Shao hurriedly stopped Mu Hanzhang's approach.
Zhao Meng walked over from the other side, saw Mu Hanzhang standing three steps away, and teased, "That's right, it wouldn't be good if this fine skin gave a kick."
"Zhao Meng! You shut up!" Jing Shao glared at General Zhao, who was talking nonsense, and waited for Xiao Hei to quiet down before he jumped off his horse, looked at the messy stables, and asked the horseman on the ground, "What's going on here?"
"Back to your majesty, I woke up late in the morning and was too late to cut fresh grass for Little Black, so I took dry forage for him to eat, who knew that he ate one bite and spit it out, and launched into a frenzy." The horse herder knelt on the ground and answered one by one, fearing that the king would blame himself.
"And this horse picks its food? Animals shouldn't be spoiled!" General Zhao wasn't annoyed by the king's scolding, he walked up and patted Xiao Hei, saying to Mu Hanzhang, "Why doesn't the military commander dare to go forward yet? To go into battle, it's not good to be as timid as a pussy."
Mu Hanzhang ignored the hard-spoken General Zhao, lifted his foot and slowly walked to the manger, looked carefully for a moment, frowned slightly, picked up a piece of hay and said to the horse herder, "Are the horses in this stable eating this kind of grass?"
The horse herder didn't understand what the military master was asking for, raised his eyes to look at the king, and answered truthfully. He was afraid that Xiao Hei didn't like to eat hay, so he took the new hay and gave it to him separately. The new grass is not dry, half of it is still green grass, it is more delicious than hay.
"Junqing, is there something wrong?" Jing Shao sensed something was wrong and turned his head to ask Mu Hanzhang who was beside him
"There's aconite grass in this grass!" Mu Hanzhang handed the grass in his hand to Jing Shao.
Zhao Meng took a handful of grass and looked at it, "What ooze, isn't this just ordinary thatch?"
Jing Shao looked at the grass leaves in his hand, the half-dried leaves were still a little green, slightly wider than thatch, and not too harsh to the touch. Horses are born with the ability to recognize poisonous grass, as long as they are not starving, they will not eat, Xiao Hei ate too much last night, naturally will be picky about poisonous grass.
"Call the Left Guard." Jing Shao frowned, with Jun Qing's nature, if it wasn't a sure thing, he wouldn't have said he wouldn't come.
It just so happened that the left and right guards heard about the incident at the stables and rushed over.
"I've seen aconite grass in Shu, not in this shape." Zhao Meng saw that the king looked grave and couldn't help but interject, the aconite grass is a gut-breaking grass, who would be so mischievous as to use this to deal with a horse?
"The one that grows in Shu is the Yellow Grass Owl, this one is the Long Leaf Owl, which grows in the grasslands." The left protector said expressionlessly, he always loved horses, and naturally paid extra attention to the horse's grass.
"Whinny~" Xiao Hei snorted, seemingly echoing the Left Protector's statement.
Jing Shao stroked that big black head and said in a deep voice, "Check!"
An hour later, those who fed the horses, those who managed the forage stores, and those who escorted the grain were all brought into the king's tent.
"Your Majesty, it's really none of my business!" The people kneeling below cried and kowtowed, poisoning a warhorse was a major offense of killing the head.
"Your Highness, the last general has already checked, and there is a small amount of aconite grass mixed in with all the new grasses in the grass storehouse." The left guard said.
"Several of you, do you have anything to say?" The Right Guardian smiled and walked to a few people, "Poisoning a warhorse is a capital offense, if no one admits to it, all of you will have to lose your heads."
"Your Highness spare your life! I don't think it's any of my business." A few people took turns to state that the matter of the grass, the grass was sent yesterday, the storehouse has always been no outsiders close to the people who escorted the delivery of the people have not seen someone in the middle of the package, and the horse herder is even more innocent, he is only responsible for taking the grass to the horse to eat, it is not possible to give the entire storehouse of grass mixed with poisonous grass.
Each had their own reasons, but everyone was here, and the poisonous grass couldn't have flown in on its own. "All deny it, drag them all out and chop them up!" Zhao Meng raised his hand, after something like this happened, an example must be made.
Jing Shao frowned, he also felt that it wasn't the people in the army who did this. The person who poisoned the horses wanted to poison all the horses, this did not happen in his previous life, and this time when he stayed at the outskirts of the capital, this kind of thing happened. However, there was no problem with the ins and outs, where did the poisoned grass come from?
"Wait!" Mu Hanzhang, who had been sitting on the side listening for half a day, suddenly spoke out, stopping the guards from dragging people, "The matter hasn't been investigated clearly yet, these people can't be killed yet."
"Military division, military law, you say this, is not to harbor anyone?" Zhao Meng is not accustomed to the readers of the grinding, check what to check, this kind of thing stops for one more day, the barracks will be one more point of danger, the battlefield happened this kind of thing are to be quick, kill them all will not have a problem.
This kind of incident happened right after this military division had just joined the military camp, it was really a bit suspicious. Hearing this, the crowd's eyes on Mu Hanyang became a bit off.
"General Zhao is in such a hurry to kill someone, is he not trying to cover something up?" Mu Hanzhang flipped through the records of the grain and grass storehouse in his hands and said without haste.
"You ......," Zhao Meng choked.
Mu Hanzhang closed the pamphlet in his hand and did not intend to let him off the hook, then analyzed, "The army is tightly guarded everywhere, and if you dare to lay hands on the grain and grass, there must be an accommodation from someone with a rather high official position." A pair of eyes as black as dotted paint stared straight at General Zhao, as if they had seen through everything.
"You ...... spit blood!" Zhao Meng was so infuriated that his face turned red and his circle of beard shook a little.
"Mr. Jun didn't say it was you who did it either, what are you excited about?" The Right Guard watched the fun and interjected, while the Left Guard remained expressionless without saying a word.
Jing Shao held his fist against his lips and couldn't help but stifle a couple chuckles even though he knew he shouldn't.
"Your Highness, I think we should take these people into custody first and wait until the matter is clearly investigated before coming to a conclusion." Mu Hanzhang got up and cupped his fists to Jing Shao.
"If you're capable, you're the one to investigate this matter!" Zhao Meng pointed at Mu Hanzhang.
Mu Hanzhang slightly hooked his lips, "It's okay for me to check."
"Gotta set a time limit!"
"Three days."
"Good! If you can't find out after three days, you'll be as guilty as them!" Zhao Meng was so exasperated by Mu Hanzhang's bland attitude that he rose to a high pitch.
"As long as General Zhao doesn't make trouble out of it." Mu Hanzhang's tone remained unchanged, his voice warm and calm, but it was more convincing than the wailing General Zhao.
"Hmph! I'll squat with them in the military prison!" Zhao Meng was so angry that he almost jumped up, although he was not accustomed to it, he did not do that kind of villainous thing, "Then we have to make a military order!"
Mu Hanzhang glanced at him, thinking that this General Zhao is not entirely a reckless man, let Yun Song bring pen and paper, with elegant and powerful script to write down a military order, the first to sign the word "Jun Qing". Yun Song will military order to Zhao Meng in front of the General Zhao took the pen, also do not look, brush two signed their own big name, grabbed a few people on the ground, turned around and left.
Mu Hanzhang folded up the military order and handed it to Jing Shao.
After the crowd left, Jing Shao couldn't help but hold his own Wangfei into his arms, "Is there any certainty that this matter will be cleared up?" Just now, when Jun Qing went against Zhao Meng, he was really too handsome, and the sharpness of him was as if he had unsheathed his sword, mesmerizing people.
Mu Hanzhang was held in Jing Shao's lap, and moved a bit uncomfortably, "It's just a guess, and I'm not ten percent sure."
"Zhao Meng is a reckless man, why do you need to be general with him." Jing Shao frowned when he heard this, he couldn't help but worry, military orders are not made casually, if he couldn't find out by then it would be troublesome.
"What I signed is my 'word', not my 'name', Da Chen Laws and Regulations, all military warrants where the drawing is not in my full name are not countable." Mu Hanzhang laughed lightly.
Jing Shao froze for a moment, swallowed his saliva, and thought to himself that it would be better for him not to easily anger his own princess in the future.
Mu Hanzhang asked the people not to publicize this matter, while he himself asked for the account books in the barracks and scrutinized them.
In the evening, Jing Shao, who came back from practicing, took a bath and came over to the desk, and under the candlelight, Mu Huanzhang had a large stack of account books by his side, quietly flipping through them. Jing Shao casually flipped through these ledgers, not only for grain and grass, but also for weapons, uniforms, camp tents, mobilization of soldiers, and all other accounts.
"What are you looking at these for?" Jing Shao was puzzled, "Aren't you checking on the grain and grass?"
"I had wanted to take a look at the army's account books, and it just so happened to be an opportunity, so I took it all to look at." Mu Hanzhang turned over a page and lifted his pen to write down a few words on a piece of paper aside.
"These are not in a hurry, you can see them anytime you want to," Jing Shao picked the person up from behind, "It's too late, we'll see it tomorrow."
"I'll finish this one!" Muhan Zhang struggled.
"No, this king is sleepy, the military division wants to serve the bed!" Jing Shao said as he threw the man onto the wide bed couch and pounced after himself.
Mu Hanyang was pounced on by the person pressurized gasping up, reached out and pushed him, suddenly heard the footsteps of the soldiers patrolling outside the tent, busy holding down Jing Shao to prevent him from moving. Only then did he remember that the tent was lit, and the movements of the people in the tent could be seen from the outside!
Jing Shao was pressed against the chest of the person underneath him, and with his chin resting just above a small bean through his thin summer clothes, he gently rubbed back and forth.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang glared at him and turned her head to blow out the candles beside the bed.
"Junqing, you ......" Jing Shao widened his eyes, his own princess today was so active, blowing out the candles, which is obviously seducing ah! So, quickly took off the outer shirt, looking for that soft lips and kissed it.
Mu Hanzhang was kissed off guard, trying to push away the guy who was messing around, but his strength seemed to be a refusal in the eyes of the people on his body, and even more wantonly put his hand into his inner shirt, caressing lightly on that glistening chest.
"Well ......," Mu Hanzhang was aroused and shuddered, and when Jing Shao's hand caressed his shorts, he couldn't bear to raise his leg, pushing against the waist and abdomen of the man on top of him, pushing him off his body.
"Junqing ......," Jing Shao was thrown down and disgruntledly stuck up again.
"The candle flame in the tent is still burning, and it can be seen from outside." Mu Hanzhang frowned and pointed to the brass candlestick in front of the table, on which eight candles were burning beeping.
Jing Shao was busy jumping up, blowing out the candles in one breath, and getting back under the covers to take the person into his arms.
"Your Highness has forgotten what he said the day before yesterday?" Mu Hanzhang pulled over the quilt to cover him, "Recently, we have to nourish our energy, and we have to get up early tomorrow, so go to bed early." The gentle voice spoke as a matter of course, just like the exhortation of a loyal subject.
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao heard him mention the day before yesterday, immediately lost his breath, shook the person in his arms, but he just buried his face into his chest, quietly closed his eyes seem to have fallen asleep.
I thought to fool around for a day this matter is even past, how could I expect my own Wangfei actually this kind of grudge! Jing Shao only had to rub the person toward his arms again ...... to sleep!

chapters.title: 43 - The Truth
chapters.content:
The three-day time limit is about to pass, Mu Hanzhang does not seem to be in a hurry at all, just daily in the king's tent to look through the account book, and occasionally go to the barracks to see.
"What did the Military Counselor ask you today?" The Right Guardian asked as he caught the junior soldier who was going to go back to eat, he was really curious about how this Mr. Jun was going to find the murderer within three days.
"The sergeant asked me when I was issued this soldier's uniform and how often I could eat meat." The young soldier answered honestly.
"Soldier clothes? Eating meat?" The Right Guard listened in confusion, what does this have to do with poison ivy? After letting this little soldier go, he caught another one to ask.
"The master of the army asked me how often I send letters to my family, and who writes for me," the tall soldier smiled nervously, "The master of the army also said that because I answered the question well, I could ask him to write it in the future." That is the king's military division ah, the word must be better than the village's Xiu Cai writing, the old mother of the family can also take it to show off with the village people.
The right guard listened to even more confused, where is this with what ah! Unwillingly caught a few more to ask, all are some irrelevant questions, and chicken skin parents, completely irrelevant.
The Left Guard stepped forward and patted the frothing Right Guard, "Eat."
"You say, what exactly is the Warlord looking into?" The Right Guard asked bitterly.
The Left Protector's face was expressionless as he turned around and walked away, "I'll eat first."
"Hey hey, wait for me!" The right guard was busy chasing after him, the two of them had their meals together, and if they went late they were going to be eaten up by that guy!
Three days of the period is coming, Zhao Meng early in the morning from the prison, waiting to see the so-called "military division" in the tent, and consciously say that the readers of the Zhao general, but also pulled the left and right army guards, a few lieutenants to come together.
The center tent was where the generals discussed tactics and issued military orders, it was about the same size as Jing Shao's king's tent, except that there were no beds in the tent. Jing Shao sat on top of the high platform, looking at the group of wolf-like hans below, and gave Zhao Meng a somewhat sympathetic look.
Mu Hanzhang sat on the chair beside Jing Shao, and in his hand he also held a black plume goose feather fan that military advisors in history books would hold. This is still yesterday's right guard specially sent him in order to know the news in advance.
"Warlord, the three day limit has come and gone, I, Old Zhao, have come to listen to Warlord's high opinion." Zhao Meng lifted the few suspects who were squatting in the cell with him over again and stood in the center of the tent and said in a rough voice.
"General is truly in a hurry." Mu Hanzhang fanned the goose feather fan in his hand twice and lightly glanced at the bearded man on the stage.
Really squatted in the military prison for three days, although the soldiers in the prison will be good food and drink for, just three days have not washed General Zhao is really a bit sloppy, and wearing white clothes look immaculate compared to Mu Hanzhang, since it is very abrupt.
Being swept over by the eyes with faint dislike, the general Zhao, who has always been unconventional, was a little uncomfortable, and wiped his face with his hand and said, "Less nagging, we have signed the military order, you quickly say who is the murderer in the end?"
Mu Hanzhang lightly hooked his lips, slowly reaching out with his fan and pointing to the several people kneeling under the stage: "Several of them, all of them, and none of them."
"What is this talk?" Zhao Meng said in disbelief.
Several small generals are also puzzled, infantry lieutenant quietly asked the right guard yesterday to find out what, get the right guard's bitter face, yesterday's military division with him around half a day, did not say anything, but also took away his "bribe" of the feather fan.
"To say that none of them are, is only because the poisonous grass was not put there by a few of them, because before the escorting officer received this batch of hay, it had already been laced with aconite grass." Mu Hanzhang lightly flapped his goose feather fan twice, watching with satisfaction as everyone on the stage instantly changed color. Against these reckless people, straight forwardness would definitely not work for them, but instead, making a show of being mysterious would make them look at them in a higher light.
"The military master is clear about this!" The horse herder was the first to let out a cry and happily kowtowed towards Mu Hanzhang, his guts were about to be broken from the moment the king's horse went berserk, and when the military master uttered such a sentence, at least his head was saved.
The few remaining people also reacted and were busy following suit.
"However," Mu Hanzhang paused, "the poisonous grass was escorted all the way, stored in the treasury, and after being taken out to feed the horses, which no one even realized that there was poisonous grass in the forage, a few of them couldn't escape the chastisement."
A few people heard this, pinched the sweat at the same time relieved, the so-called death penalty can be avoided living crimes, as long as the death penalty can be avoided, the other is not important.
"So it's the grass seller who cut the poisonous grass in by mistake?" The Right Guardian picked up the conversation.
"Long-leafed aconite grass is born in the northwestern grasslands, wouldn't it be possible to cut it in the outskirts of the capital?" Zhao Meng remembered what the Left Protector had said about the aconite grass, and clearly didn't believe Mu Hanzhang's words.
Mu Hanzhang shook his head, "It wasn't by chance, but someone deliberately did it, wanting to poison the war horse."
"Now that the army hasn't started, the poisoned war horses can still be bought again, it doesn't affect the war at all, so who's too full to do this kind of unethical thing?" Zhao Meng felt that this military advisor was obviously making things up.
"This, we have to ask the scribe who keeps the books in this camp." Mu Hanzhang took a sip of the tea on the table and
"Clerk?" Jing Shao who had been listening attentively on the side could not help but ask a question, last night he had pestered him for half a day and instead of telling him the truth about the actual facts, Jun Qing did not let him eat the people, causing him to get anxious and angry for the rest of the night.
Clerk, is responsible for registering books, writing transfer orders, in charge of correspondence and other clerical people in the military, the military everything from simple, this five thousand people in the battalion clerk a total of four people, in addition to writing letters, transfer time will think of, usually no one pays attention to these people.
Mu Hanzhang nodded and said to Jing Shao: "I checked all the accounts in the army, not to mention the previous ones, alone this expedition the grain and grass money allocated by the Ministry of the Interior, the accounts are nearly 30% less, and the accounts recorded and the actual spending is far from each other."
"What!" Jing Shao sat bolt upright.
Mu Hanzhang took out his own two days copied down part of the accounts to Jing Shao see, the accounts written all the soldiers uniforms per season three sets, in fact, only two sets, the daily meal standard, according to the accounts recorded, at least one meal every day can eat meat, in fact, seven days can only be eaten once, and most of the time only rice gruel and steamed buns.
The generals under the stage heard the words and their expressions became grave, and the Right Protector couldn't help but say, "If what Mr. Jun said is true, then what does this clerk's false accounting have to do with this poisonous herb?"
Mu Hanzhang slowly rubbed the handle of his goose feather fan, "Before the army departs, the Ministry of Revenue will send someone to check the accounts."
Other things are good to say, that can not match the 30% of the accounts is not a small amount. A large number of horses died, we must replenish in time, as long as the King of Cheng reported to the court, will be allocated a large number of silver, then make some of the means of stealing, will be able to offset the accounts of the wrong. And the poison of aconite, livestock in the, will instantly paralyzed, fever, foaming at the mouth, and horse plague is quite similar. Once judged as a horse plague, these horse corpses will be burned and buried, and no one will take a closer look.
When Mu Hanyang said all of his analysis, the entire center tent fell silent.
"The end is a poisonous plan ...... " said the left guard slowly.
"But these clerks were originally assigned manpower by the Ministry of Households as well." The right guard frowned and said, the Ministry of households this is their own hit their own face? A few small clerk certainly do not have the courage to make this kind of bold thing, above certainly have high officials to protect, just how to look at is the Ministry of households to supervise the theft.
"Among the Ministry of Revenue, they are not all of one mind." Mu Hanzhang sighed and said, this time, I don't know who is going to be sent to check the accounts, at least it's not all the way with the previous people who were greedy for the ink, and that's what forced them to come up with this plan.
Jing Shao slowly clenched his fists, the life in the army is known to be hard, when he went out to conquer the Huns he ate almost the same as now, so he simply can't realize that there is something wrong with it. He finally knew how he got the last Ministry of Revenue's participation in his deduction of military pay, not that he had deducted silver, but that the Ministry of Revenue had allocated more money to him, and then let the money disappear without his knowledge!
"Arrest all those clerks!" Zhao Meng was so angry that he blew out his beard, and within a short time, four skinny clerks were captured, kneeling on the ground with fear and trembling. For such a big crime, the four naturally refused to admit it, relying on the fact that they had official positions and the army couldn't torture them, so they kept on sophistically arguing.
Zhao Meng didn't care about this, and kicked the nearest person: "I can't eat well every day, but it turns out that it's all gone into your grandchildren's wallets!" His kick was not light, and the person who was kicked immediately fell to the ground and spit out acidic water.
Jing Shao slammed the account book into their faces and said in a cold voice: "But it's just a small secretary, you really take yourself as a court official! Even if the king kills you today, the people in the court can't find fault with the king!"
Even though this is not entirely true, King Cheng's violence is well known, and the Right Guard told them with a sneer that even in the military, everything should be dealt with according to military law.
This is even a few days of fear, now this situation is afraid of the sky can not be, was Zhao Meng kicked the man struggled to get up to take the lead in confessing, the other three people also had to follow the crime. They are only shrimp soldiers and crab generals, only know that their upper is a Ministry of households, and then above do not know.
"Deceitful!" Jing Shao stood up and was about to lead the four back to the capital.
Mu Hanzhang was busy pulling him back, giving him a look of tranquility, "This is a big matter, not something to be discussed lightly."
Jing Shao took a deep breath, "Lock up these four people first, you guys stand down and wait for this king to discuss with the military division before making a decision."
The left guard personally pressed the four towards the military prison, Zhao Meng wanted to say something but was pulled away by the right guard.
"Jun Qing, what are you trying to say?" Jing Shao drank a mouthful of tea, he would never let this matter rest today, even if he delayed the expedition, he would still have to find out all the people hiding behind it!
Mu Hanzhang looked at him in anger and sighed softly, "If you bring them into the palace today, you will only alert the snakes, and Father will hastily close the case in order to appease you for an early expedition."
The words are all true, but today's matter has touched Jing Shao's bottom line, so instead of calming him down, it made his heart burst into flames, pushing the cups on the table to the ground with a clatter, and looking at Mu Huanzhang with anger in his eyes, "What should I do then? Is it hard for me to swallow this breath?"
When Mu Hanzhang saw his appearance, he pursed his lips and fell silent without saying a word. Even though he knew that Jing Shao was not angry at himself, the look in those eyes still pierced him. On the day of the bridal chamber, those eyes also looked at him in this way ......

chapters.title: 44 - Bare Shoulders
chapters.content:
Jing Shao waited for half a day, did not see Jun Qing speak, just convergence of the eyes silent, this moment of silence actually strange let him calm down, only to react to their own just spoke too much.
"I didn't say to let you swallow this breath," Mu Hanyang said softly, his hands tightly interlocked in his lap, and his goose feather fan fell to one side without realizing it, "this matter must still ...... hmm?"
Jing Shao looked at him like this, suddenly his heart ached, walked forward, took the hands that were clenched to the point of white knuckles into his own hands, saw him raise his head in confusion, stretched out his other hand and touched his face, "I'm not mad at you." How could he forget how sensitive his Jun Qing was.
"Junqing ......," Jing Shao squatted down and tilted his head to look at him.
Mu Hanzhang looked down at Jing Shao whose eyes were full of heartache, his slightly bitter heart suddenly became sour and sweet, he couldn't help but hook up his lips and slowly came over to drop a kiss on those beautiful eyes, "You are my husband, it's right to be angry with me, just since you feel you shouldn't be on your own, then in the future, if you make a mistake, you will be punished."
"Good." Jing Shao got an unsolicited kiss, and immediately his heart blossomed, and his own princess agreed to whatever she said.
"What would be a good punishment?" Mu Hanzhang narrowed a pair of beautiful eyes, "How about just punishing you for sleeping in the study for three days?"
"How can that be?" Jing Shao immediately became unhappy, resting his head on his own princess's leg, holding that strong narrow waist and shaking it, "When people quarrel as husband and wife, they all quarrel at the head of the bed and make up at the end of the bed, do you know why?"
"Why?" Muhan Zhang curled her mouth and let him rock her in his arms.
"Because they rolled from the head of the bed to the end of the bed and performed that cloud and rain thing, if they were happy naturally they made up." Jing Shao cheekily said.
"Nonsense again!" The white handsome face reddened, Mu Hanzhang pushed him, "To be serious with you, you can't handle today's matter on your own, besides the expedition is coming up, you don't have that much energy. So it's best to leave this to King Rui." The second prince had already performed the ceremony of being crowned a few days ago, now he should be called King Rui.
"Brother?" Jing Shao stood up, narrowing his eyes in thought. This dynastic curves, he really impatient to meddle, this matter involves the Ministry of households, their own to find the father at most the people who directly do this thing, but brother in the dynasty has a wide range of contacts, let him do, it may be more than that.
"We are in the right, naturally we should take advantage of the opportunity to get some benefits." Mu Hanyang hooked his lips, picked up the goose feather fan on the ground and gave Jing Shao a fan, the weather in July is still so hot, Jing Shao because of this half of the morning tossing and turning, has sweated all over.
"You have a point, I will go to my brother's mansion in a while." Jing Shao was comforted by the fan, so he plopped back down.
"You take these account books and the ones I transcribed with you, and if there are any particular obstructionists in the courtroom tell your brother along with them," Mu Hanzhang thought for a moment, and then gave another explanation, "Remember to carry those of his staff behind his back."
"Shogun?" Jing Shao raised his head, Rui Wang's house on those few cleaners he is recognized, usually meet are also polite, and many dishonorable means to rely on them to think, really for the two brothers of them to contribute a lot of things, why should they turn their backs on them?
Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips, remembering the day he saw those people in the second prince's mansion and couldn't take back the hostility, "If brother takes on the great lineage, these few people must be removed, or else they will be detrimental to you."
Jing Shao frowned, understanding what his own princess meant. People with heavy thoughts would think the worst of everything, and those individuals were afraid that they would have already advised their brother to guard against him.
Fortunately, he did not go to his father on impulse, Jing Shao stood up and took the person on the chair into his arms, in his last life, he promised that if he survived, he would listen to him in everything, even if today's Jun Qing does not know, he has to fulfill this promise, which is also for his own good, after all, those who are hooking up with each other, even though he has re-lived his life, he is ultimately still not good at it.
Bringing four big living people was too conspicuous, Jing Shao mounted Xiao Hei and ran towards the capital alone.
Mu Hanzhang looked at that dusty back, secretly told himself, should try to trust him more. He turned around and went back to the king's tent to find out the military order he signed that day, but today's matter is not yet finished!
"Mr. Jun!" The right and left guards were discussing this time with the freshly changed General Zhao, and the right guard was plotting with a fluttering brow that he could eat meat all the time in the future, when he turned his head and saw Mu Huanzhang standing outside the tent, he was busy stopping the conversation and respectfully called out to him as mister.
Because of the heat, a few big old men were not afraid of people looking away, the tent's door curtains were wide open, and Mu Hanzhang had just walked to the door, when he was discovered by the people inside.
Zhao Meng saw Mu Huanzhang come in and stood up a bit uncomfortably, "What's the matter with the military commander coming?"
Mu Hanzhang slowly paced in and took out the paper contract from his sleeve: "Does General still remember this?"
Three people saw the military order, immediately changed his face, at that time Zhao Meng said but the loser and those people with the same crime, those people although not killed, but also because of negligence of duty each received twenty sticks, now think, the military division in the tent deliberately emphasize a few people can be exempted from the death of a living crime is difficult to escape, is calculated to this military order.
"I, Old Zhao, have always been true to my word, willing to gamble, willing to lose!" Zhao Meng said as he took off his protective bronze armor and was about to get his army stick.
The right guard was busy to solve the problem and said, "Military division, General Zhao is just a momentary mood, you do not take him into account." This march is imminent, the general received a military stick but to delay the trip, to Zhao Meng's nature will certainly be hard to carry the horse, rushed to the northwest for fear of not being able to fight at all.
Mu Hanzhang looked at the Right Protector and smiled coldly, "Dare I ask the Protector, if it is me who loses today, is this military order still a momentary whim?"
The right guard heard the words immediately speech blocked, to Zhao Meng that unforgiving nature, if the military division failed to find out the real culprits, even if there is the king's protection, he will not be able to let go, a group of military generals so bullying a weak scholar, really dishonorable.
"You don't have to say it, I, Zhao Meng, am a man of the heavens and will never deny it!" General Zhao pushed the Right Guard away and patted his chest.
"Good!" Mu Hanzhang handed the military order to Zhao Meng, "General is indeed a true hero, what is written on this military order, will the general do?"
"That's natural," Zhao Meng yanked over the piece of paper and looked down at it, "even if it takes my old Zhao's brain ......"
Speaking voice came to an abrupt end, Zhao Meng stared wide-eyed at the words on the paper, the right guard was curious, but also went over to see, above the black and white clearly written, if the military division fails to find out the truth, then the same crime with the perpetrator of the case, and if it is found out, then Zhao Meng stripped topless and ran a lap around the entire camp ......
"This ......" The right guard was stunned, this is not even a punishment for Zhao Meng, who has always been a big man, it is only a joke, but the punishment for the military division is unambiguous.
Zhao Meng was dumbfounded for a long time before he suddenly knelt down on one knee and cupped his fists, "Mr. Jun is a true gentleman, please accept a bow from me, Zhao Meng!"
"General, please don't!" Mu Hanzhang was busy stepping forward to stop his movement, "Junqing is just a military priest, he is not worthy of a bow from the general. It's just that we all work for the same king, so I just hope that we can live in harmony."
"With your talent, sir, you deserve to be a military general!" Zhao Meng said or owed a bow, got up and took off his shirt, and said that being bare-chested was nothing at all to him, and took the initiative to take off his middle shirt, leaving only a pair of shorts, and ran out with bare feet.
On this day, all the soldiers in the army saw the Lord General running around the camp untidy, no, not very tidy, so that those who burned the fire stopped adding wood, those who carried the rice dropped the bun basket, those who juggled the sword slipped the handle, and those who fought with fists forgot their movements, and all of them watched in dumbfounded amazement as the General whizzed solemnly by wearing only a pair of pants.
Jing Chen listened to Jing Shao tell him the ins and outs and pondered for a long time, "Do you know who is going to check the accounts this time?"
"Who?" Jing Shao didn't know much about the factions among the Household Ministry.
"Xiao Yuan!" Jing Chen said as he flipped through the list of personnel in the Ministry of Households and pointed to the name of the Minister of Households.
Xiao Yuan and Jing Shao are good friends, the people in the court more or less know, this time he was sent to come, naturally let some people panic.
"In that case, it's a good thing," Jing Shao remembered the Minister of Household who had impeached him in his previous life, and got up his mind, "Why don't we take the opportunity to pull the Minister of Household down."
"The Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue followed Father in his early years, want to move him for fear that it is not easy," Jing Shao frowned, "but once this matter is out, he can't get out of it, allow me to think about it."
Jing Shao nodded, Xiao Yuan was a dependable person, due to his casting, he had not been able to get promoted in his last life, not only because he himself was resting on his laurels, but it was also a fact that his top boss had stayed in his position and had not moved. Now, before anything happens, he will pull out the fangs of all those who have harmed him!
When he was about to leave, Jing Shao suddenly turned back, hesitated for a moment, and finally opened his mouth and said, "Brother, those few staff members of yours, they don't seem to be treating me well."
"They think heavily, naturally think of everyone in a bad light," Jing Chen froze, when was his own brother so perceptive, even those few deep hearted can see through? Turned to realize, perhaps is Jing Shao in the battlefield practiced out, for the malicious will be more sensitive than ordinary people, reached out and touched his head, whispered, "Do not pay attention to them, once the big thing is accomplished, these people will not stay one."
Bureaucrats and cleaners are only good at these unseemly tactics, which are really necessary before ascending the throne, but after ascending the throne, they can't use these speculative tricks to govern the world, so the bureaucrats can only be bureaucrats for the rest of their lives, and they can't be big officials, and they know so much, and no matter what, Jing Chen won't keep them.
Jing Shao nodded at his words, so that he himself would be able to give an explanation to the princess when he returned.
When Jing Shao returned to the camp, it was already time for the Jade Rabbit to rise in the east, and the surrounding mountains and forests were silent and deserted, only the torches in the barracks were brightly lit. First, he ran to the king's tent to see his own princess, but found no one in the tent in the dark.
"Where's the Warlord?" Jing Shao asked the guards watching outside the door.
"Back to Your Highness, the military master and the generals are drinking in the center tent." The guard replied honestly.
"Drink!" Jing Shao's eyes widened, having trouble imagining Jun Qing and that group of people bare-chested and hooking up, throwing down the guards and turning toward the center tent to run at a fast pace.

chapters.title: 45 - Drunkenness
chapters.content:
In the middle of the tent at the moment, the lights were bright, the sound of people was booming, and from time to time came the sound of boxing and yelling. Jing Shao felt bad when he heard it, and lifted the tent curtain.
Just see a few lieutenants sitting on one side, obviously already drunk but also in the fist, the Yue riding lieutenant pulling the infantry lieutenant to talk non-stop, the right guard hangs on the left guard and cries: "I did not just beat the two dogs a meal, his mother that shrew even gave me a slap, I was only seven years old ah, woo ... ..." was hung on the left guard face listening to him crying slowly drinking with his bowl of wine in his hand, letting his tears and snot rubbed on his own body. ... "The hung left guard listened to his crying expressionlessly, holding the bowl of wine in his hand and drinking slowly, letting his tears and snot rubbed onto his body.
Zhao Meng was telling Mu Hanzhang with great interest about the scandal that King Cheng had made in the desert. "The king was planted down from his horse, and there was a rock on that sand dune that just happened to cut through the king's pants, opening up such a big gash! The king couldn't care about his pants, and chopped off the man's head with his sword," said the bare-chested General Zhao, who couldn't help but raise his hand to hook over Mu Huanzhang's shoulder, and thought he was whispering, "Hahaha, at that time, if it was off by a millimeter, the king's life would have been over! The emperor let the king take a male wife, we also said, is not because at that time really hurt, hehehe ......"
And this scene, which happened to be seen by Jing Shao, was instantly enraged, rushing over and knocking Zhao Meng to the ground with a punch, and yanking his own princess up from the seat with one hand.
"Your Highness, you come and drink too!" Zhao Meng didn't feel any pain at all because he was drunk and lay on the ground looking at Jing Shao and laughing.
"He's just drunk, why are you so calculating?" Mu Hanyang Zhang's cheeks were a little slightly flushed, but his eyes were clear and he clearly hadn't drunk much.
"He dared to slight you, how can I spare him?" Jing Shao was furious and kicked the man on the ground two more times.
"Nonsense again!" Mu Hanzhang glared at him, hooking up a bit between men is lighthearted? After saying that, he looked around and lightly breathed a sigh of relief, turned around and walked towards the outside, "Finally, I've poured them all down, let's go back." The drinking capacity of these military men is really impressive, even if he skillfully dunked them, he drank for so long before collapsing.
Jing Shao smiled lightly at his words, these people wanted to dunk the military master but were dunked by the military master instead, he was about to go and pull his own princess but realized that he had a weak footstep and tripped over Zhao Meng on the ground and almost fell, he was too busy reaching out and putting his arms around the person in his arms, "Junqing, you've had too much to drink?"
"Only shallowly tasted a few cups," Mu Hanzhang raised his hand and rubbed the corner of his forehead, feeling a little dizzy, so he put his head on Jing Shao's shoulder and murmured softly, "This wine is a little strong ......"
With the scent of wine, along with this pampering general warm voice soft words sprayed in the ear, Jing Shao immediately felt a cat's paw scratching in the heart, itchy and very intolerable. Look around, a group of drunks when no one noticed, picked up his own princess, raised his feet and walked out. When he passed Zhao Meng, he couldn't help but kick again, before he turned out of the tent and left.
The left guard sitting in the corner and drinking silently looked at the king's back, and the hand holding the wine paused in the air.
"Little left, you say, what right does she have to beat me? That evil bitch, oo......" The right guard slid into the left guard's lap, still dryly howling.
The Left Guard quietly put down his cup, slung the Right Guard over his shoulder, and walked out of the center tent as well, leaving a group of drunks snoring loudly on the floor.
"Junqing," Jing Shao carried the person in his arms to the bed, "I'll carry you to bathe, okay?"
"I'll just wash myself." Mu Hanzhang still looked very sober and spoke and acted calmly, but Jing Shao knew that he was indeed drunk.
Reach out and undo the outer shirt's sash, take off the layer of snow-colored veil, Jing Shao looked at his expression, see him still a look of calm and collected, can't help but be a little funny, kissed on the cheeks of the pink color. The army is stored in the strong wine, full of strength, Mu Hanzhang's volume of alcohol is only general, even if it drank a few cups, this time the strength of the wine up, certainly still not very sober.
"Stop it." Mu Hanzhang pushed Jing Shao, his mind was still clear, but his body's movements were a bit uncontrollable, the movement to push reached the man's chest, it turned into sticking on then slowly sliding down.
Jing Shao was aroused by this almost seductive action that made his lower abdomen tighten, quickly stripped off the clothes of the person in his arms, and carried him to sit in the large bath tub in the tent.
Jun Qing was thin-skinned and always refused to share a bath with him, except when he did it hard and had no strength, he had never seen him so well-behaved. Taking the fragrant dew to wash his hair, Jing Shao let the person in his arms lean on his chest, tenderly rubbing the soft and smooth green silk in his hands, feeling fresh and interesting.
Large hands with thin calluses gently caressed between the hair, slowing down the sudden pain in the head, very comfortable, Mu Hanzhang squinted his eyes, a little drowsy.
After washing his hair, Jing Shao took a cloth towel and wiped his body, the cloth towel crossed that glistening chest, slowly depicting the lines of the muscles. That day, after listening to the words of the Imperial Doctor Zheng, he realized that Jun Qing's body should have been deliberately exercised, otherwise with his traumatized tendons and veins, he was afraid that he would have long become a sickly man. That was why his body had less obvious, but very beautiful muscles, and he often said that he was in good health.
The body in his arms is slender and beautiful, the skin that has not been exposed to the wind and sun is glistening and moist like jade, and the two points of cherry blossom red float out of the water from time to time along with his movements and sometimes they do not go into the water. The cloth towel in his hand had fallen into the water at some point, and when Jing Shao came back to his senses, a hand had already caressed that beautiful collarbone.
"What are you doing? Well ......" Mu Hanzhang looked up at him, but in the next moment he pressed down on the back of his neck and gagged his lips.
It wasn't a good wine when the sweetness of the spirits remained between his lips and teeth, but at the moment Jing Shao felt that this wine was even more delicious than the agar jelly in the palace, and couldn't help but want more. A pair of hands slid along that smooth line of the spine to that rounded place, kneading back and forth.
"Well ......" Even though he was a little drunk, Mu Hanzhang was still able to realize the danger and dodged the hands that kept harassing him.
Jing Shao stifled a grunt as the person in his arms fidgeted just enough to brush against the damning spot, causing it to be completely refreshed. Opening his mouth, he bit an ear that had been smoked pink by the hot water, "This is something you asked for." Raising his hand, he dabbed some scented dew on his fingertips and resumed probing downward.
"Don't, I don't have the strength." Mu Hanzhang's spirit is awake, after being tricked by him that night he decided to leave him out to dry for a few days, wouldn't it be a lost cause if he got his way at this moment! Naihe a certain □ smoked hearted guy did not listen to him at all, Mu Hanzhang still wanted to say something, but a finger suddenly squeezed into his body, making him unable to help but whimper out, "Bastard ......唔......"
The white neck tilted back, pulling a graceful arc, the delicate knot of his throat sliding up and down from his panting, Jing Shao lowered his head and bit down, and the movements in his hands did not stop.
When Jing Shao felt that it was almost time, he held the person in his arms so that he faced towards himself, and cupped those two rounded pieces in his hands to let him slowly sit down.
"Ah~" Mu Hanzhang furrowed his brows in pain and shook his head vigorously.
"You're not allowed to drink with that group of people in the future, got it?" Jing Shao said viciously, but the movements of his hands were gentle and incomparable, letting down little by little.
"Bastard ......," Mu Hanzhang lay on Jing Shao's shoulder and shone a bite on that shoulder.
"Look, how much you've learned to swear." The bite wasn't much of a force at all, instead it was more like a kiss, and Jing Shao felt a growing itch in his heart, letting him sit down completely as soon as he let go of his hand.
"This is not ...... ah ~ pain ......" Mu Hanzhang still want to argue something, by this sudden sudden change of heart to forget everything.
Jing Shao kissed the corners of his eyes that were oozing thin tears, and gently stroked the spine of the person in his arms, "Don't be afraid, I won't move, it won't hurt for a while."
Mu Hanyang breathed slowly, slowly adapting to the huge object that suddenly stabbed into his body, and when he eased through the pain, the familiar tingling sensation gradually crept up again.
"Does it still hurt?" Jing Shao heard him stop huffing and let him wrap his arms around his neck, moving slowly.
Soft murmur gradually become uncontrollable, a time the whole tent are immersed in a dense ambiguous atmosphere, the sound of water turbulence accompanied by that warm voice chanting, only shy a hook remnant of the moon hidden in the clouds. Starlight flickering, summer wind through the forest, the quiet military tent occasionally overflowed gasp, startled the birds resting on the roof of the tent.
The night, it's still long.
The next day, Mu Hanzhang rubbed the corners of his forehead, which was swollen and painful because of his hangover, and slowly sat up. The silky brocade blanket slipped off his body, revealing a little red mark, and only then did he remember what happened last night, and he couldn't help but feel a little chagrined, turning his head to look, the seat beside him was already empty, and a burst of drill slogans came from outside the tent. Jing Shao this guy!
So, in the next few days, the king, who had annoyed the military master by taking advantage of the situation, went back to the days when he could kiss and touch every night but couldn't eat anything. As the saying goes, if a person who has eaten delicacies from the sea and the mountains goes back to eating vegetarian, how can one be so sad? So, the king who can not get satisfaction every day, only hard to drill soldiers, making these days in the army wail everywhere.
The court also did not have much news for a few days, until seven days later, the emperor sent the Minister of the Ministry of households, Xiao Yuan, to check the army's account books in advance, and suddenly erupted many ministers together to impeach the Minister of the Ministry of households and a number of his subordinates fever. The emperor was furious, ordered a thorough investigation, the more investigation the more alarmed, not only is the king's private army, along with the other armies near the city were also many deductions.
"Brother Xiao, this time it was also thanks to your reputation that those people revealed themselves." Jing Shao held a cup of wine and patted Servant Xiao's spine.
Xiao Yuan stumbled when he was slapped, and said with a pretense of bravado, "It was only because of His Majesty's skillful governance that he was able to discover it in time!"
The two men toasted and proceeded to laugh.
Mu Hanzhang sat on the side, looking at the two people who were boasting to each other, he couldn't help but have some headache: "Brother Xiao, this time, those who check the accounts of the Ministry of the household should be reluctant to allow you to come is, how did you end up choosing you?" This point he has never understood, since those people dare to do this kind of thing, will certainly be able to control each checking the accounts of the people, how will allow Xiao Yuan this variable to participate in it?
"Hehehe, this, in fact, I just wanted to take this opportunity to give you two a farewell before I grabbed this errand ......" Xiao Yuan dryly laughed twice and said.

chapters.title: 46: Before the Expedition
chapters.content:
The entire court was in a mess because of this little selfishness of Servant Xiao. However, these disturbances didn't spread much to Jing Shao's military camp, because he was going to leave for the army in a few days, and the camp was busy organizing its internal affairs.
The court because the case is not finished investigating, the first confiscation of the family property of that group of officials are only small minions, can not plug the gap in the army, Hongzheng Emperor and let the treasury to allocate another silver to fill the military vacancies.
The army's account suddenly has a lot of surplus money, someone needs to take over and reorganize in a hurry, but Mu Hanzhang is only the military priest, has no power to manage these.
Zhao Meng proposed Jing Shao to promote him to the military division general, Mu Huanzhang excuses that he has just entered the military camp, can not be this position. Finally compromise, sealed a military division general. Although it is the military division of the general, can manage military affairs can not command the military division, but now there is no other strategist in the army, the power given by this position has been enough.
The Ministry of households now have no time to send a new clerk to, Mu Hanzhang will promote a few literate soldiers as a clerk. A few days ago he asked clearly, those clerks are arrogant, soldiers are mostly looking for familiar people to write, he will be mentioned in those names one by one, now all called to the tent, out of a few topics for them to write, and finally left eight literate at the same time will be able to calculate the accounts.
"Do you understand the accounts that each of you is responsible for?" Mu Hanzhang put away the accounts in his book and asked the eight people under the stage. The accounts in the army were relatively simple, he had chosen a good and relatively detailed way of keeping accounts, and after teaching them for a whole day, he thought that they must have all learned almost everything.
"Understood!" The eight replied in a neutral voice.
"The military division taught this so well, illiterate can learn." Wang Er smiled and said, when the first carry rice to see the military division, but also think that this person is a flower show, in the army is not very useful, but now, but a few days, this Mr. Jun in the army has been a high reputation, and transfer him to do the clerk, you do not have to do that carry rice and burn the fire of the hard work, he is a hundred willing.
Mu Hanyang nodded slightly, "At the end of every ten days will be handed over to me to check the account book, what do not understand are also in that day to ask me, weekdays if it is not critical or matters of importance, do not have to come to ask, you can take their own ideas."
Several people heard the words, they are all happy, so, not only to avoid a lot of trouble, this little bit of small power can also bring a lot of benefits.
"However, the ugly words in front, if you dare to embezzle the military pay or the matter is important and hide not to report, all military justice, never mercy!" Mu Hanzhang cold face, said in a deep voice.
"Yes!" Several people were busy saluting and answering yes, they couldn't afford to throw away this good job, naturally they wouldn't lose their heads for some small benefits.
When those people dispersed, Mu Hanzhang rubbed his brow with some fatigue, the expedition is imminent, the army has to deal with a lot of things, and these days there is no clerk, the accounts are confusing and very troublesome, he yesterday sorted out the accounts for a day to straighten them out.
"Is your son tired?" Yun Song came in to deliver the tea and couldn't help but be a little worried when he saw Mu Hanzhang showing his fatigue.
"There's no harm in it," Mu Hanzhang shook his head and handed a piece of paper to Yun Song, "These things, you go back to the royal residence tomorrow to fetch as much as you can."
"Yes." Yun Song put the piece of paper into his arms and retreated when he saw that Mu Hanzhang still had things to attend to.
"Yun Song," Jing Shao, who had returned from practicing, called out to his own boy, "You go to the other courtyard tomorrow and tell Ren Feng to bring all the people I want."
"Yes," Yun Song hesitated, "but Gongzi explained that I will return to the mansion tomorrow to pick up my things."
"In that case," Jing Shao mused for a moment, "then go fetch your things, and go to the other house the day after tomorrow."
"Yes," Yun Song responded, secretly saying that in the king's heart indeed the wangfei's affairs were more important than his own, so he said one more sentence, "Those newly selected clerks have already gone back, and the duke looks as if he is a bit tired."
Jing Shao sniffed, frowned, lifted the curtain and walked in, and saw that his own princess was still busy in front of the case.
"Why aren't you done yet?" Jing Shao walked over and wrapped the person into his arms.
Mu Hanzhang struggled, "Wait, I'll finish this." After saying that, he wrote a few more lines on the booklet before putting down the pen, rubbing his sore shoulders, glancing at the broad chest behind him, and couldn't help but lean on it.
Jing Shao hooked his lips, touched the person in his arms to show his tired face, and hugged him upwards so that he could lean comfortably, "The accounts are not all apportioned down, why are you still busy?"
"The soldiers in the army will send letters out every month, but these family letters will probably be used to deliver messages, even some of them are unintentional," Mu Hanzhang took a letter and showed it to him, it said that in the army camp on the outskirts of the capital, the food has gotten better in the last couple of days, and that they even ate beef, "If the enemy reads these contents, they will know the location of the army, and also find out the source of some special ingredients, which is dangerous."
Jing Shao nodded, the military letters will be more than a person to check before sending them out, but it is always inevitable that there will be omissions, things like beef will not usually be noticed.
"I wrote letters to review the charter, and listed all the ones that can't be written in, you see what else you want to add, write it all together, and turn around and have them transcribe it a few times and send it to the clerk." Mu Hanzhang just wrote the copy of the charter handed to him.
Jing Shao took the charter but did not read it, only looking down at the person in his arms.
"What's wrong?" Muhan Zhang looked at him in disbelief.
"I'm wondering what kind of blessings I accumulated in my last life that I could get you to accompany me." Jing Shao looked at him, without a hint of teasing in his eyes, he was seriously wondering what he had done in his last life that the heavens had treated him so favorably and allowed him to live again.
Mu Hanzhang looked at his serious eyes and slowly hooked his lips, "To be able to get a good man like you, I am the one who is blessed with deep fortune."
The two looked deeply at each other, and could see the other's cherishing and love from each other's eyes, and couldn't help but slowly move closer and gently kissed each other's lips.
"Warlord!" Zhao Meng violently lifted the curtain and called out in a loud voice before he even entered.
The two people who had just made contact panicked and separated, Mu Hanzhang sat up straight and looked down at the account book on the table, while Jing Shao gritted his teeth and stared at Zhao Meng.
"Your Highness is also here!" General Zhao raised his head in greeting and sat down on the chair next to him with a big grin.
"General how did you run so fast and didn't wait for me!" The right guard noisily ran in as well, followed by the left guard with calm footsteps.
"You guys came over at this hour, but what is it?" Mu Hanzhang put down the wolf brush he was pretending to hold in his hand and looked up at the three.
Zhao Meng stroked his bushy beard and winked at the Right Guard, "Speak!"
