"Ah, we discussed that the days in the army have suddenly gotten better in the past two days, so we want to purchase some new things ...... What are you yanking me for?" The Right Guard was talking in a lively manner when he was suddenly yanked by the Left Guard.
"Hey, why are you so long-winded," Zhao Meng said in dissatisfaction, "It's better for me to say that it's really inconvenient for the military division to stay in the king's tent with the king all the time, and now that there's money in the accounts, we have to hurry up to buy the military division a better camp." General Zhao felt that the military division was now in charge of his own accounts and must be too embarrassed to offer to spend money on himself, so he pulled his left and right guards to persuade him.
Jing Shao heard, immediately alarm bells ringing, now live together are a few days can not eat mouth, if then separate sleep is not worse! The mood of the original was disturbed the pleasure of the mood suddenly became more bad, cold voice: "The military division will not martial arts, if there is an assassin will not have no power to fight back? This king thinks that living in the king's tent is quite good."
"Where can there be any assassins in the barracks, moreover, even if there are assassins, they are assassinating the king, which have killed the military division, if I say live in the king's tent before ...... Aiyo, what are you pinching me for!" The right guard said half, was the left guard violently pinched the waist nest, can not help but turn his head to yell.
"Tent since is to be equipped, since ancient times there is no military division to live in the king's tent," Mu Hanyang glanced at Jing Shao obviously become iron face, can not help but smile, "but three days after the departure, now then set up tents also have to other tents to move place, it does not pay for it, and so on the way of the march and then add it. "
When Jing Shao heard this, his face only got a little better, waving his hand to drive away the three people who had nothing to do with messing around with their ideas.
"Junqing, do we really need to build another tent?" When the crowd had left, Jing Shao reluctantly hugged his own princess.
"I'm your military advisor now, not the crown princess, if you don't want to be criticized, you still need to do enough on the surface." Mu Hanzhang patted the head on his shoulder.
"Then won't we have to sleep separately!" Jing Shao protested in dissatisfaction.
"Well," Mu Hanzhang nodded, looking at Jing Shao's crying face, he couldn't help but reach out and pinch his cheeks, "However, Your Highness can go to my minister's tent at night to discuss the military situation."
"Right, why didn't I think of that!" Jing Shao sniffed and couldn't help but brighten up, pulling Mu Hanzhang up, "Come on, let's go back to the king's tent and explore for a while!"
The next day, Yun Song went back to the royal residence, will Mu Hanzhang want one by one to find all the things brought over.
There were quite a lot of things, but they were all small objects, so it didn't take much work. Curious, Jing Shao peered over and saw a jasper xiao at a glance.
"Jun Qing, you know how to play the xiao!" This thing hadn't seen him use it before, Jing Shao was a little curious as he held the blowjob and looked back and forth, the body was turquoise and warm in his hands.
"Learned when I was young, the zither is too heavy, marching in the way, but this xiao can be carried around," Mu Hanzhang explained, "if the road is short of money, you can also pawn it."
Jing Shao play jade xiao hand paused, literati not all very cherish their own qin xiao? Why is my own princess so special ......
In the blink of an eye, it was the day of the expedition, and the generals were glowing and ready to go early in the morning. They were the elite in the hands of the king, and the rest of the army would be rushing to the southwest one after another from all over the country, and would finally converge at the border of the southwestern fiefdom at a distance of three hundred miles.
Yun Song said goodbye to the Mu Han Zhang back to the King's House, originally thought that after those daily chores have to personally do, but did not expect Jing Shao actually brought him a maiden, and this maiden is not someone else, it is followed by the ghost of nine knives to learn a few months of concealed weapons Ge Ruoyi!
Author's Note: Military rank:
The "Military Counselor and Sacrificer" is a general military counselor and advisor with no military power;
The "Middle Division" and the "Middle General of the Division" are chiefs of staff and have partial military power;
The "General" is the Chief of General Staff, the leader responsible for organizing and directing the military construction of the whole army and organizing and directing the military operations of the whole army. (This was invented in the Three Kingdoms period, so I'm going to use it, gah gah gah)

chapters.title: 47 - The Village Under the Mountain
chapters.content:
Long road march, Jing Shao's this elite did not bring siege equipment and heavy armor, but after all, it is not all cavalry, but also with pots and pans and things like that, marching speed is not fast, so Mu Huanzhang's carriage did not drag its feet, one followed Jing Shao's horse slowly.
Ge Ruoyi just quietly sitting in front of the car, at any time to the car in the tea and water, lunch break, Jing Shao will drill into the military division of the carriage to take a nap. The right guard is very jealous, often grabbed the driver's position, by the way with the military division of this beautiful girl close to, but Ge Ruoyi always ask ten answer, even though the right guard for the military division of the origin of the curiosity of the heart scratching the liver, but also from the Ge Ruoyi here to set to the only words.
"The Military Counselor's maid, naturally, can keep secrets better than you." The left guard patted the drooping right guard.
"Left, are you comforting me?" The Right Guard glanced at him obliquely.
"Naturally." The Left Guard turned on his horse with an expressionless face and continued on his way.
So line more than ten days, to the Daxing mountain range, the endless mountains blocked the road ahead, have to detour more than a hundred miles, Jing Shao ordered to camp first, the next day.
"The Long Snake Formation is weak in both offense and defense, once we meet the enemy, we'll just stand and be beaten!" In the center tent, Zhao Meng pointed at the formation diagram and said.
"But marching in the mountains, you certainly can't go fast without setting up a long snake formation!" The Right Guardian pointed at the topographical map and said.
"What are they fighting about?" Jing Shao, who had had dinner, walked in with his military advisor, and saw the two men struggling with red faces and necks, so he asked the Left Protector, who was expressionlessly and silently reading a book on military affairs, on the side.
"Back to Your Highness, they're exploring what to do with the mountain path in the southwest." The left guard said.
Jing Shao realized, today encountered a large line of mountains blocking the road, because of the soldiers and horses apparatus in the body, over the mountains than the detour is more time-consuming, so the choice of a detour, but the southwest of the land everywhere hills, around the inability to go around, can only go to the mountains of the time, how to go is a big problem.
"Military division, you say, which of this mountain road marching does not set up a long snake formation?" The Right Guard tugged Mu Hanzhang to look at the southwestern topographical map on the table, most of the mountain passes were narrow and other formations were definitely not set up.
"I didn't say that we can't set up a long snake formation, but if the enemy army has an ambush on the mountain path, the long snake will take a chest wound and obviously stand to be beaten, so I said that we should open the path in advance with the vanguard!" Zhao Meng was afraid of being misunderstood and was busy explaining.
Jing Shao frowned, since the princess read the book of the sages since childhood, the art of war naturally never read, bring him to this also did not expect him to help in the battlefield, simply do not want to be separated from him only. See his convergence of eyes, was about to open the mouth to help, but saw a moist and slender hand took the side of a simple sand table on the wooden stick, in the sand drew a fork.
"Warlord, what is this?" Zhao Meng looked at the fork drawn by Mu Hanzhang, unsure.
Jing Shao's eyes widened suddenly when he saw the symbol.
"This formation is called Punching Yoke," Mu Hanzhang said slowly, pointing the wooden stick at the corners of the fork, "the soldiers stand in four corners, still marching in a long snake, with the front, left, and right as fronts, both offensive and defensive."
"Wonderful, wonderful!" The Right Guard froze for a moment, then suddenly clapped his hands and shouted.
Zhao Meng excitedly surrounded that fork and scrutinized it for half a day, "The military division is really knowledgeable, Zhao Mou admires it!"
Mu Hanzhang but smiled.
"I told you to read more, but do not listen," this yoke formation Jing Shao also know, but unusual military books are not recorded, never read military books of Jun Qing and how to know? Heart shocked, face but put on a look of course, jing shao pulled over his own military division said, "tomorrow I and the military division to go to the neighborhood to do a thing, you guys lead the troops first, after a few days we will catch up."
"What is Your Highness going to do to go?" Zhao Meng looked at Jing Shao with little approval, it was not a good thing for a general to go AWOL during a march.
"This matter is very important to the battle of southwest, you guys these days more watch over, do not make any mess." Jing Shao snorted, apparently unwilling to talk more, a few people also have the sense to shut up.
Only after leaving the center tent did Mu Hanzhang ask suspiciously, "Where are we going tomorrow?"
"To find a secret treasure." Jing Shao hooked his lips and smiled mysteriously.
Mu Hanzhang glanced at him and turned around to head towards his own tent, while the prince behind him followed very consciously.
"How did you follow in again?" Mu Hanzhang helplessly looked at the guy who relied on his bed and did not leave, since the military division tent was set up by the king's tent, this person has not slept in the king's tent, originally it was still the middle of the night sneaking in, but now it is already blatantly relying on not leaving.
"I'll go back a bit later," Jing Shao took the hand of the man in front of him and dragged him into his arms, "I really do have something serious to ask you."
Mu Hanzhang rolled his eyes, who talks about business would carry the military division into his arms to talk about it?
When Jing Shao saw his expression, he couldn't help but go over and kiss him, "Have you read military books? This yoke rushing formation is not something that would be found in the Da Chen Laws."
Mu hanzhang heard him ask this, the smile on his face gradually faded a bit, "The military book was read when I was young." Childhood reading early, his memory and good, will often do homework in addition to reading some other books. At that time, he saw that his first son was arrogant and uneducated, often causing his father to sigh, so he secretly learned some military arts, expecting his father to be able to remember him one day when he abandoned his first son. Waiting until a little older to understand, the commoner son can not bear the title, even if he is ten times stronger than Mu Lingbao twenty times, the father will never be able to treat them the same.
Jing Shao heard, only feel the heart aching, pearl in the dust, this is how a regrettable thing?
"I actually saw you when I was a child." Feeling Jing Shao's gradually tightening arms, Mu Hanzhang smiles and puts his chin on his shoulder, at that time, the Emperor went to Marquis Beiwei's residence in microdress to find his father to play chess, bringing the tiny third prince along. The first mother only allowed Mu Lingbao to play with Jing Shao alone, he wanted to see what the Emperor's son looked like, but he was not allowed to go forward, he could only secretly hide behind the rockery to watch them play in the garden.
"Yeah? I don't even remember." Jing Shao scratched his head, these things have been more than twenty years for him, how could he still remember, he couldn't help but feel regretful, very curious about what the Jun Qing of his childhood looked like? He thought that he must have been white and tender, with a pair of big eyes as clear and penetrating as pearls. "What did I do then?"
"You ......" Mu Hanzhang thought of the situation when he was young and couldn't help but laugh out softly, "You want Mu Lingbao to give you as a horse to ride, he refused, you beat up and cried. While he cried, you also inserted a moonflower on his head, saying that he is a little bitch, just know how to cry, insert a flower to get married."
"Hehehehehehe ...... " Jing Shao heard, could not help but smile smugly, did not think that Jun Qing actually remembered his childhood so clearly, "It seems that when you were a child you wanted me to be your husband, rushed to come to see each other. "
Mu Hanzhang was reddened by his words and got up to drive him back to the king's tent. Jing Shao could only go back to the king's tent to bathe first, and only after the candle flame was extinguished did he quietly feel his way into the warlord's tent again.
The next day, Jing Shao woke up the person in his arms early, and taking advantage of the dawn, he brought his own princess to ride on Xiao Hei, and ran straight towards the mountains in the distance.
Mu Hanzhang looked helplessly at the king who was acting as if he were a deserter, leaning into his arms and yawning a little, "Where are we going?"
"Yamashita Village." Jing Shao replied.
The village under the mountain is a village at the foot of the big line of mountains, said the village, in fact, has been considered a small town, because the road at the foot of the mountain is good to go, here spontaneously formed a market town. Surrounding mountain villages often people come down here to sell some mountain treasures hunting, but also here to buy some things.
Today was a double day, a market day, and the only street was bustling with activity.
"Tiger skin, top quality tiger skin! Spotted big tiger on Purple Cloud Mountain, top quality leather!" A hunter was hawking tiger skins on the street, attracting many onlookers.
"You are really good at killing tigers!" Someone complimented.
"That was, when that tiger was catching a rabbit and running toward the tiger s hole, and was shot in the eye ...... by one of my arrows," the hunter sputtered, boasting of his valor.
"A tigress carrying food back to the nest, this is a tiger cub to feed, sinful yo!" The old woman carrying the bamboo basket heard this, sighed and shook her head and left.
Mu Hanzhang heard this and couldn't help but frown, "What's wrong with a young son ......"
Jing Shao, who was excitedly looking at the tiger skin, heard the sigh of the man beside him and knew that he was moved with compassion, so he said to the hunter, "Do you still remember where that tiger's den is?"
"I remember since," the hunter rolled his eyes, "but there's no road, it's all forest, and no one can find it but me."
Jing Shao pulled out a piece of broken silver: "You get me the tiger cubs in the nest, this is the deposit, two days later here, if it comes to fruition, then I'll give you ten times the silver."
"Really!" The hunter took the piece of silver and was overjoyed, "Don't worry, sir, it's on me!"
"It's just an animal, what's the point of sympathizing with those!" The butcher from the opposite store grunted, lifted the big knife in his hand, and bongbongdangdi chopped pork on the wooden pier.
Mu Hanzhang saw Jing Shao's behavior, his heart rejoiced, and hearing the butcher's words, he did not frown tightly, turned to the butcher and said, "The young son is in the nest, and if he is not rescued, he will surely starve to death."
"Hmph, if you pity your young son," the butcher raised the pork in his hand, "you'll shed tears over this suckling pork as you eat it!"
Jing Shao sniffed and turned to look, to see that body only draped in a cummerbund, raising the hands of pork pieces of the strong man, suddenly overjoyed, quickly walked up to the front: "Dare I ask the strong man, but the surname Hao?"
This man was the very purpose of his trip, the descendant of a former general, a fierce general that Jing Shao had only stumbled upon in his last life in the 20th year of Hongzheng, Hao Dabao!
"You don't recognize such big words!" The butcher took the butcher's knife in his hand and banged on the large plaque hanging on the pork stall.
Mu Hanzhang followed the butcher's knife to see, written on the top of the bucket of four words "Hao Ji meat store"! Then look at the corner of the mouth twitching Jing Shao, can not help but stifle laughter.
"Let you chop a meat, where you dry say not work is not it!" At this time, a full-blooded girls from the house, not long, a strong woman with a meat pot came out, thrown to Hao Dazhe, "Quickly cut, cut these are chopped into bashful, Father Li waiting to use it!"
"Hey." The butcher, who had been incredibly grumpy just a moment ago, just responded with a low voice and honestly lowered his head to chop the pork.

chapters.title: 48 - Tiger Cubs
chapters.content:
Mu Hanzhang waited in the only restaurant in town for nearly two hours before Jing Shao came over to him, rather downcast.
"What, not convinced?" Mu Hanzhang pushed the rice bowl to him and explained that Xiao Er would add two more hot dishes.
Just Jing Shao saw Hao Dazhou, overjoyed, would like to persuade him to go with himself, I did not expect that the man said that they want to chop bashfulness, let him wait a while and then say. Midsummer weather is hot, it is about to arrive at noon, Jing Shao is afraid of their own Wangfei hot, then let him go to the restaurant and so on him, where he waited for nearly two hours to be able to talk with Hao Dazhou into the house. I thought I knew him very well, he is a descendant of a famous general, martial arts, military law extraordinary, nested in this small mountain village to kill pigs is naturally depressed, who knows that they show their intention to recruit, that person is still your deputy "how do you so much trouble" expression.
"I'm having a good time killing pigs and selling meat, why should I go to the battlefield and fight to the death? No way!" Hao Dazhe said this and blew him out of the pork store.
"If you want to get a good general, you naturally have to be patient and seek it," Mu Hanzhang poured him a cup of water, "It will still take a few days for the army to go around the Daxing Mountain, so we can stop here for a few more days, so don't be in a hurry."
Jing Shao tilted his head and gulped down the water in the cup, "This water tastes really cool!"
Mu Hanzhang had poured him a cup, telling him that this water was well water that had not been burned, directly from the well in the backyard of the tavern, ice cold with some sweetness, very good: "I have booked a room in this store."
"Huh?" Jing Shao swallowed a mouthful of rice and looked up at him, "Junqing, are you calculating that I can't persuade him?"
"Marrying a wife still need three books and six appointments, this Na Xian and marrying a wife is a reason, must be sincere and means are available," Mu Hanzhang slowly drank a mouthful of water, "but there is a difficulty."
"What difficulties?" Jing Shao frowned in thought.
In his previous life, he was transferred here in the 19th year of Hongzheng's reign because of a muddleheaded and money-grubbing magistrate who was not strict enough in ruling the people. The magistrate bullied Hao Dazhou's neighbor's little daughter, he was not angry, took a pig knife and chopped the magistrate to death, the magistrate to take him down, the villagers petitioned for him, the magistrate confused with the whip to drive away the villagers, a moment of chaos, the magistrate even killed two innocent people, suddenly provoked the people to change.
Jing Shao then attacked the king of Huainan was thwarted, with troops on the way back to the capital just met the civil unrest, with troops to quell the chaos after the people in front of the beheading of the county magistrate to be able to civilian indignation. At that time, Hao Dazhou trained a group of villagers who do not know how to fight with the soldiers, so that he had the heart of the talent, and then asked for a decree to recruit, Hao Dazhou into the command.
It's just that, these days, that magistrate probably hasn't taken the imperial exams yet.
Mu Hanzhang said indifferently, "The bedding in this inn is all very old, so I'm afraid there will be fleas."
"Huh?" Jing Shao froze, and only then did he realize that the difficulty his own princess was talking about was this.
Mu Hanzhang looked at his dumbfounded appearance and couldn't help but hook his lips, "After we eat, let's go pull some fabric and spread it on the bed for the night."
"Why don't you let Xiao Er change the bed for a new one?" Jing Shao frowned, this kind of broken inn in a small mountain village will definitely have fleas, in case the glistening jade-like skin of his own princess bites out the pimples, what can be done?
"It's dangerous to show your wealth in a place like this, and it would be inappropriate for you to give that hunter broken silver today." Mu Hanzhang persuaded, raising his hand to give him some dishes.
"This town is out of mountain treasures and wild deer, often merchants come to collect them, we are not considered the richest in this way." Jing Shao picked up the bowl, huffed and puffed and ate all the dishes in the bowl, and then extended the bowl to his own princess.
Mu Hanzhang glared at him and resumed giving him chopsticks, "Xiao Er said that to get a new bed would require a hang of money, but to go to the cloth shop across the street to pull a new sheet would only cost thirty wen."
"Cough cough cough ......" Jing Shao sniffed and immediately choked on his rice. After saying half a day, Jun Qing is too expensive!
The two went to the cloth shop to pull two sheets back, the market has not much stalls. Most of the people who come here to catch the market are the mountain people in the nearby mountains, and they have to rush back early to reach home before dark, so by dusk, the streets are already very cold, and even the stalls that sell bashful noodles have disappeared. Two people can not, only to go back to the inn to eat the price is quite high meal.
The room of the inn is really very dirty, Jing Shao looked at the bed in front of him, felt that even if he put the new sheet in his hand to lay on it, his own princess would not be willing to sleep on it, and simply held him and rolled over to the roof of the inn, spread the sheet on the layers of rubble, and he himself paid a high price to the second to buy a new bed quilt.
"The mountains are cold at night, no new quilt will be frozen," Jing Shao used the quilt to wrap his own princess, "this inn is this way of doing business, near and far only one, there is no way." And not lack of money, why is my Wangfei more and more stingy?
Mu Hanzhang was wrapped in a warm quilt, resting on Jing Shao's arm, looking up at the night sky over the mountains, "When this battle is over, I want to do some other business."
"Good, in a couple years I'll take you to live in Jiangnan, business is good there." Jing Shao smiled and wrapped the person into his arms, "How come you are suddenly so attached to money?"
"Listen to Xiao Yuan said, these years among the Ministry of households is a very serious problem, the treasury is afraid that has long been empty, if you want to get that position, silver is also indispensable." Mu Hanzhang sighed, yesterday Rui Wang sent a letter, said that the barracks of corruption and ink matter has become more and more big, he vaguely realized that this also involves Yongchang Bo and the fourth prince. If all these years of silver were obtained by the fourth prince, it would be troublesome.
"Worry about these later," Jing Shao touched the top of the head of the person in his arms, "Quickly help me think about how to persuade Hao Da Dao."
Hao Dazhu's ancestor was a mighty general in the former dynasty, using the army like a god, Taizu is also very admired. After the demise of the former dynasty, Hao family ancestors do not obey the court, in the Daxing mountain range to occupy the mountain as the king, only to Hao Dagger generation, the cottage has been declined, and now only fell into a pig killing business.
Mu Hanyang Zhang converged his eyes and pondered for a moment, "Listening to you say so, his ancestor was against the court, and now he wants him to switch to the Chen Dynasty ungeneral, I'm afraid it's not easy, tomorrow I will also go with you to take a look, and then think of a way to do it."
The two of them slept on the roof for the night, the cool breeze of the summer night in the mountains, covered with a quilt is very comfortable.
The next day, the two had just arrived in front of the pork store when they were stopped by a man, Jing Shao was startled and immediately protected himself in front of Mu Hanzhang.
"Sir, you said yesterday that you would give ten times the money if you fetched the tiger cubs, you are not framing me, are you?" It was the same hunter from yesterday, who handed over a bamboo basket when he finished speaking.
Jing Shao lifted the bamboo basket, only to see a black thing inside scratching back and forth, "This is a tiger cub?"
"Then there is still a fake?" The hunter pinched out the contents, "I went up the mountain before dawn, and all the other tiger cubs were taken by who knows what, and only this one survived by falling into a mud pit."
Jing Shao looked at the black mass really don't want, but Mu Hanzhang already in the neighboring stall bought cloth towel to the small things wrapped in, only to pay the silver sent that person to leave.
Using a cloth towel to wipe the mud that hadn't dried, revealing the little tiger cub's little face that was covered in mud, although it was still dirty, it could be seen that it was a tiger. Its body was about a foot long, its eyes half-open, and it gave a listless cry, "Woowoo~"
"Yo! Tiger cub!" Hao Da Dao that fat lady is end meat pier out, heard the tiger cub's call, then excitedly come over to see.
Mu Hanzhang glanced at her, "Is there warm water in sister-in-law's house, this tiger cub must be washed first."
"Yes yes, just boiled a pot of water for scalding pig hair, you come with me." The fat lady seemed to be very happy and greeted Mu Hanzhang to follow him into the house.
Mu Hanzhang gave a wink to Jing Shao, holding the tiger cub himself and going inside with the fat lady, meeting Hao Dazhe who was killing a pig in the courtyard, "You go watch the stall first, I'll give this tiger cub a bath before I go."
When Hao Da Dao saw Mu Han Zhang, he frowned slightly and put down the pig-killing knife in his hand and walked out.
Although the fat lady was ferocious, her work was unambiguous, and she very nimbly ran a basin of warm water and put the little tiger cub into the water, "Come on, it's time for a bath!"
"Woohoo!" The little tiger cub was startled, just to struggle, suddenly smelled the pig's blood on her arm, pumped the little nose, squinting was only half-open eyes to find the blood-stained place, opened his mouth and licked, and the more licked the more energetic, but also open the mouth without full teeth, to the thick arm gnawed, but the tiger's small mouth is even smaller, how to gnaw how to gnaw can't be half a circle of the arm into the mouth, and simply completely forgotten that he had been soaked in the water. Into the water this matter.
Mu Hanzhang looked at her skillful movements and asked, "Does sister-in-law love raising cats and dogs and such?"
"Haha, I love this kind of small things since I was a child." The fat lady laughed, the gentleman in front of her was gentle and kind, and his voice was gentle and elegant, so that she could not be ferocious, and while washing, she chatted with Mu Hanyang, and talked about her childhood when she followed her father to walk the streets to sell his art, and competed in the martial arts.
"I think it must be that Brother Hao won the ring to marry a beauty, right?" Mu Hanzhang smiled and looked at Hao Dazhou who had taken the opportunity to make his third trip into the courtyard with the pork.
"Che, him?" The fat lady glared at her husband who was not far away, "He lied to my father that he is the king of the mountain in this Daxing Mountain, and lied to my father that if I follow him, I will be able to eat fragrant food and drink spicy food." Saying this, she took a cloth towel and held the washed tiger cub and wiped it, the cub struggled discontentedly and wowed and wowed and wowed and wowed.
"I heard from the people in the village that the Hao family's ancestors were actually mountain kings." Mu Hanzhang took the washed tiger cub and looked down at it, its yellow and black fluffy fur was wet, perhaps because it had followed the tigress before and eaten well, despite being hungry for a day, it was still round and looked at him with a pair of round amber-colored tiger eyes, "Woohoo!"

chapters.title: 49 - Returning to camp
chapters.content:
"Che, what king of the mountain," the fat lady got up and pinched some pieces of minced meat on the wooden pier where she chopped the meat to give to the little tiger cubs, "their family is not working since his grandfather's generation."
"Big Brother Hao is full of martial arts, but he uses it to kill pigs, don't you think it's condescending?" Mu Hanzhang sat down on a wooden bench in the courtyard, took the meat and put it in his hand for the little tiger to eat.
The fat lady glanced at him and grumbled in anger, "That deadbeat listens to me on everything, but this one refuses to listen, I said I'd let him take the martial arts exam, but he just doesn't want to go, he just knows how to kill a pig, he's really no good!"
Mu Hanzhang heard gently hooked lips, this lady looks rude, but actually very fine heart, she has long known that they are here to persuade Hao Da Dao, let him come in to wash the tiger, in fact, is to persuade them to stop insisting on: "Sister-in-law really is a sensible person, just now the world has changed, Hao family ancestor even if the former general, but the great-grandfather has always been praised for it, but also did not Hao family designated as a rebel. And Hao big brother he was born in the Great Chen Dynasty, naturally is a citizen of the Chen Dynasty, so he can rely on his own skills to build a career."
The fat lady sniffed and looked down at the tiger cub eating, but did not answer.
The little tiger shook off its soaked fur, grubbing at the meat pieces to eat sweetly, but the teeth did not grow, biting and biting the empty place, only to change the direction and bite again.
Mu Hanzhang saw it eating happily so he didn't disturb it, he just spread out the cloth towel and let the sunlight onto the small body so that the fur could dry: "Sister-in-law is so diligent and thrifty, she is only a rich butcher after a lifetime of mixing. I don't know if sister-in-law has ever thought that if she has heirs in the future, will she still let them be butchers?"
The fat lady sniffed, couldn't help but start to get angry again: "This is something I scold him every day, even if he goes to be a constable, his children won't have an expectation in the future. This is good, give birth to a son also as a butcher, give birth to a daughter no one dares to marry!"
"Sister-in-law must also know our intentions, the king is a man who cherishes talent, and nowadays if a military general who is not from a worldly family wants to achieve something, following the king is the best." Mu Hanzhang took the well-fed tiger cub in her arms and rubbed his fur.
"Hoo ......" little tiger lying in Mu Han Zhang's arms, originally still some resistance, but when the soft slender hand stroked its fur over and over again, will gradually quiet down, not long after the fear of a day and night of the little tiger cub fell asleep.
Mu Hanzhang see the time is almost, some words say more than bad, then holding the arms of the fur ball rise, "This matter is not forced, really pity Hao big brother's talent, which deliberately came to a trip. Just marching on the way, can not be delayed, we will leave tomorrow, Hao big brother if you really do not want to, then also let it go." Finished, will be a piece of broken silver to the rattan chair, is to help clean the little tiger and those broken meat money, do not wait for the fat lady to say anything else, turn around and walk out.
When Jing Shao and the two of them left, the fat lady grabbed Hao Dabao by the ears and dragged him into the house.
"Ma'am, you say these are really reasonable, but this King Cheng is violent and temperamental, go to be his subordinate, at that time, once the battle for the Crown Prince is brought to the stage, there will only be one way to die." Hao Da Dao bitterly sat on the chair, today Jun Gongzi those words he also heard, born as a great Chen people, should serve the court that gave birth to their own, and the former dynasty is too far away from him, perhaps their own persistence all along is not necessarily the right. Heroes are useless, he himself these years is not not feel the bitterness, but the king is really not a good master.
"That's not the way to put it, I see that he treats that warlord very well and even buys him tigers. A lord who treats his subordinates like daughters-in-law, I think it's much better than those hypocritical literati!" This king came to the village under the mountain just for him, which shows his sincerity, besides, they will be leaving tomorrow, after this village there will be no more store, the fat lady is a bit anxious.
"Woohoo~" laying on the roof, the little tiger excitedly scratched at the sheets underneath him, Jing Shao pinched the restless furry mass up, "If you make any more trouble, I'll throw you down!"
The tiger struggled, twisted his head to bite, but the neck is too short, can not reach, only limbs swinging.
"Huh, it's a little kid!" Jing Shao stretched out a finger and poked the small tiger whip hidden in the white fluff on his abdomen.
"Yes?" Mu Hanzhang, who was resting on Jing Shao's arm, looked up to see and, unable to see clearly, reached down and put the little tiger in the gap between them.
"Ow~" the tiger cub, upset at being placed on his back, grabbed the covers and rolled over, flushing his butt at the two men who were pawing at him.
"Where do we send it?" Holding the long tail that wiggled around, Mu Hanzhang pursed his lips with some reluctance, it was really uncharacteristic to bring a tiger cub that was of little use on a march, but there was some real reluctance to let it go.
Seeing his own princess's reluctance, Jing Shao, who had intended to buy it for him to play with, hooked his lips, "Kiss me and I'll let you keep it."
"Really?" Muhan Zhang turned his head to look at him.
Jing Shao nodded seriously, closed his eyes and pointed to his lips. Waiting for half a day, also did not see the people around him action, was about to open his eyes, slowly feel a hot breath is getting closer and closer, and then, a slightly cool, soft, fluffy thing touched the corner of his mouth. Suddenly opened his eyes, and met a pair of innocent amber eyes "Woohoo?". .
When he looked up, Mu Hanzhang, who was holding the little tiger, fell on top of him with a smile.
The next day, when Jing Shao went there again, the fat lady was chopping meat at the pork stall, with an extra horse beside her.
"You are here!" The fat lady saw the two, very happy, she has been afraid that they lost patience today straight away, wiped her hands on her apron, "I'll go call him!" After saying that, turned around and went into the house, then heard a burst of noise inside, after a long time, carrying the family heirloom hybrid knife Hao Dazhou was dragged out by his own lady.
Jing Shao busy walked forward and took hold of the rather reluctant Hao Dazhe: "Hao big brother is willing to come out to help me, the little king is really lucky to have three lifetimes!" The tone is sincere, but also does not lose the bravado of the martial arts general, let a person have a good feeling.
"The king praised, Hao mou is only painted with a body of brute force, really thanks to the king look up to." Hao Da Dao is a little uncomfortable, secretly this Cheng Wang is young, speak and do things but very calm and skillful, remembered that day in the butcher store with him alone to talk about the content, it is not possible to say that he really is a bright master. And follow him to mix for a period of time before saying it.
"I'll look for you in the army when I dish out this pork store," the fat lady waved the pig-killing knives in her hand at the three men mounted on their horses, "These two pig-killing knives of my old lady are also capable of fighting!"
To catch up with the detouring team as soon as possible on the return trip, Hao Dazhou took them on a mountain road through the Daxing Mountains to intercept the head of the team.
Jing Shao got Hao big knife this fierce general, the mood is very good, three feudal kings, the king of Huainan is the most difficult to deal with, the person strategy and mind are not lost him, even in some of the plotting means more than him, even if the Huainan army is not as large as the number of court army, but still repeatedly let him return in defeat. If there was not Hao Da Dao help, Huainan fiefdom is afraid of not a decade or eight years to fight down. Now in advance to get him, I think the time to hit the southwest and southeast of the two places, will be greatly shortened.
Hao Dabao glanced strangely at Mu Huanzhang, who was sitting in front of the king on the same horse as him in the same city, "Why doesn't the military master ride his own horse?"
"He's not good at horsemanship, and he usually rides in a carriage during his marches." Jing Shao explained.
Mu Hanzhang shouldered him with his elbow, he was very good at horsemanship, but Jing Shao never allowed him to ride by himself, always thinking he would fall off.
Hao Da Dao not quite agree with a glance at them, since the king has married his wife, but with the military division of this ambiguous behavior, really not good. So the eye for clean first in front of the road.
"This little tiger hasn't been named yet, what's a good name?" Seeing Hao Dazhou walking ahead, Mu Hanzhang relaxed his body and leaned against the chest of the person behind him, touching the little tiger cub that was pressed in his arms but kept leaping around trying to catch Little Black's mane.
"Called Little Yellow." Jing Shao freed a hand and flicked the fluffy round head.
"Woohoo!" The little tiger threw his head, dissatisfied and hugged Jing Shao's hand to gnaw vigorously, but the teeth did not grow, always stuck his finger between the two teeth, so anxious that the little guy whimpered.
"That name sounds like it's for a cat." Mu Hanzhang frowned.
"The livestock of the royal family are all small characters!" Jing Shao pointed with his chin at Xiao Hei, who was walking sullenly.
"Little ......," Mu Hanzhang swallowed the small spoon that reached his mouth, "little yellow, also."
With the trail to take a shortcut, in less than a day, the three of them crossed the Daxing Mountain, and after a short rest in the town beside the official road, they went straight after the army.
Back to the barracks, Mu Hanzhang was a little worried that Zhao Meng would reject Hao Dazhe, but Zhao Meng saw his Mixed Sword, and pulled to have a test. Jing Shao gave him a reassuring look, the so-called people with the type of gathering, these big and thick men in fact the most easy to get along with, just a game or a pot of wine, will soon be able to call brothers and sisters.
The two were soon gesticulating in the open space in front of the tent, drawing many people to stop and watch.
The Right Guard, who was watching from the sidelines, saw the little yellow furry head in the arms of the Warlord and came over with gusto: "Warlord, what's this?"
"Wha-woo?" The little tiger that was sleeping and whirring was woken up, opening a pair of big hazel eyes to look at him, his round furry ears flopped over in sleep, rather comical.
"Yo! Tiger cub!" The Right Guardian cried out in surprise, as he carried the tiger cub over and held it up in front of him for a closer look.
"Ow ~" the little tiger recognizes life, struggling, but the tiger is small no strength, can not struggle, then raised a small hairy paw, according to the right guard handsome face is a claw.
"Aigoo!" The Right Guard was caught off guard and wailed in pain, subconsciously his hand let go and the little tiger cub fell towards the ground.
When it was too late, Mu Hanzhang was about to pick it up, when a shadow crossed, and the yellow fur ball had landed safely in Ge Ruoyi's arms.

chapters.title: 50: Tiger's Teeth and Crane's Beak
chapters.content:
"Good hands!" Being scratched with three blood marks of the right guard could not care about his face, seeing Ge Ruoyi's pace could not help but praise, no wonder the military division to go to war and also bring a maiden, but it turns out that this maiden is an expert ah!
Mu Hanzhang was slightly surprised, Ge Ruoyi had only been learning concealed weapons from the Ghost Nine Blades for a few months, how did she have such a stance?
"This is my family's footwork called 'Barefoot Treading Waves', it's just a small means, I've made the Right Guardian laugh." Ge Ruoyi calmed the little tiger in her arms and smiled.
"Aiya, this is a good thing, when you have time, teach me too!" The Right Guardian smiled and came over, poking the little tiger head in her arms with his hand, "Little thing, quite a strong nature!"
"Ruoyi has said that it is a family heirloom, if Right Guard wants to learn, he has to become a Ge family member first." Seeing Ge Ruoyi's face in difficulty, Mu Hanzhang went up to carry the tiger cub back and flirted.
"OK! This I am willing to ...... ouch!" The right guardian hemmed and hawed, and wanted to say something, his head was suddenly whooped and slapped, and indignantly turned around, right into the left guardian's expressionless face, "Why are you hitting me again?"
"You're bleeding from your face." The Left Guard said.
"Is it?" The Right Guard touched it, and sure enough the scratches were already oozing blood, and it kinda hurt, "It's okay, this little cut will heal in a little while."
"Take the medicine." The left guard pulled him about to go back to the medicine.
"What's there to medicate, having a scar on my face is a symbol of manhood, not to mention that the Emperor can even give me a military credit for this injury!" The Right Guard struggled, medicating this small injury would surely be laughed at by Zhao Meng's grandson.
"Then how are you going to report this credit to the Emperor that the Southwest King scratched it?" The left guard impatiently grabbed him by the collar and dragged the noisy man into the tent.
The surroundings were finally quiet, and Mu Hanzhang smiled and rubbed the little tiger's head, thinking that he had to cut the claws of this little thing before he could do so.
Ignore the noise of those people outside, tired all the way back to the military tent Mu Hanzhang flopped onto the wide soft bed, sleeping two days on the roof, but also really miss this clean and soft bed. Little tiger in the bed round, began to that rise and fall of the soft quilt pouncing around, playing not happy.
When Ge Ruoyi came in with the meal, Mu Huanzhang was already fast asleep, the little tiger grasping a strand of his green silk and gnawing on it, smiling softly as she placed the plate on the small table in the tent, "Gongzi eat something before you sleep."
The aroma of the meal made Mu Hanzhang, who had eaten dry food for a day, instantly hungry, pulled his hair out of the tiger's mouth, took a cloth towel and wiped the saliva stained on it, got up and sat down in front of the small table, looking at the colorful and fragrant meal in front of him, he couldn't help but be a little surprised, "Did you make this?" Although the food in the army had improved, it would never reach this level.
"Your Excellency is tired, when eat something good." Ge Ruoyi smiled, the king had just specifically explained that she would personally fry two dishes for the princess to eat.
"You have the heart, but it's better to do this kind of thing sparingly, I'm the military division should also eat with the generals." Although he said so, Mu Hanzhang still picked up the chopsticks, "You go get some minced meat to feed the tiger cubs." Xiao Huang this name, he still can't call out, always feel that call a tiger Xiao Huang some stupid.
Ge Ruoyi looked at the tiger cub biting the pillow on the bed and gave Mu Hanzhang a bowl of soup, "The slave girl will go get it again in a while, this tiger cub will need to be fed personally if the prince wants to raise it for a long time." This kind of beast's cub, feed it since young, it will take the person who give it food as mother, when it grows up, it won't hurt the master.
Mu Hanzhang nodded slightly at his words, "How would Ruoyi know about this?"
"The slave girl's family used to be in the sea business, and my father had obtained a lion cub ......" Ge Ruoyi said, the smile on her face gradually converged, that male lion was almost shot into a sieve by the archers of the Southeast King in order to protect her, and it was by hiding under the lion's body that she was able to escape.
From the lapel pulled out a small purse to mu hanzhang see, it contains a handful of golden lion hair, hair hard and bright, you can imagine that this was once grown in a how powerful lion body. Mu Hanzhang tied the purse back to Ge Ruoyi, sighed softly: "Ruoyi, now the war has begun, lips are dying and teeth are cold, the Southeast King will not be for the Southwest to withdraw the feudalism sit back and do nothing, the attack on the Southeast is sooner or later ......."
"Gongzi do not have to persuade, Ruoyi intention has been decided," will purse tightly clutched in the hands, Ge Ruoyi smile but already tears in the eyelashes, "slave girl alive is to revenge, rely on the army to destroy the southeast, it is difficult to eliminate my heart hate!"
Mu Hanzhang looked at her and couldn't help but sigh.
After another half a month, the first batch of troops to join the army and the King of Cheng joint, traveling to the border of Shu, suddenly met with torrential rainfall, Jing Shao ordered to set up camp. On the way to the rain, and the lack of medicinal herbs, the army is very easy to get sick, marching in the rain and not go fast, it is not worth the loss, such as waiting for the rain to stop and then go.
"Junqing, don't come out yet, I'll call you when the camp is set up." Jing Shao lifted the curtain of the carriage to the man in the carriage.
"You come up too." Mu Hanzhang put down the tiger cub in his arms and took a cloth towel to wipe the rainwater from Jing Shao's face.
Jing Shao smiled, took his rain-stained finger and poked the little tiger: "I'm fine, have to go watch them." After saying that, he jumped off the carriage and went to command the people to set up camp, the Xiang army that came to converge had a general leading them, and would never listen to Zhao Meng's orders for them, so he could only be the one to step in.
"Your Excellency, Ruoyi is going to go ahead." Ge Ruoyi, who was sitting in front of the car, looked at the sky and said to Mu Hanzhang.
"Now?" Mu Hanzhang was a bit stunned, this heavy rainstorm day, the strong men in the military camp had to stay for a few days, but a weak woman had to rush now, it was really inappropriate.
Ge Ruoyi smiled, "This kind of rain is four or five days at a time and shall not stop, yesterday the king received the news that the southwest king is selecting beauties to be given to the southeast king, go late for fear that you won't be able to catch up."
Mu Hanzhang frowned, looking at the woman who said such words in a cloudy manner, inexplicably felt heartache: "This you take, once you have avenged, must not do anything stupid, wait for us in the southeast."
Ge Ruoyi took the silver ticket handed to her by Mu Huanzhang, and after a long silence, she knelt on the footrest and gave him three kowtows, "If by any chance she survives this time, Your Highness and Your Highness's kindness, Ruoyi will use the rest of her life to properly repay them!"
Jing Shao commanded the people to set up the tent, his entire body was already thoroughly wet, Ge Ruoyi was wearing a straw raincoat and leading a horse to him.
"You go, you will be met outside of Shengjing Pass." Jing Shao handed her a token, "Have you resigned with the princess?"
"Fang has already said it." Ge Ruoyi replied, the sound of clattering rain hid the choking in her words, kneeling in the rain, she kowtowed three times to Jing Shao in a regular manner, turned over on her horse, and raised the whip to go. The horse's hooves stepped on the muddy water, stirring up splashes, that was covered by the straw raincoat's slender figure, quickly disappeared in the rain curtain.
The people who have nothing are the most terrible, so the ancients said that everything should be left room for error, the heavenly moral order, retribution, catching all the people, sooner or later one day will be all the evil consequences. Just like his own rebirth, perhaps there is a heavenly will in the underworld. Jing Shao froze for a moment, toward the carriage driven by the driver to the front of the tent.
Because of the torrential rain blocking the road, Jing Shao in the tenderness of the military tent laziness for a few days, just for the little yellow, is more and more look at the eyes.
"Junqing ......" Jing Shao pounced his own princess on the bed, "There's nothing to do around here, let's do something fun ...... "Said he began to undo the sash of the person underneath him.
"No, it's broad daylight, um......" Mu Hanzhang struggled and tried to push away the person on top of her.
"Woohoo~" the little tiger cub saw Jing Shao picking at his master's sash and followed suit, scratching and nibbling at the snow-white sash.
"Get lost, this is mine!" Jing Shao immediately unhappy, pinching the tiger thrown to the side, but the tiger is energetic, was thrown also thought it was playing with him, and jumped and scurried back, holding Jing Shao's hand nibbling, belly to the sky, the two back paws also kept stomping and scratching.
"Hahaha ......" Mu Hanzhang looked at this scene and couldn't help but laugh out loud, Jing Shao looked at his own princess with an iron face, laughing out loud at a time like this, what atmosphere is gone ......
Finally waited for the clouds and rain, the army once again forward, soon with the Shu army convergence, to the southwest border of the place is already in September, Qian army has been waiting there, since then, 100,000 troops have been assembled.
They should have camped fifty miles away from Shengjing Pass, but Jing Shao ordered them to camp a hundred miles west of Shengjing Pass.
"Your Majesty, in order to enter the southwest, we must take the Shengjing Pass." Zhao Meng said to the map, not quite agreeing with Jing Shao's wanting to set up camp a hundred miles away, the only way to move siege equipment is to get closer.
Old black on the north-south vertical more than two hundred miles, only Shengjingguan a low-lying mountains, if you want to march to the southwest, this is the road must be passed.
"Shengjing Pass must have heavy troops outside, if we attack here, we will certainly suffer heavy casualties." Jing Shao sat on the platform and said in a deep voice, anyone feels that attacking the southwest from Shengjing Pass into the most appropriate, the last life he also thought so, but did not realize that Shengjing Pass is good to break, behind the pass stretches for dozens of miles on the narrow mountain road everywhere ambush, and the pass is relevant. From this entry, even if you can get in, it will be time consuming and exhausting, and let the Southwest King have the advantage, and even delayed until the Southeast King to come to the aid of the time.
"How is that going to happen, in this hundreds of miles around, besides this Shengjing Pass, there is only the Tiger's Tooth Pass, don't you want us to enter from there?" Hao Da Dao couldn't help but voice out, he read the art of war since he was a child, for these passes are very clear. Here the tiger's tooth on Jingzhou that tiger's tooth pass is different, this time named the tiger's tooth crane mouth, terrain strange and steep, jagged rocks, like a crane's mouth, on the cliffs like a tiger's tooth jagged, only a mountain pass, the real Yifu Dangguan Wanfu can not be opened!
"Woohoo~" These days only Jing Shao called the little tiger cub by its name, everyone else called it Little Tiger, so when Little Yellow heard someone mention Tiger's Teeth, he thought it was calling himself and followed with a chorus.

chapters.title: 51: The Golden Pocket
chapters.content:
"The old black mountain stretches for two hundred miles, after the victory pass is dozens of miles of narrow road, which if there are many ambushes, the army will be like catching turtles in a jar, no one sped to the aid of the end is not good." Mu Hanzhang saw Jing Shao insisted, timely help him say something.
"The military division has a point, but the Tiger's Tooth Pass is even more treacherous than the Shengjing Pass, and the King of the Southwest only needs to set up a formation of less than a hundred people there to stop my thousands of troops." Zhao Meng furrowed his brows and pointed at the location of the Tiger's Tooth and Crane's Beak.
Jing Shao knew the method of breaking the Tiger's Tooth Pass, but that method was too tricky and too specific, for this life has not yet come to the southwest of him, to say this kind of words is very difficult to convince people, can not help but knit his brows: "This matter will be discussed tomorrow!"
The crowd dispersed, Jing Shao sat behind the high platform, still frowning at the southwest map. Living a new life, obviously know the direction of things, but can not say it, when it is suffocating. Sighed lightly, really can't, tomorrow let them take troops to Shengjing Pass, their own rate of a team of light cavalry to attack that tiger's tooth is.
"Did you get some news that you can't talk about?" Mu Hanzhang looked at him like that, pursed her lips, and sat down next to him.
Jing Shao looked up at his own princess, whose eyes were full of worry, and reached out to take him into his arms, "Junqing, how could you guess so accurately?"
"The military masters all know the art of reading minds, don't you know?" Mu hanzhang smiled and flirted back, slowly lowered his eyes, because he liked him, he would always pay attention to his emotions, he could see that Jing Shao seemed to know a lot of things, but he didn't know where he got the information from. If he doesn't mention himself, he can't ask, when he wants to talk about it that day, he will naturally say it, right?
"Jun Qing, there are some things that I can't say for myself, not deliberately trying to hide them from you." Jing Shao sighed and placed his chin on the shoulder of the person in his arms.
"Well," Mu Hanzhang answered softly, slowly sitting up straight and looking at him, "now for your news, see if I can help you."
Jing Shao pulled the map on the table to, will he know of the Southwest Army ambush place and tiger's teeth pass to crack the method one by one exhaustive said. Mu Hanyang Zhang more listen, eyebrows knit deeper, so fine layout structure, Jing Shao settled in the southwest of that scout is really powerful, but also because too specific, but let a person feel not trustworthy.
"These small details they will not believe, and the battlefield is ever-changing, I also do not have a full grasp of the Southwest King will really end up according to this." Jing Shao sighed, knowing everything, but also feel that the world is changing, everything will not necessarily go according to the original road, then suddenly some uncertainty.
"Who do you think is the best person to break the Tiger's Tooth Pass?" Mu Hanzhang didn't pick up on his words, but asked the question directly.
"Hao Da Dao!" Jing Shao said without hesitation, this is also one of the reasons why he was in a hurry to find Hao Dazhou, when the broken tiger's tooth is he personally went, because of the victory in the pass fought for months and could not do, it is not easy to break through but was ambushed, had no choice but to take the risk of this army marshal to take people to break the tiger's tooth pass. The tiger's teeth and crane mouth seems steep, in fact, not many troops. But it needs skills, must be a strong martial arts and know how to improvise people can.
Mu Hanzhang nodded slightly, "Just leave this to me, I will be able to persuade him tonight."
When Jing Shao heard the word "tonight", his heart suddenly lingered: "How are you going to persuade him?"
"I have my own way." Mu Hanyang smiled mysteriously, but he was unexpectedly pressed behind him by Jing Shao's pinched wrists, and suddenly his body fell unsteadily into Jing Shao's arms.
"Don't go!" Jing Shao immediately burning with rage, in the middle of the night to let their own Wangfei to persuade Hao Dazhou, how to think how dangerous, their own Wangfei look so good, in case Hao Dazhou take the opportunity to put forward what non-thinking, Junqing in order to not let themselves difficult to make a compromise and then ...... the more I think the more terrible, in short, can never let him go.
Mu Hanzhang stunned for half a day, do not know, until he heard him say what "human face and beast heart" "martial arts" only reacted to what Jing Shao is angry, can not help but be angry and funny: "Where do you think again? "
I really don't understand how Jing Shao could come up with so many things from a single sentence, could it be that he had been thinking too much about tactics lately, and had to look at things many more steps, so much so that he had fallen into some bull's-eye?
The two argued for half a day, and in the end Mu Hanzhang couldn't argue with him, and only agreed to Jing Shao going outside the tent to listen to the wall.
Jing Shao stood outside Hao Da Dao's tent, holding his breath and listening carefully to the movements inside.
"What's the matter with the military master coming so late?" Hao Da Dao said politely.
"Since there is something, I had to come to disturb General." Mu Hanzhang's equally polite voice sounded warm and moist and very pleasing to the ear.
"Ha, the last general is now just an advantageous general appointed by the king, so I can't say that I'm a general." Hao Da Dao sat down and carefully wiped his Mixed Sword.
"With Brother Hao's talent, it's only a matter of time before he's appointed as a general," Mu Hanzhang said with a light smile, "It's just that now that Brother Hao was appointed as a benefit general just after he joined the military camp, although most of the generals know of the general's ability, without military service, it's ultimately difficult to convince the public."
That day Hao big knife just into the camp and Zhao Meng match, although the experience of the enemy is not as good as killing the enemy for many years of general Zhao, but because of the superior martial arts was not the slightest inferior, and finally by virtue of the family heirloom of the mixed blade, a move to stop the iron whip Zhao Meng, Jing Shao was able to make an exception to the direct sealing of his benefit generals.
"This Hao Mou naturally know, the military division has something to say may as well speak directly." Hao Da Dao to this military division of the impression is not bad, intellect and mind are superior, in the village under the mountain at a glance to persuade him to join the army in his family that the key to the Hedong lion, and in a few words to her to say.
Jing Shao stood outside the tent counting the hours, two people talking not loud, some words can not really hear, then some anxious.
"Your Highness, why are you here?" When the right guard saw Jing Shao, he excitedly went up and patted him, "Your Highness also came to discuss sword techniques with Big Brother Hao?"
Explore my ass! Jing Shao only felt the veins on his forehead jumping straight up, squeezing his fists to a crunch, it was at this time, Mu Huanzhang lifted the curtain and came out, seeing Jing Shao's iron-clad face, he tried to suppress the corner of his mouth that wanted to curve upwards, and said to the Right Guard: "It's getting late, General Hao will still have to lead the troops in the morning, so the Right Guard will also go to bed early."
For can not explore the sword, the right guard is quite disappointed, then thought of the left guard will make the sword, similar to the sword, so again excitedly ran to the left guard tent, anyway, they two guards are guarding the camp do not have to go to war, less sleep a moment does not matter.
